AI.translation: rl_rob 是一个用于教授强化学习的开源 Python 库。它实现了现代课程的发展脉络，从表格型时间差分学习、线性函数近似到深度基于价值和策略梯度的方法，每个算法都从第一原理编写，使其更新规则在几行代码中即可见。所有智能体共享一个接口，因此学习者可以直接在各个阶段之间比较方法，并追踪从时间差分误差到权重变化的深度强化学习更新过程。该库支持教学和评估，学生可以实现、修改和解释更新规则，而不仅仅是编写可运行的代码。
AI.summary: rl_rob 是一个专为强化学习教学设计的开源 Python 库，它从零实现了一系列从表格型方法到深度策略梯度的算法，具有高度透明的代码和统一的接口，旨在帮助学生深入理解并修改底层的更新规则。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 教学库, Python, 深度强化学习, 表格方法
AI.comments: 该论文介绍了一个名为 rl_rob 的开源 Python 库，专门用于强化学习教学。其最大创新在于从零开始实现算法，代码透明且易于阅读，覆盖了从表格型方法到深度策略梯度的完整课程体系，非常适合教育和学生深入理解算法底层更新规则。

title: Erase the Injected Region: Multimodal Prompt-Injection Defense with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal indirect prompt injection embeds malicious instructions in external media that also contains information needed for the user's task. Existing defenses can block the attack yet impair the model's use of that information, leaving a gap between attack defense and task preservation. We propose ERASE, an on-policy self-distillation method that constructs its reference by erasing the injected region in place. Modality-appropriate blank content replaces the injection while the surrounding media is preserved. A student reading attacked media learns from a frozen base model reading the erased view through full-distribution token-level feedback on its own rollouts. Across image, audio, and video on two model sizes, ERASE records near-zero observed attack success on the evaluated benchmark while retaining task utility close to the undefended clean-input level. On 3B audio, ERASE reaches 60.1% attacked-input accuracy compared with ARGUS's 33.1%, within 0.5 points of the undefended clean-input level. Experiments show that ERASE reduces injection dependence from 6.26 to 0.0095 on 3B audio while staying close to the base model on the erased input. Out-of-domain accuracy also stays near the base level. Our code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.title_translation: 擦除注入区域：基于同策略自蒸馏的多模态提示词注入防御
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ERASE的多模态提示词注入防御方法，通过擦除注入区域的同策略自蒸馏机制，在防御攻击的同时完美保留了任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态间接提示词注入防御虽然能够阻止攻击，但会损害模型对任务所需信息的利用，在攻击防御和任务保留之间存在差距。
AI.method: 提出名为ERASE的同策略自蒸馏方法，通过原位擦除注入区域（用模态适配的空白内容替换注入并保留周围媒体），让读取受攻击媒体的学生模型通过其自身的rollouts上的全分布词元级反馈，向读取擦除后视图的冻结基础模型学习。
AI.result: 在图像、音频和视频等多种模态及两种模型规模下，ERASE实现了接近零的攻击成功率，同时将任务实用性保持在接近未防御清洁输入水平的高度；在3B音频上，攻击输入准确率达到60.1%（优于ARGUS的33.1%），且注入依赖度大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: ERASE成功弥补了多模态提示词注入防御中“防御攻击”与“保留任务信息”之间的鸿沟，在多种模态和模型大小上均取得了优异的防御效果和任务性能。
AI.translation: 多模态间接提示词注入将恶意指令嵌入到外部媒体中，而这些媒体同时也包含用户任务所需的信息。现有的防御方法虽然可以阻止攻击，但会损害模型对该信息的利用，从而在攻击防御和任务保留之间留下了差距。我们提出了ERASE，这是一种同策略自蒸馏方法，它通过在原地擦除注入区域来构建其参考。用模态适配的空白内容替换注入，同时保留周围的媒体。阅读受攻击媒体的学生模型通过其自身rollout上的全分布词元级反馈，向阅读擦除视图的冻结基座模型学习。在图像、音频和视频以及两种模型规模下，ERASE在评估基准上记录了接近零的观察到攻击成功率，同时保持了接近未防御清洁输入水平的任务实用性。在3B音频上，ERASE达到了60.1%的受攻击输入准确率（相比之下ARGUS为33.1%），在未防御清洁输入水平的0.5个百分点以内。实验表明，ERASE将3B音频上的注入依赖度从6.26降低到0.0095，同时在擦除输入上保持接近基座模型的水平。域外准确率也保持在基座水平附近。我们的代码将在被接收后公开。
AI.summary: 论文提出了ERASE，一种用于多模态提示词注入防御的同策略自蒸馏方法。通过擦除恶意注入区域并利用冻结基座模型对擦除视图的反馈，该方法在近乎完全消除攻击成功率的同时，高度保留了模型处理正常多模态任务的能力。
AI.keywords: Multimodal Prompt Injection, Self-Distillation, Defense, Task Preservation, Safety
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为ERASE的端到端自蒸馏防御机制，通过擦除注入区域并利用同策略自蒸馏，在有效防御多模态间接提示词注入攻击的同时，极大地保留了模型的任务实用性，解决了以往防御方法中防御与任务性能难以兼顾的痛点。

title: SERIAL-7: Deriving, Realizing, and Preserving Machine-Verifiable Outputs Across Representations
comments: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
summary: Large language models increasingly generate structured outputs consumed by programs and downstream systems, where semantic correctness alone does not guarantee reliable execution. We introduce SERIAL-7, a Korean-English benchmark built around an executable verification framework for machine-verifiable generation across seven representations. Using 177 validated canonical artifacts, SERIAL-7 separates semantic derivation (Derive), constrained artifact generation (Realize), and cross-representation preservation (Preserve). Its 43 atomic representation constraints are paired with executable checks over format, structure, and task-specific semantics, enabling progressively stricter verification from representation compliance to full artifact validity. Across ten models, REALIZE-L3 HSR ranges from 42.0% to 93.9%, while Full Compliance exposes additional artifact-level failures beyond correct final answers and valid representations. These results show that reliable structured generation requires explicit, executable verification of how artifacts are realized and preserved across representations.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding

AI.title_translation: SERIAL-7：跨表征推导、实现与保持机器可验证输出
AI.tldr: SERIAL-7是一个评估大模型生成机器可验证结构化输出的基准，通过可执行验证框架解耦推导、实现与保持过程，全面暴露工件级执行错误。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的结构化输出常直接被程序与下游系统消费，但在这些场景中，仅凭语义正确性并不能保证下游系统的可靠执行。
AI.method: 提出了涵盖韩英双语的SERIAL-7基准测试与可执行验证框架，涵盖七种表征形式。该方法使用177个经过验证的规范工件，将过程拆解为语义推导（Derive）、受限工件生成（Realize）和跨表征保持（Preserve），并设置了43个原子表征约束，配合针对格式、结构及任务特定语义的可执行检查，实现从表征合规到完整工件有效性的逐级严格验证。
AI.result: 在十个模型上的评测显示，REALIZE-L3 HSR表现差异较大（范围为42.0%至93.9%）；“完全合规”（Full Compliance）指标进一步揭示了即使在最终答案正确且表征合规的情况下，依然存在额外的工件级执行失败。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的结构化输出生成不仅要求最终答案正确，还需要通过显式的可执行验证机制，对工件在跨表征下的实现与保持过程进行严格检验。
AI.translation: 大语言模型越来越多地生成供程序和下游系统消费的结构化输出，而在这些场景中，仅凭语义正确性并不能保证可靠执行。我们提出了 SERIAL-7，这是一个基于可执行验证框架构建的韩英双语基准，用于评估跨七种表征形式的机器可验证生成能力。基于177个经过验证的规范工件，SERIAL-7 将语义推导（Derive）、受限工件生成（Realize）和跨表征保持（Preserve）进行了解耦分离。其包含的43个原子表征约束与针对格式、结构及任务特定语义的可执行检查相结合，实现了从表征合规到完整工件有效性的渐进式更严格验证。在十个模型上的实验中，REALIZE-L3 HSR 的得分范围在 42.0% 到 93.9% 之间，而“完全合规”（Full Compliance）则揭示了在最终答案正确且表征有效之外存在的额外工件级失败。这些结果表明，可靠的结构化生成需要对工件在不同表征间的实现与保持方式进行显式的可执行验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SERIAL-7基准与可执行验证框架，将结构化输出生成解耦为推导、实现和保持三个维度，通过43项覆盖格式与结构的原子可执行约束，评估大语言模型在跨七种表征形式下的机器可验证生成可靠性。
AI.keywords: 结构化输出, 大语言模型, 机器可验证生成, 基准测试, 可执行验证
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将结构化输出的生成过程解耦为语义推导、约束实现和跨表征保持三个阶段，并设计了细粒度的可执行约束检查，弥补了仅关注语义正确性而忽视机器可靠执行的评估空白。其主要局限在于基准目前仅基于177个规范工件且主要覆盖韩英双语。

title: STAR-FER: Adaptive Selective Restoration for Edge-Based Low-Resolution Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Variable interaction distances continuously degrade facial resolution in edge-based affective interaction, making low-resolution facial expression recognition (FER) difficult under limited computation. Full-face image or feature restoration incurs substantial overhead, whereas lightweight recognition pipelines may miss local cues that remain discriminative after degradation. We propose STAR-FER, a scale-and-task-adaptive selective restoration framework that balances recognition performance and resource constraints. A lightweight image-scale conditioned Gate jointly predicts a pixel-wise spatial ranking and a continuous restoration budget, then applies exact-support projection to obtain an input-dependent free-form mask. The mask-conditioned restorer retains complete facial context while concentrating sparse restoration and residual insertion on the selected support. Across seven degradation scales from x2 to x8 on the complete RAF-DB test set, STAR-FER achieves 80.92% mean accuracy and 71.64% Macro-F1, improving the low-resolution ResNet-18 baseline by 2.25 and 2.71 percentage points, respectively. It surpasses SR-FER by 1.04 accuracy points while requiring 8.84 GFLOPs, a 54.29% reduction, with 28.01% mean mask coverage, and maintains effective recognition at unseen non-integer scales. These results show that spatial-ranking and continuous-budget driven selective restoration reduces spatial modification and computation while maintaining low-resolution FER performance, offering an efficient path to resource-constrained affective interaction.

AI.title_translation: STAR-FER：面向边缘端低分辨率面部表情识别的自适应选择性修复
AI.tldr: STAR-FER通过动态预测掩码对低分辨率人脸的关键判别区域进行选择性稀疏修复，在计算量大幅减少54%的同时显著提升了表情识别精度。
AI.motivation: 在基于边缘设备的情感交互中，交互距离的变化会导致面部图像分辨率动态退化，且在受限计算资源下难以处理；全脸图像或特征修复开销过大，而传统的轻量级识别方案又易丢失退化后仍具判别力的局部线索。
AI.method: 提出了STAR-FER框架，包含一个轻量级图像尺度条件门控（Gate）和一个基于掩码的恢复器。门控联合预测像素级空间排序和连续修复预算，并通过精确支撑投影生成依赖输入的自由形式掩码；恢复器在保留完整面部上下文的同时，仅在选定的支撑区域集中进行稀疏修复与残差插入。
AI.result: 在RAF-DB测试集（涵盖x2到x8共7个退化尺度）上，STAR-FER取得80.92%的平均准确率和71.64%的Macro-F1，相比低分辨率ResNet-18基线分别提升2.25和2.71个百分点；比SR-FER准确率高1.04个百分点，同时计算量降至8.84 GFLOPs（减少54.29%），平均掩码覆盖率仅为28.01%，并在未见过的非整数尺度下保持有效识别。
AI.conclusion: 基于空间排序和连续预算驱动的选择性修复机制，在维持低分辨率表情识别高性能的同时显著减少了空间修改与计算量，为资源受限场景下的情感交互提供了一条高效路径。
AI.translation: 在基于边缘设备的情感交互中，变化的交互距离会持续降低面部分辨率，导致在有限计算资源下难以进行低分辨率面部表情识别（FER）。全脸图像或特征修复会带来巨大的开销，而轻量级识别流水线可能会丢失退化后仍然具有判别力的局部线索。我们提出了STAR-FER，这是一种尺度与任务自适应的选择性修复框架，旨在平衡识别性能与资源约束。该框架利用一个轻量级的图像尺度条件门控（Gate），联合预测像素级空间排序和连续修复预算，随后应用精确支撑投影获取依赖输入的自由形态掩码。掩码条件恢复器在保留完整面部上下文的同时，将稀疏修复与残差插入集中在选定的支撑区域上。在完整的RAF-DB测试集上，涵盖从x2到x8共七个退化尺度，STAR-FER达到了80.92%的平均准确率和71.64%的Macro-F1，相比低分辨率ResNet-18基线分别提升了2.25和2.71个百分点。它在准确率上超越SR-FER达1.04个百分点，同时仅需8.84 GFLOPs（降低了54.29%），平均掩码覆盖率为28.01%，并在未见过的非整数尺度下保持了有效的识别能力。这些结果表明，由空间排序和连续预算驱动的选择性修复在保持低分辨率FER性能的同时减少了空间修改和计算量，为资源受限的情感交互提供了一条高效途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向边缘端低分辨率面部表情识别的自适应选择性修复框架STAR-FER。通过轻量门控自适应预测关键区域掩码并分配修复预算，模型能够在保留全局上下文的同时对关键判别区域进行局部稀疏修复。实验证明，该方法在显著降低计算量（减少54.29% GFLOPs）的同时超越了现有全图修复基线，并在多种退化尺度下均取得了优异的识别性能。
AI.keywords: 低分辨率面部表情识别, 自适应选择性修复, 边缘计算, 连续预算, 情感交互
AI.comments: 该论文针对边缘计算场景下低分辨率表情识别（FER）的痛点，创新性地提出了基于空间排序与连续预算驱动的自适应选择性修复机制，避免了全图超分辨率的高昂计算代价，同时保留了局部关键判别特征。其不仅大幅降低了FLOPs（减少54.29%），而且在跨尺度及非整数未知尺度下表现出良好的泛化性，对资源受限的边缘情感交互系统具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Migrating a Legacy Scientific Application with an AI Coding Agent: NICAM from Fortran to Kokkos
summary: Migrating from Fortran to C++/Kokkos broadens access to hardware accelerators through backends such as CUDA and HIP while offering greater flexibility in software design. However, legacy Fortran applications often have large codebases, making manual porting time-consuming and costly. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and AI coding agents have made large-scale code migration increasingly feasible. In this study, we ported NICAM (Nonhydrostatic ICosahedral Atmospheric Model), a legacy Fortran climate model accelerated with OpenACC, to C++/Kokkos with the assistance of Claude Code. The agent translated the code directly from Fortran to C++/Kokkos under human review. Approximately 140,000 lines of Fortran were analyzed and ported into 35,000 lines of C++/Kokkos, covering the dynamical core and seven physics packages. A 100-member ensemble comparison with the original Fortran model showed that the port is statistically consistent with the original. Performance was evaluated on Miyabi-G, an NVIDIA GH200 cluster, and Sirius, an AMD MI300A cluster. Compared with the Fortran/OpenACC baseline on GH200, the port achieved application speedups of $1.71\times$ on GH200 and $1.54\times$ on MI300A. The CUDA build achieved a GPU kernel-time speedup of $1.38\times$ on GH200. After normalization by peak memory bandwidth, the HIP build on MI300A achieved $0.96\times$ the kernel performance of the Fortran/OpenACC baseline.

AI.title_translation: 使用AI编码助手迁移传统科学计算应用：将NICAM从Fortran迁移至Kokkos
AI.tldr: 本研究利用AI编码助手成功将14万行的传统Fortran气候模型NICAM迁移至C++/Kokkos，实现了显著的性能提升和统计正确性。
AI.motivation: 从Fortran迁移到C++/Kokkos可以通过CUDA和HIP等后端支持扩展对硬件加速器的访问，并提供更高软件设计灵活性，但手动移植庞大的遗留代码库耗时长且成本高，因此需要探索利用大语言模型和AI编码助手来实现大规模代码迁移的可行性。
AI.method: 在人类审核的辅助下，使用AI编码助手（Claude Code）将大型传统Fortran气候模型（NICAM）直接翻译并重构为C++/Kokkos代码，并在NVIDIA GH200和AMD MI300A集群上对迁移后的代码进行性能评估和100成员集成比较。
AI.result: 成功将约14万行Fortran代码移植为3.5万行C++/Kokkos代码，涵盖动力核心和七个物理包；100成员集成比较显示移植版与原版统计一致；在GH200上实现1.71倍的应用加速，在MI300A上实现1.54倍的应用加速。
AI.conclusion: 利用AI编码助手能够高效、低成本地完成超大规模传统科学计算应用的代码迁移，并且生成的C++/Kokkos代码在多个硬件平台上展现出优异的性能和正确性。
AI.translation: 从Fortran迁移到C++/Kokkos通过CUDA和HIP等后端扩展了对硬件加速器的访问，同时在软件设计上提供了更大的灵活性。然而，传统的Fortran应用程序通常拥有庞大的代码库，导致手动移植既耗时又昂贵。大语言模型（LLM）和AI编码最近的进展使得大规模代码迁移越来越可行。在这项研究中，我们在Claude Code的协助下，将使用OpenACC加速的传统Fortran气候模型NICAM（非静力学二十面体大气模型）移植到了C++/Kokkos。在人类的审查下，AI助手直接将代码从Fortran翻译成了C++/Kokkos。大约14万行的Fortran代码被分析并移植为3.5万行的C++/Kokkos代码，涵盖了动力核心和七个物理包。与原Fortran模型的100成员集成比较表明，移植版本与原模型在统计上是一致的。性能评估在NVIDIA GH200集群Miyabi-G和AMD MI300A集群Sirius上进行。与GH200上的Fortran/OpenACC基线相比，移植版在GH200上实现了1.71倍的应用加速，在MI300A上实现了1.54倍的应用加速。CUDA版本在GH200上实现了1.38倍的GPU内核时间加速。在按峰值内存带宽归一化后，MI300A上的HIP版本达到了Fortran/OpenACC基线内核性能的0.96倍。
AI.summary: 本研究利用AI编码助手成功将大型传统Fortran气候模型NICAM迁移至C++/Kokkos，重构了约14万行代码。结果表明，AI辅助迁移不仅保持了计算结果的统计一致性，还在NVIDIA和AMD加速器集群上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: AI 编码助手, 代码迁移, Fortran, Kokkos, 气候模型
AI.comments: 该论文展示了利用AI编码助手（如Claude Code）将大型传统科学计算Fortran代码库（14万行）成功迁移至现代C++/Kokkos框架的巨大潜力，不仅大幅减少了人工移植的时间成本，而且在多个异构加速器上实现了性能提升和统计一致性，为科学计算现代化开辟了新途径。

title: GenDSR: Transferring Representations from Video Generation Models for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial reasoning is essential for connecting visual intelligence to thephysical world, yet remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), which must preserve scene state while tracking how spatial relations evolve over time. Meanwhile, video generation models (VGMs), trained to synthesize temporally coherent world dynamics, offer a rich source of spatiotemporal representations. We present GenDSR, a framework that transfers intermediate representations from VGM into VLM for dynamic spatial reasoning. Rather than treating a VGM feature as a monolithic prior, GenDSR constructs two complementary branches: a raw branch preserving holistic generative context and a delta branch emphasizing temporal variation. Task-conditioned tokenwise gates then fuse both signals and inject the result into the native visual representation. On DSR-Bench, GenDSR achieves 67.2%, surpassing the previous best result and establishing a new state of the art.

AI.title_translation: GenDSR：从视频生成模型迁移表征以实现动态空间推理
AI.tldr: 提出GenDSR框架，通过迁移视频生成模型的时空表征来增强视觉语言模型的动态空间推理能力，在DSR-Bench上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 动态空间推理对连接视觉智能与物理世界至关重要，但对视觉语言模型而言极具挑战，而训练用于合成时间相干世界动态的视频生成模型蕴含丰富的时空表征，可用于解决该难题。
AI.method: 提出了GenDSR框架，构建了保留整体生成上下文的原始分支和强调时间变化的差分分支，并通过任务条件化的逐标记门控机制将两者融合后注入视觉语言模型的原生视觉表征中。
AI.result: 在DSR-Bench上达到了67.2%的准确率，超越了以往的最佳结果并确立了新的技术最高水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: GenDSR通过有效迁移视频生成模型的时空表征，显著提升了视觉语言模型的动态空间推理能力，在DSR-Bench上创造了新的最优记录。
AI.translation: 动态空间推理对于将视觉智能连接到物理世界至关重要，但对于视觉语言模型（VLM）来说仍然具有挑战性，VLM必须在跟踪空间关系随时间演变的同时保持场景状态。同时，经过训练以合成时间相干世界动态的视频模型（VGM）提供了丰富的时空表征来源。我们提出了GenDSR，一个将VGM的中间表征迁移到VLM中用于动态空间推理的框架。GenDSR没有将VGM特征视为单一先验，而是构建了两个互补分支：一个保留整体生成上下文的原始分支和一个强调时间变化的差分分支。然后，任务条件化的逐标记门控融合这两种信号，并将结果注入原生视觉表征中。在DSR-Bench上，GenDSR达到了67.2%的准确率，超过了以往的最佳结果并确立了新的技术水平。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GenDSR框架，通过将视频生成模型中的中间时空表征迁移到视觉语言模型中来解决动态空间推理难题。该框架通过双分支结构捕捉全局上下文与时间变化，并利用门控机制进行特征融合，显著提升了模型在DSR-Bench上的性能。
AI.keywords: 动态空间推理, 视频生成模型, 视觉语言模型, 表征迁移, 空间时序表征
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将视频生成模型的时空表征迁移到视觉语言模型中，通过原始分支和差分分支捕捉整体生成上下文与时间变化，在动态空间推理任务上取得了SOTA效果，为VLM增强物理世界理解提供了一条新途径。

title: MILES-Rec: Uncovering Implicit Intents from Mobility Behaviors for Cross-Domain POI Recommendation
summary: Map applications bridge everyday mobility with local services, creating opportunities to recommend places by uncovering users' implicit intents. However, utility-driven map interactions provide only indirect and incomplete evidence of consumption demands, making it challenging to infer personalized service needs from observed behaviors. We propose MILES-Rec, a cross-domain POI recommendation framework that infers latent service intents from heterogeneous map behaviors and expresses them as prioritized natural language queries. It first learns from progressive reasoning demonstrations that synthesize user profiles and map histories for situation understanding, intent expansion, and query prioritization. We then introduce intent-aligned group relative policy optimization, using subsequent user interactions to reward query relevance and ranked service coverage while penalizing redundancy and excessive response length. A two-level credit assignment mechanism integrates shared list-level advantages with query-specific advantages, coordinating individual query quality with the complementary coverage of the complete query list. We further construct MILES-Bench from real user interaction logs on a large-scale mapping platform, supporting training and evaluation across diverse services under rich and sparse behavioral histories. Extensive experiments against general-purpose LLMs and specialized recommendation baselines demonstrate superior POI retrieval utility and strong service and semantic alignment, with consistent gains from behavioral policy optimization across four backbone scales.

AI.title_translation: MILES-Rec：从移动行为中挖掘隐式意图以进行跨域 POI 推荐
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 MILES-Rec 的跨域 POI 推荐框架，它能从地图移动行为中提取隐式意图并转化为自然语言查询，显著提升了兴趣点推荐的准确度。
AI.motivation: 现有的地图应用交互行为大多是由效用驱动的，仅提供间接且不完整的消费需求证据，因此很难从观察到的移动行为中准确推断出个性化的服务需求。
AI.method: 提出 MILES-Rec 框架，通过渐进式推理示范学习隐式服务意图并表达为自然语言查询；引入意图对齐的群组相对策略优化以及两级信用分配机制来优化查询相关性和服务覆盖率。
AI.result: 在 MILES-Bench 上的广泛实验表明，与通用大语言模型和专用推荐基线相比，MILES-Rec 具有更优的 POI 检索效用、强大的服务与语义对齐能力，且行为策略优化在四个骨干模型规模上均取得了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的 MILES-Rec 框架能够有效从异构地图行为中挖掘隐含意图并转化为自然语言查询，在跨域 POI 推荐任务中表现出优异的检索效用以及语义对齐能力。
AI.translation: 地图应用程序将日常出行与本地服务连接起来，通过揭示用户的隐含意图创造了推荐地点的机会。然而，效用驱动的地图交互仅提供消费需求的间接和不完整证据，使得从观察到的行为中推断个性化服务需求具有挑战性。我们提出了 MILES-Rec，这是一个跨域 POI 推荐框架，它从异构地图行为中推断潜在的服务意图，并将其表示为优先级的自然语言查询。它首先从渐进式推理演示中学习，这些演示综合了用户画像和地图历史，用于情境理解、意图扩展和查询优先级排序。然后，我们引入了意图对齐的群组相对策略优化，使用后续的用户交互来奖励查询相关性和排名的服务覆盖率，同时惩罚冗余和过长的响应长度。两级信用分配机制将共享的列表级优势与查询特定优势相结合，协调单个查询质量与完整查询列表的互补覆盖。我们进一步从大型地图平台上真实的用户交互日志中构建了 MILES-Bench，支持在丰富和稀疏的行为历史下跨多样化服务的训练和评估。针对通用大语言模型和专用推荐基线的广泛实验证明了其卓越的 POI 检索效用以及强劲的服务和语义对齐能力，并且行为策略优化在四个骨干模型规模上带来了持续的性能提升。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 MILES-Rec，一个基于跨域的兴趣点（POI）推荐框架，它通过挖掘异构地图行为中的隐式意图并将其转化为自然语言查询来提升推荐效果，同时构建了新基准数据集 MILES-Bench 验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 兴趣点推荐, 跨域推荐, 移动行为, 自然语言查询, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将地图应用中的隐式移动行为转化为自然语言查询，并结合强化学习（意图对齐的群组相对策略优化）和两级信用分配机制，有效提升了跨域兴趣点（POI）推荐的准确性和可解释性。同时，作者构建了全新的基准数据集 MILES-Bench，验证了方法在不同规模骨干模型下的泛化能力和优越性。

title: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent multimodal foundation models exhibit strong perception, reasoning, and in-context learning capabilities, but translating these capabilities into physical action remains challenging. Through real-world experiments across diverse manipulation tasks, we find that ChatGPT-6-Astra, a state-of-the-art general-purpose reasoner, can serve as a physically actionable, context-responsive manipulation policy, demonstrating effective fine manipulation and spatial reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce LEXP, a harness for learning from physical experience through context-space adaptation. LEXP combines task-level planning with an experience module that interprets execution evidence, extracts and retains lessons with applicability conditions, and reuses relevant lessons to generate contextual feedback for subsequent actions. Model weights and the action interface remain fixed throughout. Across 12 real-world manipulation tasks, LEXP achieves $23/36$ successful trials (63.9\%), compared with $19/36$ (52.8\%) with memory alone and $2/36$ (5.6\%) for vanilla Astra. On three tasks, bread transfer, sort trash and toiletries, and retrieve drawer, removing planning reduces success from $7/9$ to $4/9$, while removing retained experience reduces it to $3/9$. Execution traces illustrate feedback-guided corrections and cross-episode reuse of an inspection strategy. Execution analyses illustrate how task structure and experience-derived feedback guide task progression, action correction, and experience reuse. These results support context-space adaptation as a practical mechanism for turning physical interaction into reusable guidance for robotic manipulation.

AI.title_translation: 从物理体验中学习：机器人操作的上下文空间适应
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了LEXP框架，通过上下文空间适应机制，让固定权重的多模态大模型能够从真实世界的物理操作经验中学习、规划和自我纠错，显著提升了机器人的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 尽管近期的多模态基础模型展现出强大的感知、推理和上下文学习能力，但将其能力转化为物理动作仍然具有挑战性，需要探索如何让通用推理机有效地作为物理动作和上下文响应的操作策略。
AI.method: 引入了LEXP（Learning from Physical Experience through context-space adaptation），结合了任务级规划与经验模块，该模块能够解释执行证据、提取并保留带有适用条件的教训，并重用相关教训为后续动作生成上下文反馈，且模型权重和动作接口保持不变。
AI.result: 在12个真实世界的操作任务中，LEXP取得了23/36（63.9%）的成功试验次数，优于仅使用记忆的52.8%和纯Astra的5.6%；消融实验表明移除规划或保留的经验均会导致成功率下降。
AI.conclusion: 上下文空间适应（LEXP）被证明是一种将物理交互转化为机器人操作可复用指导的实用机制，能有效提升大模型在真实世界物理操作中的性能。
AI.translation: 近期的多模态基础模型展现出了强大的感知、推理和上下文学习能力，但将这些能力转化为物理动作仍然具有挑战性。通过在各种操作任务中进行真实世界的实验，我们发现最先进的通用推理机ChatGPT-6-Astra可以作为一个具备物理可操作性、上下文响应能力的操作策略，展现出有效的精细操作和空间推理能力。基于这些发现，我们引入了LEXP，这是一个通过上下文空间适应从物理经验中学习的工具。LEXP将任务级规划与经验模块相结合，该经验模块能够解释执行证据、提取并保留带有适用条件的教训，并重用相关教训来为后续动作生成上下文反馈。在此过程中，模型权重和动作接口保持不变。在12个真实世界的操作任务中，LEXP取得了23/36（63.9%）的成功试验次数，而仅使用记忆的方法为19/36（52.8%），纯Astra方法为2/36（5.6%）。在面包转移、垃圾与洗漱用品分类、取回抽屉这三个任务中，移除规划会使成功率从7/9降至4/9，而移除保留的经验则会降至3/9。执行轨迹展示了反馈引导的纠错以及跨剧集的检查策略重用。执行分析说明了任务结构和经验导的反馈如何指导任务进展、动作纠错和经验重用。这些结果支持了上下文空间适应作为一种实用机制，能够将物理交互转化为机器人操作的可复用指导。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了如何利用最先进的推理模型进行机器人操作，并提出了通过上下文空间适应从物理经验中学习的框架（LEXP）。LEXP通过结合任务级规划和经验模块，在保持模型权重不变的前提下，实现了物理交互经验的提取、保留和重用，在多个真实世界操作任务中显著提升了成功率。
AI.keywords: 机器操作, 上下文空间适应, 物理经验学习, 多模态基础模型, 任务规划
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种通过上下文空间适应（LEXP）让多模态大模型从物理经验中学习的新方法，在保持模型权重不变的情况下显著提升了机器人在复杂操作任务中的成功率，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: Transferring Peptide-Target Interaction Patterns to Small Molecules by Joint Guidance for Diffusion and Flow Matching
summary: Generating small molecules to target protein-protein interactions (PPIs) remains one of the most challenging yet high-reward frontiers in drug discovery. Unlike traditional small-molecule drugs that bind to deep, well-defined pockets, PPI interfaces often comprise broad, shallow binding surfaces. A natural strategy is to leverage known peptide-target interactions, as peptide ligands provide rich interface-level constraints. However, a major algorithmic challenge is that rigid atom-level conditioning on peptide structures can over-constrain the generative space and exclude valid small-molecule solutions. To address this challenge, we present PIFT (Peptide InterFace Transfer), a novel framework that transfers peptide-target interaction patterns to small molecules through joint sampling-time guidance of masked discrete diffusion and continuous flow matching. PIFT first maps peptide-target and small-molecule-target interfaces into a shared, target-conditioned interaction space, capturing transferable interface information across molecular modalities. The resulting peptide-derived reference then jointly steers building-block logits and 3D coordinates toward peptide-compatible molecules while preserving a strong adapted molecular prior. Extensive experiments across diverse PPI targets show that the learned representation captures cross-modal interaction compatibility, while peptide guidance improves interface recovery and achieves strong docking performance and favorable molecular properties.

AI.title_translation: 联合扩散和流匹配指导下将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子
AI.tldr: PIFT框架通过联合扩散和流匹配，将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子，以生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的小分子，解决了传统方法过约束的问题。
AI.motivation: 在药物发现中，生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的小分子极具挑战性，因为PPIs界面通常宽泛且浅。利用已知的肽-靶点相互作用是一种策略，但传统的原子级刚性条件会过约束生成空间，排除有效的小分子解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了PIFT（Peptide InterFace Transfer）框架，通过掩蔽离散扩散和连续流匹配的联合采样时指导，将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子。PIFT首先将肽-靶点和小分子-靶点界面映射到共享的、靶点条件化的相互作用空间，然后利用肽衍生的参考联合引导构建块对数和3D坐标，生成与肽兼容的小分子。
AI.result: 学习到的表示捕获了跨模态相互作用兼容性；肽指导改善了界面恢复；实现了强大的对接性能和有利的分子特性。
AI.conclusion: PIFT框架成功地将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子，有效地生成了具有良好性能和特性的PPIs靶向小分子，克服了传统生成方法中的过约束问题。
AI.translation:
**论文题目：** 联合扩散和流匹配指导下将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子

**摘要：** 在药物发现中，生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的小分子仍然是最具挑战性但回报丰厚的领域之一。与结合到深层、明确口袋的传统小分子药物不同，PPIs界面通常包含宽泛、浅层的结合表面。一种自然的策略是利用已知的肽-靶点相互作用，因为肽配体提供了丰富的界面级约束。然而，一个主要的算法挑战是，对肽结构进行刚性的原子级条件限制会过度约束生成空间，并排除有效的小分子解决方案。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了PIFT（Peptide InterFace Transfer），这是一个新颖的框架，通过掩蔽离散扩散和连续流匹配的联合采样时指导，将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子。PIFT首先将肽-靶点和小分子-靶点界面映射到一个共享的、靶点条件化的相互作用空间，捕获跨分子模态的可转移界面信息。由此产生的肽衍生参考然后联合引导构建块对数和3D坐标，生成与肽兼容的分子，同时保留强大的适应性分子先验。对各种PPI靶点的广泛实验表明，学习到的表示捕获了跨模态相互作用兼容性，而肽指导改善了界面恢复，并实现了强大的对接性能和有利的分子特性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PIFT（Peptide InterFace Transfer）框架，旨在通过联合扩散和流匹配的采样时指导，将肽-靶点相互作用模式有效转移到小分子，以生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的小分子。该方法解决了传统原子级约束可能导致生成空间过约束的问题。PIFT通过将不同分子模态的界面映射到共享空间，并利用肽衍生参考来引导小分子生成，实验证明其能捕获跨模态兼容性，改善界面恢复，并展现出优异的对接性能和分子特性。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用, 小分子生成, 肽-靶点相互作用, 扩散模型, 流匹配
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入联合扩散和流匹配的采样时指导，巧妙地解决了将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子生成中的过约束问题。其创新点在于构建了一个共享的相互作用空间，并利用肽信息进行软引导，而不是硬性约束，这对于开发靶向PPIs的新型小分子药物具有重要意义。该方法为药物发现领域提供了一个有前景的新工具。

title: OrionLink: Single Sign-On with Oblivious Identity Brokers
summary: Single Sign-On (SSO) is a federated authentication mechanism that improves user experience by enabling access to multiple services, or Relying Parties (RPs), through a single authentication at an Identity Provider (IdP). To reduce integration complexity, many RPs rely on third-party Identity Brokers (Brokers) that aggregate numerous IdPs into a unified interface, thereby simplifying protocol management and interoperability. However, while brokers ease development, they introduce a fundamental security and privacy risk: sensitive authentication credentials and user behavioral data are exposed to the broker, creating a high-value single point of failure. Existing SSO solutions provide limited protection against these risks. With the goal of achieving broker obliviousness, we address these challenges at their root and present OrionLink, a comprehensive privacy-enhancing SSO pipeline that is compatible with existing brokered SSO architectures and systematically mitigates broker-induced risks without sacrificing usability. OrionLink incorporates two core components: (a) an anonymous pseudonym derivation scheme that generates unlinkable, per-RP identifiers to prevent cross-service user tracking; (b) an anonymous key exchange protocol that establishes end-to-end encrypted channels to protect user data from broker visibility. We further instantiate OrionLink with two new features, preserving broker functionality and deployability. We implemented a prototype of OrionLink within a brokered SSO environment, and experimental evaluation shows that the framework achieves substantial security and privacy improvements with acceptable performance overhead.

AI.title_translation: OrionLink：使用茫然身份代理的单点登录
AI.tldr: OrionLink是一个保护隐私的单点登录（SSO）方案，它通过匿名化技术防止第三方身份代理获取用户的敏感凭据和行为数据，解决了传统 brokered SSO 中的隐私泄露和单点故障问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管第三方身份代理（Brokers）简化了单点登录（SSO）的协议管理和互操作性，但它们会接触到敏感的认证凭据和用户行为数据，从而带来严重的安全和隐私风险（单点故障与跨服务追踪）。现有解决方案保护有限，因此需要实现对代理的“盲化”（broker obliviousness）。
AI.method: 提出了OrionLink隐私增强型SSO流水线，包含两个核心组件：(a) 用于生成不可链接、每个依赖方（RP）专属标识符的匿名假名派生方案；(b) 用于建立端到端加密通道、保护用户数据免受代理窥视的匿名密钥交换协议。并构建了原型系统进行了实验评估。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，OrionLink原型在显著提升安全性和隐私性的同时，仅引入了可接受的性能开销。
AI.conclusion: OrionLink成功实现了在保留现有代理SSO架构功能和部署便利性的同时，消除了第三方代理带来的隐私和安全风险，且性能开销在可接受范围内。
AI.translation: 单点登录（SSO）是一种联合认证机制，它通过在身份提供者（IdP）处进行一次认证，便能访问多个服务（即依赖方，RP），从而改善用户体验。为了降低集成复杂度，许多RP依赖于第三方身份代理（Brokers），这些代理将众多IdP聚合成一个统一的接口，从而简化了协议管理和互操作性。然而，虽然代理简化了开发，但它们引入了一个根本性的安全和隐私风险：敏感的认证凭据和用户行为数据暴露给了代理，从而造成了一个高价值的单点故障。现有的SSO解决方案对这些风险的保护有限。为了实现代理盲化（broker obliviousness），我们从根本上应对这些挑战，并提出了OrionLink——一个全面的隐私增强型SSO流水线，它与现有的代理SSO架构兼容，并在不牺牲可用性的情况下系统地减轻了代理引起的风险。OrionLink包含两个核心组件：（a）匿名假名派生方案，生成不可链接的、按RP划分的标识符，以防止跨服务用户追踪；（b）匿名密钥 exchange协议，建立端到端加密通道以保护用户数据免受代理可见性影响。我们进一步用两个新功能实例化了OrionLink，以保持代理的功能性和可部署性。我们在代理SSO环境中实现了OrionLink的原型，实验评估表明，该框架在具有可接受的性能开销的同时，实现了显著的安全和隐私提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OrionLink，一个旨在解决第三方身份代理单点登录（SSO）中安全与隐私风险的隐私增强型SSO流水线。通过引入匿名假名派生方案和匿名密钥交换协议，OrionLink在保持与现有架构兼容的前提下，防止了跨服务用户追踪并保护了用户数据免受代理可见性影响。
AI.keywords: Single Sign-On, Identity Brokers, Privacy-Enhancing, Anonymous Key Exchange, Pseudonym Derivation
AI.comments: 该论文针对第三方身份代理（Identity Brokers）在单点登录（SSO）中带来的隐私泄露和安全单点故障问题，提出了OrionLink协议，实现了代理对身份和行为数据的“盲化”（Oblivious），在保持现有架构兼容性的同时提升了隐私性。创新点在于通过匿名化假名派生和匿名密钥交换实现了端到端加密与不可链接性，具有较强的实用价值。

title: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
summary: Motion planning in clutter is embodiment-specific: the feasible free space and reachable commands depend on each robot's geometry and dynamics. Existing cross-embodiment policies output normalized commands that disregard these differences, or compensate through per-robot training and distillation. World models can in principle pool cross-embodiment data, yet command-conditioned models bind their latent dynamics to a single action space, while pose-conditioned models omit the mapping from commands to body-specific motion. On flat ground, however, embodiment affects the planner's observations only through the camera ego-motion. This letter proposes Hourglass, an hourglass-shaped architecture that factorizes cross-embodiment motion planning at this interface: a body-agnostic world model and each robot's differentiable ego-dynamics, which map commands to that ego-motion, are coupled only through it. The world model is trained on data pooled across embodiments and camera mounts; each robot's ego-dynamics is a reduced-order template with identified physical parameters. A generalist parameter-conditioned policy is learned once at this junction: each imagined step rolls out the template and then the world model, and imagination training through each robot's template makes the policy body-aware. On seven simulated robots of five locomotion types, the generalist policy outperforms imitation-learning and diffusion-policy baselines on the same world model by 3.8--10.6 percentage points in success rate and matches per-robot specialists without dedicated training, while approaching its parameter-conditioned MPPI teacher within 1.4--2.8 points without an online map. After three minutes of teleoperated driving for identification, the synthetic-data-trained model transfers zero-shot to a real skid-steer robot unseen in training, navigating unseen indoor scenes.

AI.title_translation: 通过将无具身世界模型与可微分自身动力学相结合进行跨具身运动规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Hourglass 架构，通过结合无具身的世界模型和可微分的自身动力学，实现了跨机器人的通用运动规划，并在模拟和真实世界中展现了出色的零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨具身策略通常忽略机器人几何和动力学的差异，或者依赖繁琐的逐机器人训练和蒸馏。为了利用跨具身数据并克服动作空间绑定的限制，本文旨在提出一种能够解耦并适应不同机器人具身的通用运动规划方法。
AI.method: 提出 Hourglass 架构，将与具身无关的世界模型与每个机器人的可微分自身动力学（通过相机自身运动耦合）相结合，并在该交汇点训练一个通用的参数化策略，利用模板和世界模型进行想象训练。
AI.result: 在七种模拟机器人（五种运动类型）上，通用策略的成功率比基线高出 3.8 到 10.6 个百分点，无需专门训练即可媲美专家，且经过三分钟遥操作辨识后可零样本迁移至未见过的真实四轮差速机器人。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了跨具身机器人在复杂环境中的高效运动规划，展现了出色的泛化能力和零样本真实世界迁移能力。
AI.translation: 杂乱环境中的运动规划是特定于具身的：可行的自由空间和可达到的指令取决于每个机器人的几何形状和动力学。现有的跨具身策略输出忽略这些差异的归一化指令，或通过每个机器人的训练和蒸馏来进行补偿。世界模型原则上可以汇集跨具身数据，然而指令条件模型将它们的潜在动力学绑定到单一动作空间，而姿态条件模型则省略了从指令到具身特定运动的映射。然而，在平坦地面上，具身仅通过相机自身运动影响规划器的观测。这封信提出了 Hourglass，一种沙漏形架构，它在这个接口处分解了跨具身运动规划：一个与具身无关的世界模型和每个机器人的可微分自身动力学（将指令映射到该自身运动），仅通过它进行耦合。世界模型在跨具身和相机安装的数据上进行训练；每个机器人的自身动力学是一个具有已识别物理参数的降阶模板。一个通用的参数条件策略在这个交汇点被学习一次：每个想象的步骤都会展开模板然后是世界模型，通过每个机器人的模板进行想象训练使得该策略具有具身意识。在五种运动类型的七个模拟机器人上，通用策略在相同世界模型上的成功率比模仿学习和扩散策略基线高出 3.8-10.6 个百分点，在无需专门训练的情况下匹配了每个机器人的专家，同时在没有在线地图的情况下接近其参数条件的 MPPI 教师 1.4-2.8 个点。经过三分钟的遥操作驾驶进行识别后，在合成数据上训练的模型零样本迁移到一个在训练中未见过的真实滑移转向机器人，在未见过的室内场景中进行导航。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Hourglass 架构，用于解决复杂环境下的跨具身运动规划问题。通过将与具身无关的世界模型与机器人的可微分自身动力学在相机自身运动接口处耦合，该方法训练了一个通用的参数化策略，在模拟和真实机器人实验中均展现出优异的性能和零样本泛化能力。
AI.keywords: Cross-Embodiment, Motion Planning, World Model, Differentiable Ego-Dynamics, Robotics
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的跨具身运动规划方法 Hourglass，巧妙地将与具身无关的世界模型与可微分的自身动力学（ego-dynamics）通过相机自身运动（ego-motion）进行解耦和耦合。这一设计使得单一通用策略能够零样本迁移到多种不同类型的机器人甚至真实世界上，具有极高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: StrictPRMBench: A Replayable Evaluation Benchmark for Auditing Fixed-Score PRM Aggregation
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) score reasoning steps, but best-of-N selection also requires a rule that aggregates those scores. We study that rule as a separate evaluation object. StrictPRMBench fixes mathematical reasoning pools, scorer evidence, and the source trace of a deletion intervention, so that different reducers face the same recorded selection problem. Across seven scoring checkpoints and two benchmarks, the stored N=32 outcomes give higher deletion-induced selection instability for product than geometric mean (GM) in all 14 cells. The equal-cell difference is +0.0965; a shared-problem bootstrap, conditional on these checkpoints and frozen pools, gives a 95% interval of [0.0846,0.1086]. A pre-injection-defined sensitivity excludes replacement slots that are either reducer's clean winner and retains 4,459 of 4,622 cell-problem records. The retained difference is +0.0986 [0.0875,0.1098]. Effects are heterogeneous: the two Qwen cells have positive percentile-bootstrap intervals on retained support but two-sided exact paired p-values of 0.0625 and 0.0703. Clean-pool Qwen accuracy does not detect a product advantage, but this is not an equivalence result. We provide versioned outcome records, CPU reanalysis, and an explicit evidence-availability contract. The contribution is a diagnostic evaluation protocol and a reproducible audit of recorded selector behavior, not a new PRM, a universally optimal reducer, or evidence of deployment-wide harm. Raw-score replay and outcome-record reanalysis are distinguished: missing primary edited-score vectors limit independent evaluation of new reducers under the same stress.

AI.title_translation: 严格PRM基准：用于审计固定分数PRM聚合的可重现评估基准
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了StrictPRMBench，一个用于评估固定分数过程奖励模型（PRM）聚合规则的基准。研究发现，在相同的条件下，乘积聚合比几何平均聚合导致更高的选择不稳定性，并提供了一个可重现的评估协议和对选择器行为的审计。
AI.motivation: 研究者旨在将PRM评分的聚合规则作为一个单独的评估对象，以审计固定分数PRM聚合的行为，并发现不同聚合规则在相同条件下可能导致不同的结果。
AI.method: 构建了StrictPRMBench基准，固定了数学推理池、评分者证据和删除干预的源跟踪。在七个评分检查点和两个基准上，对32个结果进行了分析，比较了乘积聚合和几何平均聚合在选择不稳定性上的差异。
AI.result: 在所有14种情况下，乘积聚合比几何平均聚合导致更高的选择不稳定性，差异为+0.0965。经过过滤后，差异为+0.0986。研究还发现，不同模型（如Qwen）对聚合规则的反应存在异质性，并且在某些情况下，即使没有检测到产品优势，也不能得出等价的结论。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一个诊断性评估协议和可重现的审计，用于评估选择器行为，而不是开发新的PRM或最优聚合器。研究强调了原始分数回放和结果记录重新分析的区别，并指出了独立评估新选择器所面临的限制。
AI.translation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）对推理步骤进行评分，但“N选最佳”的选择还需要一个聚合这些分数的规则。我们将该规则作为一个单独的评估对象进行研究。StrictPRMBench固定了数学推理池、评分者证据和删除干预的源跟踪，以便不同的缩减器面对相同的记录选择问题。在七个评分检查点和两个基准上，存储的N=32结果显示，与几何平均（GM）相比，乘积在所有14个单元格中产生了更高的删除诱导选择不稳定性。单元格间的差异为+0.0965；条件化于这些检查点和固定的池，一个共享问题的引导给出了[0.0846, 0.1086]的95%区间。预先定义的敏感性排除了缩减器的干净获胜者所在的替换槽，并保留了4,459个（共4,622个）单元格-问题记录。保留的差异为+0.0986 [0.0875, 0.1098]。效应是异质的：两个Qwen单元格在保留的支持上具有正的百分位数引导区间，但双侧精确配对p值为0.0625和0.0703。干净池Qwen准确性未检测到产品优势，但这并非等价结果。我们提供了版本化的结果记录、CPU再分析和明确的证据可用性契约。贡献是诊断性评估协议和对记录的选择器行为的可重现审计，而不是新的PRM、普遍最优的缩减器或部署范围损害的证据。原始分数回放和结果记录重新分析是区分的：缺失的主要编辑分数向量限制了在相同压力下对新缩减器的独立评估。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了StrictPRMBench，一个用于评估固定分数过程奖励模型（PRM）聚合规则的可重现基准。通过固定推理池和干预，研究发现乘积聚合比几何平均聚合在面对删除干预时导致更高的选择不稳定性。该研究提供了一个诊断性评估协议和可重现的审计，用于分析选择器行为，并强调了结果记录在独立评估中的重要性。
AI.keywords: 过程奖励模型, 聚合规则, 评估基准, 选择不稳定性, 可重现性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的评估基准StrictPRMBench，专注于PRM评分聚合规则，这是一个通常被忽视但至关重要的方面。研究结果表明，不同的聚合规则可能对模型行为产生显著影响，尤其是在面对对抗性干预时。然而，该研究也指出了独立评估新缩减器所面临的挑战，即缺乏可用的原始分数数据。未来的工作可以关注如何更好地共享和利用这些原始数据，以促进更全面的模型审计和开发。

title: HIPC: Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control via Goal-Conditioned Motion Closure
summary: Recent generative models are widely used to provide whole-body motion for humanoid tracking. Current methods combine motion generators with controllers in an open-loop paradigm, which leads to critical issues: tracking errors can accumulate into spatial drift, and the planner cannot adapt to unexpected physical disturbances without feedback from physical execution. However, directly feeding realized states back to the planner in a closed loop can cause discontinuities, resulting in physical jitter and even falls, since such states are out of distribution during training. To bridge this gap, we propose HIPC, a real-time Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control framework that couples a generative model with motion tracking into a unified planning-and-control paradigm. HIPC introduces a goal-conditioned motion planning trained with a canonical motion representation that avoids gimbal-lock singularities under extreme orientations and supports motion generation on diverse geometric and semantic conditions. Then, HIPC adopts two strategies, deviation-decayed recovery and history re-anchoring, to mitigate the out-of-distribution shift caused by realized-state feedback. Finally, HIPC operates a real-time asynchronous planning-and-control system, with latency compensation to reduce temporal mismatch for inference delay. Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness of HIPC under switching and composition of diverse conditions. Results show that HIPC achieves state-of-the-art goal-reaching accuracy among existing methods while simultaneously demonstrating robustness to physical perturbations and the ability to recover from falls.

AI.title_translation: HIPC：通过目标条件运动闭合实现人形机器人迭代规划与控制
AI.tldr: HIPC是一个实时人形机器人迭代规划与控制框架，通过结合生成模型与运动跟踪，解决了现有方法的误差积累、对扰动不适应以及闭环反馈导致的不连续性问题，实现了高精度、鲁棒性和跌倒恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 当前人形机器人运动跟踪方法将生成模型与控制器开环结合，导致跟踪误差累积成空间漂移，规划器无法适应物理扰动。直接闭环反馈又会因状态分布外而引起不连续性、物理抖动甚至跌倒。
AI.method: HIPC提出一个实时人形机器人迭代规划与控制框架，将生成模型与运动跟踪耦合为统一的规划-控制范式。它引入了目标条件运动规划，使用规范运动表示避免万向节锁死。通过偏差衰减恢复和历史重新锚定两种策略，减轻实际状态反馈引起的分布外偏移。此外，HIPC采用实时异步规划-控制系统，并进行延迟补偿。
AI.result: HIPC在多样条件切换和组合下有效。实验表明，HIPC在现有方法中实现了最先进的目标达成精度，同时展示了对物理扰动的鲁棒性以及从跌倒中恢复的能力。
AI.conclusion: HIPC通过其迭代规划和控制框架，成功解决了人形机器人运动控制中的关键问题，实现了高精度、鲁棒性和恢复能力。
AI.translation: 最近的生成模型被广泛用于提供人形机器人跟踪的全身运动。当前方法将运动生成器与控制器以开环范式结合，这导致了关键问题：跟踪误差会累积成空间漂移，并且规划器在没有物理执行反馈的情况下无法适应意外的物理扰动。然而，在闭环中直接将实际状态反馈给规划器会导致不连续性，从而引起物理抖动甚至跌倒，因为这些状态在训练时是分布外的。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了HIPC，一个实时的人形机器人迭代规划与控制框架，它将生成模型与运动跟踪耦合到一个统一的规划-控制范式中。HIPC引入了目标条件运动规划，该规划通过规范运动表示进行训练，避免了极端姿态下的万向节锁死奇异性，并支持在多样化的几何和语义条件下生成运动。然后，HIPC采用两种策略，即偏差衰减恢复和历史重新锚定，以减轻由实际状态反馈引起的分布外偏移。最后，HIPC运行一个实时异步规划-控制系统，并通过延迟补偿来减少推理延迟造成的时间不匹配。大量的实验证实了HIPC在多样条件切换和组合下的有效性。结果表明，HIPC在现有方法中实现了最先进的目标达成精度，同时展示了对物理扰动的鲁棒性以及从跌倒中恢复的能力。
AI.summary: HIPC是一个实时人形机器人迭代规划与控制框架，旨在解决现有生成模型在人形机器人运动跟踪中存在的误差累积、对扰动不适应以及闭环反馈导致不连续性的问题。它通过引入目标条件运动规划、规范运动表示、偏差衰减恢复和历史重新锚定等策略，将生成模型与运动跟踪统一到规划-控制范式中。实验证明，HIPC在目标达成精度上达到SOTA，并具备对物理扰动的鲁棒性和从跌倒中恢复的能力。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 迭代规划与控制, 目标条件运动, 运动生成, 实时控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的闭环规划与控制框架HIPC，有效解决了人形机器人运动生成中常见的误差累积和对物理扰动适应性差的问题。其核心创新在于通过目标条件运动规划和特定的反馈处理策略（偏差衰减恢复、历史重新锚定）来弥合开环与闭环之间的差距，同时避免了直接闭环反馈带来的不连续性问题。规范运动表示也提高了系统在极端条件下的鲁棒性。这是一个重要的进步，对于实现更自然、更鲁棒的人形机器人运动控制具有重要意义。

title: Pix2Evidence: A Multimodal RAG System for Text and Visual Evidence
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over visually rich documents must find both relevant content and the evidence that supports an answer. Screenshot retrieval preserves images and page structure, but written facts within screenshots also need to be searchable. Moreover, topical relevance alone does not identify which retrieved tile contains evidence for the answer. We introduce Pix2Evidence, a multimodal RAG system that encodes each screenshot tile together with its available transcription into a single fused image--text representation, so that layout and readable text are considered jointly during retrieval. To guide evidence selection, a vision-language teacher describes the visible content that supports each training question. We use these descriptions to adapt the retriever, then rerank the retrieved candidates before answer generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Pix2Evidence outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Across five widely-used Wikipedia QA benchmarks, the non-reranked Pix2Evidence leads the main comparison in answer accuracy on four. On MMSearch, it reaches 26.0\%, 4.4 percentage points above PixelRAG. We will release the code and share derived data where licensing and privacy reviews permit.

AI.title_translation: Pix2Evidence：用于文本和视觉证据的多模态 RAG 系统
AI.tldr: Pix2Evidence 是一个新型多模态 RAG 系统，它通过图文融合表征和教师模型引导的证据检索，显著提升了视觉富文档问答的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉富文档检索增强生成（RAG）系统需要在检索相关内容的同时找到支持答案的证据，但纯粹的主题相关性无法识别哪个检索瓦片包含真正的答案证据，且现有的截图检索和文本搜索往往是割裂的。
AI.method: 将每个截图瓦片与其文本转录编码为单一的图文融合表征；利用视觉语言教师模型描述支持每个训练问题的可见内容以适应检索器；并在生成答案前对检索到的候选进行重排。
AI.result: 在五个广泛使用的维基百科 QA 基准测试中，未经重排的 Pix2Evidence 在四个基准测试的答案准确率上处于领先地位；在 MMSearch 上达到了 26.0%，比 PixelRAG 高出 4.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Pix2Evidence 通过将图文融合表征与视觉语言教师模型引导的检索重排相结合，显著提升了多模态 RAG 系统在富文本视觉文档问答中的表现。
AI.translation: 在视觉丰富的文档上进行检索增强生成（RAG）时，必须同时找到相关内容和支持答案的证据。截图检索保留了图像和页面结构，但截图中的书面事实也需要是可搜索的。此外，仅靠主题相关性并不能识别出哪个检索到的图块包含答案的证据。我们介绍了 Pix2Evidence，这是一个多模态 RAG 系统，它将每个截图图块及其可用的转录文本编码为单一的融合图像-文本表征，以便在检索过程中共同考虑布局和可读文本。为了指导证据选择，视觉语言教师模型描述了支持每个训练问题的可见内容。我们使用这些描述来调整检索器，然后在生成答案之前对检索到的候选进行重新排序。大量的实验表明，Pix2Evidence 优于最先进的方法。在五个广泛使用的维基百科 QA 基准测试中，未经重排的 Pix2Evidence 在其中四个测试的答案准确率上领先于主要对比方法。在 MMSearch 上，它达到了 26.0%，比 PixelRAG 高出 4.4 个百分点。我们将在许可和隐私审查允许的情况下发布代码并共享派生数据。
AI.summary: Pix2Evidence 是一个用于文本和视觉证据的多模态 RAG 系统，它通过将截图瓦片与转录文本进行图文融合表征，并利用视觉语言教师模型来适应检索器和重排候选，从而在富文本视觉文档的问答任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 多模态 RAG, 视觉富文档, 图文融合, 证据检索, 问答系统
AI.comments: Pix2Evidence 创新性地将截图瓦片与文本转录组合为融合的图文表征，并在检索阶段引入视觉语言教师模型指导证据选择，有效结合了布局和文本信息，在多个 QA 基准上取得了当前最优的性能。

title: HandMimicX: Learning Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation via an Object-Centric Policy from Egocentric Videos
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation from human videos remains an open challenge, particularly in the context of transferring a single demonstration into a spatially generalizable robotic skill and maintaining physically plausible human-like interactions. Unlike prior works that emphasize hand-motion imitation, we introduce an object-centric framework for acquiring dexterous skills from egocentric human RGB-D videos. Within our framework, we formulate the reinforcement learning (RL) objective in terms of object motion to decouple the underlying skill from the specific hand trajectory and impose constraints on hand-object interaction states to promote more anatomically natural hand configurations. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate that our method enables efficient learning from human videos and generalizable skill transfer across novel spatial configurations.

AI.title_translation: 手部模仿X：从主视角视频中学习面向对象的策略以实现类似人类的灵巧操作
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为HandMimicX的面向对象的框架，用于从主视角RGB-D视频中学习灵巧操作。该方法通过将强化学习目标与物体运动相关联，并将手部与物体交互状态进行约束，从而实现从单一演示到空间可泛化的机器人技能的转移，并保持物理上合理的人体交互。实验证明该方法能够有效地从人类视频中学习并泛化到新的空间配置。
AI.motivation: 从人类视频中学习灵巧操作是一个开放的挑战，特别是在将单一演示转移到空间可泛化的机器人技能以及保持物理上合理的人体交互方面。以往的研究侧重于模仿手部运动，但忽略了更通用的物体交互。
AI.method: 提出一个面向对象的框架，从主视角人类RGB-D视频中学习灵巧操作。该框架将强化学习（RL）目标表述为物体运动，从而将底层技能与具体的手部轨迹解耦。同时，对物体交互状态施加约束，以促进更符合解剖学的手部配置。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实机器人上的大量实验表明，该方法能够有效地从人类视频中学习，并能泛化到新颖的空间配置。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的面向对象的框架能够有效地从人类视频中学习灵巧操作，实现与具体手部轨迹无关的技能泛化，并保持自然的人体交互。
AI.translation: 学习人类灵巧操作仍然是一个开放的挑战，尤其是在将单一演示转移到空间可泛化的机器人技能以及保持物理上合理的人体交互方面。与以往强调手部运动模仿的工作不同，我们引入了一个面向对象的框架，用于从主视角人类RGB-D视频中学习灵巧技能。在我们的框架中，我们根据物体运动来表述强化学习（RL）目标，以将底层技能与具体的手部轨迹解耦，并对物体交互状态施加约束，以促进更符合解剖学的手部配置。在模拟和真实机器人上的广泛实验证明，我们的方法能够有效地从人类视频中学习，并能泛化到新颖的空间配置。
AI.summary: HandMimicX是一个新颖的面向对象的框架，它利用主视角RGB-D视频来学习人类的灵巧操作。通过将强化学习目标与物体运动相关联，并约束手部与物体的交互状态，该方法能够将单一演示转化为空间上可泛化的机器人技能，同时保持逼真的人体交互。实验结果表明，该方法在模拟和真实机器人上都表现出色。
AI.keywords: 灵巧操作, 面向对象, 主视角视频, 强化学习, 技能泛化
AI.comments: 该研究在灵巧操作学习领域取得了重要进展，通过引入面向对象的框架和解耦手部轨迹的方法，有效解决了从人类视频中学习并泛化机器人技能的挑战。该方法在保持物理合理性方面也具有优势。然而，未来可以进一步探索该方法在处理更复杂的手部动作和多样化物体交互场景中的鲁棒性和适应性。

title: Efficient cross-domain multi-factor authentication
summary: Secure cross-domain authentication is crucial for protecting information exchange across terminals in different security domains. However, existing cross-domain authentication models suffer from inflexibility, high storage and computational consumption. In response to these problems, a cross-domain multi-factor authentication protocol with improved efficiency (CDAuth) is proposed. CDAuth employs a universally applicable multi-factor authentication approach, integrating pseudo-identity, attribute concealment, and biometric hiding. The authentication information sets can be freely added or modified to accommodate various access scenarios. This boosts privacy, flexibility, and applicability compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, multi-edge servers as Certification Authorities (CAs) store only the union of terminal attributes and a verification token per user in their subdomains, instead of each user's attribute and biometric sets as in traditional schemes, significantly reducing storage consumption. Additionally, replacing the bilinear pairing operations with the native group operations, while maintaining security, significantly reduces computational consumption. Our analysis shows that CDAuth can resist common security attacks and is more efficient than the previous schemes.

title: Joint-Health-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot Control Under Actuator Degradation
summary: Robots deployed in unstructured environments are susceptible to actuator-authority degradation, which reduces the effective control authority of individual actuators and can cause reinforcement learning policies trained under nominal dynamics to fail. Existing robustness approaches rely on discrete fault labels, broad domain randomization, or global latent variables, often without explicitly modeling continuous per-joint residual actuation capability. We propose a joint-health-aware reinforcement learning framework for robust robot control under simulated actuator degradation. Our framework encodes actuator condition in a continuous joint-health vector and models degradation as multiplicative attenuation of executed actions. A dedicated HealthNet estimator infers per-joint health from recent observations and actions, allowing the policy to redistribute control effort across healthy and degraded joints. We evaluate the method on Walker, Go2, Cassie, and Panda-based ManiSkill manipulation tasks under diverse degradation masks and severity levels. The method outperforms nominal and degradation-trained no-health baselines on the main evaluated metrics. Relative to the nominal baseline, task-level locomotion returns improve by up to 250.1\% and manipulation success rates by up to 15.2 percentage points; in the high-degradation Cassie group, return increases from 3.94 to 40.50 (+928.0\%). Ablations support the contribution of per-joint health estimation, action-degradation modeling, and health-conditioned control.

title: Geometry-Aware Humanoid Retargeting via Manifold ODEs
summary: In this paper, we focus on interaction-preserving motion retargeting, which transfers human demonstrations to humanoids while maintaining spatial relationships with objects and terrain. Previous work, such as OmniRetarget, addresses this task through temporally coupled constrained optimization, requiring repeated sequential quadratic programming (SQP) iterations at each frame. We study this problem from an ordinary differential equation (ODE) perspective by modeling the continuous-time limit of its framewise Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions as an ODE on the robot configuration manifold. This viewpoint offers two benefits: (i) it connects OmniRetarget's SQP iterations to a backward discretization of the ODE, enabling us to establish their local convergence under suitable regularity assumptions; and (ii) it leads to TaSP-KKT (tangent-space parametrization for KKT flow), a new retargeting method based on a forward discretization of the KKT flow. The proposed method achieves the same first-order convergence to the ODE solution as the corresponding backward scheme while requiring only one weighted tangent-cone projection and a closed-form manifold update per step, thereby avoiding repeated inner SQP iterations. Numerical experiments show that TaSP-KKT achieves retargeting quality comparable to, though slightly lower than, that of OmniRetarget while running approximately twice as fast.

title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
comments: 40 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 5 Extended Data figures, 6 Extended Data tables
summary: Language-model agents now carry out long scientific work in biology, but their judgements about conventions, skills, errors, evidence and stopping are made inside the reasoning that does the work, where they cannot be measured, replaced or improved on their own. Here we present Operon-S1, a fast decision system, a System 1 for the agent, that separates judging from doing. A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge. Across seven life-science benchmarks, a local decision model took over these judgements in 0.6 s at the median for an in-loop request on CPU at no request cost, with no measurable change in the agent's score on five of six benchmarks, whereas the general language model that drives the agent, asked the same questions, accounted for 8.0% to 35.2% of task cost. Every decision is recorded with its consequence. Retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raised decision accuracy on every question in each of three trained versions, and a new version enters service only through a promotion gate. Task-level results in this study use the public checkpoint. The same closed decisions serve wet-laboratory protocol troubleshooting and the design of a germline target enrichment panel. Like the regulator of an operon, which switches genes on and off without making their products, Operon-S1 steers the agent without doing its work, and makes the agent's judgements a layer that can be measured, replaced and trained.
comment: 40 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 5 Extended Data figures, 6 Extended Data tables

title: Quantile Propagation Planning for Budgeted Tail-Risk Evaluation
summary: Risk-aware planning must identify rare, costly outcomes using only a limited number of model evaluations. Monte Carlo rollouts spend this budget on noisy tail estimates, while planning from the mean can miss the tail entirely. We introduce quantile propagation planning (QPP), which propagates a small, fixed set of disturbance quantiles through the dynamics and integrates the resulting cost curve to evaluate both mean and tail risk. The method is exact at the propagated levels, converges as the quantile grid is refined, and admits a one-sided conservatism guarantee under stated structural conditions. In controlled overload and inventory tasks, QPP reduces realized tail cost and constraint violations relative to mean-rollout planning. On overload, it remains competitive with sampled evaluators that use substantially more trajectories. These results position QPP as a transparent, budget-controlled approach to tail-risk evaluation.

title: CalibSwitch: Observation-Driven Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Recovery and Selective Maintenance for Multimodal Perception
summary: Camera--LiDAR perception on mobile robots and intelligent vehicles depends on reliable sensor geometry throughout deployment. Installation variations create uncertainty in the initial extrinsics, while changing observation quality makes frame-wise estimates fluctuate during operation. This paper presents CalibSwitch, an observation-driven framework that separates absolute extrinsic recovery from selective state maintenance. A cross-modal absolute extrinsic generator (CAEG) combines projection-free bidirectional feature interaction with geometry-regularized learning to recover complete SE(3) candidates from image--point observations and coarse view context, without a supplied numerical initial transform. A selective recurrent calibration policy (SRCP) combines observation quality and temporal history to determine when a candidate should replace the working geometry consumed by a frozen multimodal detector. On nuScenes, CAEG achieves mean translation and rotation errors of 0.248 m and 5.884$^\circ$. Under sustained geometric transitions, SRCP reaches a mean composite error of 1.46 with 9.70\% candidate commitments, outperforming quality-based and temporal-consistency gating at comparable commitment rates. Relative to unconditional per-frame updating, it improves frozen-detector mAP and NDS by 1.43 and 0.92 points. Paired geometry--observation uncertainty tests, two real-vehicle platforms, and 13.5-FPS single-camera Jetson execution demonstrate the system value of selective geometric-state maintenance for continuous perception.

title: DiffWBC: Unlocking Steerable General Humanoid Motion Tracking via One-Step Diffusion Whole-Body Control
summary: General humanoid motion trackers typically rely on deterministic policies that cannot adapt online without brittle reference editing or costly retraining. We present DiffWBC, shifting whole-body control to a generative paradigm via a one-step diffusion model. By modeling distributions over future trajectories, DiffWBC unifies general tracking, test-time steering, and simulation-free failure discovery within a single controller: (1) Generative general tracking: DiffWBC requires a single forward pass per 50 Hz control step and can be distilled from an RL teacher or trained from scratch via model-based RL, achieving the lowest local tracking error among six general trackers on held-out benchmarks (20.1 mm on BONES) and deploying on a physical Unitree G1. (2) Zero-shot test-time steering: differentiable cost gradients and body-group masks modulate the frozen controller online, substantially outperforming kinematic reference editing (0.84 clean pass at 1.25 m ceiling vs. 0.10) and zero-shot generalizing across hurdles, spatial reaching, actuator faults, and tray balancing. (3) Simulation-free failure discovery: plan dispersion across generation noise effectively identifies physical tracking failures (91% precision in top 2%) without physics simulations; targeted fine-tuning on flagged clips resolves 50% of failure cases. Videos and interactive demonstrations are available at https://diffwbc.github.io/#selfassess.

title: Do Transaction Prices Reflect Visual Preference? A Diagnostic Study with Multimodal Language Models
summary: Existing visual preference evaluation relies on costly human annotations or preference reward models, whereas online marketplace transaction prices are readily available and reflect real purchasing behavior, offering potential low-cost supervision. However, transaction prices conflate visual preferences with non-visual factors such as provenance, demand, and competition, making aggregate accuracy insufficient to distinguish model errors, unreliable price signals, and protocol confounds. To address this identifiability challenge, we introduce MarketImage, a diagnostic framework that identifies when transaction prices reflect visual preferences, where they fail, and whether multimodal language models can recover human-supported visual preference signals. MarketImage comprises three components: (i) MarketImageArt, 266 six-image comparison sets with transaction prices and price-blind human rankings; (ii) MarketImageLens, a tie-preserving protocol that partitions 3,990 within-set image pairs into price-human agreement, conflict, and price-tie regions while separately auditing presentation-order effects; and (iii) MarketValuator, six elicitation methods spanning direct comparison, independent scoring, budget constraints, and multi-agent aggregation to evaluate signal recovery by static visual scorers and three multimodal language models. Experiments show that only 24.2% of image pairs have a non-tied price direction, of which 34.7% agree with the human majority. Within this region, HPSv2 leads at 66.4% Recoverable Accuracy; Qwen's budgeted and aggregated variants trail baselines, while GPT interface gains remain statistically unresolved. Thus, transaction prices encode recoverable visual preferences only under limited conditions and should be treated as uncertain proxies rather than ground truth.

title: LEAP: Efficient LLM Inference Scheduling with Generalizable Length Prediction
summary: Length-aware scheduling reduces request latency in LLM serving by prioritizing shorter requests. However, despite their large model sizes, length predictors can suffer degraded ranking performance under domain and task shifts, and adapting them can require costly retraining. Their prediction overhead can further offset the benefits of scheduling. To improve the generalization and efficiency of length-aware scheduling, we propose \textbf{LEAP}, a length prediction system with fast online adaptation and asynchronous CPU execution. LEAP reuses the serving model's prefill hidden states, which contain information about the output length, and extracts this signal through a linear readout. To adapt to substantial domain and task shifts, it updates the readout at test time through recursive least squares, using completed requests as supervision without gradient computation or historical-data replay. Prediction and updates run asynchronously on CPU, while prediction and initial batch ordering overlap the remaining GPU prefill. Across the evaluated cross-domain transfers, LEAP retains strong ranking performance, and online adaptation improves Spearman correlation by 64.7\% under a larger domain shift. Serving experiments show that LEAP reduces average per-token latency by 15.9--40.8\% compared with the evaluated length predictors, while achieving 1.9\% higher throughput with $30{,}569\times$ fewer predictor parameters than the strongest evaluated baseline.

title: Defining Page-Centric Visual Document Retrieval and Evaluating Existing Benchmarks
summary: In modern information retrieval (IR), documents are increasingly encountered as structured sequences of visually rich, paginated units, rather than as flat text. Example documents encountered in our daily life include Word files, PDFs, and slide decks. Free text-centric retrieval systems either ignore this structure entirely or destroy it through arbitrary passage chunking. In this paper, we formulate page-centric Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) with pages as the fundamental indexing units and document context available for assessing page relevance. The formulation distinguishes two retrieval granularities, page and document, and three retrieval paradigms: independent-item, evidence-set, and iterative retrieval. We then assess 42 benchmarks using eight criteria covering corpus characteristics, query construction, relevance annotation, and ranking support. Our analysis shows two main findings on current VDR research. First, evaluation remains concentrated on page-level independent-item retrieval, with fewer resources supporting document-level, evidence-set, and iterative settings. Second, queries originating from real user information needs independently of target corpus content and graded relevance judgments are uncommon, while the coverage and verification of relevance judgments vary substantially. Both findings reveal gaps between the capabilities applications require and those existing evaluation protocols can establish. We provide benchmark selection guidance and identify priorities for future benchmark design, emphasizing alignment between task requirements, relevance semantics, and evaluation protocols.

title: Task-Performance Routing for Multi-Teacher Distillation in CT Medical Image Segmentation
comments: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/EdvinCecilia/TPR_MultiTeacher
summary: Pre-trained models offer complementary strengths in CT organ segmentation, but their relative accuracy varies across organs and spatial regions. Multi-teacher knowledge distillation can combine these strengths in a single student, yet global or instance-level teacher weights overlook variation within a 3D volume. We propose Task-Performance Routing (TPR), which uses region-wise segmentation errors to determine teacher weights during training without learned routing parameters. In hard regions, TPR favors teachers with lower prediction errors; in easy regions, it uses uniform weights to combine their knowledge. A hierarchical spatial partition provides fine-grained routing in shallow encoder stages and coarse-grained routing in deep stages. Experiments on BTCV, MSD-Liver, and MSD-Pancreas with two teacher pairs and two backbone architectures show higher Dice scores than the individual teachers, adaptive ensembles, and evaluated multi-teacher distillation baselines. On MSD-Pancreas, TPR achieves Dice scores of 65.40% with SwinUNETR and 68.25% with U-Net, compared with 64.38% and 67.45% for the corresponding adaptive ensembles. Inference uses the student alone, with no routing or teacher overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/EdvinCecilia/TPR_MultiTeacher.

title: Control-Oriented Modeling of Heat Exchangers with Improved Low-Flow Dynamics
summary: Existing low-order models of heat exchangers can lose dynamic accuracy at low flow rates, when fluid residence times become significant. This paper proposes two control-oriented models that improve the low-flow performance. The first extends a finite-volume formulation with the first spatial temperature moment, whereas the second uses Chebyshev--Lobatto collocation. Both capture the coupled heat-transfer and transport dynamics and improve the performance when the system behavior is dominated by the inlet-temperature dynamics. At equal state dimension, comparisons with a high-order reference show more accurate delayed outlet-temperature responses while retaining steady-state accuracy.

title: Generated storm lifecycles fill the rare-event tail of short rainfall records
summary: Historically rare ''one-in-a-generation'' storms are occurring with unprecedented frequency, causing catastrophic damage and mounting casualties, and exposing the vulnerability of infrastructure designed around short observational records. To overcome the limitations of sparse data, we present StormGen, a generative machine-learning model that transforms an observed storm's initial hours into complete, physically plausible hourly rainfall lifecycles in minutes. Evaluated on a decade of southeast Texas rainfall, StormGen produced close counterparts for 4\5% of the most severe 2\% of storms--compared to just 3\% for stochastic storm transposition--and maintained spatial coherence over full 24-hour sequences. Crucially, from a single hour of initial rainfall, the model successfully reconstructed the specific lifecycle, spatial pattern, and extreme catchment totals of Hurricane Harvey itself, despite the event being entirely absent in training. Because storm timing alone can more than double peak flows, these complete generated scenarios provide a vital mechanism to stress-test flood protections against unprecedented extremes.

title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
summary: Training-free expert pruning makes two decisions: which experts to remove, and what the layer computes when its router still selects a removed expert. Published methods change both at once. Holding the mask fixed, we compare replacement operators from three families on OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight, with Granite as a fourth router, using paired, multiplicity-corrected tests. The largest effect is a choice usually left implicit: the survivors' gate scale. On routers trained without top-k renormalization, renormalizing the survivors' gates, a common implementation choice, costs 0.8-8.5 points and reverses whether rerouting beats MoNE's mean-output replacement; on two routers trained with renormalization, the trained scale wins at 50% pruning. We introduce the tilted novice, a closed-form low-rank map of the pruned expert's input whose rank-0 case is MoNE's constant. At 50% pruning it adds 1.2-1.8% parameters and gains 3.45 and 1.37 points over the constant on OLMoE and Moonlight, stable across calibration draws and largely unchanged by 4- and 3-bit quantization. No operator dominates: trained-scale rerouting is best on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and a partial copy of each pruned expert is statistically indistinguishable from the tilted novice on two models. Evaluation can change conclusions: at 25% pruning MoNE's constant keeps 92-97% of dense multiple-choice accuracy but only 5-65% of GSM8K and 0-17% of code scores, and the calibration domain moves the mask 4-9 times more than resampling. We propose a five-item reporting checklist.

title: When History Overrides Intent: Relational Schema Lock-In in Human-LLM Interaction
summary: Long-context interaction and persistent memory allow LLM assistants to develop history-grounded understandings of users. When users change direction, however, an understanding built through earlier exchanges may conflict with their current instruction. We introduce relational schema lock-in to describe cases in which an assistant grants that accumulated understanding authority to override the current instruction without user authorization for the intervention. Study 1 documents reports of AI assistants using prior interactions to question or alter requested actions. Study 2 reproduces the pattern across controlled histories and six models: models retained history-grounded positions but differed in whether and how those positions shaped task execution. In Study 3 with 360 participants, artifact substitution preserved task completion while reducing faithful enactment: 75.0% sent the AI's suspension letter, including 11 participants who reported cancellation as their final stated intent. Overt resistance reduced task completion while leaving sent artifacts faithful.

title: RECITE: Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence
comments: 18 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Extended version of a paper in KDD 2026 (32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20487342
summary: Overly restrictive eligibility criteria contribute to widespread enrollment failure in clinical trials, yet published recommendations for how specific criteria should be broadened remain disconnected from trial design at scale. We introduce RECITE (Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence), a framework for automated discovery, extraction, and implementation of evidence-based eligibility criteria revisions. RECITE uses protocol amendment documents from ClinicalTrials.gov to construct a dataset of 11,913 curated instances across 5,735 trials, each pairing original criteria with documentary evidence and target revisions. We benchmark fifteen LLM configurations under truncated-to-context-window and retrieval-augmented generation conditions, on a 3,116-instance sample under an LLM-as-judge protocol validated against ten domain experts (judge vs. human quadratic-weighted Cohen's $κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$). The best open-weight model, Gemma 2 9B, achieves $κ_{qw}$-aligned ordinal score $3.0 \pm 0.9$ on a 0--4 scale (normalized 0.742) and the best closed-weight model, GPT-4o, reaches $3.0 \pm 0.8$ (normalized 0.745). Using an agentic literature discovery system, we then identified 44 paper--trial matches across five publications providing trial-design and EC-modification evidence. Our findings suggest that existing clinical knowledge can be operationalized into actionable trial design recommendations.

title: BlindStep: A Secure One-Step Kernel for Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Reasoning
comments: Accepted by The Annual Computer Security Applications Conference 2026 (ACSAC, 2026)
summary:
A recurring step in two-party collaborative workflows combines a private candidate frontier with a partner's compatible evidence, scores the resulting candidates, and retains only a small frontier. Direct execution can expose intermediate candidates, local scores, or unauthorized evidence provenance. Existing MPC platforms and PSI protocols provide useful building blocks, but they do not define a unified post-alignment boundary for bounded-slot aggregation, fail-closed overflow handling, retained-frontier selection, and downstream disclosure. We present BlindStep, a fixed-shape MPC-online kernel for one such post-alignment step between two semi-honest parties. Given a frontend realizing the bounded-slot contract and an application enforcing the reveal policy $ρ$, BlindStep provides a per-invocation simulation-based guarantee in the $F_{\mathrm{align}}$-hybrid model: the kernel leaks only public setup parameters, fixed execution-shape metadata, a global overflow bit, and $ρ$-authorized Layer-2 disclosures. The guarantee excludes malicious security and multi-invocation composition, and treats frontend leakage and offline preprocessing separately.
  Within this kernel boundary, we implement six semi2k realizations in MP-SPDZ, crossing two sharing styles and three top-K strategies: H-variants compare over arithmetic shares, while B-variants convert packed ranking values to Boolean shares before selection. Under LAN, B-Queue is 6-7 times faster and uses about 40 times less communication than H-Queue at N = 256 and 2048. Against H-Sort on the same backend, B-Queue achieves speedups of 21 and 30 times and communication reductions of 204 and 290 times at N = 2048 and 8192, respectively. Under the evaluated N = 256, 100 ms RTT WAN profile, H-Sort becomes fastest, showing that round complexity can dominate backend choice for the measured MPC-online kernel.

title: Queryable Gaussian View Index: Text Retrieval and Selective Camera Localization
summary: We present Queryable Gaussian View Index (QGVI) for querying existing Gaussian scene assets and their associated calibrated reference data. Text-view retrieval and selective RGB camera localization return poses in the asset's coordinate frame. QGVI-T turns Gaussian-rendered views into a language-searchable index of scene locations, binding structured captions to known camera poses and place identifiers. Semantic and lexical retrieval select views from distinct places without online rendering, VLM calls, or a scene-specific pose network. The image route, QGVI-I, filters LoGS-based geometric estimates using distinct inlier query keypoints. It omits photometric refinement and preserves accepted pose coordinates. On nine development scenes, QGVI-T achieves 58.3% Top-1 and 78.3% Top-5 joint relevance-and-validity success, compared with 26.1% and 34.6% for our CityLoC reimplementation with refinement. QGVI-I achieves 97.3% scene-mean pose success at 1 m/2 degrees, with pooled false-acceptance and false-rejection rates of 0.707% and 1.142%. A paired cached evaluation retains all 1,775 initializer poses correct at this threshold. Recorded median text query latency is 0.020 s. Matched controls show competitive BM25 retrieval and slightly lower false acceptance for thresholded full LoGS; grid augmentation suggests modest gains on novel-view-derived descriptions. We report model-judged semantic success separately from source-camera recovery, with source-verified or estimated scales for geometric evaluation.

title: BrowseFlow: Sparse Event Flow Matching for Generative User Simulation
summary: User simulation aims to reproduce how users interact with content and products across online platforms. Recent generative approaches have enriched user simulation with behavioral history and contextual information. However, realistic browsing simulation still faces two challenges. (i) Stochastic Responses: Even with the same recommendation feed, the same user may produce different browsing responses, yielding distinct behavioral trajectories. A logged trajectory records only one such realization. (ii) Sparse Key Events: Clicks and likes provide important feedback but occur sparsely within browsing trajectories dominated by progression actions such as scrolling. Many stepwise simulators predict these actions in a dense sequence, where key events contribute relatively few training targets. To address these challenges, we propose BrowseFlow, a conditional discrete flow matching method for generative user simulation. For Sparse Key Events, BrowseFlow represents each response by its browsing extent and an ordered sequence of key events, directly modeling their counts and locations under exposure constraints. BrowseFlow learns the conditional distribution of complete browsing responses through probabilistic extent prediction and discrete flow matching over key events. Random event retention defines probability paths over partial event sequences, while transition rate matching learns stochastic insertion dynamics. For Stochastic Responses, we use the energy score, a proper scoring rule, to evaluate response fidelity and generated variability, complemented by the Wasserstein distance between key event count distributions. We further introduce TaobaoBrowse, a benchmark pairing real recommendation contexts with fine-grained browsing trajectories. Experiments across three datasets demonstrate that BrowseFlow consistently achieves the best distributional performance.

title: From the Zoo to the BULLPEN: Sample-Efficient LLM Profiling via Multi-Channel Model Embeddings
comments: 28 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/wcquesera/bullpen
summary: Choosing among the hundreds of thousands of available large language models (LLMs) requires a thorough understanding of each candidate model's properties. In practice, each property is measured by its own benchmark suite, so profiling a model on many properties means paying for many separate evaluations. To address this, model embeddings compress each model into a fixed-length vector from which many properties can be predicted. Existing methods, such as EmbedLLM, build these vectors from correctness patterns and question features, and often need large probe batteries to do so. However, many behaviors that are important when choosing a model, such as its verbosity, safety and style, show up more in how it answers than in whether it is correct. We introduce BULLPEN (Behavioral Understanding of Large Language models via Profile ENcodings), a framework that extends EmbedLLM in three ways. First, BULLPEN organizes the downstream tasks that prior work uses and adds 20 task benchmarks we built on behavior, style and provenance. Second, it is the first framework to read a model's own answer text jointly with its correctness and the question text. Third, it encodes models from a few hundred questions instead of the full 24,118-question pool. Across 260 open-weight models, our answer-text encoder scores 0.48 +/- 0.10 on the new tasks against 0.35 +/- 0.10 for the best prior encoder. Our encoders that read answer text keep at least 91% of their full-pool skill from only 400 questions (1.3% of the inference compute of the full question pool), while a correctness-only baseline keeps 83% with the same 400 questions. Because these embeddings need only model outputs, they support behavioral auditing and low-cost profiling, and could extend to API-only models. Code and data: https://github.com/wcquesera/bullpen
