AI.title_translation: FOCUS：利用最优传输监督的基于观测模仿的一阶控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 FOCUS，一种结合最优传输对齐与可微分演员-评论家的模仿学习方法，无需时间对齐即可高效稳定地解决复杂的接触丰富控制任务。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习通常缺乏时间对应关系，而可微分模拟器在通过长且充满接触的轨迹进行微分时会导致优化不稳定，因此需要一种既能对齐轨迹又能保证训练稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 引入 FOCUS 方法，结合局部最优传输对齐与短期可微分演员-评论家学习；利用软 best-of-K 目标将智能体轨迹窗口与多个采样的专家片段进行匹配，提供可微分模仿奖励，并利用学习到的评论家进行价值自举。
AI.result: 在 DFlex 的复杂接触丰富运动任务（包括由 152 个肌肉激活控制的肌肉骨骼人形机器人）中，FOCUS 相比对抗式基于观测的模仿方法和先前的可微分模仿基线，提升了样本效率和训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS 是一种有效且鲁棒的基于观测的模仿学习方法，能够无需时间对齐或专家对齐初始化，稳定地解决复杂的接触丰富控制任务。
AI.translation: 仅通过观测进行的模仿学习必须在没有已知时间对应关系的情况下，从纯状态演示中恢复行为。可微分仿真器提供了路径策略梯度，但通过长且充满接触的轨迹进行微分会使优化变得不稳定。我们介绍了 FOCUS，它将局部最优传输对齐与短期可微分演员-评论家学习结合起来。FOCUS 使用强调局部兼容匹配的软 best-of-K 目标，将智能体 rollout 窗口与多个采样的专家片段进行匹配。由此产生基于传输的成本提供了可微分的模仿奖励，而学习到的评论家则在 rollout 视野之外进行价值自举。FOCUS 既不需要时间对齐的轨迹，也不需要专家对齐的初始化或教师强迫。在 DFlex 中跨越接触丰富的运动任务（包括由 152 个肌肉激活控制的肌肉骨骼人形机器人），与对抗式基于观测的模仿方法和先前的可微分模仿基线相比，FOCUS 提高了样本效率和训练稳定性。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 FOCUS，一种结合局部最优传输对齐与短期可微分演员-评论家学习的模仿学习方法。它通过软 best-of-K 目标匹配智能体与专家片段，提供可微分奖励并自举价值，无需时间对齐或教师强迫，在复杂接触任务中展现出卓越的样本效率和稳定性。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, 最优传输, 可微分仿真, 强化学习, 机器人控制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将最优传输理论与短期可微分演员-评论家算法相结合，解决了仅靠观测进行模仿学习中长期轨迹优化不稳定和缺乏时间对应关系的难题，在复杂的接触丰富型 locomotion 任务上展现出色的样本效率和训练稳定性。

title: DeepWeave: Weaving Neural and Symbolic Evidence for ML-Based Network Intrusion Detection System
summary: Machine learning-based network intrusion detection systems can recognize complex traffic patterns, but often require substantial labelled attack data, degrade under deployment shift, and provide limited evidence for analysts. We present DeepWeave, a probabilistic neuro-symbolic Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) that makes logic an integral part of detection. DeepWeave automatically constructs and validates interpretable rules, represents neural predictions as probabilistic predicates, and reconciles both evidence sources through explicit coupling policies over packet-, flow-, and hybrid-views. The resulting proofs provide intrinsic explanations for rule-supported alerts. Across multiple datasets, DeepWeave improves low-data detection, false-positive control, transferability, and robustness. With only 50 labelled packet observations per attack class, it improves macro-F1 from 0.632 to 0.924 and reduces the attack false-positive rate from 0.075 to 0.008 over the matched neural baseline. Its proofs are also more stable than post-hoc neural attributions, while batched inference keeps probabilistic reasoning practical. These results demonstrate label-efficient, adaptable, and inspectable neuro-symbolic intrusion detection.

AI.title_translation: DeepWeave：为基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统编织神经与符号证据
AI.tldr: DeepWeave结合了神经网络和符号逻辑，在仅需极少标记数据的情况下显著提升了网络入侵检测系统的准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统虽然能识别复杂流量模式，但通常需要大量标记数据，在部署偏移下性能下降，且缺乏给分析人员的直观证据。
AI.method: 提出了DeepWeave，一个概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统，它能自动构建和验证可解释规则，将神经网络预测表示为概率谓词，并通过显式耦合策略在数据包、流以及混合视图上调和神经与符号两类证据。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，DeepWeave在仅使用每个攻击类50个标记样本的情况下，将宏F1分数从0.632提升至0.924，将攻击误报率从0.075降至0.008，同时提供了比事后神经归因更稳定的证明。
AI.conclusion: DeepWeave通过深度融合神经推理与符号逻辑，实现了标签高效、具备强鲁棒性和可解释性的网络入侵检测，是神经符号AI在安全领域应用的一个成功范例。
AI.translation: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统能够识别复杂的流量模式，但通常需要大量的标记攻击数据，在部署偏移下性能会下降，并且为分析人员提供的证据有限。我们提出了DeepWeave，这是一个将逻辑作为检测不可或缺部分的概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）。DeepWeave能够自动构建和验证可解释的规则，将神经预测表示为概率谓词，并通过对数据包、流以及混合视图的显式耦合策略来调和这两种证据来源。由此产生的证明为规则支持的警报提供了内在的解释。在多个数据集上，DeepWeave改善了低数据下的检测、误报控制、可迁移性和鲁棒性。在每个攻击类别仅有50个标记数据包观测值的情况下，它将宏F1值从0.632提高到0.924，并将匹配的神经基线的攻击误报率从0.075降低到0.008。其证明也比事后神经归因更稳定，同时批处理推理保持了概率推理的实用性。这些结果证明了标签高效、适应性强且可检查的神经符号入侵检测。
AI.summary: DeepWeave是一个概率神经符号网络入侵检测系统，它通过自动生成可解释规则并将神经网络预测转化为概率谓词，在数据包和流级别融合神经与符号证据，从而在低数据量、高误报控制、强迁移和鲁棒性方面显著优于传统的纯神经网络基线。
AI.keywords: 神经符号AI, 网络入侵检测系统, 可解释性AI, 机器学习, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: DeepWeave创新性地将神经网络与符号逻辑结合，有效解决了传统基于机器学习的NIDS在小样本、分布偏移和可解释性方面的痛点，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: ARPEGE: Dataset and Methods to Estimate Acoustic and Geometric Parameters of Rooms from Sound
summary: Can one hear the walls of a room? To foster audio signal processing research around this question we release ARPEGE, a dataset containing hundreds of ambisonic spherical-array room impulse responses recorded in 6 empty rooms, annotated by the relative positions of sources, microphones and all acoustic reflectors. The dataset includes multiple room sizes, surface materials, orientations and distances, as well as recordings of human speakers and handclaps. Two state-of-the-art methods on image source localization and blind room parameter estimation are demonstrated on the data. Initial code for re-simulating the measured room impulse responses is provided, a longer term goal being to digitally twin the dataset.

AI.title_translation: ARPEGE：通过声音估计房间声学与几何参数的数据集与方法
AI.tldr: 本文推出了ARPEGE数据集，包含6个房间中具有丰富几何与声学标注的球形阵列脉冲响应，用于支持通过声音推断房间几何与声学参数的研究。
AI.motivation: 旨在探讨并推动“能否通过声音‘听’出房间的墙壁”这一音频信号处理课题的研究。
AI.method: 构建并开源了ARPEGE数据集，采集了6间空房间中数百条球形阵列高保真立体声（Ambisonic）房间脉冲响应，标注了声源、麦克风及所有反射面的相对空间位置；包含不同房间尺寸、表面材质、方向与距离，以及真人说话和拍手录音；并在该数据上演示了两种基于镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计的SOTA方法，同时提供了重模拟测量脉冲响应的初始代码。
AI.result: 成功在ARPEGE数据集上验证了镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计这两种前沿方法的有效性，并提供了用于重新模拟测量脉冲响应的初步代码以支持房间数字孪生。
AI.translation: 人能“听”出房间的墙壁吗？为了推动围绕该问题的音频信号处理研究，我们发布了ARPEGE数据集。该数据集包含在6间空置房间中录制的数百条高阶立体声（Ambisonic）球形阵列房间脉冲响应，并标注了声源、麦克风以及所有声学反射面的相对位置。数据集涵盖了多种房间尺寸、表面材料、朝向和距离，以及人类说话者和拍手声的录音。我们在该数据上演示了两种关于镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计的前沿方法。此外，论文还提供了用于重新模拟测量房间脉冲响应的初始代码，其长期目标是对该数据集进行数字孪生建模。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ARPEGE数据集及相关方法，用于通过声音估计房间的声学与几何参数。数据集包含在6个空房间采集的数百条球形阵列房间脉冲响应，具备详尽的声源、麦克风与反射面位置标注，并涵盖多种房间尺寸、材质与声音类型。研究展示了其在镜像源定位和盲房间参数估计上的应用，并提供了仿真代码以助力数字孪生研究。
AI.keywords: 房间脉冲响应, 房间几何估计, 声学参数估计, Ambisonic, 空间音频
AI.comments: 该工作通过发布具有精细几何与声学反射面标注的真实环境Ambisonic脉冲响应数据集，为通过声音推断物理空间参数（盲房间声学估计、镜像源定位等）提供了标准基准，对空间音频、虚拟现实以及房间数字孪生技术的发展具有重要促进作用。

title: Self-Localization of Distributed Microphone Arrays Using One Source and Acoustic Reflections
summary: We present a method to estimate the relative position and orientation of two non-coplanar microphone arrays using a room impulse response (RIR) from a single source. The approach exploits early acoustic reflections, retrieved by each array in the form of a 3D image-source point cloud, using a recently-proposed image-source localization technique. The task is then reduced to aligning the two unlabeled point clouds, which is made difficult by their inherent symmetries and by spurious, missing and noisy estimates. To this aim we introduce ARCTIC, a point-cloud registration algorithm that performs a ranked search over congruent triangles anchored on the true source. Simulated and real experiments show that ARCTIC strongly outperforms two baselines, achieving mean angular and radial self-localization errors below 5 and 10 cm across 36 real RIRs measured in 6 different rooms.

AI.title_translation: 利用单个声源和声学反射的分布式麦克风阵列自定位
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用单个声源和早期声学反射来估计两个非共面麦克风阵列相对位置和方向的方法，并引入了ARCTIC算法来对齐点云，实验证明其性能优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有技术难以估计分布式麦克风阵列的相对位置和方向，尤其是在存在点云固有点对称性、虚假、缺失和噪声估计的情况下。因此，需要一种有效的方法来解决麦克风阵列的自定位问题。
AI.method: 该方法利用单个声源的房间脉冲响应（RIR）中的早期声学反射。每个阵列通过图像源定位技术检索3D图像源点云。然后，通过对齐两个未标记的点云来完成定位任务。为此，研究人员引入了ARCTIC算法，这是一种点云配准算法，通过锚定在真实声源上的全等三角形进行排序搜索。
AI.result: ARCTIC算法在模拟和真实实验中表现出显著优于两种基线方法。在6个不同房间测量的36个真实RIR中，平均角度自定位误差低于5厘米，径向自定位误差低于10厘米。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的ARCTIC算法能够有效利用声学反射实现分布式麦克风阵列的精确自定位，在复杂环境下表现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种利用单个声源的房间脉冲响应（RIR）来估计两个非共面麦克风阵列相对位置和方向的方法。该方法利用每个阵列通过最近提出的图像源定位技术检索到的3D图像源点云形式的早期声学反射。任务随后简化为对齐两个未标记的点云，这因其固有的对称性以及虚假、缺失和噪声估计而变得困难。为此，我们引入了ARCTIC，一种点云配准算法，它通过锚定在真实声源上的全等三角形进行排序搜索。模拟和真实实验表明，ARCTIC显著优于两种基线方法，在6个不同房间测量的36个真实RIR中，平均角度和径向自定位误差分别低于5厘米和10厘米。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用单个声源和早期声学反射实现分布式麦克风阵列自定位的新方法。该方法通过图像源定位技术从房间脉冲响应中提取3D图像源点云，并引入了ARCTIC算法来解决点云对齐的挑战，该算法通过全等三角形进行排序搜索。实验结果表明，ARCTIC在自定位精度上显著优于现有基线方法，实现了较低的角度和径向误差。
AI.keywords: 分布式麦克风阵列, 自定位, 声学反射, 图像源, 点云配准, ARCTIC
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于利用早期声学反射进行分布式麦克风阵列的自定位，并提出了ARCTIC算法来有效处理点云对齐中的对称性、噪声和缺失数据问题。这种方法在无需额外硬件的情况下，为多麦克风系统在复杂环境中的部署和校准提供了新的思路，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Contact-based optimization for collision-free motion planning for a million robots
summary: Multi-agent robotic systems have attracted growing interest in recent years, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. At the planning level, robot motion is often modeled using double-integrator dynamics (with low-level controllers handling the physical dynamics during execution) with a minimum-energy objective subject to collision-avoidance constraints and limits on position, velocity, and acceleration. The complexity of the problem resides in the constraints, which couple the trajectories and make the optimization problem nonconvex. Existing numerical approaches typically discretize and optimize entire trajectories, which becomes expensive for large fleets. We exploit the structure of optimal trajectories by organizing optimization around contacts, at which robots reach the minimum allowed separation. We formulate a coupled algebraic system in contact variables and reconstruct trajectories analytically between contacts. Our algorithm, sequential contact insertion (SCI), starts from unconstrained trajectories, inserts contacts at separation violations, and jointly adjusts their times and states. Numerical experiments demonstrate planning for one million robots in minutes and thousands of robots in fractions of a second. On problems feasible for a fixed-grid sequential convex programming baseline, SCI achieves median speedups of several orders of magnitude at matching solution accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 基于接触优化的百万机器人无碰撞运动规划
AI.tldr: 提出了一种围绕接触点优化且解析重构轨迹的新算法（SCI），仅需数分钟即可完成百万量级机器人的无碰撞运动规划。
AI.motivation: 传统的数值运动规划方法通常对整条轨迹进行离散化和全局优化，但在大规模机器人集群中，防碰撞约束引发的轨迹强耦合和非凸性使得计算复杂度极高、耗时极为昂贵。
AI.method: 提出顺序接触插入（SCI）算法：利用最优轨迹结构，围绕智能体达到最小允许间距的“接触”点组织优化；建立关于接触变量的耦合代数系统，在接触点之间解析重构轨迹；算法从无约束轨迹出发，在间距冲突处插入接触点，并联合迭代优化接触的时间与状态。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该算法仅需数分钟即可完成100万个机器人的运动规划，数千个机器人的规划耗时不足一秒；在保证与固定网格顺序凸规划基线相同解精度的前提下，取得了数个数量级的中位数加速比。
AI.conclusion: 通过围绕接触变量构建耦合代数系统并解析重构轨迹，顺序接触插入算法成功攻克了大规模多智能体协同规划的计算瓶颈，实现了前所未有的求解规模与计算效率。
AI.translation: 近年来，多智能体机器人系统备受关注，应用涵盖无人机编队表演以及陆地、空中和水上的自主作业。在规划层面，机器人的运动通常建模为双积分动力学（执行期间由底层控制器处理实际物理动力学），以最小能量为目标，并受限于防碰撞约束以及位置、速度和加速度限制。该问题的复杂性源于这些约束使得轨迹相互耦合，导致优化问题呈非凸性。现有的数值方法通常对整条轨迹进行离散化和优化，对于大规模集群而言计算成本极为昂贵。我们利用最优轨迹的结构，围绕机器人达到最小允许间距的“接触”来组织优化。我们在接触变量中构建了一个耦合代数系统，并在接触之间解析地重构轨迹。我们的算法称为顺序接触插入（SCI），它从无约束轨迹出发，在违反安全间距处插入接触点，并联合调整它们的时间和状态。数值实验表明，该算法可以在数分钟内完成100万个机器人的规划，并在几分之一秒内完成数千个机器人的规划。在固定网格顺序凸规划基线可行的问题上，SCI在保持相同求解精度的同时，实现了数个数量级的中位数加速。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模多智能体无碰撞运动规划问题，提出了一种名为顺序接触插入（SCI）的接触优化算法。该方法避免了全局轨迹离散化，通过在关键接触点构建耦合代数系统并结合解析轨迹重构，实现了前所未有的计算效率，可在数分钟内完成百万级机器人的无碰撞轨迹生成。
AI.keywords: 多智能体运动规划, 轨迹优化, 碰撞避免, 接触优化, 顺序接触插入
AI.comments: 该论文在多机器人运动规划的计算可扩展性上取得了突破性创新。其核心亮点在于摆脱了传统方法对整条轨迹进行全网格离散化的重计算负担，巧妙地利用双积分动力学特性，仅在碰撞边界（接触点）构建代数优化并在期间解析重构轨迹，将规划规模推进到了惊人的百万量级。潜在局限性在于规划模型简化为双积分动力学，更复杂的真实环境障碍物和高阶非线性动力学适配情况在摘要中未予详述。

title: Numerical methods for nonlinear stochastic differential equations driven by subdiffusion
summary: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) driven by subdiffusion see great applications in anomalous transport and asset price dynamics. Trusted numerical methods are essential for their application in practice. In this paper, for SDEs driven by subdiffusion with superlinear coefficients, we propose a brand-new explicit numerical method. The sharp convergence rate is proved with new techniques. The potential application of the proposed method in numerically solving a generalized Fokker-Planck equation is also illustrated. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 由次扩散驱动的非线性随机微分方程的数值方法
AI.tldr: 本文为由次扩散驱动且具有超线性系数的随机微分方程提出了一种新的显式数值方法，证明了其收敛阶，并通过模拟验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 由次扩散驱动的随机微分方程（SDEs）在反常输运和资产价格动力学中有着广泛的应用，而可靠的数值方法对于其实际应用至关重要，特别是针对具有超线性系数的情况。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对超线性系数次扩散驱动SDEs的全新显式数值方法，并利用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛率。
AI.result: 证明了所提显式数值方法的尖锐收敛阶，通过数值模拟验证了理论结果，并展示了其在数值求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的潜在应用。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种适用于超线性系数次扩散驱动SDEs的显式数值方法，证明了其尖锐的收敛阶，并通过数值模拟验证了理论结果，同时展示了其在求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的应用。
AI.translation: 由次扩散驱动的随机微分方程（SDEs）在反常输运和资产价格动力学中有着广泛的应用。可靠的数值方法对于其实际应用至关重要。在本文中，针对具有超线性系数的次扩散驱动SDEs，我们提出了一种全新的显式数值方法。利用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛阶。同时阐明了该方法在数值求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的潜在应用。最后提供了数值模拟来验证理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对具有超线性系数的次扩散驱动随机微分方程，提出了一种全新的显式数值方法，利用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛阶，并展示了其在数值求解广义Fokker-Planck方程中的应用及数值模拟验证。
AI.keywords: 次扩散, 随机微分方程, 显式数值方法, 收敛阶, 广义Fokker-Planck方程
AI.comments: 该论文针对由次扩散驱动且具有超线性系数的随机微分方程，提出了一种全新的显式数值方法，并运用新技术证明了其尖锐的收敛阶，具有较强的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: Enhancing Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction in Abstracts and Full-text Content of Academic Articles Using Large Language Models
summary: This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.

AI.title_translation: 使用大语言模型增强学术文章摘要和全文内容中的知识实体关系提取
AI.tldr: 本文评估了多种基于大语言模型和小语言模型的学术论文实体关系提取策略，发现LoRA微调的T5模型表现最优，且多策略组合能进一步提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单一类型的基于大语言模型（LLM）的策略，缺乏对多种策略在学术论文知识实体关系提取（KERE）中表现的全面评估与多视角分析。
AI.method: 研究了闭源大模型CoT提示、LoRA微调开源大模型、大模型增强小模型等多种策略，并提出了小模型增强开源大模型及闭源大模型增强开源大模型的新策略，同时构建了NLP领域的摘要和全文两个标注数据集。
AI.result: LoRA适配的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上分别取得了0.7408和0.7013的最高Macro F1分数；结合不同错误模式的策略可进一步提升KERE性能。
AI.conclusion: LoRA微调的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上表现最佳，且通过结合不同策略和错误模式分析，可进一步提升KERE的性能。
AI.translation: 本研究探讨了大预训练语言模型（LLMs）从学术论文中进行知识实体关系提取（KERE）的有效性。现有研究主要检查了基于LLM的个体类型策略，并使用精确率和召回率等指标评估模型性能。为了提供更广泛的评估，本研究调查了多种策略，包括闭源LLM的CoT提示、LoRA适配的开源LLM、LLM增强的小型预训练语言模型（SLMs）以及SLM增强的闭源LLM。此外，本研究引入了两种新策略，即SLM增强的开源LLM和闭源LLM增强的开源LLM。这些策略从多个角度进行了评估，包括评估指标、缓解SLM中观察到的错误的能力以及模型优化的潜在方向。本研究在NLP领域手动构建了两个标注数据集，涵盖摘要和全文数据集。实验结果表明，LoRA适配的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上分别获得了0.7408和0.7013的最高Macro F1分数。在LLM增强的SLM策略下，SLM也受益于LLM生成的实体描述。错误分析进一步表明，基于LLM的策略在缓解SLM错误方面的有效性因错误类型而异。基于这些策略的局限性和错误模式，提出了几个优化方向。此外，结合具有不同错误模式的策略可进一步提高KERE性能。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了利用大语言模型和预训练小模型进行学术文章知识实体关系提取的多种策略，构建了两个NLP领域的标注数据集，实验表明LoRA适配的T5模型效果最佳，且组合策略能有效提升性能。
AI.keywords: Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction, Large Language Models, Academic Articles, LoRA, Error Analysis
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究并比较了多种基于大语言模型（LLM）和小语言模型（SLM）的学术文献知识实体关系提取（KERE）策略，并创新性地提出了组合策略，具有很高的实用价值和理论指导意义。

title: CEFR Level Assessment across Languages and Text Granularities
summary: Automatic assessment of textual CEFR levels is an important task in educational natural language processing. However, accurate CEFR level prediction remains challenging due to the naturally imbalanced distribution of CEFR levels and the ambiguous boundaries between adjacent levels. To address these challenges, we propose a unified training objective that combines focal loss with supervised contrastive learning. Focal loss mitigates class imbalance by emphasizing underrepresented and difficult examples, while supervised contrastive learning learns more discriminative representations by encouraging intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. We evaluate the proposed method on sentence- and document-level CEFR assessment in both monolingual and multilingual settings. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across all settings, establishing new state-of-the-art performance on multiple CEFR assessment benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 跨语言和不同文本粒度的CEFR等级评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出融合焦点损失与监督对比学习的训练方法，成功解决了跨语言及多粒度CEFR等级评估中的类别不均衡与边界模糊难题并达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 准确预测文本的CEFR等级极具挑战性，主要由于不同CEFR等级在自然语言中存在固有的类别分布不平衡，以及相邻等级之间存在模糊的界限。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合焦点损失（Focal Loss）与有监督对比学习（Supervised Contrastive Learning）的统一训练目标。其中焦点损失通过着重关注欠代表和困难样本来缓解类别不平衡问题，有监督对比学习则通过促进类内紧凑与类间分离来学习更具区分度的特征表征。
AI.result: 在单语言与多语言设置下的句子级和篇章级CEFR评估实验中，该方法在所有设定下均持续优于强基线模型，并在多个CEFR评估基准上取得了新的最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，将焦点损失与有监督对比学习相结合的训练目标能有效应对CEFR等级评估中的类别不平衡和边界模糊挑战，在跨语言、跨文本粒度的多项基准上均达到了最先进性能。
AI.translation: 文本CEFR等级的自动评估是教育自然语言处理领域的一项重要任务。然而，由于CEFR等级天然的不平衡分布以及相邻等级之间模糊的边界，准确预测CEFR等级仍然极具挑战性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种结合焦点损失与有监督对比学习的统一训练目标。焦点损失通过强调代表性不足和困难的样本来缓解类别不平衡，而有监督对比学习则通过促进类内紧凑和类间分离来学习更具区分性的表征。我们在单语言和多语言设置下的句子级和篇章级CEFR评估中对所提方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在所有设置中均持续优于强基线模型，在多个CEFR评估基准上取得了新的最先进性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对文本CEFR等级预测中存在的类别不平衡与相邻等级边界模糊问题，提出了一种结合焦点损失与有监督对比学习的统一训练目标。该方法在单语言/多语言以及句子/篇章级多项基准测试中均超越强基线并创下SOTA表现。
AI.keywords: CEFR等级评估, 焦点损失, 有监督对比学习, 类别不平衡, 教育自然语言处理
AI.comments: 本研究精准抓住了教育NLP中CEFR等级评估的两个核心痛点：类别自然分布不平衡以及相邻等级间主观模糊性高。将Focal Loss（解决不平衡与困难样本）与有监督对比学习（拉大类间差异、聚拢类内特征）结合的思路非常契合该任务特性。此外，实验同时涵盖单语/多语以及句子/篇章多粒度，具有很高的实用价值和泛化验证性；潜在局限在于未提及是否结合序数回归（Ordinal Regression）的等级顺序先验。

title: An Efficient Randomized Hierarchical Tucker Decomposition
comments: 28 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables, presented at GAMM ANLA 2025 and METT XI
summary: We introduce randomized algorithms for computing the hierarchical Tucker decomposition of high-order tensors. Unlike traditional algorithms performed in a sequential leaves-to-root direction, our algorithms traverse the dimension tree in a root-to-leaves direction, leveraging randomized sequential projections to accelerate the computation of intermediate subspaces. This strategy can reduce the computation time by an order of magnitude relative to prior randomized algorithms using the leaves-to-root direction, while guaranteeing quasi-optimal approximation. Although the theoretical error bound is slightly larger than for leaves-to-root methods, in all our experiments the practical error adheres to the classic bound. Our results highlight the method's potential for scalable tensor decompositions in high-dimensional data analysis.
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables, presented at GAMM ANLA 2025 and METT XI

AI.title_translation: 一种高效的随机分层Tucker分解
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的从根到叶的随机分层Tucker分解算法，通过随机投影加速计算，相比现有算法计算速度快一个数量级，且近似误差接近最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的分层Tucker分解算法通常是自底向上（从叶到根）计算的，计算效率有待提高。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的从根到叶（root-to-leaves）方向的分层Tucker分解算法，利用随机投影来加速中间子空间的计算。
AI.result: 该方法将计算时间减少了一个数量级，同时保证了近似的质量，实验结果表明其近似误差与经典界限一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的从根到叶的随机分层Tucker分解算法在计算效率和近似质量方面都表现出色，为高维数据分析中的大规模张量分解提供了有前景的方法。
AI.translation: 我们为计算高阶张量的分层Tucker分解引入了随机算法。与在叶到根方向上执行的传统算法不同，我们的算法沿着根到叶的方向遍历维度树，利用随机的顺序投影来加速中间子空间的计算。与使用叶到根方向的先前随机算法相比，该策略可将计算时间减少一个数量级，同时保证了准最优近似。尽管理论误差界比叶到根方法略大，但在我们所有的实验中，实际误差都符合经典界限。我们的结果突显了该方法在हरूको维数据分析中进行可扩展张量分解的潜力。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种新颖的随机分层Tucker分解算法，该算法采用从根到叶的方向进行计算，并利用随机投影来加速中间子空间的构建。与传统的从叶到根的方法相比，该算法在计算效率上有了显著提升（一个数量级），同时仍能获得接近最优的近似结果。实验证明，该方法在实际应用中的误差符合理论预期，显示出在大规模高维数据分析中进行张量分解的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: 分层Tucker分解, 随机算法, 张量分解, 根到叶方向, 随机投影
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的随机分层Tucker分解算法，通过改变计算方向（从根到叶）并引入随机投影，显著提高了计算效率，同时保持了良好的近似精度。这种方法对于处理大规模高维数据具有重要意义，是张量分解领域的一项有价值的贡献。

title: A complete analytical characterization of optimal collision-free motion for two robots
summary: Collision-free motion planning for multi-agent robotic systems remains an active research area because of the complexity of coordinating robot trajectories, with applications ranging from coordinated drone shows to autonomous operations on land, in the air, and on water. Importantly, the analytical difficulty of nonconvex collision-avoidance constraints has so far driven the development of exclusively numerical methods. We derive a complete analytical characterization of the optimal trajectories for two robots that start and end at rest, under double-integrator dynamics and a squared-acceleration objective. We prove that these trajectories belong to eight distinct contact families and determine which family applies for each configuration of initial and final positions. We analyze the geometrical properties of the optimal trajectories, provide a numerical algorithm for computing them, and discuss how these insights may improve the performance of existing numerical trajectory optimizers.

AI.title_translation: 两台机器人最优无碰撞运动的完整解析刻画
AI.tldr: 本文首次推导出了双机器人在无碰撞条件和特定优化目标下最优运动轨迹的完整解析解，并将其分为八个接触族。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中的无碰撞运动规划由于非凸避碰约束的解析难度，目前几乎完全依赖于数值方法，缺乏完整的解析刻画。
AI.method: 通过数学推导，证明最优轨迹属于八个不同的接触族，并确定了针对不同初始和最终位置配置的适用族，同时给出了数值计算算法。
AI.result: 得出了两台静止起止、具有双积分动力学和平方加速度目标的机器人在最优无碰撞运动下的完整解析刻画，分析了几何性质，并提出了计算算法。
AI.conclusion: 成功推导出了双机器人在满足无碰撞条件及二次加速度目标下的最优轨迹解析解，并将其划分为八个不同的接触族。
AI.translation: 多智能体机器人系统的无碰撞运动规划仍然是一个活跃的研究领域，因为协调机器人轨迹具有复杂性，其应用范围从协调无人机表演到陆地、空中和水上的自主操作。重要的是，非凸防撞约束的解析难度至今推动了纯数值方法的发展。我们推导了两个机器人在双积分动力学和平方加速度目标下，以静止状态开始和结束的最优轨迹的完整解析刻画。我们证明了这些轨迹属于八个不同的接触族，并确定了哪个族适用于初始和最终位置的每个配置。我们分析了几何性质，提供了计算它们的数值算法，并讨论了这些见解如何改善现有数值轨迹优化器的性能。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了双机器人的无碰撞运动规划问题，突破性地推导出了在双积分动力学和平方加速度目标下最优轨迹的完整解析特征，将其分类为八个接触族，并提供了相应的数值计算算法及性能优化见解。
AI.keywords: 无碰撞运动规划, 双机器人, 解析解, 双积分动力学, 最优控制
AI.comments: 该论文突破了以往纯数值方法的局限，首次对双机器人最优无碰撞运动给出了完整的解析刻画，对多智能体运动规划理论的发展具有重要意义。

title: Digital sovereignty in professional translation workflows: a case study of migrating from Windows to Linux
comments: 14 pages, submitted for formal peer review at the 47th Translating and the Computer conference (Luxembourg) 8/10 December 2026
summary: This study examines digital sovereignty in professional translation through a screening of computer-assisted translation tools and translation management systems, and a case study of migrating a translator's workstation from Windows to Linux. The framework combines three principles - Control, Continuity and Exit - with three practical requirements: native Linux operation, independence from mandatory external services, and independent access to essential data and resources. Drawing on documentary evidence and the limited number of responses received from providers, the ecosystem screening distinguishes Linux accessibility from operational independence: browser-based platforms may remain dependent on provider-controlled infrastructure. The migration case demonstrates the feasibility of reconstructing one professional workflow around a locally operable Linux core, using LoopCAT, LibreOffice and locally run TranslateGemma, alongside tools for optical character recognition, communication, credential management and backup. Selected cloud services remained available where needed. The findings suggest that digital sovereignty depends on how workflow dependencies are organized, rather than on individual applications or operating systems. It does not require technological isolation, but meaningful control over essential components, continuity of work and practical exit options. The framework is tailored to the case examined here and may require adaptation to other professional workflows.
comment: 14 pages, submitted for formal peer review at the 47th Translating and the Computer conference (Luxembourg) 8/10 December 2026

AI.title_translation: 专业翻译工作流程中的数字主权：从Windows迁移到Linux的案例研究
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了专业翻译中的数字主权，并通过将翻译工作站从Windows成功迁移至Linux的案例，证明了依托本地开源与离线工具重构自主可控工作流的可行性。
AI.motivation: 探讨专业翻译中的数字主权问题，解决翻译人员过度依赖外部专有基础设施、特定商业软件及操作系统所带来的数据失控、业务中断和供应商锁定等风险。
AI.method: 提出了融合三大原则（控制、连续性、退出）与三项实践要求（原生Linux运行、独立于强制性外部服务、独立访问关键资源）的评估框架；基于文档证据和供应商反馈对CAT及TMS工具生态进行筛选；并通过具体案例将翻译工作站从Windows迁移至Linux，以LoopCAT、LibreOffice、本地部署的TranslateGemma及辅助工具构建本地化核心工作流。
AI.result: 生态筛选表明，Linux上的可访问性不等于操作独立性（基于浏览器的工具仍高度依赖供应商云端）；迁移案例验证了基于本地Linux核心重构专业翻译工作流的可行性，不仅能利用本地化工具满足核心需求，还能在必要时灵活保留特定云服务。
AI.conclusion: 数字主权取决于工作流中依赖关系的组织方式，而非个别应用程序或操作系统本身。实现数字主权无需技术孤立，关键在于对核心组件拥有实质控制力、确保工作连续性，并具备切实可行的退出选项。
AI.translation: 本研究通过对计算机辅助翻译工具和翻译管理系统的筛选，以及将翻译人员工作站从Windows迁移到Linux的案例研究，探讨了专业翻译中的数字主权问题。该分析框架结合了三项原则——控制、连续性和退出，以及三项实践要求：原生Linux运行、独立于强制性外部服务、独立访问关键数据和资源。结合文献证据和从供应商处收到的有限回复，生态筛选区分了Linux上的“可访问性”与“操作独立性”：基于浏览器的平台可能仍然依赖于供应商控制的基础设施。迁移案例表明，围绕本地可运行的Linux核心（采用LoopCAT、LibreOffice和本地运行的TranslateGemma，辅以光学字符识别、通信、凭据管理和备份工具）重构专业工作流程是可行的。在需要时，选定的云服务仍然可用。研究结果表明，数字主权取决于工作流依赖关系的组织方式，而非个别应用程序或操作系统本身。它不需要技术孤立，而是需要对关键组件的实质性控制、工作的连续性以及切实可行的退出选项。该框架专为本研究所涉案例定制，在应用于其他专业工作流程时可能需要调整。
AI.summary: 本文研究了专业翻译领域的数字主权问题。作者制定了涵盖控制、连续性与退出原则的评估框架，并在分析现有翻译软件生态的基础上，通过将一个翻译工作站从Windows系统迁移至Linux的实证案例，证明了利用本地化工具重构专业翻译工作流的可行性，指出数字主权的核心在于合理管控工作流依赖关系而非追求绝对的技术孤立。
AI.keywords: 数字主权, 计算机辅助翻译, 工作流程, Linux迁移, 连续性
AI.comments: 本研究切入点新颖且具有极强的现实意义。在云端CAT/TMS和SaaS模式普及导致数据主权和供应商锁定（Vendor Lock-in）风险加剧的背景下，文章首次系统化地将“数字主权”概念引入专业翻译实践。提出的“控制、连续性、退出”分析框架兼具理论深度与实践指导价值。局限性在于研究主要基于单一翻译工作站的个案，对于高度依赖特定商业闭源生态（如SDL Trados）或复杂团队协作网络的大规模工作流，其迁移策略的普适性仍需进一步检验。

title: SCRBench: Beyond Equivalence Checking for Semantic Change Reasoning in Code
summary: Understanding how code changes affect program semantics is a core aspect of code reasoning in language models. It is commonly evaluated by asking whether two programs are semantically equivalent, but a yes/no answer does not reveal whether a model knows which code change caused a semantic difference, or which sequence of code changes produced the modified program. We study two tasks that ask these questions directly, diagnosing semantic change and reconstructing sequences of code changes, alongside detecting semantic equivalence. We build SCRBench, 67,658 Python program pairs generated by applying sequences of code changes that preserve or alter program semantics, and evaluate five language models on a stratified subset of 4,500 pairs. Detecting semantic equivalence exposes weaker models, whose accuracy declines as changes accumulate, but the strongest models remain near the ceiling. Diagnosing semantic change reveals weaknesses that equivalence accuracy hides: a model with 94.71% equivalence accuracy diagnoses only 54.44% of semantic changes. Reconstructing sequences of code changes is much harder: the best model reconstructs the exact sequence for only 39.27% of pairs, and no model exceeds 1.11% when five changes are applied. High equivalence accuracy therefore overestimates how well models reason about the semantic effects of code changes.

AI.title_translation: SCRBench：超越等价性检查的代码语义变化推理
AI.tldr: 现有语义等价性检查无法完全评估语言模型对代码语义变化的理解。本文提出了两个新任务（诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列）和数据集SCRBench，发现即使在等价性检查中表现好的模型，在这些新任务上也表现不佳，表明现有模型对代码语义变化的推理能力被高估了。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过语义等价性检查来评估语言模型对代码变化的理解，但这种“是/否”的答案无法揭示模型是否知道哪个代码变化导致了语义差异，或者哪些代码变化序列产生了修改后的程序。因此，需要更深入的任务来评估模型对代码语义变化的推理能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了两个新任务：诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列，与检测语义等价性并行评估。构建了SCRBench数据集，包含67,658个Python程序对，通过应用保持或改变程序语义的代码变化序列生成。在4,500个分层子集对上评估了五个语言模型。
AI.result: 检测语义等价性任务暴露了较弱模型的缺陷，但最强模型仍接近上限。诊断语义变化任务揭示了等价性准确率所隐藏的弱点：一个具有94.71%等价性准确率的模型只能诊断54.44%的语义变化。重建代码变化序列任务难度更大：最佳模型只能为39.27%的程序对重建出精确的序列，当应用五个变化时，没有模型超过1.11%。高等价性准确率高估了模型推理代码变化语义效果的能力。
AI.conclusion: 现有的语义等价性检查高估了语言模型对代码语义变化推理的能力。更细粒度的任务（如诊断语义变化和重建变化序列）揭示了模型在理解代码语义变化方面的显著局限性。
AI.translation: 理解代码变化如何影响程序语义是语言模型中代码推理的核心方面。这通常通过询问两个程序是否语义等价来评估，但“是/否”的答案无法揭示模型是否知道哪个代码变化导致了语义差异，或者哪个代码变化序列产生了修改后的程序。我们研究了直接询问这些问题的两个任务：诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列，以及检测语义等价性。我们构建了SCRBench，一个包含67,658个Python程序对的数据集，这些程序对通过应用保持或改变程序语义的代码变化序列生成。我们评估了五个语言模型在4,500个分层子集对上的表现。检测语义等价性任务暴露了较弱模型的不足，其准确率随着变化的积累而下降，但最强的模型仍接近上限。诊断语义变化任务揭示了等价性准确率所隐藏的弱点：一个具有94.71%等价性准确率的模型只能诊断54.44%的语义变化。重建代码变化序列的难度更大：最佳模型只能为39.27%的程序对重建出精确的序列，当应用五个变化时，没有模型超过1.11%。因此，高的等价性准确率高估了模型推理代码变化语义效果的能力。
AI.summary: 本文指出，现有的语义等价性检查不足以全面评估语言模型对代码语义变化的理解能力。为此，作者提出了SCRBench数据集，包含67,658个Python程序对，并引入了诊断语义变化和重建代码变化序列这两个新任务，以更细致地评估模型。实验结果表明，即使在语义等价性检查中表现优异的模型，在诊断和重建任务上的表现也显著下降，尤其是在变化数量增加时。这表明，高估了语言模型在代码语义变化推理方面的实际能力。
AI.keywords: 代码语义变化, 语言模型, 语义等价性, SCRBench, 代码推理
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入更细粒度的评估任务和数据集SCRBench，揭示了当前语言模型在理解代码语义变化方面存在的深层局限性，即使它们在传统的语义等价性检查中表现良好。这对于未来代码理解模型的研究方向具有重要指导意义，强调了超越简单二元判断的必要性。

title: ORION: An Outcome-Driven LLM Advisor for RL-Based Multi-Domain 6G Slice Placement
summary: Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. This joint decision problem is NP-hard under continuous arrivals. Experiments on a parametrized family of multi-domain topologies show that no fixed planning strategy dominates across all regimes: the performance ranking reverses between topology classes, and feasible placements exist for most rejected requests but remain undiscovered. These findings identify the plan layer as the decisive performance lever. We introduce ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator in which two LLM agents translate service intents into structured requests and generate abstract placement plans. A cooperative multi-agent RL coordinator selects the cross-domain partition, treating the plan as a persistent soft prior, while per-domain agents place the functions. ORION main contribution lies at the plan layer: an outcome-driven episodic memory that records, for each completed attempt, the network-condition profile, the proposed plan, and its verified feasibility outcome. The memory feeds verified successes and labelled failures back to the planner, thereby closing the adaptation loop using deployment feasibility rather than a scalar reward assigned to the planner's own proposals. To isolate the effect of the plan quality, we evaluate the planner on held-out topology families while keeping the downstream selection and execution mechanisms fixed. Under this controlled setting, the proposed memory improves admission by $4.6$--$11.5$ percentage points over the same planner without memory, while importance-based retention accounts for most of the improvement over a first-in-first-out store.

AI.title_translation: ORION：面向基于强化学习的多域6G切片部署的结果驱动型大模型顾问
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ORION的基于LLM和强化学习的多域6G切片部署顾问，通过引入结果导向的情节记忆机制，显著提升了网络切片的接纳率。
AI.motivation: 在连续到达请求下，跨行政域部署6G网络切片的联合决策问题属于NP-hard问题，且实验发现没有单一的固定规划策略能在所有场景下占优，现有的规划层缺乏基于部署可行性的自适应闭环机制。
AI.method: 提出ORION分层编排器。其中包含两个LLM智能体（负责将服务意图转化为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划）、一个多智能体强化学习协调器（选择跨域分区并将计划作为持久软先验），以及按域运行的智能体；同时引入了结果导向的情节记忆机制，将网络条件、提议计划及验证后的可行性结果记录并反馈给规划器。
AI.result: 在控制变量的评估设置下，所提出的记忆机制使切片接纳率比没有记忆的同类规划器提高了4.6至11.5个百分点，其中基于重要性的保留策略是提升性能的关键所在。
AI.conclusion: ORION通过引入基于结果导向的情形记忆机制，有效解决了6G多域切片部署中的NP-hard决策难题，显著提升了网络切片的接纳率和规划性能。
AI.translation: 在跨行政域部署6G网络切片时，每个到达的请求都需要在线决策：哪个域托管哪个虚拟网络功能、流量如何穿过域边界以及是否接纳该切片。在连续到达的情况下，这个联合决策问题是NP-hard的。对一组参数化多域拓扑族的实验表明，没有一种固定的规划策略能够在所有机制下占优：性能排名在拓扑类别之间发生逆转，并且大多数被拒绝的请求实际上存在可行但未被发现的部署方案。这些发现确定了规划层是决定性能的关键杠杆。我们引入了ORION，这是一个分层编排器，其中两个LLM智能体将服务意图转化为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划。一个合作式多智能体强化学习协调器选择跨域分区，将计划视为持久的软先验，而各个域的智能体则负责放置功能。ORION的主要贡献在于规划层：一个结果导向的情节记忆机制，它记录每个完成的尝试的网络条件配置文件、提出的计划及其验证后的可行性结果。该记忆将验证成功的案例和标记失败的案例反馈给规划器，从而利用部署可行性（而不是分配给规划器自身提案的标量奖励）闭环适应过程。为了隔离计划质量的影响，我们在保留下游选择和执行机制不变的情况下，在未见过的拓扑族上评估了规划器。在此受控设置下，所提出的记忆机制使接纳率比没有记忆的同一规划器提高了 $4.6$ 到 $11.5$ 个百分点，而基于重要性的保留机制解释了其优于先进先出存储的大部分改进。
AI.summary: 本文针对6G多域网络切片部署中复杂的联合决策难题，提出了名为ORION的层次化编排器。ORION创新性地结合了LLM智能体与多智能体强化学习，并引入了一种结果导向的情节记忆机制，通过记录部署成功与失败的真实反馈来闭环优化规划层，实验证明该方法显著提升了切片接纳率。
AI.keywords: 6G网络切片, 大语言模型, 多智能体强化学习, 资源编排, 情节记忆
AI.comments: 本文将大语言模型（LLM）与多智能体强化学习相结合，提出了一种面向6G网络切片部署的创新框架ORION。其核心亮点在于将部署可行性直接反馈给规划层，通过情境记忆机制有效闭环自适应过程，显著提升了切片接纳率，对未来智能网络资源调度具有重要的参考价值。

title: Verify--Backtrack Loop: Structured Precondition Recovery for Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Language agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks in interactive environments, where actions often depend on latent preconditions. The core difficulty is not trajectory length but recovery: when a prerequisite is missing or an earlier decomposition fails, trying another plausible action rarely helps. ReAct and later reflection or adaptive-planning methods support local correction, but express recovery as free-form text, with no explicit control state linking the terminal goal, the active goal, and the failure source. We introduce the Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL), a training-free extension of ReAct that turns precondition discovery and failure diagnosis into structured planning-state updates. VBL maintains the task decomposition as a bounded goal stack and, on goal activation, execution failure, or material state change, jointly verifies two horizons---whether the active goal contributes to the terminal goal and whether it is feasible in the current state. These dual-horizon judgments, combined with typed failure attribution, trigger explicit operations---Push, Pop, retry, or BacktrackTo the parent. We evaluate VBL with Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-V3.2 on AppWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld. VBL improves over ReAct and reflection-based control on every backbone--benchmark pair. On the challenging AppWorld setting, it improves task success by up to 22.07 percentage points over ReAct. Ablations show that removing either verification or diagnosis degrades performance, in several settings below ReAct, confirming that the two mechanisms are complementary. These results show that reliable long-horizon interaction benefits from revising the planning state, not merely the next action.

AI.title_translation: 验证-回溯循环：长视距语言智能体的结构化先决条件恢复
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL)的无训练方法，通过结构化规划状态更新和双重视距验证，显著提升了语言智能体在长视距任务中的恢复能力和成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在交互式环境中处理长视距任务时，动作往往依赖于潜在的先决条件。核心困难在于恢复（当先决条件缺失或早期分解失败时，尝试其他看似合理的动作很少有帮助）。现有的 ReAct、反射或自适应规划方法将恢复表达为自由文本，缺乏将终极目标、活动目标和失败根源联系起来的显式控制状态。因此，需要一种结构化的先决条件恢复方法来提高长视距交互的可靠性。
AI.method: 引入Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL) 框架，作为 ReAct 的无训练扩展。它将任务分解维护为一个有界目标栈，并在目标激活、执行失败或状态变化时，联合验证两个视距（活动目标是否对终极目标有贡献以及当前状态下是否可行），结合类型化的失败归因，触发显式操作（Push、Pop、重试或回溯到父目标）。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上结合 Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-4o 和 DeepSeek-V3.2 进行评估，VBL 在所有骨干网络与基准测试的配对上均优于 ReAct 和基于反射的控制方法。在更具挑战性的 AppWorld 设置中，它将任务成功率比 ReAct 提升了多达 22.07 个百分点。消融实验表明，移除验证或诊断中的任何一个都会导致性能下降，证明了这两个机制的互补性。
AI.conclusion: Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL) 是一种用于长视距语言智能体的、无需训练的结构化先决条件恢复方法，它通过维护有界目标栈、联合验证和定型失败归因，显著优于传统的 ReAct 及基于反射的方法，证明了修改规划状态对长视距交互的重要性。
AI.translation: 语言智能体越来越多地在交互式环境中处理长视距任务，其中的动作往往依赖于潜在的先决条件。核心难易点不在于轨迹长度，而在于恢复：当先决条件缺失或早期的分解失败时，尝试另一个合理的动作很少有帮助。ReAct 及后续的反射或自适应规划方法支持局部纠正，但将恢复表达为自由文本，缺乏连接终极目标、活动目标和失败源的显式控制状态。我们引入了验证-回溯循环（Verify--Backtrack Loop, VBL），这是 ReAct 的一个无需训练的扩展，它将先决条件发现和失败诊断转化为结构化的规划状态更新。VBL 将任务分解维护为一个有界的目标栈，并且在目标激活、执行失败或实质性状态变化时，联合验证两个视距——活动目标是否有助于终极目标，以及它在当前状态下是否可行。这些双重视距判断与类型化失败归因相结合，触发显式操作——推送（Push）、弹出（Pop）、重试（retry）或回溯到父节点（BacktrackTo）。我们在 AppWorld、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上使用 Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-4o 和 DeepSeek-V3.2 对 VBL 进行了评估。在每一个骨干网络-基准测试对上，VBL 的表现均优于 ReAct 和基于反射的控制。在极具挑战性的 AppWorld 设置中，它比 ReAct 的任务成功率提高了 22.07 个百分点。消融实验表明，移除验证或诊断中的任何一个都会降低性能，在几个设置中甚至低于 ReAct，这证实了这两种机制是互补的。这些结果表明，可靠的长视距交互受益于修改规划状态，而不仅仅是修改下一个动作。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL)，一个用于长视距语言智能体的结构化先决条件恢复框架。VBL 通过有界目标栈维护任务分解，利用双重视距联合验证和类型化失败归因来触发显式规划状态操作（如 Push、Pop、BacktrackTo）。实验表明，VBL 在多个基准测试中显著提升了任务成功率，优于传统的 ReAct 和反射方法。
AI.keywords: 语言智能体, 长视距任务, 结构化规划, 先决条件恢复, 任务分解
AI.comments: 该论文提出了Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL)，将长视距语言智能体的先决条件发现和失败诊断转化为结构化的规划状态更新。创新点在于引入了有界的任务目标栈以及对双重视距（active goal对terminal goal的贡献及当前状态下的可行性）的联合验证，这比传统的自由文本反射更具控制力和系统性。消融实验证明了验证和诊断机制的互补性，对于提升长视距任务的成功率具有重要意义。

title: Poly Versus Polyval
summary: We revisit the basic construction of polynomial evaluation based hash function, which we call Poly, over binary extension fields over $GF(2^n)$, where $n=64k$ and $k\geq 2$. Unlike GHASH, the NIST standard polynomial evaluation based hash function for $n=128$, Poly does not perform the unnecessary bit reversals of each $n$-bit block, and consequently is faster than GHASH. Further, Poly differs from Polyval, -- a faster alternative to GHASH, -- in that Poly performs usual reduction, while Polyval performs Montgomery reduction. We identify suitable choices of the field representing irreducible polynomials which makes usual and Montgomery reductions efficient. We provide detailed algorithms, and associated proofs of correctness for both kinds of reductions. Based on the algorithms, we report carefully optimised assembly implementation of both Poly and Polyval for $n=128,256$ and $512$. Our theoretical analysis and experimental timing results show that for $n=128$, Polyval is faster than Poly, while for $n=256$ and $512$ (as well as for higher values of $n$), Poly is faster than Polyval. The cases $n=128$ and $256$ are of current relevance due to the ongoing NIST process for developing cryptographic accordions.

AI.title_translation: Poly 与 Polyval 的对比
AI.tldr: 本文对比并优化了散列函数 Poly 与 Polyval 在不同扩展域大小下的性能，发现 $n=128$ 时 Polyval 更快，而 $n \geq 256$ 时 Poly 更快。
AI.motivation: 现有的 NIST 标准散列函数 GHASH 包含不必要的位反转操作，而其改进型 Polyval 采用 Montgomery 约简。为了探索在更大的扩展域（如 $n=256, 512$ 等）下采用常规约简的 Poly 是否能超越 Polyval，论文重新审视并优化了 Poly 和 Polyval 的基础结构与约简算法。
AI.method: 研究了二进制扩展域 $GF(2^n)$ 上的多项式求值散列函数 Poly 和 Polyval，选择合适的不可约多项式以实现高效的常规约简和 Montgomery 约简，提供了详细的算法及正确性证明，并针对 $n=128, 256, 512$ 进行了优化的汇编实现与性能评估。
AI.result: 理论分析与实验结果表明，在 $n=128$ 时，Polyval 的运行速度快于 Poly；但在 $n=256$、$512$ 以及更高的 $n$ 值时，Poly 的运行速度则快于 Polyval。
AI.conclusion: 通过精细优化的汇编实现与理论分析，论文得出结论：当 $n=128$ 时 Polyval 更快，而当 $n \geq 256$ 时 Poly 更快，为未来密码学协议的选择提供了实用的性能基准。
AI.translation: 我们重新审视了基于多项式求值的散列函数（称为 Poly）的基本结构，该函数构建于 $GF(2^n)$ 的二元扩展域之上，其中 $n=64k$ 且 $k \geq 2$。与 GHASH（针对 $n=128$ 的 NIST 标准多项式求值散列函数）不同，Poly 不需要对每个 $n$ 位块进行不必要的位反转，因此比 GHASH 更快。此外，Poly 与 Polyval（GHASH 的更快替代方案）的不同之处在于，Poly 执行常规约简，而 Polyval 执行 Montgomery 约简。我们确定了使常规约简和 Montgomery 约简高效的域表示不可约多项式的合适选择。我们为这两种约简提供了详细的算法以及相关的正确性证明。基于这些算法，我们报告了针对 $n=128、256$ 和 $512$ 的 Poly 和 Polyval 的仔细优化汇编实现。我们的理论分析和实验计时结果表明，对于 $n=128$，Polyval 比 Poly 快，而对于 $n=256$ 和 $512$（以及更高的 $n$ 值），Poly 比 Polyval 快。由于当前正在进行开发密码学协议的 NIST 进程，$n=128$ 和 $256$ 的情况具有现实意义。
AI.summary: 本文重新研究了二进制扩展域 $GF(2^n)$ 上基于多项式求值的散列函数 Poly（采用常规约简）与 Polyval（采用 Montgomery 约简），给出了详细算法与正确性证明。通过对 $n=128, 256, 512$ 的优化汇编实现，实验证明在 $n=128$ 时 Polyval 更快，而在 $n \geq 256$ 时 Poly 表现更优。
AI.keywords: Poly, Polyval, GHASH, 多项式求值散列函数, 二进制扩展域
AI.comments: 该论文重新审视并优化了基于多项式求值的散列函数 Poly 与 Polyval，深入探讨了不同二进制扩展域上的约简算法，并通过汇编实现证明了在不同参数 $n$ 下两者的性能优劣，对密码学标准制定具有重要参考价值。

title: Channel Measurement and Characteristics Analysis for Indoor Flexible Pinching Antenna Systems in the mmWave Band
summary: Pinching antenna (PA) systems offer flexible antenna configurations for future wireless communications, yet how PA geometry, orientation, and position affect channel characteristics in practical environments remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, this paper first presents an indoor PA system channel measurement campaign at 59.5~GHz. A dedicated time-domain channel sounder is developed with frequency conversion and a circular-waveguide-to-dielectric-waveguide transition to feed the radio frequency (RF) signal into a flexible dielectric waveguide. Using this platform, office measurements quantify channel attenuation and channel characteristics by examining four PA geometries, arc PA orientation, circle PA pinching position, and transmitter--receiver height difference. The channel measurement data are analyzed in terms of path loss, shadow fading, root-mean-square (RMS) delay spread, Rician K-factor, normalized capacity, and spatial similarity. Indoor path loss models for PA systems are fitted for each PA geometry. The results reveal geometry-dependent attenuation and shadow-fading variability, with the arc PA showing greater variability than the circle PA. Arc PA rotation shifts the delay spread and conditional K-factor distributions. Moving the circle PA produces nonmonotonic changes in delay spread and normalized capacity, while spatial similarity remains relatively high at many receiver locations as the pinching position changes. These observations provide an empirical basis for PA systems channel model and system design.

title: Connectivity-Aware Client Selection in Decentralized Federated Learning
summary: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) has emerged as a scalable alternative to centralized federated learning, removing the single point of failure and communication bottleneck at the server. However, most existing decentralized approaches rely on full-neighborhood broadcasting, where each client transmits its model update to all of its neighbors in each communication round. While effective, this results in significant communication overhead and high energy consumption. This paper applies spectral graph tools as lightweight client selection methods that leverage the graph topology by analyzing the spectral properties of the graph Laplacian over a fixed communication graph. Specifically, we exploit eigenvector embeddings and heat/diffusion kernel similarities to guide each client in selecting only a subset of structurally relevant neighbors, i.e., those that are most beneficial for the convergence of the federation process. This topology aware randomization matches or outperforms uniform neighborhood subsampling and approaches the accuracy of full broadcasting. The largest gains, about $3$ percentage points, emerge under strong data heterogeneity on larger, structurally rich graphs, while the total number of transmitted messages is reduced by $50\%$ compared to naive broadcasting.

title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
comments: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/RuurdKuiper/BYOD ; Gemma demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Ruurd/byod-gemma-2-9b . Links to all four demos are included in the paper
summary: Unlike autoregressive (AR) models, diffusion language models (DLMs) permit parallel token updates, flexible generation, and bidirectional attention, but leading systems rely on costly pretraining or full-model fine-tuning. We present Build Your Own DLM (BYOD), a generalizable LoRA-only recipe for parameter-efficient AR-to-DLM conversion. Without architecture-specific tuning, BYOD induces diffusion generation in Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, and Ministral 8B; to our knowledge, this is the first reported AR-to-DLM conversion of a Mistral model. The adapters comprise 4.1-5.8% of final parameters while every base-model parameter remains frozen; each 25,000-iteration conversion needs at most 102.4M tokens, processed in 3.1-4.0 hours on one Google Colab GPU. All four models generate from fully masked sequences, use bidirectional context in a controlled attention test, and retain substantial parent-model knowledge. BYOD-Gemma is the strongest BYOD conversion on our nine-task evaluation, reaching 50.6% average accuracy compared with 51.9% for LLaDA 8B Instruct in the same harness. Open-generation quality at low network function evaluation (NFE) budgets remains the principal limitation: BYOD perplexity is 8.3-11.1 versus 4.1 for LLaDA and 2.2-3.0 for the AR parents when generating 128 tokens in 64 steps. To enable further experimentation and inspection, we provide a standalone training and evaluation implementation and interactive demos for all four conversions. BYOD thus provides a practical route for extending diffusion generation to other existing model families while identifying the gap that efficient conversion must next close.
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/RuurdKuiper/BYOD ; Gemma demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Ruurd/byod-gemma-2-9b . Links to all four demos are included in the paper

title: Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B: Adapting a 2.6B Hybrid Model to Tajik Tool Calling, and What Continued Pretraining Takes Away
comments: 12 pages, 9 tables, 3 figures. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B
summary: We release Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B, a Tajik adaptation of the 2.6B-parameter hybrid model LFM2.5-2.6B-Base, built for tool calling in Tajik on modest hardware. The recipe has two stages: LoRA continued pretraining (CPT) on 1,485,319 cleaned Tajik web documents for 3 epochs, then one epoch of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a mix of machine-translated Tajik tool calls, English tool calls kept as replay, and Tajik instructions. On a 174-item tool-calling test set built from BFCL v3 and machine-translated to Tajik, strict full-call accuracy on Tajik prompts rises from 20.69 for the base model to 64.14 (paired difference +43.45 points, 95% interval +35.2 to +51.7); a lenient parser that also accepts the base model's own call formats puts the base at 31.72. English shows no detectable change (76.55 and 77.24). Every CPT checkpoint scores zero: CPT removes the native tool-call format and, as the lenient re-scoring shows, part of the skill itself. Outside tool calling, accuracy on a Tajik knowledge benchmark rises from 28.0 to 35.0, Belebele Tajik shows no significant change, and English MMLU falls from 60.8 to 52.5. The model is not a general Tajik assistant. It almost never declines when no tool fits (6.9% correct on Tajik, against 31.0% for the base under the lenient parser), it is weak at multi-turn calls, and its calls should be checked before they are executed. We describe the data, the training settings and every evaluation in enough detail to repeat them.
comment: 12 pages, 9 tables, 3 figures. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B

title: Exact construction of quasi-uniform designs over polytopal domains
summary: We develop two sampling algorithms for constructing extensible designs with mesh ratio at most two on finite unions of full-dimensional rational convex polytopes. Starting from a rational initial point, both algorithms produce rational coordinates and perform the geometric comparisons governing point selection exactly. This ensures that distance ties and geometric degeneracies are handled without rounding ambiguity, preserving the prescribed selection rules and mesh-ratio guarantee at every stage. The first algorithm, Local Exact Farthest-Point Sampling (LEFPS), implements a prescribed farthest-point rule by local updates of the restricted Voronoi diagram. The second algorithm, Arithmetic-Aware Admissible Sampling (AAS), minimizes the representation length of reduced rational coordinates over admissible fragment vertices and edge midpoints. Since the cost of exact arithmetic depends on coordinate lengths, we analyze both operation counts and bit complexity. For fixed dimension and input, each sampling rule admits an $O(N\log N)$ unit-cost implementation and a separate implementation with $\widetilde O(L_N)$ bit complexity, where $L_N$ is the total length of the output coordinates. On rational interval covers, every admissible sequence from the vertex-midpoint candidate set has logarithmic coordinate height. We also identify the ordered sequences explicitly for LEFPS on interval unions and four-dimensional coordinate-order domains, and for AAS on a rectangle and a nonconvex cross. These descriptions yield direct generation with $O(N)$ unit-cost work and optimal $Θ(N\log N)$ bit work, including exact quality measures at every prefix. Numerical experiments compare local Voronoi maintenance, coordinate growth, and direct generation.

title: Patch-Based Deep Kernel Learning for Data Assimilation and Bias Correction with Extremely Sparse Observations
summary: Data Assimilation (DA) reconstructs the state of a spatio-temporal system by combining sensor observations with the output of a numerical model. Since model states are high-dimensional while observations cover only a small fraction of the domain, DA is a challenging large-scale estimation problem, central to weather forecasting and oceanography. Classical variational methods such as 3D-Var rely on a hand-crafted background error covariance that assumes unbiased errors, and therefore cannot capture state-dependent correlations or systematic model biases. Moreover, their cost grows with the size of the domain. Deep learning (DL) methods can perform DA and bias correction (BC) non-linearly, but typically offer limited interpretability and no calibrated uncertainty estimates. We propose a hybrid framework that couples a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a learnable-kernel Gaussian Process (GP) to jointly perform DA and BC from extremely sparse observations. The model is trained end-to-end by maximizing the marginal log-likelihood, learns a data-driven covariance over the whole grid, and provides both the Maximum A Posteriori analysis and its uncertainty by design. A patch-based strategy reduces the $O(N^3)$ training cost of exact GPs over $N$ grid points to $O(N)$ for a fixed patch size. Inference remains exact and only requires solving a linear system whose $O(m^3)$ cost depends on the number of observations $m \ll N$, not on the domain. The learned covariance can also replace the hand-crafted one in 3D-Var, improving its accuracy without changing the variational formulation. Experiments on sea surface temperature and salinity, with both synthetic and real, extremely sparse in-situ observations, show that the framework outperforms 3D-Var, a classical GP and a competing DL model, while reducing inference time by more than 98% with respect to 3D-Var.

title: Serial Rug-Pull-Like Exits on Pump.fun: Team-Level Evidence and Its Sensitivity to Team Construction
summary: We study repeated, team-associated selling around sharp collapses of Pump.fun tokens in several deliberately selected data windows, separating the measurement from claims of fraud, common ownership or realized profit. Because token prices derived from trade amounts are not fully reliable, we compare a price-based screen with a screen that uses only the bonding-curve reserve and SOL amounts; most price-based episodes are also found by the reserve screen. Episodes concentrate in groups well beyond a within-hour label-shuffle benchmark, and most of them are collapses sold by a single creator wallet. The recorded own-token cash flow of the identified groups is positive in most windows and negative in a few, but the sign of the negative results is fragile: it changes with the screen, with the definition of a group, with the length of the window and with trading costs of about two per cent per side. A daily SOL price covariate shows no association with the incidence of episodes. An agent-based simulation of a team exit on a bonding curve, extended with a latent attention to each token and calibrated to marginal moments of the data, shows that the team's result depends mainly on the attention that tokens attract, on fees and on the team's own trading, that continual trading by the team is costly and that reacting to the inflow of other traders adds little. The model reproduces the sign of group-level results but not the early exits that are common in the data. Missing token transfers, verified migration labels and human-labelled validation prevent identifying operator profit or fraud prevalence.

title: Scout-Refine-Correct: Teaching Flow Models to Refine Their Own Samples
summary: The quality of image generation models trained with diffusion or flow matching is largely fixed by the training budget: at inference, the only available lever is the number of sampling steps, and additional steps improve quality only up to a point. We present a training recipe, Scout-Refine-Correct (SRC), that instead gives a flow-matching generator a genuine inference-time refinement capability. At each sampling step the model takes a scout rollout -- $K$ steps ahead along its own trajectory -- extrapolates a full-sample estimate, and feeds that estimate back to itself as a self-conditioning signal before taking the real step. This can be repeated for $R$ refinement rounds. Two correction losses, applied during training at states the model's own rollouts actually reach rather than only on the ground-truth path, teach the model to use this signal to reach new samples instead of collapsing to a suboptimal one. On ImageNet-256, SRC improves LightningDiT-B from FID~14.5 to FID~7.26 at NFE~550, matching a privileged best-of-$N$ baseline that uses an oracle FID verifier to choose among samples. SRC uses no external verifier, no reward signal, and, after ablation, almost no extra parameters over the base architecture. Combining SRC with best-of-$N$ improves the result further, to FID~3.81 at NFE~4400, showing that the two axes are complementary. We ablate the main design choices -- the architectural pathway for the scout signal, the scout horizon, each correction loss, and the training schedule to demonstrate key working components of training.

title: DrawSplat: Atlanta World-Guided Implicit Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Reconstruction
summary: RGB-D SLAM requires accurate online tracking, high-quality rendering, and geometrically consistent reconstruction. Existing Gaussian SLAM methods mainly optimize Gaussian primitives with photometric, depth, or local frame-to-model constraints, which are often insufficient in indoor scenes with weak textures, large planar structures, noisy depth, and long trajectories. The resulting maps may suffer from pose drift, surface thickness artifacts, noisy normals, and blurred structural boundaries. We propose DrawSplat, an Atlanta World-guided implicit Gaussian SLAM framework for indoor reconstruction. DrawSplat follows a drawing-like process: explicit point-line geometry first sketches the structural layout, and implicit neural Gaussians then fill in high-fidelity appearance and continuous geometric details. It estimates camera poses, sparse geometry, and gravity direction through point-line joint tracking, infers structural planes from tracked lines using the shared-gravity component of the Atlanta World prior, and converts them into differentiable regularization terms on Gaussian centers and normals. To improve compactness and efficiency, DrawSplat further combines an anchor-based implicit neural Gaussian representation with adaptive structural sampling, which allocates Gaussian capacity to structurally informative regions. Experiments on multiple datasets show that DrawSplat achieves robust tracking, high-fidelity rendering, and strong geometric reconstruction among Gaussian-based SLAM systems, while maintaining a practical balance among quality, efficiency, and model size.

title: Real Computation or Merely Naming? A Pre-Registered Mechanism Audit of 25 Cognitive-Architecture Modules in an LLM-Based Agent System
comments: 40 pages. Static audit of 25 cognitive-architecture modules (18 carry no computed value to any production output), pre-registered interventions on 11 modules, 61 frozen criteria (53 confirmed / 5 falsified), two repair controls (0.028 -> 1.000 task success; -52% error). Artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23433900
summary: Agent systems built on local large language models are increasingly marketed through the vocabulary of cognitive architecture: modules named global workspace, theory of mind, causal reasoning, or active inference are listed as features, and the presence of the name is taken as the presence of the mechanism. We ask the prior question -- does the named computation actually happen -- and contribute a transferable verification method for the claim-implementation gap: a four-question static audit protocol with line-number evidence and call-chain tracing, demonstrated on two systems. We audit a system claiming 25 cognitive mechanisms, pre-register falsifiable predictions for 11 modules and execute the interventions, replicate the protocol on the IIT-phi core of a second, independent system with its own pre-committed falsification criteria, and run two repair experiments as positive controls. In 18 of 25 modules the computed value never reaches any production output; three idle-wiring shapes new to the dead-code and code-smell literatures emerge (connected-but-never-called, called-but-inert, called-but-content-blind). Of 61 frozen criteria across 12 interventions, 53 were confirmed, two partially adjudicated, five falsified, one adjudication-ambiguous. Repairs raised planner task success from 0.028 to 1.000 and cut state-controller error by 52%. Module names and module computations must be audited as independent claims; the protocol and the five-class failure taxonomy are reusable for the claim-implementation gap at two-system, case-level depth.

Static audit of 25 cognitive-architecture modules (18 carry no computed value to any production output), pre-registered interventions on 11 modules, 61 frozen criteria (53 confirmed / 5 falsified), two repair controls (0.028 -> 1.000 task success; -52% error). title: An energy-constrained implicit step-and-truncate algorithm and its robust error estimates
summary: Deriving mesh-robust error bounds is an open problem for low-rank methods, including dynamical low-rank (DLR) and step-and-truncate (SAT) approaches, as highlighted in a recent review. Existing bounds can depend on Lipschitz constants that grow with inverse mesh size, making them impractical, particularly for kinetic equations, a major application of low-rank methods. We develop a unified framework for implicit SAT that provides a discrete counterpart of energy-localization analysis for nonlinear partial differential equations. By restricting numerical solutions to energy-localized regions, we obtain one-sided Lipschitz stability with constants independent of spatial resolution. The resulting error estimates and time-step restrictions are mesh robust, answering this open problem for the class of implicit SAT schemes covered by our assumptions. We emphasize that energy localization provides a general mechanism for mesh-independent robust error estimates in low-rank approximation, extending beyond the SAT methods considered here. Analogous results for DLR methods will be presented in subsequent work. Returning to implicit SAT, we demonstrate the broad applicability of the framework through error estimates for different classes of equations. Specifically, for semilinear parabolic and Vlasov--Poisson equations, we establish robust first-order error bounds for backward-Euler SAT under suitable regularity assumptions. Energy localization also has practical implications. We design an energy-constrained implicit SAT algorithm. Implicit SAT methods without energy constraints can select incorrect solution branches even when their algebraic residuals are small. Moreover, time-step reduction can be essential for continuation into larger energy regions. Numerical experiments support these conclusions.

title: VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act: Unintended Task Execution and Start Suppression
summary: A robot should act only on an instruction from a person or on an intent that the robot explicitly represents and generates. Unintended actions taken without such an instruction can cause risk or inconvenience to people and the environment. We examine how recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies respond when the instruction is missing or meaningless. We apply a paired protocol with empty, neutral, nonsense, infeasible, and wrong-task instructions to six model checkpoints in LIBERO-Goal simulation. Holding the initial state fixed and varying only the instruction, we ask three questions: whether the robot starts to move, which task it completes, and what the instruction determines. Even when the instruction was empty, the robot started moving in every episode with all six checkpoints, and with five of them it often completed a task that the instruction had not specified. On two GR00T checkpoints, the instruction determined which task was executed but not whether the robot started moving; the robot moved even on infeasible instructions. We then tested three methods for suppressing the start: prepending "if no task is given do not move" to the instruction; a gate that holds the robot when the first action chunk for the given instruction nearly equals that for an empty instruction; and fine-tuning the policy to hold still on non-task inputs. The prefix stopped the robot in none of the six checkpoints, and the gate held it on non-task inputs in five of the six checkpoints. The fine-tuned policy never completed a task on non-task inputs, but it did not reliably keep the robot still, and it failed to suppress the start on infeasible instructions.

title: What Should LLMs Forget: Reinforcement Unlearning of Knowledge Associations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) acquire extensive factual knowledge during pre-training, which may include sensitive, private, or copyrighted information, motivating the development of unlearning methods that selectively remove specific knowledge while preserving general capabilities. However, existing approaches typically optimize entire responses without explicitly identifying the knowledge to be forgotten, resulting in coarse and uncontrolled forgetting. To address this, we revisit the forgetting target of LLM unlearning and introduce Knowledge Association (KA), which characterizes the association between a query context and its target knowledge and is instantiated by the corresponding conditional predictive distribution, as the fundamental target of forgetting. Based on KA, we propose Knowledge Association Reinforcement Unlearning (KARU), a unified reinforcement learning framework that suppresses forgotten knowledge associations while preserving retained ones. Specifically, KARU derives complementary mechanisms from the KA-based formulation: token-level reward construction for finer-grained forgetting supervision, distribution-level regularization for precise knowledge suppression, and proximity-aware retain sampling to mitigate collateral degradation. Experiments across diverse LLMs on representative benchmarks demonstrate that KARU consistently improves forgetting effectiveness over existing baselines while maintaining comparable retention performance and general utility.

title: Prompt Less, Infer More: Static Analysis-Guided LLM Type Annotation for Python
summary: Type annotations improve the maintainability and reliability of Python programs, but many real-world projects remain under-annotated because manual annotation is time-consuming and error-prone. Recent neural and LLM-based type inference systems can recover missing annotations, yet they often trade accuracy for efficiency. Existing approaches often fail to exploit project-wide type evidence, or do so inefficiently through unnecessary model calls and noisy prompts. We present SALT, an LLM-based type inference system guided by static analysis. SALT integrates static analysis with LLM inference to resolve types statically, prioritize LLM queries, and construct concise type-aware context. To demonstrate the effectiveness of SALT, we evaluated it on 12 real-world Python projects. SALT achieves the best accuracy among the evaluated systems and reduces estimated LLM cost by up to 78.5% compared with a strong coding-assistant baseline. It also shows similar cost savings with the frontier model GPT-5.5, demonstrating that SALT remains effective with strong LLMs.

title: Attention Maps Know When to Think: Training-Free Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard reasoning strategy in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), showing strong performance in complex vision-language tasks such as reasoning segmentation. However, our analysis reveals that indiscriminate CoT usage can lead to degraded performance by inducing unnecessary reasoning, a phenomenon we term overthinking. In reasoning segmentation, overthinking often leads to misalignment between the query's intent and visual grounding. To address this, we propose Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT), a training-free adaptive framework that selectively triggers CoT based on the input's intrinsic difficulty. We find that the entropy of the model's attention maps reliably reflects task difficulty: low entropy indicates confident, localized grounding, while high entropy suggests uncertainty and potential benefit from CoT. DA-CoT uses this entropy signal to determine whether to apply CoT prompting. Additionally, we introduce a Bidirectional Rethinking mechanism that enables the model to automatically flip its reasoning decision when the initial output fails, enhancing robustness by recovering from failures induced by overthinking and underthinking. DA-CoT demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Reasoning Segmentation benchmarks while significantly improving inference efficiency.

title: List 3-Coloring in tame classes of graphs in quasipolynomial time
summary:
A class of graphs $\mathcal{G}$ is tame if there is a constant c such that every $n$-vertex graph in $\mathcal{G}$ has at most $n^c$ minimal separators. Many important graph classes are tame, including chordal graphs, permutation graphs, and circle graphs. Several fundamental problems, most notably Max Weight Independent Set, can be solved in polynomial time on every tame class, which explains in a unified way their tractability on all these classes.
  We show that List 3-Coloring can be solved in quasipolynomial time on every tame class of graphs.

title: Lowered crossover points of Anthropic's subexponential 3-SAT algorithm
summary: The October 2026 refutations of the Exponential Time Hypothesis count satisfying assignments in time $2^{o(n)}$, but an asymptotic bound does not say from which input size, the crossover point, they beat the best known algorithms. We make the #3-SAT recursion of Anthropic's algorithm explicit and lower its crossover points, computed from the main term of the proved bound, by proved changes. For the bound in the number $m$ of clauses, at clause density one, the crossover point drops to about $2^{420}$ clauses from $2^{33858}$; for general 3-SAT, in the number $n$ of variables, our estimate drops to $2^{8.6\cdot10^9}$ variables from $2^{2.2\cdot10^{12}}$. With integer tables the recursion counts, for every $j$, the assignments satisfying exactly $j$ clauses in time $2^{O(m/\sqrt{\log m})}$. We observe that this refutes the Sparse Max-3-SAT Hypothesis of Alman and Vassilevska Williams, which also follows from either refutation by the reduction of Impagliazzo, Paturi and Zane, and we lower the crossover point of this computation to about $2^{1016}$ clauses from $2^{68364}$. The distance is structural: we define a rewrite-and-merge class that contains the recursion and all our constructions, and prove that in the main-term model no grid algorithm in it can gain for general 3-SAT below about $2^{6000}$ variables. For two balanced homogeneous merges we prove with quantum functionals an exponent of at least $(\log_2K)^{-3}$ per edge bit, which excludes running times $2^{n^{1-c}}$. Independently of SAT, we formalise the algorithm as a model of computation, Signed Network Sums, which contains rank-one methods and contraction trees. On the complete graph with four nodes, one-level constructions contract the network in $N^{23/6}$ if $ω=2$ and in about $N^{3.93}$ on the current (preprint) matrix-multiplication curve, below the bound $N^4$ of every rank-one method or contraction tree.

title: RTPolicy: Real-Time (32.9 Hz) Multi-View Visuomotor Policy for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
summary: Low inference latency is critical for closed-loop robotic manipulation, especially under asynchronous inference, where action chunks must be updated promptly to correct accumulated deviations. However, existing visuomotor policies rely on computationally expensive visual backbones, resulting in high inference latency and deployment overhead. In this paper, we propose RTPolicy, a multi-view visuomotor policy that attains accurate manipulation with high inference efficiency. Its core design combines view-aware feature fusion with visual compression to aggregate complementary information across camera views into a compact token representation. The representation conditions a flow-matching action generator with the robot state and flow time, reducing the cost of action generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this design reduces the computational cost of visual representation and action generation while preserving visual information required for manipulation. On the RoboTwin~2.0 single-task clean evaluation across 50 tasks, RTPolicy attains a mean success rate of 52.26\%, outperforming the strongest leaderboard baseline $π_0$ (46.4\%). We further evaluate RTPolicy under asynchronous streaming inference on a real bimanual platform, where RTPolicy attains a mean success rate of 72.0\% and sustains real-time inference at 30.35 ms (32.9 Hz) on the RDK S600 and 149.72 ms (6.7 Hz) on the RDK S100, both in INT16. Project Page: https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/RTPolicy.project.

title: A Gaussian Process Regression-Enhanced Two-Sweep Parameterized Power Method for Computing Extreme Eigenpairs
summary: For computing the dominant eigenvalue and the corresponding eigenvector of a real and symmetric matrix, inspired by the parameterized power method and multistep iteration, we propose a two-sweep parameterized power method, and establish its convergence theory. To further improve the convergence speed of the new method, we use Gaussian process regression (GPR) to predict the quasi-optimal parameter and give a version of the proposed method based on GPR. Numerical experiments show that the two-sweep parameterized power method with quasi-optimal parameters outperforms some existing methods in terms of computing efficiency.

title: What Carries Architectural Signal? A Code-to-Architecture Mapping Study
summary:
Code-to-architecture mapping assigns source files to modules of a reference architecture. Representations of implementation artifacts can capture code text, dependencies, and directory organization, but predictive gains alone do not establish the contribution of additional graph processing. Dependencies may already be encoded in these representations, while directories may closely match the reference decomposition. We investigate how artifact representations and graph context affect mapping on ten Java, C, and C++ systems with a limited labeling budget. We compare lexical, structural, and contextual file representations and assess each predictor with and without dependency neighbors. Using a Heterogeneous Graph Transformer (HGT), we compare file-level graphs extended with member nodes summarizing each file's program elements, folder nodes, or both, alongside a variant encoding folder paths directly in file representations. We compare folder-aware predictions with a directory rule using the same labeled files.
  Representations encoding dependency information outperform lexical representations on most systems. Additional neighbor aggregation can improve mapping, depending on the predictor and aggregation direction. Folder-aware variants yield the largest and most consistent gains across the evaluated HGT configurations. However, the directory rule achieves per-system median accuracy of 89-100%, and adding folder information does not consistently improve predictions for files the rule misclassifies. Member nodes provide no consistent improvement over file-level graphs. These findings support assessing what file representations and directory organization already provide before attributing improvements to graph neural networks.

title: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning benchmarks that allow for systematic evaluation across text length and reasoning depth, we introduce GRIT-Bench. Experiments demonstrate that GRIT significantly improves both reasoning accuracy and grounding fidelity over existing RLVR methods.

title: Probability-Layer Clustering for Bound-and-Budget Calibration in Multi-Bound Robust Bidding of Renewable-Based Virtual Power Plants
summary: RVPPs that aggregate dispatchable and non-dispatchable renewable energy sources, storage, and flexible demand that bid in the day-ahead and secondary reserve markets must cope with uncertainties in market prices, renewable generation, and demand. MBRO is well suited to this setting because it hedges adverse realizations through several deviation layers while keeping the final bidding problem as a tractable, scenario-free MILP. Its performance, however, depends on how the deviation bounds and uncertainty budgets are calibrated. Existing MBRO implementations commonly rely on fixed percentile-based bounds and externally specified budget vectors, usually examined through sensitivity analysis. This paper proposes PL-MBRO, that constructs parameter-specific deviation bounds from historical data conditional on selected risk-attitude quantiles and automatically derives the corresponding uncertainty budgets from empirical cluster probabilities. For each uncertain parameter, k-medians clustering partitions the historical daily profiles into representative probability layers; the cluster median defines the balanced representative, while favorable and adverse within-cluster percentiles define the optimistic and pessimistic representatives. The empirical cluster probabilities are mapped to integer full-horizon uncertainty budgets over the 96 quarter-hourly periods, while the robust inner problem determines the periods in which the corresponding deviation layers are most adverse to the schedule. Compared with a percentilebased MBRO benchmark, in-sample and out-of-sample tests on an RVPP bidding in both markets show that PL-MBRO consistently achieves better realized economic outcomes across the optimistic, balanced, and pessimistic strategies, with improvements of up to 92.7% in-sample and 57.3% out-of-sample, measured relative to the absolute value of the corresponding benchmark realized profit.

title: Chance-Constrained Inspection Viewpoint Sequencing for On-Orbit Servicing via Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous inspection of a target spacecraft is typically the initial step in on-orbit servicing. Planning close-proximity observation viewpoints involves a complex combinatorial problem constrained by coverage, fuel, and safety considerations. This paper models the viewpoint selection as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and applies Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian relaxation to solve it. The system combines a high-level planner, which sequences camera viewpoints on an observation sphere around the target, with a low-level model that assesses each transfer using the Clohessy--Wiltshire (CW) equations for relative motion. The deterministic constraints on single-impulse reachability and $Δv$ cap are enforced directly on the action set. Safety margins are affected by navigation and manoeuvre errors, making the actual clearance stochastic. To address this, a chance constraint on the realised trajectory is implemented, with a Lagrangian multiplier governed by PID control to adapt the penalty during training. The approach is tested on a Galileo-class navigation satellite in medium Earth orbit, modelled as a point cloud where visibility from each viewpoint considers field-of-view and line-of-sight occlusion. Across various risk budgets, the trained policy maintains the keep-out violation rate within the specified limit, achieving coverage close to its maximum and staying within the mission $Δv$ budget. Compared to the usual practice of applying a fixed margin to the keep-out radius and planning deterministically, the chance-constrained policy attains less than half the violation rate at comparable coverage. This makes the collision risk an explicit design parameter, eliminating the need for re-tuning per case. The learned policy selects a viewpoint without the repeated Monte Carlo risk estimates required by a greedy, chance-constrained planner at every decision point.

title: A Constructive Orbit-Based Theory of Learnability
summary: We develop a finite-dimensional orbit framework for constructing data-adapted dictionaries, sparse realizations, and predictive extensions. The method uses wrapped weighted shifts to generate orbit dictionaries and local interpolation maps from independent orbit representatives, turning the learning problem into three explicit tasks: scaffold discovery, sparse realization on the discovered dictionary, and prediction through learned sparse coordinates. We introduce CCDS as the main constructive ingredient: a deviation-controlled sparse realization procedure that recovers MP/OMP-type behavior at the minimal-deviation boundary while allowing feasible interior paths with prescribed residual geometry that is inaccessible to MP/OMP. We prove generic orbit independence, exact block interpolation with norm control, observable bounds on sparse approximation distortion, sparse realization guarantees on selected supports, and fixed-path stability under admissible perturbations of the block interpolants. These results connect sparse approximation, interpolation, and finite-dimensional operator dynamics through the construction and analysis of data-induced orbit dictionaries. Experiments on synthetic geometry, controlled realization tests, and standard classification benchmarks show that selected orbit scaffolds have substantially better matched-rank projection behavior than random orbit or unstructured alternatives, that CCDS attains near-zero realization error at the minimal-deviation boundary, and that predictors trained from the sparse CCDS certificates give competitive performance.

title: TADP: Dual-Branch Temporally Adaptive Differential Privacy for Expression-Aware Video Anonymization
summary: We present TADP, a temporally adaptive differential privacy (DP) framework for inference-time privacy-preserving video generation under fixed-length clip-replacement adjacency. TADP uses a dual-branch design to extract identity and expression representations, clips and privatizes both branches with temporally adaptive Gaussian mechanisms whose noise scales depend only on preceding privatized releases within the same clip and are bounded below by history-uniform calibrated minima, and accounts for their joint release via adaptive Rényi Differential Privacy (RDP) composition. The clip-level RDP guarantee is converted to $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy, while soft quantization and subsequent temporal processing are applied only after privatization as DP post-processing. Experiments on facial expression datasets show reduced identity leakage under evaluated attacks, usable perceptual quality and temporal stability, and high facial expression recognition utility relative to the evaluated privacy-preserving baselines. TADP formally satisfies clip-level DP and empirically provides a favorable privacy--utility trade-off under the evaluated threat models and datasets.

title: Direct Action-Manifold Modeling for Efficient and Robust Bimanual Manipulation
