The 2 x 2 design separates augmentation from hyperparameter tuning, with exact duplication, random oversampling, class weighting, and SMOTEN as balancing controls. For Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), the gain over tuned raw training does not withstand Holm correction, although BNB attains the highest mean accuracy (97.50%). The boosted-tree models benefit substantially: XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost improve by 18.10, 28.45, and 10.09 percentage points, respectively. A Hamming-distance audit places 91.0% of standard held-out profiles within one symptom bit of the training data. Accuracy decreases on a same-disease 1-bit-purged challenge; nevertheless, XGBoost and LightGBM retain large augmentation gains. We also evaluate robustness to missing and spurious symptoms and the faithfulness of BNB explanations. Overall, Bernoulli perturbation is useful for some model families, but benchmark accuracy should be interpreted together with template proximity.

title: Locality-Controlled Out-of-Distribution Guidance for Robust Regulatory DNA Sequence Design
summary: Designing regulatory DNA sequences for targeted gene-expression control is an important challenge. Recent approaches frame this task as property-conditioned generation, where diffusion models trained on natural sequences are guided toward high predicted activity through reward-based fine-tuning or sampling-time guidance. We show that single-reward evaluation can obscure reward-hacking behavior. By decomposing evaluation into property, novelty, and plausibility, we identify an empirically underexplored region of the evaluation space in which all three objectives are satisfied, but no existing baseline succeeds. We postulate that this gap arises because prior methods treat guidance primarily as a matter of magnitude. In regulatory DNA, however, sequence grammar is spatially nonuniform: motif positions are sensitive to perturbation, while background regions allow more exploration. We therefore propose LOCOGEN by reformulating guidance as a problem of locality. LOCOGEN learns an invariant motif mask through sequence-level invariance learning to protect motif positions, while applying OOD damping only to background positions. It operates at sampling time on a frozen diffusion backbone, without retraining the backbone. Across HepG2, K562, and SK-N-SH, LOCOGEN reaches this previously underexplored region of the property-novelty-plausibility space. Code is available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/LocoGen.

title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
summary: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.

title: Task Vectors Can Be Linearly Decomposed into Interpretable and Controllable Components
summary: Task Vectors (TVs) provide a compact way to steer large language models, but they are typically treated as atomized directions merely extracted from hidden states, leaving their internal functional structure poorly understood. Motivated by prior work that decomposes in-context learning into Task Recognition (TR) and Task Learning (TL), we ask whether a single TV can likewise be decomposed into functionally meaningful components. We formulate a TR/TL-based decomposition from candidate-label unembeddings, separating each TV into TR, TL, and residual components, and try to optimize the TR and TL coefficients using Bayesian optimization for more effective intervention. We evaluate this formulation across multiple model families, classification tasks, and both instruction- and demonstration-based TVs. Across these settings, TR/TL-based optimization identifies intervention directions that outperform the original TVs. Although optimization over random directions can also improve performance, TR/TL-based search yields more reliable gains, particularly for instruction-based TVs. Moreover, isolated interventions on the decomposed components produce distinct logit-level effects that are consistent with their intended functional roles. Together, these results suggest that TVs are not monolithic steering directions, but can be decomposed into functionally meaningful components that support both interpretation and control.

title: Feasibility of Common-Stream-Only Sensing in ZF-RSMA with Imperfect CSIT
comments: Accepted at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026. 6 pages, 5 figures
summary: Reusing the Rate-Splitting Multiple Access (RSMA) common stream for sensing eliminates dedicated probing signals in Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), but creates a feasibility bottleneck: the common-power fraction must simultaneously support common decoding, private decoding, and target detection. This paper investigates this tradeoff in downlink zero-forcing RSMA with imperfect channel state information at the transmitter (CSIT) and imperfect successive interference cancellation (SIC). With the common beam fixed over a sensing dwell through sensing geometry, the common-power fraction becomes the sole design variable. We prove that the communication-feasible set is either a closed interval or empty. Analytical outage expressions localize these endpoints, revealing a high-signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) floor-ceiling effect: common decoding dictates a common-power floor, while imperfect CSIT and SIC impose a private-decoding ceiling. For sensing, the conditional detection constraint is affine, preserving the interval structure. A geometry-matched common beam ensures monotonic detection improvement, reducing joint-feasibility check to the communication-feasible upper endpoint. Simulations validate our analysis, identifying regimes where common-stream-only sensing is viable.

title: Do LLMs Know When They Are Wrong About Molecules? In-Context Property Prediction with Self-Reported Uncertainty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used in many domains, but molecular property prediction with them is still little explored. In this work we evaluate the capability of 7 frontier LLMs to predict molecular properties together with a self-reported uncertainty from in-context examples, and compare them with classical baselines trained on the same molecules. We use 4 datasets and screen each for contamination of the training data of the LLMs: three are clean, and the fourth, ESOL, is memorised by most of the models and serves as a comparison. On the clean datasets every LLM improves with the context, at 30 examples the most accurate one beats every baseline. The requested reasoning effort changes accuracy little. The self-reported uncertainty ranks the prediction errors weakly, with Spearman rank correlations of up to 0.46, about the level reached by the uncertainties of the baselines. Combining uncertainty and prediction, on lipophilicity the most certain half of the best LLM is the most accurate at small context sizes; on BACE and antiviral, and on lipophilicity at large context sizes, the best LLMs are on par with the best baseline. On the contaminated ESOL dataset the LLMs show no improvement with the context size, as expected for a memorised dataset, and their stated uncertainty is smaller on the molecules whose value they recall.

title: $W^{1,p}$ error estimates of an IPDG and a class of HDG methods for the Poisson problem on convex polyhedral domains
summary: This paper analyzes a symmetric interior penalty discontinuous Galerkin (IPDG) method, a hybrid mixed DG method, and two representative hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) methods for the Poisson problem on convex polyhedral domains. For any fixed $ε\in (0,\frac{1}{2})$, we first derive optimal discrete $W^{1,p}$ error estimates for $2\leq p<\frac{1}ε$ by combining the interface Green's functions developed in \cite{lq2026} with the Fubini-type weighted estimates established in this paper. These error estimates lead to discrete $W^{1,q}$-$W^{1,p}$ inf-sup stability for $2\leq q<\frac{1}ε$, where $q$ is the conjugate number of $p$ such that $\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q}=1$. Using this stability result and a suitably constructed dual problem, we extend the optimal error estimates to $\frac{1}{1-ε}<p<2$ and subsequently establish the corresponding inf-sup stability for $\frac{1}{1-ε}< q<2$. Thus, both optimal discrete $W^{1,p}$ error estimates and discrete $W^{1,q}$-$W^{1,p}$ inf-sup stability hold throughout the range $\frac{1}{1-ε}<p<\frac{1}ε$, with $q=p/(p-1)$. Note that all of the aforementioned results are free of logarithmic factors and also hold on polyhedral meshes (except for the hybrid mixed DG method). Compared with the conforming finite element method (FEM), establishing such error estimates and inf-sup stability results for DG methods on convex polyhedral domains is more delicate because their analysis involves mesh-dependent norms. Consequently, the operator interpolation theory employed for conforming FEMs cannot be directly applied to DG methods. Finally, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 凸多面体区域上泊松问题的IPDG方法及一类HDG方法的 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计
AI.tldr: 本文利用界面格林函数、加权估计和对偶技术，证明了凸多面体域上IPDG和HDG方法在 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}<p<\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 范围内无对数因子的最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计及 inf-sup 稳定性。
AI.motivation: 对于凸多面体域上的泊松问题，由于间断有限元（DG）方法的分析涉及依赖于网格的范数，导致经典协调有限元法所用的算子插值理论无法直接适用，因此在多面体域上建立DG方法的最优 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计和 inf-sup 稳定性更为困难和精细。
AI.method: 将已有文献建立的界面格林函数与本文提出的Fubini型加权估计相结合，推导 $2\leq p < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 下的误差估计；进而利用所得稳定性及巧妙构造的对偶问题，通过对偶技巧将最优估计和 inf-sup 稳定性推广到 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < p < 2$ 的范围。
AI.result: 针对对称IPDG、混合杂化DG以及两种代表性HDG方法，在 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < p < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$（其中 $q=p/(p-1)$）的整个范围内，证明了最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计与离散 $W^{1,q}$-$W^{1,p}$ inf-sup 稳定性，所得结果均无对数因子，且对多面体网格适用（混合杂化DG除外），并给出了数值算例验证。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了所考虑的IPDG和HDG方法在凸多面体域及多面体网格上，对于 $p\in (\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}, \frac{1}{\varepsilon})$ 的整个区间均满足无对数因子的最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计和对应的离散 inf-sup 稳定性。
AI.translation: 本文分析了凸多面体区域上泊松问题的一种对称内部惩罚间断有限元（IPDG）方法、一种混合杂化DG方法以及两种具有代表性的可杂化间断有限元（HDG）方法。对于任意固定的 $\varepsilon \in (0, \frac{1}{2})$，我们首先将已有文献开发的界面格林函数与本文建立的Fubini型加权估计相结合，推导出了当 $2 \leq p < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 时的最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计。这些误差估计导出了在 $2 \leq q < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 下的离散 $W^{1,q}$-$W^{1,p}$ inf-sup 稳定性，其中 $q$ 是 $p$ 的共轭数，满足 $\frac{1}{p} + \frac{1}{q} = 1$。利用该稳定性结果和一个构造合适的对偶问题，我们将最优误差估计推广到 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < p < 2$，并随后建立了 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < q < 2$ 时对应的 inf-sup 稳定性。因此，在整个范围 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < p < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$（其中 $q=p/(p-1)$）内，最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计和离散 $W^{1,q}$-$W^{1,p}$ inf-sup 稳定性均成立。值得注意的是，上述所有结果均不含对数因子，且在多面体网格上也成立（混合杂化DG方法除外）。与协调有限元方法相比，在凸多面体域上为DG方法建立此类误差估计和 inf-sup 稳定性更为精细，因为其分析涉及依赖网格的范数；因此，适用于协调有限元的算子插值理论无法直接应用于DG方法。最后，本文给出了一个数值算例以验证理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了凸多面体区域上泊松问题的对称IPDG和HDG等间断有限元方法，利用界面格林函数、Fubini型加权估计及对偶技术，克服了网格依赖范数带来的分析难题，在 $\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon} < p < \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 区间内建立了无对数因子的最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计和离散 inf-sup 稳定性，并通过数值算例验证了理论。
AI.keywords: Poisson problem, interior penalty discontinuous Galerkin, hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin, $W^{1,p}$ error estimates, inf-sup stability
AI.comments: 该论文通过将界面格林函数与Fubini型加权估计相结合，成功克服了不连续有限元（DG）涉及网格依赖范数而无法直接应用传统连续算子插值理论的难点，在凸多面体区域上建立了不含对数因子的最优离散 $W^{1,p}$ 误差估计与 inf-sup 稳定性，成果具有较强的理论创新性和通用性。

title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
summary: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

AI.title_translation: Latent-Lens：通过潜在通信实现小型语言模型的视觉感知
AI.tldr: Latent-Lens通过在潜在空间直接通信，使小型语言模型能够感知视觉信息，避免了基于文本的瓶颈，显著提高了性能。
AI.motivation: 在模块化多智能体系统中，独立的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）与小型语言模型（SLMs）之间通过离散文本交换信息会造成空间和细粒度细节的信息丢失瓶颈，这对容量有限的SLMs尤为严重。现有的潜在通信方法未探索VLM如何将视觉信息传递给单独预训练的纯文本SLM。
AI.method: 本文提出了Latent-Lens，一个轻量级的编解码器，它直接在潜在空间中弥合了冻结VLM和冻结SLM之间的表示差距，使它们能够纯粹通过隐藏状态进行通信。该编解码器包含一个域编码器，将VLM的隐藏状态投影到SLM的嵌入空间；以及一个注意力解码器，形式化为LoRA，用于训练SLM关注这些视觉前缀，总共只训练了约1.6M参数（占组合模型大小的0.2%）。
AI.result: 在视觉问答（CLEVR, GQA）任务上，Latent-Lens实现了81.0±7.9%和65.4±5.4%的性能，与相同LoRA预算下文本通信的58.3±5.7%和61.8±1.0%相比有显著提升（相对冻结文本通信提升+30.2–69.8pp）。在图像字幕（Flickr8k）任务上，它比相同基线提高了+16.5（冻结模型提高+18.8）。该方法还通过TinyLlama-1.1B和InternVL2-1B进行了评估，显示其对不同架构、词汇和隐藏维度的适应性。
AI.conclusion: Latent-Lens通过在潜在空间直接实现VLM和SLM的通信，有效地克服了基于文本的信息传递限制，并以极小的训练开销显著增强了SLM的视觉感知能力。
AI.translation: 将独立的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和小型语言模型（SLMs）桥接在一个模块化多智能体系统中，通常会迫使它们以离散文本形式交换信息，这为空间和细粒度细节带来了有损的瓶颈。这种限制对于容量有限的SLMs来说尤其严重，因为它们更依赖于输入信号的质量。最近的潜在通信方法在语言模型之间交换状态。然而，VLM如何将视觉信息传递给单独预训练的纯文本SLM仍未被探索。我们提出了Latent-Lens，一个轻量级的编解码器，它直接在潜在空间中弥合了冻结VLM和冻结SLM之间的表示差距，使它们能够纯粹通过隐藏状态进行通信。该编解码器由一个域编码器组成，将VLM的隐藏状态投影到SLM的嵌入空间，以及一个注意力解码器，形式化为LoRA，用于训练SLM关注这些视觉前缀，同时仅训练约1.6M参数（占组合模型大小的0.2%）。在视觉问答（CLEVR，GQA）任务上，Latent-Lens实现了81.0±7.9%和65.4±5.4%的性能，与相同LoRA预算下文本通信的58.3±5.7%和61.8±1.0%相比（相对冻结文本通信提升+30.2–69.8pp），而在图像字幕（Flickr8k）任务上，它比相同基线提高了+16.5（冻结模型提高+18.8）。我们还使用TinyLlama-1.1B和InternVL2-1B评估了Latent-Lens，它们使用了不同的架构、词汇和隐藏维度。
AI.summary: Latent-Lens旨在解决视觉-语言模型（VLMs）与小型语言模型（SLMs）之间通过离散文本通信时存在的信息丢失问题。该研究提出了一种名为Latent-Lens的轻量级编解码器，它通过在潜在空间直接连接冻结的VLM和SLM，实现纯粹基于隐藏状态的通信。该编解码器包含一个将VLM隐藏状态投影到SLM嵌入空间的域编码器，以及一个作为LoRA实现的注意力解码器，用于训练SLM关注视觉前缀，且仅需训练约1.6M参数。实验结果表明，Latent-Lens在视觉问答（CLEVR, GQA）和图像字幕（Flickr8k）任务上均显著优于基于文本的通信方法，有效提升了SLMs的视觉感知能力。
AI.keywords: 潜在通信, 小型语言模型, 视觉感知, 视觉-语言模型, 编解码器
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了Latent-Lens，通过直接在潜在空间而非离散文本空间实现冻结VLM和冻结SLM之间的通信。这种方法有效解决了传统文本通信带来的信息损失瓶颈，特别是对资源受限的SLM而言。其核心贡献在于采用轻量级编解码器（域编码器和LoRA形式的注意力解码器），仅需训练极少量参数即可显著提升SLM的视觉感知能力，体现了高效性和模块化设计的优势。

title: Higher-Order Kinematic Derivatives for Aspect-Preserving Real-Time Numerical Inverse Kinematics
summary: This paper leverages the higher-order kinematic derivatives of serial robots to achieve efficient, aspect-preserving real-time inverse kinematics. First, a family of higher-order solvers is derived, with a necessary orientation-error correction map, yielding the QuIK4 and QuIK5 methods with fourth- and fifth-order convergence. Second, an aspect-preserving step limiter extrapolates the Jacobian determinant along the step to predict and avoid singularities, shortening steps only when they head toward a singularity rather than when the current iterate is ill-conditioned. Third, a Hermite-interpolation certifier verifies the aspect of each answer, and a certified restart algorithm recovers failures from proven same-aspect seeds. The proposed methods are shown to outperform prior methods, reducing failures by up to four orders of magnitude and nearly eliminating aspect switching at tracking-level errors. A C++ library is released with ROS 2 integration.

AI.title_translation: 保持构型的实时数值逆运动学的高阶运动学导数
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用高阶运动学导数实现高效、保持构型、实时数值逆运动学的新方法，大幅降低了失败率和构型切换。
AI.motivation: 传统的实时逆运动学求解器在收敛速度、奇异性处理以及保持机器人运动学构型（aspect）方面存在不足，容易导致失败或构型突变。
AI.method: 首先推导了具有第四和第五阶收敛性的高阶求解器（QuIK4和QuIK5）；其次设计了基于雅可比行列式外推的构型保持步长限制器以预测和避免奇异性；最后通过Hermite插值认证器验证构型，并采用经证实的同构型种子恢复失败。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法优于先前的方法，将失败率降低了多达四个数量级，并在追踪级误差下几乎消除了构型切换，同时发布了带有ROS 2集成的C++库。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用高阶导数、前瞻性奇异性规避和严格的构型认证，所提出的方法在实时逆运动学中实现了极高的收敛速度和构型保持率，大幅超越现有技术。
AI.translation: 本文利用串联机器人的高阶运动学导数来实现高效、保持构型的实时逆运动学。首先，推导了一系列带有必要方向误差校正映射的高阶求解器，产生了具有第四阶和第五阶收敛性的QuIK4和QuIK5方法。其次，提出了一种保持构型的步长限制器，沿步长外推雅可比行列式以预测和避免奇异性，仅在趋向奇异性时缩短步长，而不是在当前迭代条件数差时缩短。第三，利用Hermite插值认证器验证每个解的构型，且经证实的同构型种子所设计的 certified restart 算法可恢复失败。实验表明，所提出的方法优于先前的方法，将失败率降低了多达四个数量级，并在追踪级误差下几乎消除了构型切换。同时发布了带有 ROS 2 集成的 C++ 库。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于高阶运动学导数的实时机器人逆运动学求解框架。通过引入第四/五阶收敛求解器、前瞻性奇异性规避步长限制器以及基于Hermite插值的构型保持认证与恢复算法，显著提高了逆运动学的收敛性、成功率和构型稳定性。
AI.keywords: 逆运动学, 高阶导数, 串联机器人, 奇异性规避, 实时计算
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了高阶运动学导数、雅可比行列式外推步长限制器以及Hermite插值构型保持认证器，极大地提升了串联机器人实时逆运动学的求解效率、收敛速度和构型保持能力，并开源了C++/ROS 2实现，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
summary: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show consistent performance improvements across diverse MICL settings and demonstrate that correctly inducing underlying rules directly leads to stronger and more stable performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于显式规则归纳的多模态上下文学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ERIM框架，通过显式规则归纳和两阶段训练策略，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在上下文学习中的性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态上下文学习（MICL）方法主要将任务视为直接的输入-输出映射，忽视了显式归纳和推理底层规则的重要性，从而限制了模型的性能和可解释性。
AI.method: 提出ERIM框架，构建规则中心的MICL数据集，引入规则归纳的显式监督，并通过混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习相结合的两阶段训练策略对多模态大语言模型进行微调。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，ERIM在各种MICL设置下都能带来持续的性能提升，证明了正确归纳底层规则能够直接带来更强、更稳定的性能。
AI.conclusion: ERIM框架通过显式规则归纳有效提升了多模态大模型在上下文学习中的性能与稳定性，为解决定义模糊的多模态任务提供了新途径。
AI.translation: 多模态上下文学习（MICL）的一个核心挑战源于那些在没有上下文时定义模糊、需要从演示中揭示潜在规则的任务。现有方法主要将MICL视为直接的输入-输出映射，忽视了显式归纳和推理此类规则的重要性，从而限制了性能和可解释性。我们提出了ERIM（用于多模态上下文学习的显式规则归纳），这是一个统一的框架，通过显式归纳支配演示样本的潜在规则来增强MICL。利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力，ERIM构建了以规则为中心的MICL数据集，引入了规则归纳的显式监督，并通过结合混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习的两阶段训练策略，微调MLLM以执行显式规则归纳。大量实验表明，在各种MICL设置下性能均有一致的提升，并证明了正确归纳底层规则能直接带来更强、更稳定的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ERIM（显式规则归纳多模态上下文学习）框架，通过构建规则中心的数据集并采用两阶段训练策略（混合冷启动SFT与强化学习），使多模态大语言模型能够显式地归纳和推理演示样本背后的潜在规则，从而提高MICL的性能和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 多模态上下文学习, 显式规则归纳, 多模态大语言模型, 强化学习, 监督微调
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将显式规则归纳引入多模态上下文学习（MICL）中，通过结合监督微调与强化学习的两阶段训练策略，提升了多模态大模型的性能和可解释性。

title: CypherGuard: Database-Grounded Correction for Reliable Text-to-Cypher
summary: Text-to-Cypher translates natural-language questions into Cypher queries over property graphs. Graph database systems increasingly adopt this translation as a native query interface. Large language models generate fluent Cypher but stay unreliable. On Cypher-Bench a small model answers only 31.4% of questions correctly, and even a strong model plateaus at 71.76%. The dominant failure modes are structural rather than linguistic. For example, a generated query may parse correctly and follow the schema, yet still return zero rows because it traverses a relationship against the stored graph direction. To address this issue, we present CypherGuard, a training-free framework that detects and corrects these structural faults. Our approach uses two core components: a graph-native error taxonomy to guide repair, and a mined rule library to guide query generation. At inference time, CypherGuard first rewrites schema-detectable faults, then re-executes each draft and repairs it only when the query errors or returns nothing. On CypherBench test questions, across seven graphs, CypherGuard reaches 88.50% overall execution accuracy, +25.08% over the same-backbone zero-shot floor, surpassing an RL-fine-tuned 7B specialist and the strongest training-based system that we compare against.

AI.title_translation: CypherGuard：面向可靠Text-to-Cypher的数据库落地纠错方法
AI.tldr: CypherGuard是一个无需训练的纠错框架，通过图原生错误分类与挖掘规则库解决Text-to-Cypher中的结构性错误，大幅提升了大模型图查询的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在将自然语言转换为Cypher查询时虽然流利，但由于存在结构性错误（如违背存储图方向导致返回空行等），导致准确率不可靠且存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出CypherGuard框架，包含两个核心组件：用于指导修复的图原生错误分类法和用于指导查询生成的挖掘规则库。在推理阶段重写模式可检测的错误，并在查询出错或返回空结果时进行动态重执行与修复。
AI.result: 在Cypher-Bench的七个图数据库测试中，CypherGuard达到了88.50%的整体执行准确率，比零样本基线提升了25.08%，超越了RL微调的7B模型以及对比的最强训练系统。
AI.conclusion: CypherGuard在无需模型训练的前提下，通过运行时检测、重写与动态重试机制，大幅提升了Text-to-Cypher的执行准确率，超越了多种基于微调或训练的复杂系统。
AI.translation: Text-to-Cypher 将自然语言问题转换为属性图上的 Cypher 查询。图数据库系统越来越倾向于采用这种翻译作为原生查询接口。大型语言模型虽然能生成流利的 Cypher，但依然不可靠。在 Cypher-Bench 上，一个小模型只能正确回答 31.4% 的问题，即使是强大的模型也停留在 71.76% 的瓶颈。主要的失败模式是结构性的，而不是语言学的。例如，生成的查询可能解析正确并符合架构，但由于逆着存储的图方向遍历关系，仍然返回零行。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 CypherGuard，一个检测并纠正这些结构性故障的无训练框架。我们的方法使用两个核心组件：指导修复的图原生错误分类法，以及指导查询生成的挖掘规则库。在推理时，CypherGuard 首先重写模式可检测的故障，然后重新执行每个草稿查询，并且仅在查询出错或返回空结果时才对其进行修复。在 CypherBench 测试问题中，跨越七个图，CypherGuard 的整体执行准确率达到了 88.50%，比同骨干网络的零样本基线提高了 +25.08%，超越了 RL 微调的 7B 专家模型以及我们对比的最强基于训练的系统。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CypherGuard，一个用于可靠Text-to-Cypher的无需训练的数据库落地纠错框架。通过图原生错误分类法和挖掘规则库，该框架在推理时检测并修复结构性故障，显著提高了大语言模型在图数据库查询上的执行准确率。
AI.keywords: Text-to-Cypher, 图数据库, 大语言模型, 数据库落地纠错, CypherGuard
AI.comments: CypherGuard提供了一种无需训练、数据库落地的纠错框架，通过结合图原生错误分类法和挖掘规则库，有效解决了Text-to-Cypher中普遍存在的结构性失效问题，显著提升了大模型生成图查询的准确率。

title: Scaly: an Optimizing Compiler for Optimal Control
summary: We present Scaly, an open-source optimizing compiler for optimal control, written in Python, that generates fast C code. Scaly provides a modeling language embedded in Python for the parametric optimization problems that arise in model predictive control and moving horizon estimation, and computes the sparse derivatives that standard optimization solvers need. Scaly accepts general nonlinear programs but applies optimizations specific to optimal control, which preserve the repeated structure of a problem, such as the stages of a horizon, through differentiation down to the generated loops. The generated C depends only on the C math library and never allocates memory dynamically. On three benchmark problems, Scaly evaluates the Hessian of the Lagrangian up to 26 times faster than CasADi, with smaller binaries and build times that stay nearly constant with the horizon. With the same solver, Scaly shortens the solver time per control step on every benchmark, by a factor of up to 9.

AI.title_translation: Scaly：一个用于最优控制的优化编译器
AI.tldr: Scaly是一个开源的Python优化编译器，专门用于最优控制，能生成快速的C代码，并在基准测试中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决模型预测控制和移动视界估计中出现的参数优化问题，并生成快速的C代码来处理这些问题所需的稀疏导数。
AI.method: Scaly是一个用Python编写的开源优化编译器，它提供了一个嵌入在Python中的建模语言，用于最优控制中的参数优化问题。它能计算优化求解器所需的稀疏导数，并接受一般的非线性规划，同时应用针对最优控制的特定优化，通过微分保留问题的重复结构，直至生成的循环。生成的C代码仅依赖于C数学库且不动态分配内存。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试问题上，Scaly计算拉格朗日Hessian的速度比CasADi快26倍，生成更小的二进制文件，并且构建时间随视界保持几乎不变。使用相同的求解器，Scaly将每个控制步骤的求解器时间缩短了最多9倍。
AI.conclusion: Scaly显著提高了最优控制问题的性能，通过专门的优化和高效的C代码生成，实现了比现有工具更快的导数计算和更短的求解时间。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Scaly，一个用Python编写的开源最优控制优化编译器，它能生成快速的C代码。Scaly提供了一个嵌入在Python中的建模语言，用于模型预测控制和移动视界估计中出现的参数优化问题，并计算标准优化求解器所需的稀疏导数。Scaly接受一般的非线性规划，但应用了针对最优控制的特定优化，通过微分将问题的重复结构（例如视界阶段）保留到生成的循环中。生成的C代码仅依赖于C数学库，并且从不动态分配内存。在三个基准问题上，Scaly计算拉格朗日Hessian的速度比CasADi快26倍，生成更小的二进制文件，并且构建时间随视界保持几乎不变。使用相同的求解器，Scaly将每个控制步骤的求解器时间缩短了最多9倍。
AI.summary: Scaly是一个用Python开发的开源优化编译器，专注于最优控制领域。它通过提供一个嵌入在Python中的建模语言，来处理模型预测控制和移动视界估计中的参数优化问题，并高效计算稀疏导数。Scaly能够对非线性规划应用针对最优控制的特殊优化，在代码生成过程中保持问题的结构。实验结果显示，Scaly在计算Hessian方面比CasADi快26倍，并能将求解时间缩短9倍，同时生成更小、构建时间更稳定的二进制文件。
AI.keywords: 最优控制, 优化编译器, 模型预测控制, 稀疏导数, C代码生成
AI.comments: Scaly的创新之处在于其专门针对最优控制问题进行优化，通过在编译过程中保留问题的结构（如视界阶段），从而生成高度优化的C代码。这种方法显著提升了计算效率，尤其是在稀疏导数计算和求解器时间方面，使其成为模型预测控制和移动视界估计等应用中一个非常有前景的工具。其不动态分配内存的特点也增强了代码的稳定性和实时性。

title: Measuring What Matters: A Causal Reliance Score for Histopathology Image Segmentation
comments: 15 pages, 8 figures, accepted into Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA) 2026 conference
summary: Reliable histopathology segmentation requires models that rely on pathology-relevant structures rather than spurious background correlations. In this work, we argue that improving architectures alone is insufficient if models continue to rely on spurious correlations rather than pathology-relevant features. We introduce a causality-inspired evaluation framework based on controlled interventions that explicitly probes model sensitivity to foreground tissue structure and background/domain variation. Building on this, we propose the Causal Reliance Score (CRS), a metric that quantifies the relative sensitivity of model predictions to foreground perturbation versus background/domain variation under controlled interventions. To support this analysis, we design augmentation strategies that act as implicit counterfactual interventions during training, encouraging invariance to nuisance factors while preserving morphology. We demonstrate how these interventions reveal behavioural differences between models that are not captured by standard metrics such as Dice or IoU. While we instantiate our framework using a self-supervised transformer (CAUSE-ViT), the primary contribution of this work is not a new architecture, but a principled intervention-based methodology and evaluation metric for auditing model behaviour in medical image segmentation. Our results suggest that evaluating model behaviour through counterfactual interventions is essential for developing reliable and clinically robust medical image segmentation systems.

AI.title_translation: 测量重要性：一种用于组织病理学图像分割的因果依赖分数
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果干预的评估框架和因果依赖分数（CRS），以量化组织病理学图像分割模型对前景组织结构而非背景噪声的敏感性，揭示了标准指标未捕捉到的模型行为差异，并强调了反事实干预对开发可靠医疗图像分割系统的重要性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的组织病理学分割模型应依赖于病理学相关结构而非虚假背景关联。论文认为，仅改进架构不足以解决模型依赖虚假关联的问题，因此需要一种方法来明确探测模型对相关特征的依赖性。
AI.method: 本文引入了一个受因果关系启发的评估框架，该框架基于受控干预，明确探测模型对前景组织结构和背景/领域变化的敏感性。在此基础上，提出了一种因果依赖分数（CRS），量化模型预测在受控干预下对前景扰动与背景/领域变化的相对敏感性。为支持此分析，设计了在训练期间作为隐式反事实干预的增强策略，鼓励对无关因素的不变性，同时保留形态。
AI.result: 这些干预措施揭示了模型之间行为上的差异，而这些差异是Dice或IoU等标准指标无法捕捉到的。结果表明，通过反事实干预评估模型行为对于开发可靠且临床鲁棒的医学图像分割系统至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 通过反事实干预评估模型行为对于开发可靠且临床鲁棒的医学图像分割系统至关重要。
AI.translation: 可靠的组织病理学分割需要模型依赖于病理学相关的结构，而不是虚假的背景关联。在这项工作中，我们认为，如果模型继续依赖虚假关联而非病理学相关特征，仅改进架构是不足够的。我们引入了一个受因果关系启发的评估框架，该框架基于受控干预，明确探测模型对前景组织结构和背景/领域变化的敏感性。在此基础上，我们提出了因果依赖分数（CRS），这是一个量化模型预测在受控干预下对前景扰动与背景/领域变化的相对敏感性的指标。为了支持这项分析，我们设计了在训练期间作为隐式反事实干预的增强策略，鼓励对无关因素的不变性，同时保留形态。我们展示了这些干预措施如何揭示模型之间行为上的差异，而这些差异是Dice或IoU等标准指标无法捕捉到的。虽然我们使用自监督Transformer（CAUSE-ViT）实例化了我们的框架，但这项工作的主要贡献不是一个新的架构，而是一种基于干预的、有原则的方法论和评估指标，用于审计医学图像分割中的模型行为。我们的结果表明，通过反事实干预评估模型行为对于开发可靠且临床鲁棒的医学图像分割系统至关重要。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的因果启发评估框架和Causal Reliance Score (CRS)，旨在解决组织病理学图像分割模型过度依赖虚假背景关联而非病理学相关特征的问题。通过受控干预和隐式反事实增强策略，该方法能够量化模型预测对前景组织结构和背景变化的相对敏感性，从而揭示标准指标无法捕捉到的模型行为差异。研究强调，这种基于干预的评估方法对于开发可靠和临床鲁棒的医学图像分割系统至关重要，其主要贡献在于提供了一种审计模型行为的原则性方法论和评估指标。
AI.keywords: 组织病理学分割, 因果依赖分数, 反事实干预, 模型行为审计, 医学图像分割
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它将因果推断引入了医学图像分割模型的评估中，提出了一种新颖的、基于干预的方法论和指标（CRS），来审计模型的行为。它强调了仅仅改进模型架构是不够的，更重要的是要确保模型依赖于正确的、病理学相关的特征，而不是虚假的背景噪声。这对于提高医疗AI的可靠性和临床可信度具有重要意义，因为它能帮助开发者理解模型失败的原因，而不仅仅是观察其性能指标。

title: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
comments: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022
summary: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
comment: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022

AI.title_translation: 面向差速轮式机器人的结合编码器的视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合轮式编码器的紧耦合视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM系统，有效克服了纯视觉SLAM易失效的缺点，实现了高精度、鲁棒的实时状态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉惯性里程计（VIO）方法在实际实验中常常因为临时缺乏特征点和快速运动而失效，且大多数相关方法并未开源。为了克服纯视觉SLAM的这些局限性，本研究引入了轮式编码器来提升系统在恶劣条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对编码器的生成式测量模型，推导了最大后验（MAP）估计及优化所需的雅可比矩阵，并构建了一个紧耦合的视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-D SLAM系统。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上的测试表明，该系统实现了实时、准确且鲁棒的状态估计，均方根误差（RMSE）约为2-7厘米，并且已将源代码和包含编码器信息的数据集公开。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发并验证了一个紧耦合的视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-D SLAM系统，通过融合编码器数据克服了纯视觉SLAM的局限性，实现了高精度和鲁棒的实时状态估计。
AI.translation: 近年来，视觉惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了令人瞩目的成果，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化可以实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且在实际实验中往往由于临时缺乏特征点和快速运动而失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同步定位与建图（SLAM）的临时失效问题。在此，我们为编码器提出了一种生成式测量模型，并推导了最大后验（MAP）估计的表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用这一理论提出了一种新颖的紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-D SLAM系统。在我们自己采集的数据集上的测试证实，我们的建模工作实现了实时、准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为2-7厘米）且鲁棒的状态估计。包含编码器信息的源代码和数据集已发布以供验证。
AI.summary: 该论文针对差速轮式机器人提出了一种新型紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-D SLAM系统。通过引入专门设计的编码器生成式测量模型及MAP估计优化方法，有效解决了传统视觉SLAM在特征点缺失或快速运动时易失效的问题，实验证明其具备高精度和强鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 视觉惯性SLAM, 编码器, RGB-D, 紧耦合, 状态估计
AI.comments: 本文针对差速轮式机器人，创新性地提出了将轮式编码器与视觉、惯导及RGB-D传感器进行紧耦合的SLAM系统。其最大亮点在于提出了一种用于编码器的生成式测量模型并推导了相应的MAP估计与雅可比矩阵，有效解决了纯视觉方法在特征点缺失或快速运动时失效的问题。该开源工作对具身智能和移动机器人定位具有较高的实用价值。

title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
summary: Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the teacher's internal chain-of-thought (CoT) traces. Independent queries to the same teacher request intermediate derivations, validity checks, and corrections for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons with three baselines. We further introduce Stepwise Explanation Information Gain (SEIG), a diagnostic based on the log-ratio of a frozen student's probabilities of correct step completion under stepwise and global explanations. Analyses on GSM8K show that incorrect-answer trajectories can remain useful when they preserve valid intermediate reasoning, while further decomposition yields limited additional gains.

title: WorkIng: A Real-World and Synthetic Highway Work-Zone Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Navigation
comments: Accepted to WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material. (c) 2027 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted
summary: Highway work zones are critical edge cases for autonomous vehicles (AVs), combining atypical geometries and jurisdiction-specific regulations that existing benchmarks fail to capture: real-world datasets lack 360° multi-modal, full-scene 3D work zone annotation, and no single recorded site can span the layouts and regulatory variants needed for generalizable models. We present WorkIng, a dual-domain benchmark and training resource. WorkIng-Highway provides a 360° multi-modal work zone benchmark with synchronized 128-channel LiDAR, six RGB cameras, and RTK-GPS across 32 km, yielding 12,000+ annotated frames and 227,399 tracked 3D bounding boxes. WorkIng-CARLA complements this with procedural simulation spanning 24 regulation-aware scenarios across six canonical topologies and six international traffic standards, populated by 100+ custom 3D assets. Benchmarking representative 3D detection and end-to-end planning architectures shows that real-world data remains the primary performance driver, and that scenario-stratified synthetic augmentation improves architectures across 2D recognition, 3D detection, and trajectory planning. Resources: https://github.com/cvims/WorkIng
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material. (c) 2027 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted

title: MERIDIAN: Memory-Encoded Rituals for Intimacy across Distance in an Interactive, Asynchronous Neighbourhood
comments: 13 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Playable game: https://jingyifan.love; source code: https://github.com/rayford295/yi-town
summary: How can shared memories become playable structures for partners who live in different time zones? We present MERIDIAN, a pre-deployment design case of Yi Town, a bilingual browser game developed by one member of a long-distance couple as a gift for the other. Nine levels translate personally meaningful events, places and cultural references into tasks within a navigable pixel town. A birthday prologue and a fictional wedding frame the intended experience. Drawing on research through design, we reconstruct four design changes from 109 development commits, 28 changelog versions and three design specifications. These records support six situated design commitments, including memory-derived mechanics, staged access, local progress storage and bilingual coverage. The implementation combines a union-based progress model with manually exchanged, checksummed codes and time-zone-dependent scenery. An implementation audit reproduced 153 passing unit tests and examined all 1,024 canonical progress codes, while identifying limits involving resets, unversioned level registries and residual transcription errors. The application has no author-operated backend for progress, but external media services and browser speech recognition limit its privacy and offline guarantees. No recipient evaluation or relationship outcomes are reported. The contribution is an inspectable account of design decisions and their trade-offs, including the tension between authoring a personal gift and preserving the recipient's freedom to interpret, decline or reshape it. The game is playable at https://jingyifan.love and its source is public at https://github.com/rayford295/yi-town.

title: Characterizations and MacWilliams-Like Identities of Weakly Regular Bent Partitions
summary: Bent partitions play a significant role in the theory of bent functions. In this paper, we study weakly regular bent partitions, that is, all generated bent functions are weakly regular (called in class $\mathcal{WRBP}$). Let $Γ=\{A_{i}, i \in V_{m}\}$ be a bent partition of $V_{n}$ in class $\mathcal{WRBP}$, where $V_{n}$ denotes an $n$-dimensional vector space over the prime field $\mathbb{F}_{p}$, $n$ is even, $m \leq \frac{n}{2}$, and $m \geq 2$ if $p=2$. We first characterize bent partition $Γ$ in terms of the duals of component functions of vectorial bent functions. In particular, we prove that if $p \neq 3$, then all bent functions generated by $Γ$ are regular. Building on the above result, we give characterizations of bent partition $Γ$ in terms of two classes of linear codes. When $n \geq 4$ and $m=\frac{n}{2}$, except for the case where $(p, n)=(2, 4)$ and $|A_{i_{0}}|=1$ for some $i_{0}$, we show that $Γ$ is obtained from a spread (after a shift). Particularly, any normal bent partition of $V_{n}$ of depth $p^{\frac{n}{2}}$ in class $\mathcal{WRBP}$ must be obtained from a spread (after a shift), where $n \geq 4$. We establish the Macwilliams-like identities for bent partitions in class $\mathcal{WRBP}$. Furthermore, if $p$ is odd, we present some nonexistence results on bent partitions in class $\mathcal{WRBP}$.

title: Clinical-Protocol-Aware Cyber Resilience for Connected Clinical Technologies Under AI-Enabled Adversarial Conditions
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Healthcare increasingly relies on connected medical devices, clinical information systems, cloud services, and distributed-care technologies, creating cybersecurity risks across clinical workflows. AI-enabled capabilities can accelerate vulnerability discovery and attack-path analysis, increasing the need to limit compromise propagation. This paper proposes a clinical-protocol-aware cyber-resilience framework based on bounded clinical micro-networks and controlled interconnections. The framework integrates clinical factors into cybersecurity design, management, and evaluation, covering prevention, containment, and incident response. A parameterized Monte Carlo simulation distinguishes technical cyber exposure from modeled clinical consequence. Experiments investigate architectural connectivity, adversarial capability, security controls, protocol dependency, risk alignment, communication directionality, lifecycle integration, and response timing. Under the simulation assumptions, connected architecture increases mean cyber exposure by 56.3% relative to segmented architecture, while combined prevention and containment reduce exposure by 60.1% relative to no controls. Increasing protocol dependency raises the modeled clinical-impact index from 1.021 to 7.567 without changing mean cyber exposure, demonstrating that technical exposure and clinical consequence can diverge. Risk-alignment experiments further indicate higher modeled clinical impact when greater technical risk corresponds to greater clinical significance. The findings support comparative architectural analysis, not calibrated estimates of real-world cyber risk, control effectiveness, or patient harm. The framework provides a clinical-context-aware approach to security-boundary design, control prioritization, and coordinated containment in connected healthcare environments.

title: Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings
comments: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Eunchan24/PEEL
summary: Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. To test whether this regularity is usable, we introduce PEEL (Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies): a minimal probe over these frozen embeddings, trained once with an order-embedding objective that represents hierarchy as vector containment; a minimum spanning arborescence then decodes taxonomic DAGs. Using only a concept vocabulary (no documents), PEEL recovers taxonomic DAGs with high structural fidelity on two OLLM benchmarks, transferring to a new domain with no target-edge supervision. The end-to-end OLLM pipeline, which jointly discovers concepts and induces structure from document corpora, is reported as a cross-task reference. Pre-trained retrieval embeddings encode a decodable granularity gradient; a minimal probe renders it as explicit parent-child (is-a) structure.

title: Hard Sample-Conditioned Decorrelated Attention for Robust Face Recognition
comments: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Multi-head attention in Vision Transformers (ViTs) allows independent attention patterns across heads, but without explicit regularization, heads may learn redundant patterns rather than complementary roles. Correlation-based penalties encourage head disentanglement, yet apply uniform regularization across all training samples. In face recognition (FR), hard samples whose embeddings lie close to competing identities are critical for optimization and generalization. Motivated by this, we propose ViT-HarDis, which conditions attention head disentanglement on sample difficulty: samples with high cosine similarity to negative class centers receive stronger head decorrelation, enforcing specialization where identity ambiguity is highest. Experiments show improvements over both the baseline and uniform disentanglement on most benchmarks. Our analysis shows that ViT-HarDis reduces the similarity of hard samples to competing class centers while decreasing inter-head attention similarity, and that applying disentanglement only to the final transformer layers outperforms regularizing the entire network. Trained on WebFace4M, ViT-HarDis achieves SOTA results among ViT-based methods on IJB-B, IJB-C, and TinyFace Rank-1, while achieving the best IJB-B and TinyFace results when trained on MS1MV3, improving FR without architectural modifications or additional inference cost. Code: https://github.com/TaharChettaoui/Hard-Sample-Conditioned-Attention-for-FR.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

title: Different Models, Shared Failures: Auditing Frozen-Encoder Pools for Medical Segmentation
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 47 pages, 8 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/eunseobchoi/CoFailMed
summary: Average segmentation accuracy and model count do not reveal whether models fail on the same cases. We present CoFailMed, an audit of correlated failures in pretrained-encoder pools for medical segmentation. Across five 2D tasks, we evaluate 11 public pretrained encoders (a controlled sample, not a census) using frozen features and separately trained $1\times 1$ readouts with four seeds per encoder. Shared-checkpoint pairs have the highest mean per-case Dice correlation. An expanded 17-encoder analysis shows that distinct checkpoints within the same encoder family remain more correlated than cross-family pairs. At the pooled 33rd-percentile Dice threshold, four-member pools drawn from distinct encoders have mean effective sizes of 1.56-2.92, estimated from failure correlations in pools with enough failures and passes per member. In the primary pool, richer readouts and fine-tuning narrow the Dice-correlation gap between pairs sharing a checkpoint (or the DINOv2-B/S release) and all other pairs. Yet dependence between different encoders can increase, and fine-tuning does not consistently increase effective pool size at 33rd-percentile thresholds recomputed for each training recipe. A smaller between-group gap can coexist with greater dependence. Pool evaluation should therefore report absolute dependence and threshold-specific effective size alongside accuracy and nominal pool size. The CoFailMed release provides aligned per-case traces, analysis scripts and study code to reproduce the central audit results.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 47 pages, 8 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/eunseobchoi/CoFailMed

AI.title_translation: 不同模型，共同故障：医学分割冻结编码器池的审计研究
AI.tldr: 不同医学分割模型常在相同样本上共同失败，导致模型池的实际有效规模显著低于名义数量，微调亦难以消除这种故障依赖性。
AI.motivation: 平均分割准确率和模型数量无法揭示不同模型是否在相同的样本用例上发生故障，缺乏对预训练编码器模型池中相关性故障的系统审计。
AI.method: 提出了 CoFailMed 审计基准，在 5 个 2D 医学分割任务上，针对 11 个公开预训练编码器（使用冻结特征及每个编码器 4 个随机种子训练的 1x1 readout）进行每例 Dice 相关性评估，并扩展至 17 个编码器分析同家族与跨家族的相关性，同时探索了更丰富 readout 和微调对故障依赖性及有效池大小的影响。
AI.result: 共享检查点的模型对具有最高的每例 Dice 相关性，同家族但不同检查点间的相关性也高于跨家族模型对；在 33% 分位数 Dice 阈值下，由不同编码器组成的四成员模型池其平均有效大小仅为 1.56 至 2.92；更丰富的 readout 和微调会缩小检查点共享对与其它对之间的相关性差距，但不同编码器之间的依赖性可能增加，微调并不一定会增加有效池大小。
AI.conclusion: 模型池的评估应当在报告准确率和名义大小的同时，补充汇报绝对依赖性以及特定阈值下的有效池大小。
AI.translation: 平均分割准确率和模型数量无法揭示不同模型是否会在相同的病例上发生故障。我们提出了 CoFailMed，这是一项针对医学分割预训练编码器池中相关故障的审计研究。在五个 2D 任务中，我们使用冻结特征及每个编码器 4 个随机种子独立训练的 1×1 readout，对 11 个公开的预训练编码器（对照样本而非普查）进行了评估。共享检查点的模型对具有最高的平均每病例 Dice 相关性。对 17 个编码器的扩展分析表明，同一编码器家族内的不同检查点之间的相关性仍高于跨家族模型对。在汇集的第 33 百分位数 Dice 阈值下，从不同编码器中抽取的四成员模型池的平均有效大小仅为 1.56-2.92（基于在每个成员有足够失败和通过用例的模型池中的故障相关性估算）。在主要模型池中，更丰富的 readout 和微调缩小了共享检查点（或 DINOv2-B/S 发布版本）的模型对与所有其他模型对之间的 Dice 相关性差距。然而，不同编码器之间的依赖性可能会增加，并且在为每个训练方案重新计算的第 33 百分位数阈值下，微调并不能持续增加有效模型池大小。组间差距缩小可以与更大的依赖性并存。因此，模型池评估应在报告准确率和名义大小的同时，汇报绝对依赖性和特定阈值的有效大小。CoFailMed 开源了对齐的每病例追踪数据、分析脚本和研究代码，以复现核心审计结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CoFailMed，用于审计医学分割预训练编码器池中的相关性故障。通过跨 5 个 2D 任务评估多个预训练编码器，发现同家族模型存在高度故障相关性，导致模型池的实际有效大小显著低于名义大小，微调也无法稳定提升有效多样性。因此研究建议在模型池评估中引入绝对依赖性和有效池大小指标。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分割, 预训练编码器, 故障相关性, 有效池大小, 审计分析
AI.comments: 该研究关注医学图像分割模型池中的相关故障（correlated failures），指出仅靠平均准确率和模型名义数量会高估集成的多样性，具有重要的实用与安全性审查价值。其局限在于目前仅在五个2D任务和有限的预训练编码器样本上进行了审计。

title: Implicit Assumptions About Tasks in Continual Learning
comments: Accepted to the Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Continual learning is the study of how a model accumulates knowledge from data received over time, rather than all at once. In practice, this is typically achieved by dividing a dataset into tasks and presenting them sequentially. Explanations of the resulting measurements take into account factors such as the similarity between segments, the rate at which the data changes and the order of presentation. Each of these factors can be defined in terms of the underlying data, the partition imposed on it, or the learner that encounters it. These levels do not necessarily coincide, and it is usually left implicit which level a reported quantity refers to. We separate these and identify which properties acquire a value at each level. In controlled teacher--student experiments, we demonstrate that partitioning the same underlying trajectory at different levels of granularity, changing the order of presentation, and varying the similarity structure of the underlying data all result in different measured outcomes. We review representative benchmarks to determine which of these properties are stated. Where the underlying data cannot be inspected, as in foundation models built on undisclosed pre-training corpora, its properties are inherited by the model's initial state, and the training applied on top of it can be described.
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents at NeurIPS 2026

AI.title_translation: 持续学习中关于任务的隐式假设
AI.tldr: 持续学习中，对数据、任务划分和学习者三个层面因素的测量结果常因隐式假设而混淆，本文旨在区分这些层面并实验证明其对学习结果的影响。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中，解释模型性能时考虑的因素（如数据相似性、变化率、呈现顺序）可以从底层数据、数据划分或学习者本身三个层面定义。然而，这些层面常常不一致，且报告的量化指标通常隐式地指代某个层面，导致混淆。因此，本文旨在明确区分这些层面及其属性。
AI.method: 本文首先区分了持续学习中影响因素的三个层面（底层数据、数据划分、学习者）及其各自的属性。然后，通过受控的师生实验，证明了在不同粒度上划分相同的基础轨迹、改变呈现顺序以及改变基础数据的相似性结构都会导致不同的测量结果。此外，本文还回顾了代表性的基准测试，以确定其中哪些属性被明确说明。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在不同粒度上划分相同的基础轨迹、改变呈现顺序以及改变基础数据的相似性结构都会导致不同的测量结果。这强调了明确区分数据、划分和学习者层面属性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过区分持续学习中任务的隐式假设层面，并实验证明这些层面因素（如数据划分粒度、呈现顺序、数据相似性）对学习结果有显著影响。这表明在评估和解释持续学习模型的性能时，必须明确这些隐式假设，尤其是在底层数据不可检查的场景下。
AI.translation: 持续学习是研究模型如何从随时间接收到的数据中积累知识，而不是一次性接收所有数据。在实践中，这通常通过将数据集划分为任务并按顺序呈现来实现。对所得测量结果的解释会考虑诸如片段之间的相似性、数据变化的速度和呈现顺序等因素。这些因素中的每一个都可以根据底层数据、对其施加的划分或遇到它的学习者来定义。这些层面不一定一致，并且报告的量化指标通常隐式地指代哪个层面。我们区分了这些层面，并确定了每个层面获得值的属性。在受控的师生实验中，我们证明了在不同粒度上划分相同的基础轨迹、改变呈现顺序以及改变基础数据的相似性结构都会导致不同的测量结果。我们回顾了代表性的基准测试，以确定其中哪些属性被明确说明。在底层数据无法检查的情况下，例如在基于未公开预训练语料库构建的基础模型中，其属性由模型的初始状态继承，并且可以在其上应用的训练进行描述。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了持续学习中关于任务的隐式假设问题。持续学习通过顺序任务来积累知识，但对性能的解释常混淆了数据、任务划分和学习者这三个层面的因素。作者区分了这些层面及其属性，并通过受控实验证明，数据划分粒度、呈现顺序和数据相似性结构的变化都会显著影响测量结果。文章还审查了现有基准测试，并讨论了在基础模型中底层数据不可检查时，其属性如何由模型初始状态继承的问题，强调了明确这些隐式假设的重要性。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 隐式假设, 任务划分, 数据相似性, 学习者层面
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入分析持续学习中存在的隐式假设，揭示了在评估和解释模型性能时，数据、任务划分和学习者这三个层面的因素常常被混淆的问题。其创新点在于明确区分了这些层面，并通过实验验证了它们对学习结果的独立影响。这对于持续学习领域的基准测试设计、结果解释以及未来研究方向都具有重要指导意义，尤其是在面对大型预训练模型时，对底层数据属性的理解变得尤为关键。

title: Whose Values, Which Contexts, and What Signals? Grounding Cultural Value Alignment with Re3Culture
summary: Cultural value alignment requires not only model optimization but also a well-specified target grounded in real-human evidence. Yet how such targets should be grounded in human data remains largely unexplored, raising three fundamental questions: (1) whose values should be represented? (2) where should cultural values be observed? and (3) what signals reveal underlying values? We investigate these questions through Re3Culture, a large-scale dataset linking (i) Representative communities: 700+ human participants across four cultures recruited through cultural-affiliation screening and demographic-aware sampling; (ii) Realistic scenario: culturally sensitive scenarios selected by community members, e.g., family and kinship; and (iii) Revealed value signals: 1,400+ value surveys, 20,000+ topic-grounded behavioral principles and explicit value priorities with responses for 6,000+ situated questions. Our analysis shows why these choices matter for defining the target, with three implications. First, estimating cultural values requires both community affiliation and broad internal coverage. Substituting other cultures or restricting subgroup coverage shifts value estimates. LLM simulations also disproportionately reflect particular subgroups. Second, values must be observed in concrete, community-guided situations. Abstract questionnaire profiles weakly recover situated priorities, and communities differ in which scenarios they identify as culturally value-revealing. Third, value priorities should be elicited explicitly, not learned from response preferences or bottom-line answers alone. Preferences conflate value agreement with other response-level qualities, and similar answers can be derived from different value priorities. By addressing these requirements, Re3Culture provides the first human-grounded resource that explicitly informs target definition for cultural value alignment.

AI.title_translation: 谁的价值观、何种情境以及何种信号？利用 Re3Culture 实现基于现实的文化价值对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出基于真实人类数据的大规模数据集 Re3Culture，系统阐明了文化价值对齐中代表群体、现实情境与显式价值信号三大关键要素对定义对齐目标的重要性。
AI.motivation: 文化价值对齐不仅需要优化模型，还需要建立在真实人类证据之上的明确目标。然而如何利用人类数据确立这些目标仍未被充分探索，主要面临三个根本问题：代表谁的价值观、在何种情境下观察文化价值，以及通过何种信号揭示潜在的价值观。
AI.method: 构建了包含三大核心维度的大规模数据集 Re3Culture：（1）代表性群体：通过文化归属筛选与人口统计感知抽样，招募覆盖4种文化的700多名真实人类参与者；（2）现实情境：由社区成员挑选文化敏感场景（如家庭与亲属关系）；（3）揭示的价值信号：采集1400多份价值调查、20000多个基于主题的行为原则与显式价值优先级，以及针对6000多个情境化问题的回答。
AI.result: 分析揭示了三项关键结果：（1）评估文化价值需兼顾社区归属与广泛的内部子群体覆盖，替换文化群体、限制子群体覆盖或使用大模型模拟都会导致价值估计失真；（2）价值观必须在由社区引导的具体情境中观察，抽象问卷难以复原情境化优先级，各文化对哪些情境能揭示价值也存在认知差异；（3）价值优先级应显式诱导，而非仅从回复偏好或最终答案推导，因为偏好易混淆价值认同与回复质量，且相似答案可能源自不同价值偏好。
AI.conclusion: Re3Culture 满足了文化价值对齐目标定义中的代表性群体、具体现实情境和显式价值信号三项核心要求，提供了首个能够显式指导文化价值对齐目标定义的人类证据资源。
AI.translation: 文化价值对齐不仅需要模型优化，还需要基于真实人类证据且明确定义的目标。然而，此类目标应如何扎根于人类数据仍基本未被探索，这引发了三个基本问题：（1）应该代表谁的价值观？（2）文化价值观应该在何处被观察？（3）什么信号能够揭示潜在的价值观？我们通过 Re3Culture 研究了这些问题，这是一个将以下三者联系起来的大规模数据集：（i）代表性群体：通过文化归属筛选和人口统计感知抽样招募的跨越四种文化的 700 多名人类参与者；（ii）现实情境：由社区成员选择的文化敏感场景，例如家庭和亲属关系；（iii）揭示的价值信号：1400 多份价值调查、20000 多个基于主题的行为原则和明确的价值优先级，以及针对 6000 多个情境化问题的回答。我们的分析展示了为什么这些选择对于定义对齐目标至关重要，并带来了三点启示。首先，评估文化价值观既需要社区归属，也需要广泛的内部覆盖。替代其他文化或限制子群体覆盖会改变价值估计，大语言模型模拟也过度不成比例地反映了特定子群体。其次，必须在具体的、由社区引导的情境中观察价值观。抽象的问卷画像很难复原情境化优先级，并且各社区在认定哪些情境具有文化价值揭示性上存在差异。第三，价值优先级应该被显式诱导出来，而不能仅从回复偏好或最终答案中学习。偏好会将价值观认同与其他回复层面的质量混为一谈，而且相似的答案可能源于不同的价值优先级。通过解决这些需求，Re3Culture 提供了第一个基于真实人类的资源，明确为文化价值对齐的目标定义提供了依据。
AI.summary: 本研究针对文化价值对齐目标的定义问题，提出了连接代表性群体、现实情境与显式价值信号的大规模数据集 Re3Culture。研究发现，准确定义文化对齐目标必须依赖具有广泛内部覆盖的特定社区群体、具体且由社区引导的情境，以及显式诱导的价值优先级，为构建更可靠的文化对齐基准提供了首个基于真实人类数据的系统资源。
AI.keywords: 文化价值对齐, Re3Culture, 代表性社区, 价值信号, 情境化优先级
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了文化价值对齐的核心瓶颈——即对齐目标本身缺乏真实人类经验与科学定义的支撑。研究通过提出三维框架（谁的价值、何种情境、何种信号）并构建大规模跨文化数据集 Re3Culture，指出了当前利用大模型模拟人类文化或依靠抽象问卷与隐式回复偏好的局限性，对AI对齐的严谨性和跨文化适应性具有重要指导意义。其潜在局限在于目前仅覆盖了4个文化群体，扩展至更多元、更细粒度的文化语境仍面临较高的标注与采样成本。

title: Accurate and Auditable ECG Classification via Visibility Graph Neural Networks
comments: 43 pages, 10 figures, 21 tables, including Supplementary Information
summary: Physicians read electrocardiograms (ECGs) from waveform shape and timing, yet accurate deep-learning classifiers rarely show which waveform regions drive their predictions. We introduce LYNX-ECG, a graph neural network that represents each heartbeat as a sparse visibility graph of timestamped turning points. On CODE-Test, LYNX-ECG reaches a macro F1 score of 0.889, outperforming five baselines including the ECGFounder foundation model, while its graphs need about 14% of the storage of graphs built from every sample. Because each node maps to a specific ECG time, we can delete clinically defined waveform regions and alter beat timing to audit predictions. For conduction disorders, the clinically expected region was the strongest evidence in more than 90% of correct predictions. Bradycardia and tachycardia calls follow heart rate with conduction intervals held fixed, and atrial fibrillation calls vanish when beat-to-beat variation is removed. Sparse visibility graphs thus pair accurate ECG classification with clinically grounded, testable explanations.
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 21 tables, including Supplementary Information

AI.title_translation: 通过可见性图神经网络实现准确且可审计的心电图分类
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LYNX-ECG的可见性图神经网络，在保证高心电图分类准确率的同时，实现了基于时间戳和临床区域的可审计解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习心电图分类器虽然准确，但很少展示驱动其预测的具体波形区域，缺乏可解释性和临床可审计性。
AI.method: 提出LYNX-ECG模型，将每个心跳表示为带有时间戳转折点的稀疏可见性图，并利用图神经网络进行心电图分类，同时通过删除特定波形区域和改变心跳时序来审计预测结果。
AI.result: 在CODE-Test数据集上，LYNX-ECG达到了0.889的宏F1分数，超越了包括ECGFounder在内的五个基线模型；同时，其稀疏图仅需全样本图约14%的存储空间，且在传导障碍、心动过缓/过速及房颤的预测审计中表现出高度的临床一致性。
AI.conclusion: LYNX-ECG结合了高准确性与可解释性，为基于心电图的深度学习分类提供了一种临床可信赖的新方案。
AI.translation: 医师通过波形形状和时序来阅读心电图（ECG），然而准确的深度学习分类器很少展示哪些波形区域驱动了它们的预测。我们介绍了LYNX-ECG，这是一个图神经网络，它将每个心跳表示为带时间戳转折点的稀疏可见性图。在CODE-Test上，LYNX-ECG达到了0.889的宏F1分数，优于包括ECGFounder基础模型在内的五个基线模型，同时其图所需的存储空间约为从每个样本构建的图的14%。由于每个节点映射到特定的ECG时间，我们可以删除临床定义的波形区域并改变心跳时序来审计预测。对于传导障碍，临床预期的区域在90%以上的正确预测中是最强的证据。在保持传导间期固定的情况下，心动过缓和心动过速的预测遵循心率，而当去除节拍间的变异时，房颤的预测则会消失。因此，稀疏可见性图将准确的心电图分类与临床扎实的、可测试的解释结合在了一起。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LYNX-ECG，一种基于稀疏可见性图的心电图神经网络分类器。它通过将心跳转化为图结构，在超越现有基线模型准确率的同时，实现了对临床波形区域和心跳时序的可解释性审计，验证了模型决策的临床合理性。
AI.keywords: 心电图分类, 可见性图神经网络, 可解释性AI, 临床审计, 心律失常
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将可见性图神经网络（Visibility GNN）引入ECG分类，不仅在公开数据集上取得了优于现有基础模型的性能，还通过图节点与时间戳的直接映射实现了可解释性和可审计性，具有极高的临床应用价值。

title: A two-stage diffusion-driven morphogenesis model with evolving connectivity
comments: Submitted to Applied Mathematical Modelling. Animation available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23808711
summary: Morphogenesis of diatom silica shells involves a sequence of topological transitions: initially separate ribs grow and branch, then merge through bridges, leaving a regular network of pores. Existing models based on diffusion-limited aggregation or reaction-diffusion reproduce either branching or pore formation, but not both within a single framework. Here we propose a two-stage model of diffusion-driven morphogenesis with evolving connectivity. The model is formulated on a fixed finite element mesh with a density field on an active layer. Stage 1 reproduces dendritic growth, where a stimulus based on the local diffusive flux exceeds a threshold. Stage 2 uses an inverted stimulus, where high local flux suppresses precipitation, stabilizing pores between the dendrites. The update rules are analogous to sensitivity in density-based topology optimization and to strain energy density in bone remodeling. The model predicts distinct morphological regimes on each stage, controlled by the respective thresholds. For a reference calculation, the predicted pore network is regular, with approximately uniform spacing, and pores are absent near the domain edges, consistent with observations on diatom valves. The model provides a unified framework for describing both stages of silica morphogenesis and suggests a route for comparing computational predictions with cryo-electron tomography data.

AI.title_translation: 具有演化连通性的两阶段扩散驱动形态发生模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合拓扑优化思想的两阶段扩散驱动模型，在统一计算框架下成功复现了硅藻硅壳的树突分支生长与规则微孔形成。
AI.motivation: 硅藻硅壳形态发生包含肋条生长分支随后桥接融合形成规则孔隙网络的拓扑转变，而现有的扩散限制凝聚或反应-扩散模型只能单独复现分支或孔隙形成，无法在单一统一框架中兼顾两者。
AI.method: 基于固定有限元网格及活性层密度场构建两阶段扩散驱动模型：第一阶段基于局部扩散通量超阈值的刺激驱动树突生长；第二阶段采用反转刺激规则（局部高通量抑制沉淀）以稳定树突间的孔隙。模型更新规则类比于基于密度的拓扑优化灵敏度与骨重塑中的应变能密度。
AI.result: 模型预测了由各阶段阈值控制的不同形态机制。参考算例预测出了间距大致均匀的规则孔隙网络，且在区域边缘附近不存在孔隙，与硅藻壳瓣的实际生物观察结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该模型建立了一个统一的理论与计算框架，能够同时描述硅质外壳形态发生的分支与孔隙形成两个阶段，并为将数值预测与冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）实验数据进行直接对比提供了途径。
AI.translation: 硅藻硅质外壳的形态发生涉及一系列拓扑转变：最初相互独立的肋条先生长并分支，随后通过桥连结构发生融合，从而留下规则的孔隙网络。现有基于扩散限制凝聚或反应-扩散的模型仅能重现分支或孔隙形成中的一种，而无法在单一框架内兼顾两者。在此，我们提出了一种具有演化连通性的两阶段扩散驱动形态发生模型。该模型建立在固定的有限元网格上，并在活性层上定义了密度场。第一阶段复现了树突状生长，其驱动机制为基于局部扩散通量超过某一阈值；第二阶段则采用反转刺激机制，局部高通量会抑制沉淀，从而使树突之间的孔隙得以稳定。该模型的更新规则类比于基于密度的拓扑优化中的灵敏度以及骨重塑中的应变能密度。模型预测了在各自阈值控制下各阶段不同的形态特征模式。参考计算显示，所预测的孔隙网络分布规则且间距大致均匀，且在结构域边缘附近无孔隙，这与硅藻壳瓣上的观察结果一致。该模型为描述硅质形态发生的两个阶段提供了一个统一的框架，并为将计算预测结果与冷冻电子断层成像数据进行对比提供了途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种具有演化连通性的两阶段扩散驱动有限元形态发生模型，第一阶段通过扩散通量刺激驱动树突生长，第二阶段通过反转刺激抑制沉淀以稳定微孔，在单一框架内成功再现了硅藻外壳从肋条分支到规则孔隙网络形成的拓扑转变过程。
AI.keywords: 硅藻形态发生, 扩散驱动模型, 拓扑转变, 有限元网格, 孔隙网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于跳出了传统的单纯反应-扩散或扩散限制凝聚（DLA）框架，巧妙地引入了类似工程拓扑优化和骨重塑的反向响应机制，成功用统一的连续体两阶段模型同时复现了复杂的分支生长与闭孔网络形成；其重要性体现在为连接理论生物形态发生模型与先进实验表征（如冷冻电镜断层成像）建立了桥梁。

title: On-device Detection of Wearer-induced NLOS on Chest-worn UWB Tags: Machine Learning, Link Indicators, or Both?
comments: Submitted to ACM Transactions on Sensor Networks
summary: Ultra-wideband (UWB) enables high-accuracy distance estimation (ranging), but performance degrades in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions. When UWB tags are worn, the human body inevitably causes a wearer-induced NLOS (WNLOS), yielding significant errors; still, despite its relevance, WNLOS remains understudied. Moreover, WNLOS detection typically must occur on-device at the tag, requiring classification accuracy to be balanced against tight runtime and energy constraints often hard to meet with machine learning (ML) -- the dominating NLOS classification approach. Meanwhile, UWB radio link indicators (LI) offer a faster and lightweight alternative that has rarely been explored. We study existing on-device ML and LI classifiers when applied to WNLOS, and propose novel hybrid ones exploiting their complementarity. We focus on chest-worn tags and analyze 21 classifiers on a dataset of 1.5 million samples across channels, PHY settings, environments, subjects, and orientations. Results show that while all of them achieve good classification accuracy, relative performance, including ranging errors due to misclassification, depends heavily on channel and PHY configuration. Runtime and energy efficiency also vary dramatically; some techniques offer marginal accuracy gains while consuming up to 39.6x more energy. Therefore, we also introduce a recommender tool to identify optimal classifiers under user-defined constraints, publicly released with our dataset.
comment: Submitted to ACM Transactions on Sensor Networks

AI.title_translation: 胸戴式UWB标签上佩戴者引起的非视距端侧检测：机器学习、链路指标，还是两者结合？
AI.tldr: 本文研究了胸戴式UWB标签的WNLOS端侧检测，评估并比较了机器学习与链路指标方法，创新性地提出了混合分类方案及分类器推荐工具，有效平衡了检测精度与端侧资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 超宽带（UWB）标签在穿戴时人体不可避免地会引起佩戴者导致的非视距（WNLOS）情况从而产生显著误差，但该问题研究不足；同时，主流的机器学习分类方法难以满足端侧设备严格的运行时间和能耗限制，而轻量级的射频链路指标（LI）又很少被探索。
AI.method: 研究了现有的端侧机器学习（ML）和链路指标（LI）分类器在WNLOS检测中的应用，提出了结合两者互补性的新型混合分类器，并在包含150万个样本的数据集上分析了21种分类器，最后开发了一个在用户自定义约束下识别最优分类器的推荐工具。
AI.result: 所有分类器都达到了良好的分类精度，但相对性能（包括误分类引起的测距误差）高度依赖于通道和PHY配置；运行时间和能耗差异巨大，某些技术在带来微小精度提升的同时多消耗高达39.6倍的能量。
AI.conclusion: WNLOS检测性能受通道和PHY配置影响显著，传统的ML方法虽准确但能耗高，而结合ML与LI的混合方法及推荐工具能够有效平衡精度、运行时间和能耗。
AI.translation: 超宽带（UWB）能够实现高精度的距离估计（测距），但在非视距（NLOS）条件下性能会下降。当佩戴UWB标签时，人体不可避免地会引起佩戴者导致的NLOS（WNLOS），产生显著的误差；尽管其具有相关性，但WNLOS仍未得到充分研究。此外，WNLOS检测通常必须在标签端侧进行，这要求分类精度必须与严苛的运行时间和能量限制相平衡，而这往往很难通过作为主导NLOS分类方法的机器学习（ML）来满足。同时，UWB无线电链路指标（LI）提供了一种更快、更轻量级的替代方案，但很少被探索。我们研究了现有的应用于WNLOS的端侧ML和LI分类器，并提出了利用其互补性的新型混合分类器。我们专注于胸戴式标签，并在涵盖不同信道、PHY设置、环境、受试者和方向的150万个样本数据集上分析了21种分类器。结果表明，虽然所有分类器都取得了良好的分类精度，但相对性能（包括由于误分类导致的测距误差）严重依赖于信道和PHY配置。运行时间和能效也存在巨大差异；某些技术在提供微不足道精度提升的同时，消耗了高达39.6倍的能量。因此，我们还引入了一个推荐工具，以在用户定义的约束下识别最优分类器，并随数据集一起公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文针对胸戴式UWB标签上由于人体遮挡引发的WNLOS检测问题，对比评估了端侧机器学习与链路指标分类器，提出了互补的混合分类方法，并发布了基于用户约束的最优分类器推荐工具和大规模数据集。
AI.keywords: Ultra-wideband, Wearer-induced NLOS, Machine learning, Link indicators, On-device detection
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究了胸戴式超宽带(UWB)标签在人体遮挡引起的非视距(WNLOS)条件下的检测问题，不仅对比了传统的机器学习和轻量级的链路指标(LI)方法，还创新性地提出了两者的混合方法，并开发了针对特定约束的最优分类器推荐工具，对资源受限的边缘设备具有很高的实用价值。

title: Reparo: Synthesizing and Validating Access Control Policies
summary: Writing correct access control policies for software applications is difficult because it requires expertise in the authorization language and a thorough understanding of the application's authorization requirements. Existing synthesis and mining approaches assume explicit authorization inputs and a trusted reference policy. However, authorization logic is often distributed across code, comments, and documentation rather than captured in a single artifact, and developer-defined policies in real-world application repositories are often incomplete, outdated, or incorrect. We present Reparo, an LLM-aided pipeline for access control policy synthesis, repair, and validation. Reparo collects repository evidence for authorization intent and uses it to guide an LLM in generating an initial policy. It then uses official policy-language validation tools to identify and automatically repair errors. For semantic validation, a different LLM derives a behavioral oracle from the same repository evidence, consisting of concrete authorization requests with expected allow or deny decisions, which Reparo executes against the generated policy. We manually assess the oracle on a statistically sized sample of 390 test cases. We evaluate Reparo on 228 real-world GitHub repositories that use Cedar, OpenFGA, or Rego. In these repositories, 40.6-55.7% of the repository policies fail their language's validation tool, whereas Reparo produces 99.0-100% valid policies after repair. Agreement with the oracle is 98.2-99.6% for OpenFGA, 82.0-86.5% for Cedar, and 76.3-80.2% for Rego. Manual review confirms 91.5-96.9% of the sampled test cases as correct. Synthesizing and validating the policy for one repository takes about five minutes and costs $0.55-$1.57. These results show that repository evidence can support both access policy synthesis and independent validation, even when no reliable reference policy exists.

AI.title_translation: Reparo：访问控制策略的合成与验证
AI.tldr: Reparo利用大语言模型和代码库证据，自动合成、修复并验证现实软件应用中的访问控制策略，解决了传统方法依赖可靠参考策略的痛点。
AI.motivation: 编写正确的访问控制策略既困难又需要专业知识，而现有的合成与挖掘方法高度依赖显式的授权输入和可信的参考策略。然而，现实应用中的授权逻辑往往分散在代码、注释和文档中，且开发者编写的策略常常不完整、过时或错误。
AI.method: 提出Reparo框架，首先收集代码库中的授权意图证据以引导大语言模型生成初始策略；然后利用官方策略语言验证工具自动修复语法错误；最后通过另一个大语言模型根据相同的代码库证据派生出行为谕示（包含具体授权请求与期望结果），对生成的策略进行语义验证。
AI.result: 在228个真实GitHub仓库（使用Cedar、OpenFGA或Rego）的评估中，原始仓库策略有40.6-55.7%无法通过语法验证，而Reparo经修复后可产生99.0-100%的有效策略；与行为谕示的一致性在OpenFGA中达到98.2-99.6%，在Cedar中为82.0-86.5%，在Rego中为76.3-80.2%；单个仓库的合成与验证平均耗时约5分钟，成本为0.55至1.57美元。
AI.conclusion: Reparo证明了利用代码库中的多样化证据能够有效支持访问控制策略的自动化合成与独立验证，即使在缺乏可靠参考策略的现实场景中也能生成高质量且语法正确的策略。
AI.translation: 为软件应用程序编写正确的访问控制策略是很困难的，因为它需要授权语言的专业知识以及对应用程序授权要求的透彻理解。现有的合成和挖掘方法假设有显式的授权输入和可信的参考策略。然而，授权逻辑通常分布在代码、注释和文档中，而不是捕获在单个工件中，并且真实应用程序仓库中由开发人员定义的策略通常是不完整的、过时的或不正确的。我们提出了Reparo，一个用于访问控制策略合成、修复和验证的LLM辅助管道。Reparo收集仓库中关于授权意图的证据，并引导LLM生成初始策略。然后，它使用官方的策略语言验证工具来识别和自动修复错误。对于语义验证，另一个LLM从相同的仓库证据中派生出一个行为谕示（behavioral oracle），包含具有预期允许或拒绝决策的具体授权请求，Reparo针对生成的策略执行这些请求。我们对手工抽样的390个测试案例（达到统计规模）进行了手动评估。我们在使用Cedar、OpenFGA或Rego的228个真实GitHub仓库上评估了Reparo。在这些仓库中，40.6-55.7%的仓库策略未通过其语言的验证工具，而Reparo在修复后产生了99.0-100%的有效策略。与行为谕示的一致性对于OpenFGA为98.2-99.6%，对于Cedar为82.0-86.5%，对于Rego为76.3-80.2%。人工审查证实了抽样测试用例中91.5-96.9%是正确的。为一个仓库合成和验证策略大约需要五分钟，成本为0.55至1.57美元。这些结果表明，即使在没有可靠参考策略的情况下，仓库证据也可以支持访问策略的合成和独立验证。
AI.summary: Reparo是一个由大语言模型辅助的管道，用于访问控制策略的合成、修复与验证。它利用代码库中的证据引导LLM生成策略，并通过官方工具修复语法错误，同时利用派生的行为谕示进行语义验证，从而在缺乏可靠参考策略的情况下高效产出高质量的访问控制策略。
AI.keywords: 访问控制策略, 大语言模型, 策略合成, 代码库证据, 语义验证
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的、基于LLM的访问控制策略合成与验证管道（Reparo），有效解决了现实世界中授权逻辑分散且缺乏可靠参考策略的难题。其结合了静态代码证据收集、语言级语法验证以及语义行为谕示（Behavioral Oracle）验证，展现出极高的自动化程度和实用价值。

title: Towards Out-of-Distribution Uncertainty Quantification for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials via Pre-Training
summary: Informative uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the practical deployment of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), as it provides insight into their reliability across chemical space. Although numerous post-hoc uncertainty estimation methods for MLIPs have recently been proposed, most have been trained in low-data regimes, restricting their applicability to narrow domains of interest. Inspired by the emergence of foundational MLIPs, we propose pre-training uncertainty estimators on large, diverse datasets to enable broader applicability. We pre-train several UQ models on large materials science datasets to quantify the uncertainty of different MLIPs, and evaluate their performance on both in-distribution and out-of-domain (OOD) adsorption-energy predictions. We find that pre-trained uncertainty estimators provide viable zero-shot uncertainty estimates across multiple datasets, while fine-tuning consistently yields positive correlations between predicted uncertainty and prediction error, even on the most challenging datasets. These results lay the groundwork for foundational UQ models for MLIPs, ultimately facilitating their deployment in practical settings by providing users with a priori information about model reliability and applicability.

AI.title_translation: 通过预训练实现机器学习原子间势的分布外不确定性量化
AI.tldr: 通过在大型多样化数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，可以为机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）提供可靠的分布内外不确定性量化，从而促进其在实际应用中的部署。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的实际部署需要准确的不确定性量化（UQ）来评估其在整个化学空间中的可靠性。然而，现有的UQ方法多在低数据量下训练，限制了其适用范围。
AI.method: 受基础MLIPs的启发，本文提出在大型、多样化的数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，以实现更广泛的适用性。研究人员在大型材料科学数据集上预训练了多个UQ模型，用以量化不同MLIPs的不确定性，并在分布内和分布外（OOD）吸附能预测上评估了它们的性能。
AI.result: 研究发现，预训练的不确定性估计器在多个数据集上提供了可行的零样本不确定性估计。此外，通过微调，预测不确定性与预测误差之间始终表现出正相关，即使在最具挑战性的数据集上也是如此。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为机器学习原子间势的基础不确定性量化模型奠定了基础，通过提供关于模型可靠性和适用性的先验信息，最终有助于其在实际环境中的部署。
AI.translation: 信息丰富的不确定性量化（UQ）对于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的实际部署至关重要，因为它提供了对它们在化学空间中可靠性的洞察。尽管最近提出了许多针对MLIPs的事后不确定性估计方法，但大多数都是在低数据量状态下训练的，这限制了它们在狭窄感兴趣领域中的适用性。受基础MLIPs出现的启发，我们建议在大型、多样化数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，以实现更广泛的适用性。我们预训练了几个UQ模型，在大型材料科学数据集上量化不同MLIPs的不确定性，并评估了它们在分布内和分布外（OOD）吸附能预测上的性能。我们发现，预训练的不确定性估计器在多个数据集上提供了可行的零样本不确定性估计，而微调始终在预测不确定性和预测误差之间产生正相关，即使在最具挑战性的数据集上也是如此。这些结果为MLIPs的基础UQ模型奠定了基础，最终通过向用户提供模型可靠性和适用性的先验信息，促进了它们在实际环境中的部署。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过在大型多样化数据集上预训练不确定性估计器的方法，以解决机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）不确定性量化（UQ）在分布外适用性受限的问题。研究表明，预训练的UQ模型能提供有效的零样本不确定性估计，并且微调后，预测不确定性与预测误差之间呈现一致的正相关，这为构建基础性UQ模型并促进MLIPs在实际应用中的部署奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 机器学习原子间势, 不确定性量化, 预训练, 分布外, 基础模型
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入预训练范式来解决机器学习原子间势不确定性量化模型的适用范围限制，具有重要的创新性。它为构建更通用、更可靠的基础性UQ模型提供了新思路，有望显著提升MLIPs在材料科学等实际应用中的部署效率和安全性。

title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
comments: 14 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, data and every monitor call: https://github.com/Mahmoud-Abbasi-svg/agent-trace-detector-eval
summary: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. Second, as tool coverage, the share of test tool calls whose tool was seen in training, falls, detector rankings cross near 50% coverage and reverse below it, because unseen tools map to inputs that training never reached. Dropout on tool inputs largely removes the reversal. Third, no detector trained on AgentDrift ranks AgentDojo traces better than chance (AUROC 0.47 to 0.52), including one that reaches 0.996 within AgentDojo. The monitor, trained on neither, reaches 0.930, but with its open backbone its released decision rule would still mostly raise false alerts at a 2% attack rate (precision 0.096). We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating trace detectors.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, data and every monitor call: https://github.com/Mahmoud-Abbasi-svg/agent-trace-detector-eval

AI.title_translation: 标准评估对被劫持LLM代理检测器隐藏了什么：罕见攻击、未见工具和基准迁移
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前LLM代理劫持检测器评估方法的局限性，包括对罕见攻击、未见工具和基准迁移的不足，并提出了评估清单。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM代理劫持检测器评估方法在攻击率、工具覆盖率和基准泛化能力方面存在缺陷，未能充分揭示检测器的真实性能，因此本文旨在探究这些标准评估所隐藏的问题。
AI.method: 作者首先审计了11项现有评估，然后使用AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准测试了多种训练过的检测器（读取工具身份、行为、调用序列、步嵌入或文本）以及一个已发布的LLM行动监控器AlignmentCheck。他们通过固定训练数据阈值或使用监控器发布的决策规则进行测试，并分析了不同攻击率、工具覆盖率和基准迁移场景下的检测器性能。
AI.result: 1. 在2%的攻击率下，AUROC为0.879的检测器精确度仅为0.076，且负样本混合会使精确度在0.039到0.117之间波动。2. 随着工具覆盖率的下降，检测器排名在约50%覆盖率处交叉并在其下方反转，因为未见工具会映射到训练未达到的输入；工具输入上的Dropout在很大程度上消除了这种反转。3. 在AgentDrift上训练的检测器在AgentDojo上的表现不比随机猜测好（AUROC 0.47到0.52），包括一个在AgentDojo内部达到0.996的检测器。未经训练的监控器达到0.930，但在2%攻击率下其发布的决策规则仍会产生大量误报（精确度0.096）。
AI.conclusion: 标准评估方法未能充分揭示LLM代理劫持检测器的真实性能，特别是在处理罕见攻击、未见工具和基准泛化方面。研究结果表明，需要更全面的评估方法来准确衡量检测器的有效性，并据此提出了评估跟踪检测器的清单。
AI.translation: 检测器可以根据大型语言模型（LLM）代理调用的工具痕迹来标记被劫持的代理。在我们审计的11项评估中，攻击或异常占测试样本的16%到86%，没有评估改变这一比例，并且有六项报告没有对来自第二个基准或来源的数据进行测试。我们质疑这些评估隐藏了什么。在AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准上，我们测试了读取工具身份、行为、调用序列、步嵌入或文本的训练检测器，以及一个已发布的LLM行动监控器AlignmentCheck，其阈值固定在训练数据上或由监控器发布的决策规则设置。首先，在2%的攻击率下，接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.879的检测器达到了0.076的精确度，并且仅负样本的混合就使该精确度在0.039到0.117之间波动。其次，随着工具覆盖率（测试工具调用中在训练中见过的工具的比例）的下降，检测器排名在约50%覆盖率处交叉并在其下方反转，因为未见工具映射到训练从未达到的输入。工具输入上的Dropout在很大程度上消除了这种反转。第三，在AgentDrift上训练的检测器在AgentDojo痕迹上的排名不比随机猜测好（AUROC 0.47到0.52），其中包括一个在AgentDojo内部达到0.996的检测器。未经训练的监控器达到了0.930，但由于其开放的骨干网络，其发布的决策规则在2%的攻击率下仍然会主要发出虚假警报（精确度0.096）。我们将这些发现转化为评估跟踪检测器的清单。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了当前LLM代理劫持检测器标准评估的局限性。研究发现，现有评估未能充分考虑罕见攻击率、未见工具以及跨基准泛化能力对检测器性能的影响。通过在AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准上测试多种检测器，作者揭示了在低攻击率下检测器精确度低、未见工具导致性能下降以及跨基准泛化能力差的问题。这些发现强调了需要更全面的评估方法，并据此提出了一份评估追踪检测器的清单。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 劫持检测, 标准评估, 基准迁移, 工具覆盖率
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了当前LLM代理安全领域评估方法的一个重要盲点。其创新之处在于通过系统的实验，量化了罕见攻击、未见工具和基准迁移对检测器性能的巨大影响，挑战了现有评估的有效性。这对于推动LLM代理安全评估的成熟至关重要，也为未来检测器设计提供了明确的方向。论文提出的评估清单具有很高的实践价值。

title: Backpropagation-free Deep Learning for Time-Series Classification
summary: Deep neural networks for time series classification (TSC) are trained almost exclusively by error backpropagation, which imposes update locking and the weight-transport problem. Backpropagation-free learning rules such as Direct Feedback Alignment (DFA), Direct Random Target Projection (DRTP), and the diffusion-inspired NoProp relax these constraints but have been evaluated almost exclusively on 2D image benchmarks. We adapt these three learners to univariate TSC with 1D convolutional architectures and present the first systematic study of them across 112 datasets from the UCR time series archive, with one hyperparameter-optimized configuration per method. The optimized learners reach mean F1 scores of 0.76 to 0.79, below ROCKET (0.83) and InceptionTime (0.84). We propose an analysis framework that relates the per-dataset gap to InceptionTime to dataset properties and tests convolutional feature learning by replacing the flatten readout with global average pooling, measured as a difference-in-differences (DD) against a backpropagation control on the identical architecture. Intra-class temporal variability is the dataset property most consistently associated with the gap for all three learners (partial Spearman $ρ$ from $0.28$ to $0.40$). Pooling harms DFA and DRTP more than backpropagation (DD $-0.025$ and $-0.055$), consistent with near-random convolutional features, whereas NoProp tolerates pooling as backpropagation does (DD $+0.013$). Relative to backpropagation on the same architectures, DRTP reduces training floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 33% and trains faster only on series longer than about 700 time steps, DFA yields no computational reduction, and NoProp reduces peak memory by 38% at the cost of 48% longer training.

AI.title_translation: 免反向传播的深度学习用于时间序列分类
AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了三种免反向传播学习规则（DFA、DRTP、NoProp）在单变量时间序列分类任务上的表现，发现它们的F1分数低于SOTA方法，且性能差距与类内时间变异性相关，计算效益也各不相同。
AI.motivation: 传统的深度时间序列分类（TSC）几乎都依赖误差反向传播进行训练，这会导致更新锁定和权重传输问题。而免反向传播学习规则（如DFA、DRTP、NoProp）可以解决这些限制，但它们几乎只在2D图像基准上进行过评估，缺乏在时间序列分类上的系统研究。
AI.method: 研究者将DFA、DRTP和NoProp这三种免反向传播学习规则应用于具有一维卷积架构的单变量时间序列分类任务。他们在一共112个UCR时间序列数据集上进行了首次系统研究，并为每种方法配置了超参数优化。此外，他们提出了一个分析框架，将数据集性能差距与数据集属性相关联，并通过用全局平均池化替换扁平化读出层来测试卷积特征学习，并与相同架构上的反向传播控制进行差异中的差异（DD）测量。
AI.result: 优化后的免反向传播学习器平均F1分数在0.76到0.79之间，低于ROCKET（0.83）和InceptionTime（0.84）。类内时间变异性是所有三种学习器与InceptionTime性能差距最相关的（偏斯皮尔曼ρ从0.28到0.40）数据集属性。池化对DFA和DRTP的损害比反向传播更大（DD分别为-0.025和-0.055），这与接近随机的卷积特征一致；而NoProp对池化的容忍度与反向传播相似（DD为+0.013）。相对于相同架构上的反向传播，DRTP将训练浮点运算（FLOPs）减少了33%，并且仅在时间步长超过约700的序列上训练更快；DFA没有计算量减少；NoProp以48%更长的训练时间为代价，将峰值内存减少了38%。
AI.conclusion: 免反向传播的深度学习方法在时间序列分类任务上的性能仍低于当前最先进的方法，且其性能受数据集的类内时间变异性显著影响。不同的免反向传播方法在计算效率和对特征学习的影响上表现各异，例如DRTP在某些情况下能减少FLOPs，NoProp能减少内存，但DFA则无明显计算优势。这些发现为未来在时间序列领域开发更高效的免反向传播学习器提供了方向。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络用于时间序列分类（TSC）几乎完全通过误差反向传播进行训练，这会带来更新锁定和权重传输问题。免反向传播的学习规则，如直接反馈对齐（DFA）、直接随机目标投影（DRTP）和受扩散启发的NoProp，放宽了这些限制，但几乎只在2D图像基准上进行过评估。我们根据一维卷积架构将这三种学习器应用于单变量TSC，并首次在UCR时间序列存档的112个数据集上对它们进行了系统研究，每种方法都经过超参数优化配置。优化后的学习器平均F1分数达到0.76至0.79，低于ROCKET（0.83）和InceptionTime（0.84）。我们提出了一个分析框架，将每个数据集与InceptionTime的差距与数据集属性相关联，并通过用全局平均池化替换扁平化读出层来测试卷积特征学习，并将其作为与相同架构上的反向传播控制的差异中的差异（DD）进行测量。类内时间变异性是所有三种学习器与InceptionTime差距最一致的数据集属性（偏斯皮尔曼ρ从0.28到0.40）。池化对DFA和DRTP的损害比反向传播更大（DD分别为-0.025和-0.055），这与接近随机的卷积特征一致，而NoProp对池化的容忍度与反向传播相似（DD为+0.013）。相对于相同架构上的反向传播，DRTP将训练浮点运算（FLOPs）减少了33%，并且仅在时间步长超过约700的序列上训练更快；DFA没有计算量减少；NoProp以48%更长的训练时间为代价，将峰值内存减少了38%。
AI.summary: 该研究系统评估了三种免反向传播学习规则（DFA、DRTP、NoProp）在单变量时间序列分类任务中的表现，并在一维卷积架构下，通过112个UCR数据集进行了首次大规模测试。结果显示，这些方法的F1分数（0.76-0.79）低于SOTA方法（如ROCKET和InceptionTime），且性能差距与数据集的类内时间变异性密切相关。分析表明，池化层对DFA和DRTP的特征学习有负面影响，而NoProp则表现出更好的鲁棒性。在计算效率方面，DRTP在长序列上能减少FLOPs和加速训练，NoProp能减少峰值内存，但训练时间更长，DFA则无明显计算优势。
AI.keywords: 免反向传播, 时间序列分类, 深度学习, DFA, DRTP, NoProp
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将免反向传播学习规则系统地应用于时间序列分类任务，并进行了大规模的实证研究。它不仅评估了这些方法的性能，还深入分析了影响其性能的数据集特性以及不同方法在计算效率上的差异。尽管目前性能仍不及反向传播方法，但这项工作为探索更高效、更生物启发式的深度学习训练范式在时间序列领域的应用奠定了基础，并指出了未来研究的方向，例如如何提升免反向传播方法在复杂时间序列特征学习上的能力。

title: Exploring Bad Minima in Transfer Learning
comments: 57 pages, 13 figures, 3 tables. MPhil thesis, University of Cambridge, 2022. Supervised by Ferenc Huszár
summary: Transfer learning is a highly successful learning paradigm in deep learning which leverages knowledge from one task and applies it to another. Despite its success, the necessary conditions for knowledge transfer are unclear and require further research. In this dissertation, our aim is to understand transferability a little better by answering the following question: Does good generalization on a source task necessarily imply transferability to a related target task? We hypothesize the answer is negative, and attempt to find counterexamples via adversarial attacks on the transfer learning procedure. Over three types of adversarial attacks, our empirical results show a strong relationship between generalization on the source task and transferability. These results do not rule out generalization on the source task as a sufficient condition for successful transfer.
comment: 57 pages, 13 figures, 3 tables. MPhil thesis, University of Cambridge, 2022. Supervised by Ferenc Huszár

AI.title_translation: 探索迁移学习中的不良极小值
AI.tldr: 本文通过对抗攻击研究了迁移学习中源任务泛化与目标任务可迁移性的关系，发现两者强相关，且未排除源任务泛化作为成功迁移充分条件的可能性。
AI.motivation: 尽管迁移学习在深度学习中取得巨大成功，但知识迁移的必要条件仍不明确，旨在探究“源任务的良好泛化是否必然意味着能够迁移到相关的目标任务”。
AI.method: 通过对迁移学习过程实施三种类型的对抗攻击来寻找反例，并进行实证分析。
AI.result: 经过三种类型的对抗攻击实验，实证结果表明源任务的泛化与可迁移性之间存在强相关性，且并未排除源任务泛化作为成功迁移充分条件的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 源任务的良好泛化与目标任务的可迁移性之间存在强相关性，但这并不排除源任务泛化作为成功迁移充分条件可能性。
AI.translation: 迁移学习是深度学习中一种高度成功的学习范式，它利用来自一个任务的知识并将其应用到另一个任务。尽管取得了成功，但知识迁移的必要条件仍不清楚，需要进一步研究。在本篇论文中，我们的目标是通过回答以下问题来更好地理解可迁移性：源任务上的良好泛化是否必然意味着可以迁移到相关的目标任务？我们假设答案是否定的，并试图通过对迁移学习过程进行对抗攻击来寻找反例。通过三种类型的对抗攻击，我们的实证结果显示了源任务上的泛化与可迁移性之间存在强相关性。这些结果并不排除源任务上的泛化作为成功迁移的充分条件。
AI.summary: 本文研究了迁移学习中源任务泛化能力与目标任务可迁移性的关系。作者通过对抗攻击检验了“源任务泛化不必然导致良好可迁移性”的假设，实证结果显示两者呈强相关，且未排除源任务泛化作为成功迁移充分条件的可能。
AI.keywords: 迁移学习, 泛化能力, 可迁移性, 对抗攻击, 深度学习
AI.comments: 这篇博士论文探讨了迁移学习中源任务泛化能力与目标任务可迁移性之间的关系，通过对抗攻击寻找反例，发现两者之间存在强相关性，并指出源任务的良好泛化仍有可能是成功迁移的充分条件。研究视角独特，方法具有启发性。

title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
comments: 39 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Playable companion and source code: https://github.com/fractalbrain-ai/10d-game
summary: This paper presents an opinionated set of ten desiderata intended to inform the design and evaluation of reinforcement-learning agents that learn continually throughout a continuing lifetime. We use these desiderata to examine a representative selection of existing approaches. Progress on individual desiderata is valuable, but the longer-term aim should be to integrate all ten within a single agent. To our knowledge, no published evaluation has yet provided evidence for such an integration.
