In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, we release an open-source software package and an interactive web application that let users easily perform TF prediction on custom sequences.

title: Robust-by-Design Distributional Learning from Contaminated Samples
summary: Modern data analysis pipelines increasingly rely on large datasets assembled through retrieval, scraping, automated filtering, and post-hoc curation, where the observed sample is often a contaminated mixture rather than the target population. Standard distributional objectives either ignore contamination and converge to the wrong target, or retain only a small trusted subset and discard most of the data. We study supervised and unsupervised learning when a clean reference sample is compared with a pooled sample from $r=(1-ε)q+εz$, where $q$ is the latent target distribution and $z$ is an unknown contaminant. Motivated by settings with noisy membership scores for all observations and exact labels for a small audited subset, we propose contamination-corrected maximum mean discrepancy (CC-MMD), a design-based estimator that combines proxy scores with audited residual corrections to recover the oracle MMD that would have been computed from the latent clean sample. CC-MMD requires no calibration assumption on the proxy scores and no structural assumptions on the contaminant beyond standard kernel regularity. We prove finite-population design-unbiasedness of the corrected kernel sums, establish asymptotic normality of the audit correction, and show consistency for the target discrepancy $\mathrm{MMD}^2(p,q;k)$. Empirically, CC-MMD tracks the oracle under increasing contamination, improves parameter recovery and prediction in contaminated regression, and enables generative models trained on heavily corrupted mixtures to recover the clean target distribution. These results show that contaminated data need not be discarded or treated as the estimand. With sparse trusted labels and abundant noisy supervision, distributional objectives can be made robust by design.

title: Clifford synthesis is NP-complete
summary:
We show that the problem of synthesizing a quantum circuit for a given Clifford operator using at most a specified amount of resources is NP-complete for several resource models of practical interest.
  Specifically, we study synthesis of a given Clifford operator using single-qubit Clifford gates and two-qubit Clifford gates, with full qubit connectivity and no additional ancilla qubits. With single-qubit gates free and CNOT as the only two-qubit gate, we show that deciding whether a given target admits an implementation using at most a specified number of CNOT gates is NP-complete, and we show that the problem remains NP-complete when any two-qubit Clifford gate is allowed and the budget counts all such gates. Moreover, we show that both results continue to hold when SWAP gates may be inserted for free, and when single-qubit gates are also considered part of the budget.
  In each case, we build on recent work by Li and Guan and show that there are polynomial-time reductions from Hamiltonian path in grid graphs to these decision problems, using a number of qubits quadratic in the number of grid vertices.

title: Inter-Frame Predictive Contour Coding for Semantic Map Compression
comments: 4 pages, 4 figures, to be presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Visual Communications and Image Processing, Singapore, December 2026
summary: Dynamic semantic maps have become an important intermediate representation for many computer vision applications. Efficient lossless compression of such maps is essential for reducing storage and transmission costs. Existing contour-based semantic map compression methods mainly exploit spatial redundancy within individual frames while largely ignoring the strong temporal correlation between adjacent semantic maps. In this paper, we propose an inter-frame predictive contour coding framework for lossless semantic map compression. The proposed framework first predicts blob positions and label indexes from the reference frame and then performs contour prediction using corresponding chain-code units in the reference contours. A mode selection mechanism is further employed to choose between intra and inter coding according to the estimated coding cost. By exploiting temporal contour redundancy while preserving the advantages of contour-based representation, the proposed framework significantly improves coding efficiency. Experimental results on the VSPW dynamic semantic segmentation dataset demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art lossless semantic map compression methods. Compared with the recent context-adaptive extended chain coding framework, the proposed inter-frame coding achieves an average bitrate reduction of 3.0\% without significant increase in the average encoding time, demonstrating an effective trade-off between compression performance and computational complexity. The source code is made publicly available at https://github.com/InterDigitalInc/LosslessSegmentationMapCompression.
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, to be presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Visual Communications and Image Processing, Singapore, December 2026

title: Addendum to "Optimal Steering of a Linear Stochastic System to a Final Probability Distribution, Part II"
summary: We hereby fill in a gap in an induction argument used in the proof of a theorem on state-covariance controllability of linear stochastic systems in an earlier paper by the authors. The mathematical statement is true. The missing point in the proof concerns the assertion that, in the canonical single-input case, the control can be assigned arbitrary endpoint values. We amend the argument by proving a slightly stronger induction statement that permits arbitrary finite endpoint jets of the control. An independent approach to homogeneous state-covariance controllability was provided in a paper by Abdelgalil and Georgiou (2025) as a corollary of strong controllability results on $\GLp(n,\mathbb R)$, and shown herein that it extends to the case of additive noise as well.

title: Incremental Stability of Gradient Flows under Generalized Polyak-Łojasiewicz Inequalities and Its Implications for General Systems
summary: Gradient flows of twice continuously differentiable strongly convex and convex objectives are, respectively, incrementally exponentially stable and non-expansive in the Euclidean metric. In this work, we investigate to what extent these properties extend to nonconvex objectives satisfying generalized Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequalities. For objectives with a unique minimizer, we establish conditions under which the gradient flow is contracting in a state-dependent Riemannian metric and incrementally exponentially stable. For objectives with nonunique minimizers, we generalize the non-expansivity of convex objectives to incremental stability for more general nonconvex objectives. We focus on incremental stability due to its implication to convergence to equilibrium points; when paired with a Lyapunov function it implies pointwise convergence to a minimizer and continuity of the endpoint map. Along the way, we derive new structural results for incrementally stable nonlinear systems and extend the analysis to Heavy-Ball and Dynamical Inertial Newton flows.

title: Fast and Accurate Hydro Unit Commitment
summary: We introduce a fast novel algorithm to commit hydro-generators. We show that our algorithm can commit 56 generators for 200 days 10,000 times faster than Hexaly, the leading commercial solver for scheduling problems, without sacrificing solution quality. Our method can commit 1792 generators for an entire year in approximately 20 seconds on commodity hardware. Hexaly is unable to solve problems of this size in reasonable time. We attain this runtime improvement by introducing a greedy-heuristic tailored for hydro units. We provide a direction for a possible proof that the error our solver makes decreases with the problem size. This is supported by our experimental results. We prove that our solver's runtime scales log-linearly in the number of generators and time periods.

title: Learning Stabilizing Latent Feedback Controllers via Multi-Step Backward Losses
summary: Can learned latent dynamics models support the design of feedback controllers that provably stabilize the original system? For linear time-invariant systems, we show that learning linear autoencoders and latent dynamics with multi-step prediction-reconstruction losses $\unicode{x2014}$ which we term "backward losses" as they encourage latent trajectories to reconstruct full state trajectories $\unicode{x2014}$ provably recovers the structure needed for stabilization. Specifically, a sufficiently long reconstruction horizon ensures that a minimum ${H}_\infty$-norm controller designed using the learned latent model stabilizes the original system through output-feedback via the corresponding encoder, provided the latent dimension is large enough to capture all non-stable modes of the underlying system. We also show why both reconstruction and a multi-step horizon are essential: forward prediction losses that require only low prediction error along latent trajectories admit global loss minimizers that discard unstable modes regardless of horizon length, while single-step reconstruction losses can yield latent models whose stabilizing controllers fail to stabilize the original system. Finally, experiments on a non-linear flexible-arm system illustrate the practical implications of our results for learning non-linear autoencoders and latent dynamics.

title: Hypergraph cycle enumeration for efficient inference of planted k-XOR with smooth trade-off
summary: We introduce hypergraph cycle enumeration (HCE), a simple spectral framework for detecting and recovering planted signals in noisy hypergraph inference problems. We study HCE on one representative problem from this class, namely planted noisy k-XOR, also known as sparse Learning Parity with Noise (LPN). Both theoretically and empirically, HCE achieves comparable recovery behavior to Kikuchi method, matching Kikuchi hierarchy. We identify parameter regimes where HCE outperforms Kikuchi method, showing that neither algorithm is universally better. We also show a subquadratic quantum speedup for HCE by replacing one of the algorithm's steps with a quantum walk. Our classical and quantum algorithms do not refute the quartic quantum speedup of quantum Kikuchi method, which remains valid for the practically relevant regime of large size and high noise strength.

title: Immersed Boundary Electrodiffusion in the Wasserstein Gradient Flow Formalism: Global Well-Posedness, Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics, and Singular Asymptotics
summary: We introduce a unified optimal transport framework for the Immersed Boundary (IB) electrodiffusion active pump model. By representing membrane chemical potential barriers and active pump potentials via smoothed Eulerian kernels ($Ψ_w, \mathcal{H}_w$), we formulate the passive dynamics as an $L^2$-Wasserstein ($W_2$) gradient flow coupled to non-conservative active pushing fields representing ATP-driven $3:2$ $\text{Na}^+/\text{K}^+$ exchangers. We establish global weak existence of solutions to the continuous Poisson--Nernst--Planck--IB system via a split-step Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto (JKO) variational scheme, backed by Calderón--Zygmund bounds for non-local Poisson drift and $H^3(\mathbb{S}^1)$ interface regularity under Stokes flow. We prove the continuous Rayleighian energy balance and establish exponential $W_2$-stability of Non-Equilibrium Steady States (NESS) under a quantitative Bakry--Émery curvature threshold. Furthermore, we analyze the dual singular limits of kernel smoothing width $w \to 0$ and dimensionless Debye length $g = λ_D / L \to 0$. We establish the precise asymptotic regime connecting regularized and sharp models, prove the $Γ$-convergence of regularized energy functionals, derive distributional interface flux jump conditions, and resolve $O(λ_D)$ Debye space-charge boundary layers to confirm bulk electroneutrality.

title: Temporal and spatial couplings in the dynamics of human walking and running
summary: Rhythmic behaviours such as walking and running are commonly modelled as dynamical systems around a stable limit cycle. To keep such models tractable, it is usually assumed that each step depends only on the previous one, that the limit cycle is fixed, and that the sagittal and frontal planes can be studied separately. Here, we test these assumptions in seven public datasets of human gait (71 participants), including 16 people who both walked and ran. We fit linear step-to-step maps and validate them by cross-validation, holding out more data where more data exist. At first sight, gait has memory: the state two steps back lowers the prediction error by up to 29\%. Yet most of this temporal coupling vanishes once the operating point may drift slowly and measurement noise is modelled; gait remains limit-cycle-like, around an operating point that moves. Running keeps more memory than walking in the same people. Spatial coupling between the planes is present in most participants, mainly from sagittal to frontal, but weak. This supports planar models of healthy gait, while a repeatable, task-dependent coupling index may serve as a measure of gait quality. The simple models are wrong, but useful enough.

AI.title_translation: 人类行走与跑步动力学中的时间与空间耦合
AI.tldr: 人类步态的表观记忆大多源自工作点的缓慢漂移，平面间空间耦合较弱，证明简化的步态动力学模型虽有不足但仍高度可用。
AI.motivation: 检验传统节律性运动动力学模型中的核心假设（即每一步仅依赖于上一步、极限环固定不变，以及矢状面与额状面可以单独解耦研究）在实际人体行走与跑步中是否成立。
AI.method: 基于7个公开步态数据集（共71名受试者，包含16名兼具步行与跑步数据的受试者），拟合线性步间映射模型，采用交叉验证方法评估预测误差，并引入工作点慢漂移机制与测量噪声模型进行对比分析。
AI.result: 表面上看步态具有记忆性（前两步状态可将预测误差降低达29%），但在引入工作点慢漂移及噪声建模后，大部分时间耦合消失，表明步态仍类似于围绕移动工作点的极限环；跑步比行走保留更多记忆；矢状面到额状面存在微弱的空间耦合。
AI.conclusion: 传统的简化步态模型虽然存在一定偏差，但已足够实用；平面解耦假设对健康步态大体成立，且这种时空耦合指标可作为量化评估步态质量的有效工具。
AI.translation: 诸如行走和跑步等节律性行为通常被建模为围绕稳定极限环的动力学系统。为了保持这些模型的可解性，通常假设每一步仅取决于前一步、极限环是固定的，并且矢状面和额状面可以分开研究。在这里，我们在包含71名受试者（其中16人同时进行了行走和跑步）的7个人类步态公开数据集中检验了这些假设。我们拟合了线性步间映射，并通过交叉验证对其进行了验证（在数据量较大处留出更多数据）。表面上看，步态具有记忆性：前两步的状态可使预测误差降低最多29\\%。然而，一旦允许工作点缓慢漂移并对测量噪声建模，这种时间耦合大部分都会消失；步态仍然呈现极限环特性，只是围绕一个移动的工作点振荡。在同一受试者中，跑步比行走保留了更多的记忆。大多数受试者在不同平面之间存在空间耦合，主要表现为矢状面向额状面的耦合，但程度较弱。这为健康步态的平面模型提供了支持，同时这种可重复的、依赖于任务的耦合指数或可作为衡量步态质量的指标。简单的模型虽然并不完全准确，但已足够实用。
AI.summary: 本研究利用71名受试者的数据检验了行走与跑步动力学中的简化假设。结果表明，所谓的步态时间记忆主要是由工作点慢漂移和噪声引起的假象，且平面间的空间耦合较为微弱，从而证实了经典简化极限环模型在健康步态研究中的实用性。
AI.keywords: 步态动力学, 极限环, 时空耦合, 行走与跑步, 步间映射
AI.comments: 该研究系统性检验了步态动力学建模中长期存在的简化假设（无记忆性、固定极限环、平面解耦），通过考虑慢漂移和测量噪声，澄清了步态中表观记忆的成因，为简化平面模型提供了有力辩护，并提出了可用于量化步态质量的新指标，兼具理论与应用价值。

title: Functorial Analysis of Group-Alphabet Cellular Automata
summary: Let $G$ be a group and let $n\in\mathbb N$. We consider one-dimensional cellular automata of length $n$ over the alphabet $G$, with periodic boundary conditions and with local rules $φ$ given by words. We construct a functor $F$ from $\mathbf{Grp}$, the category of groups (or any similar algebraic structure), to the category of pointed digraphs, and show its faithfulness. We introduce the image category $\mathcal C_{n,φ}$ of state transition graphs of all such group-alphabet cellular automata, and show $F$ is an equivalence onto this category. Consequently we investigate the translation of categorical structures in $\mathbf{Grp}$ in terms of automata, and give examples of how standard methods of homological algebra may now be applied to automata. Additionally, a graph-theoretical construction of the product in $\mathcal C_{n,φ}$ is given, together with a formula for cycle lengths and multiplicities in this product. When $G$ is abelian, further structural properties of state transition graphs follow, and we contrast these results with non-abelian counterexamples.

AI.title_translation: 群字母元胞自动机的函子分析
AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个从群范畴到有向图范畴的函子，并证明其忠实性和等价性，从而将群论结构应用于元胞自动机，并分析其状态转移图的性质。
AI.motivation: 探讨如何将群论的范畴结构和同调代数方法应用于群字母元胞自动机，以理解其状态转移图的结构。
AI.method: 构建了一个从群范畴到有向图范畴的函子F，并证明其忠实性与等价性；研究群范畴结构在自动机方面的转换，并应用同调代数方法；给出了状态转移图乘积的图论构造及循环长度和多重性的公式；对比了阿贝尔群和非阿贝尔群情况下状态转移图的结构性质。
AI.result: 构建了一个从群范畴到有向图范畴的函子F，并证明其忠实性；证明了函子F是到群字母元胞自动机状态转移图图像范畴的等价；展示了如何将群范畴结构转换为自动机，以及如何将同调代数方法应用于自动机；提供了状态转移图乘积的图论构造，以及循环长度和多重性的公式；揭示了当G是阿贝尔群时状态转移图的额外结构特性，并与非阿贝尔群进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建函子，将群论的范畴结构和同调代数工具成功应用于群字母元胞自动机，揭示了其状态转移图的深层结构特性，特别是阿贝尔群情况下的特殊性质。
AI.translation: 设 $G$ 是一个群，$n \in \mathbb N$。我们考虑长度为 $n$、字母表为 $G$ 的一维元胞自动机，具有周期性边界条件，局部规则 $\varphi$ 由词给出。我们构建了一个从群范畴 $\mathbf{Grp}$（或任何类似的代数结构）到有向图范畴的函子 $F$，并展示了它的忠实性。我们引入了所有此类群字母元胞自动机状态转移图的图像范畴 $\mathcal C_{n,\varphi}$，并表明 $F$ 等价于该范畴。因此，我们研究了 $\mathbf{Grp}$ 中范畴结构在自动机方面的转换，并举例说明了如何将同调代数标准方法应用于自动机。此外，还给出了 $\mathcal C_{n,\varphi}$ 中乘积的图论构造，以及该乘积中循环长度和多重性的公式。当 $G$ 是阿贝尔群时，状态转移图会呈现进一步的结构特性，我们将这些结果与非阿贝尔反例进行了对比。
AI.summary: 本文对以群为字母表的一维元胞自动机进行了函子分析。研究者构建了一个从群范畴到有向图范畴的函子F，并证明了其忠实性和等价性，从而将群论的范畴结构和同调代数方法引入到元胞自动机的研究中。文章给出了状态转移图乘积的图论构造，并提供了循环长度和多重性的公式，特别对比了阿贝尔群与非阿贝尔群情况下状态转移图的结构特性。
AI.keywords: 群字母元胞自动机, 函子, 范畴论, 状态转移图, 同调代数
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入范畴论的工具，为元胞自动机的研究提供了一个新颖且强大的抽象框架，特别是将群论和同调代数的方法应用于分析自动机的状态转移图。这种跨学科的方法可能为理解复杂系统的动态行为开辟新的途径。

title: CuPIQP: A Batched and Differentiable QP Solver on GPUs for Robot Learning and Control
summary: Quadratic programs (QPs) are fundamental building blocks of many robotic tasks such as inverse kinematics, whole-body control, and model predictive control. Extending these methods to large-scale robot learning and control requires solving many QPs concurrently and, for end-to-end learning, differentiating through their solutions. Efficient batched optimization is therefore essential to bringing established model-based methods into GPU-based robotics pipelines. We present \textsc{cuPIQP}, a batched and differentiable QP solver on GPUs based on a proximal interior-point method, with unified support for dense, sparse, and multistage problems. The solver exploits parallelism across independent QPs and their internal structure while preserving per-problem numerical updates and termination decisions. Benchmarks with up to 16384 QPs per batch demonstrate solve-time speedups of up to $18.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau} and $4.26\times$ over eight-core \textsc{PIQP}. In an end-to-end learning task, \textsc{cuPIQP} accelerates training by $4.6\times$ over \textsc{QPAX} and $7.8\times$ over \textsc{Moreau}. By reducing the computational cost, \textsc{cuPIQP} provides efficient, reusable infrastructure for integrating model-based optimization into large-scale robot learning and control.

AI.title_translation: CuPIQP：一种用于机器人学习和控制的基于GPU的批处理可微分QP求解器
AI.tldr: CuPIQP是一个基于GPU的批处理可微分QP求解器，它利用近端内点法，支持密集、稀疏和多阶段问题，并在机器人学习和控制中实现显著的速度提升。
AI.motivation: 二次规划（QPs）是机器人任务（如逆运动学、全身控制和模型预测控制）的基础组成部分。为了将这些方法扩展到大规模机器人学习和控制，需要并发解决大量QPs，并为端到端学习实现其解决方案的微分。因此，高效的批处理优化对于将成熟的基于模型的方法引入基于GPU的机器人管道至关重要。
AI.method: 本文提出了CuPIQP，一个基于近端内点法的GPU批处理可微分QP求解器。它统一支持密集、稀疏和多阶段问题，并利用独立QPs之间的并行性及其内部结构，同时保留每个问题的数值更新和终止决策。
AI.result: 在每批次最多16384个QPs的基准测试中，CuPIQP比Moreau实现了高达18.8倍的求解时间加速，比八核PIQP实现了4.26倍的加速。在端到端学习任务中，CuPIQP比QPAX加速训练4.6倍，比Moreau加速7.8倍。
AI.conclusion: CuPIQP通过降低计算成本，为将基于模型的优化集成到大规模机器人学习和控制中提供了高效、可重用的基础设施。
AI.translation: 二次规划（QPs）是许多机器人任务（如逆运动学、全身控制和模型预测控制）的基础组成部分。将这些方法扩展到大规模机器人学习和控制需要并发解决许多QPs，并且为了实现端到端学习，需要对其解决方案进行微分。因此，高效的批处理优化对于将成熟的基于模型的方法引入基于GPU的机器人管道至关重要。我们提出了\textsc{cuPIQP}，一个基于近端内点法的GPU批处理可微分QP求解器，统一支持密集、稀疏和多阶段问题。该求解器利用独立QPs之间的并行性及其内部结构，同时保留每个问题的数值更新和终止决策。对每批次最多16384个QPs的基准测试表明，求解时间比\textsc{Moreau}加速高达18.8倍，比八核\textsc{PIQP}加速4.26倍。在端到端学习任务中，\textsc{cuPIQP}比\textsc{QPAX}加速训练4.6倍，比\textsc{Moreau}加速7.8倍。通过降低计算成本，\textsc{cuPIQP}为将基于模型的优化集成到大规模机器人学习和控制中提供了高效、可重用的基础设施。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为CuPIQP的批处理可微分二次规划（QP）求解器，专为GPU设计，并基于近端内点法。该求解器旨在解决大规模机器人学习和控制中QPs的并行求解和微分需求，支持密集、稀疏和多阶段问题。CuPIQP通过利用GPU并行性显著提高了求解速度，在基准测试中比现有方法快高达18.8倍，并在端到端学习任务中实现了4.6倍至7.8倍的训练加速，为机器人领域提供了高效的优化基础设施。
AI.keywords: QP求解器, GPU, 机器人学习, 可微分优化, 批处理
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种在GPU上运行的高效批处理可微分QP求解器，解决了机器人学习和控制中大规模优化问题的关键瓶颈。其创新之处在于结合了近端内点法与GPU并行计算，并统一支持多种QP问题类型。显著的性能提升使其在集成模型优化到端到端机器人学习管道中具有重要意义，有望加速机器人领域的研究和应用。

title: Quantum amplification of improbable futures
comments: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, 4 supplementary tables, graphical abstract
summary: Some consequential futures consist of entirely plausible steps arranged into an unlikely sequence, such as ordinary weather anomalies combining into an extreme event or local equipment failures propagating into a widespread outage. Because the sequence as a whole carries little probability, it may be rarely observed in simulation. Quantum mechanics offers a way to change those odds: ideal amplitude amplification raises the chance of drawing such futures while preserving their relative likelihoods. For a five-state process six steps ahead, 13,888 of 15,625 futures are rare, yet together they account for about one draw in 40. We built the complete circuit in IBM's Qiskit and checked every part against an exact enumeration; four simulated rounds raised the share of rare futures drawn from 2.5% to 98.0%. On IBM's Kingston quantum computer, a two-step reference circuit that marks rare futures from a precomputed list drew them in 68.4% of shots against 43.5% for its control (z = 50); at three steps (about 1,170 two-qubit gates) the predicted signal reversed sign. Because this model's probabilities are known, every result could be checked against exact values; the mechanism is intended for simulators whose probabilities are hard to calculate, such as climate, epidemic and financial models.
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, 4 supplementary tables, graphical abstract

AI.title_translation: 不可能未来的量子放大
AI.tldr: 该论文利用量子振幅放大技术成功提高了模拟中低概率、高影响力的稀有未来事件的出现几率，并通过量子计算机硬件验证了其可行性。
AI.motivation: 某些重大但罕见的未来事件由一系列合理但概率极低的步骤组成，由于其整体概率极低在传统模拟中极难被观测到，因此需要量子力学的方法来改变这些几率并放大其观测概率。
AI.method: 利用量子力学中的理想振幅放大技术改变未来序列的概率分布，并在IBM的Qiskit中构建完整电路进行模拟，同时在IBM的Kingston量子计算机上部署参考电路进行硬件测试。
AI.result: 在Qiskit模拟中，四轮模拟将稀有未来的抽取比例从2.5%提升至98.0%；在IBM的物理量子计算机上，两步参考电路将稀有未来的抽取比例从对照组的43.5%提升至68.4%。
AI.conclusion: 量子振幅放大能够有效提高模拟中稀有未来序列的抽样概率，为难以直接计算概率的复杂系统仿真提供了可行的量子加速方案。
AI.translation: 一些具有重大影响的未来由完全合理但排列成不可能序列的步骤组成，例如普通天气异常结合成极端事件，或局部设备故障蔓延为大面积停电。由于整个序列的概率很小，它在模拟中很少被观察到。量子力学提供了一种改变这些几率的方法：理想的振幅放大提高了抽取此类未来的几率，同时保持了它们的相对可能性。对于六步之后的一个五状态过程，15,625个未来中有13,888个是稀有的，但它们加起来大约占每40次抽取中的一次。我们在IBM的Qiskit中构建了完整的电路，并针对精确枚举检查了每个部分；四轮模拟将抽取的稀有未来份额从2.5%提高到98.0%。在IBM的Kingston量子计算机上，一个两步参考电路从预计算列表中标记出稀有未来，在测试中以68.4%的几率抽取它们，而对照组为43.5%（z = 50）；在三步时（约1170个双量子比特门），预测信号符号反转。因为该模型的概率是已知的，所以每个结果都可以对照精确值进行检查；该机制旨在用于概率难以计算的模拟器，例如气候、流行病和金融模型。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了利用量子振幅放大技术来提高模拟中不可能出现的未来序列（即稀有且具有重大影响的事件序列）的观测概率。研究人员通过Qiskit模拟和IBM量子计算机硬件验证，成功证明了该机制在保持相对可能性的同时大幅提升稀有事件抽样率的有效性，未来有望应用于气候、流行病和金融等复杂模型的模拟中。
AI.keywords: 量子振幅放大, 稀有事件, 模拟仿真, 量子计算, 复杂系统
AI.comments: 该论文展示了量子振幅放大在稀有事件模拟中的强大潜力，突破了传统蒙特卡洛模拟在处理极低概率、高后果复杂序列时的效率瓶颈。尽管在实际量子硬件上面临噪声挑战，但这一概念验证为气候、流行病和金融等复杂系统的风险分析开辟了新途径。

title: D2ML: Models for Direct-to-Biology Small Molecule Screening
comments: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD)
summary: Direct-to-biology (D2B) screening enables rapid testing of newly synthesized molecules without purification. However, uncertain concentrations in crude mixtures and limited purified-compound measurements complicate the use of these data in machine learning. Here we show that models tailored to the structure of D2B data can improve prediction and guide the discovery of more potent and selective compounds. Our assay-aware models predict activity from single-point screens, relative potency across targets from crude dose-response assays, and absolute potency from purified-compound measurements. For crude assays, potency ratios between targets tested from the same well can retain selectivity information despite uncertain concentrations. A joint model that shares information across stages and balances their contributions to training improved predictions over separate neural networks. The largest gain was in crude dose-response selectivity prediction, where rank correlation increased from 0.27 to 0.40. In a separate experiment, independently trained models guided the selection of 84 new compounds to improve ROS1 potency while limiting activity against the anti-target TRKB. Synthesis and testing identified compounds that extended the measured Pareto front, achieving better combinations of potency and selectivity than those in the training data. The most selective new compound achieved a ROS1 IC50 of 14.7 nM and 233-fold selectivity over TRKB. By comparison, the most selective training compound had a ROS1 IC50 of 20.3 nM and 79-fold selectivity. ATLAS provides the experimental setting for this approach, supporting synthesis and screening of 1,000-10,000 model-selected compounds in two- to three-week cycles. Together, these results show how assay-aware learning can use the full D2B assay sequence to guide multi-objective molecular optimization.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD)

AI.title_translation: D2ML：用于直接生物学小分子筛选的模型
AI.tldr: D2ML开发了针对直接生物学（D2B）筛选数据定制的机器学习模型，通过整合不同阶段的检测信息，显著提高了活性和选择性化合物的预测与发现能力。
AI.motivation: 直接生物学（D2B）筛选允许快速测试未经纯化的新合成分子，但粗混合物中不确定的浓度和有限的纯化化合物测量使得这些数据难以用于机器学习。因此，需要开发能够有效利用D2B数据的模型来改进预测并指导更有效和选择性化合物的发现。
AI.method: 该研究开发了针对D2B数据结构量身定制的检测感知模型（assay-aware models）。这些模型能够从单点筛选中预测活性，从粗剂量反应检测中预测靶点间的相对效力，并从纯化化合物测量中预测绝对效力。通过一个在不同阶段共享信息并平衡其贡献的联合模型（joint model），在训练中优于单独的神经网络。特别是，利用了来自同一孔的靶点间效力比可以在不确定浓度下保留选择性信息。
AI.result: 联合模型改进了预测，其中在粗剂量反应选择性预测方面增益最大，秩相关性从0.27提高到0.40。独立训练的模型成功指导了84种新化合物的选择，以提高ROS1效力并限制对TRKB的活性。合成和测试结果表明，新发现的化合物扩展了测量到的帕累托前沿，实现了比训练数据中更好的效力和选择性组合。最选择性的新化合物的ROS1 IC50为14.7 nM，对TRKB的选择性是233倍，而训练数据中最选择性的化合物ROS1 IC50为20.3 nM，选择性是79倍。ATLAS提供了这种方法所需的实验环境，支持在两到三周的周期内合成和筛选1,000-10,000个模型选择的化合物。
AI.conclusion: 检测感知学习能够利用完整的D2B检测序列来指导多目标分子优化，从而发现具有改进效力和选择性的新化合物。
AI.translation: 直接生物学（D2B）筛选可以在不进行纯化的情况下快速测试新合成的分子。然而，粗混合物中不确定的浓度和有限的纯化化合物测量使得这些数据难以用于机器学习。本文展示了专门针对D2B数据结构定制的模型可以改进预测并指导发现更有效和选择性的化合物。我们的检测感知模型（assay-aware models）从单点筛选中预测活性，从粗剂量反应检测中预测靶点间的相对效力，并从纯化化合物测量中预测绝对效力。对于粗检测，来自同一孔的靶点间的效力比可以在不确定浓度下保留选择性信息。一个在不同阶段共享信息并平衡其贡献的联合模型在训练中改进了预测，优于单独的神经网络。最大的增益体现在粗剂量反应选择性预测上，秩相关性从0.27提高到0.40。在另一项实验中，独立训练的模型指导了84种新化合物的选择，以提高ROS1效力并限制对反靶点TRKB的活性。合成和测试确定了扩展测量帕累托前沿的化合物，实现了比训练数据中更好的效力和选择性组合。最具选择性的新化合物的ROS1 IC50为14.7 nM，对TRKB的选择性是233倍。相比之下，最具选择性的训练化合物的ROS1 IC50为20.3 nM，选择性是79倍。ATLAS为这种方法提供了实验环境，支持在两到三周的周期内合成和筛选1,000-10,000个模型选择的化合物。总而言之，这些结果展示了检测感知学习如何利用完整的D2B检测序列来指导多目标分子优化。
AI.summary: 该研究开发了名为D2ML的机器学习模型，专门用于处理直接生物学（D2B）小分子筛选数据。通过引入“检测感知”模型和联合建模方法，有效解决了粗混合物中浓度不确定性导致的数据利用难题。模型能够从不同筛选阶段（单点、粗剂量反应、纯化测量）整合信息，显著提高了化合物活性和选择性的预测能力。实验结果表明，该方法在粗剂量反应选择性预测上取得了显著进步，并成功指导发现了比现有化合物具有更优效力和选择性组合的新分子，为多目标分子优化提供了有效工具。
AI.keywords: 直接生物学筛选, 机器学习, 小分子发现, 检测感知模型, 多目标优化
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其“检测感知”和“联合模型”的方法，有效地解决了直接生物学（D2B）筛选数据中因浓度不确定性导致的复杂性，从而使机器学习能够更有效地利用这些数据。这种方法不仅提高了预测准确性，还成功指导了具有更高效力和选择性的新化合物的发现，尤其在药物发现领域具有重要的应用价值。通过在不同筛选阶段共享信息，最大化了有限数据的利用效率。

title: Stochastic and Noisy Oracles in Smooth Continuous Optimization
summary: We review models of inexact computational oracles in smooth continuous optimization and their implications for the convergence, computational complexity, and attainable accuracy of optimization algorithms. We adopt a framework in which zeroth-,first-, and second-order oracles are characterized by quantitative error bounds and may accept additional control parameters that influence both their accuracy and computational cost. We introduce deterministic and stochastic oracle models and illustrate their properties through a variety of examples, including finite-difference approximations, stochastic gradients, and randomized derivative estimators. Particular attention is given to the distinction between absolute and relative errors, bias and variance, and stochastic function evaluations with independent or coupled randomness. A central theme of the review is the use of common analytical tools to recover and compare convergence and complexity guarantees under different oracle models. For deterministic and stochastic first-order methods, we show how a general descent inequality leads to complexity bounds under various assumptions on the objective function and all proposed oracle models. In the stochastic setting, we develop bounds on expected stopping times and the accuracy that can be guaranteed under different oracle conditions. We also examine the total computational complexity of algorithms relying on specific oracle constructions and briefly review models of inexact second- order information and their use in optimization algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 平滑连续优化中的随机与噪声神谕模型
AI.tldr: 本文综述了平滑连续优化中的不精确神谕模型，利用统一分析框架探讨了确定性与随机性算法在不同误差、偏差和方差条件下的收敛性与计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 旨在综述平滑连续优化中不精确计算神谕模型，探讨其对优化算法的收敛性、计算复杂度和可达到精度的影响，并利用通用分析工具在不同神谕模型下恢复和比较收敛与复杂度保证。
AI.method: 采用统一的分析框架，重点考察由定量误差界表征的零阶、一阶和二阶神谕模型；通过通用的下降不等式推导不同神谕模型下的复杂度界，并研究随机设置下的期望停时与精度保证。
AI.result: 展示了通用下降不等式如何针对目标函数的各种假设以及提出的神谕模型推导复杂度界，建立了随机设置下关于期望停时和可保证精度的界限，并考察了依赖特定神谕构造的算法的总计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过统一的分析框架和通用的下降不等式，成功对比并恢复了不同神谕模型下的收敛率与复杂度保证，为深入理解确定性和随机连续优化提供了系统的理论视角。
AI.translation: 我们回顾了平滑连续优化中不精确计算神谕（oracles）的模型及其对优化算法收敛性、计算复杂度和可达精度的影响。我们采用了一个框架，其中零阶、一阶和二阶神谕由定量误差界限表征，并可能接受影响其精度和计算成本的额外控制参数。我们引入了确定性和随机神谕模型，并通过各种示例说明了它们的属性，包括有限差分近似、随机梯度和随机导数估计器。特别关注了绝对误差与相对误差、偏差与方差、以及具有独立或耦合随机性的随机函数评估之间的区别。该综述的一个中心主题是使用共同的分析工具来恢复和比较不同神谕模型下的收敛性和复杂度保证。对于确定性和随机一阶方法，我们展示了在目标函数和所有提出的神谕模型的各种假设下，通用的下降不等式如何推导出复杂度界限。在随机设置中，我们开发了在不同神谕条件下可以保证的期望停止时间和精度的界限。我们还检查了依赖于特定神谕构造的算法的总计算复杂度，并简要回顾了不精确二阶信息模型及其在优化算法中的应用。
AI.summary: 本文综述了平滑连续优化中不精确计算神谕模型的理论，分析了其对算法收敛性、计算复杂度和精度的影响。文章采用统一的框架刻画零阶、一阶和二阶神谕，通过通用下降不等式和分析工具，系统比较了不同确定性与随机性神谕模型下的收敛率与计算复杂度。
AI.keywords: 平滑连续优化, 随机神谕, 计算复杂度, 收敛性分析, 不精确导数估计
AI.comments: 该综述系统地梳理了平滑连续优化中各种不精确计算神谕（Oracles）模型，统一了确定性和随机性一阶、二阶方法的收敛性与复杂度分析框架，对于理解现代随机优化算法的理论基础具有重要参考价值。

title: Quantum Vehicle Routing Problem: a smart initialization strategy for ill-conditioned optimization landscapes
summary: With the expansion of complex transport infrastructure, new paths for linking different destinations have emerged, allowing the definition of multiple routes. The introduction of new roads may also lead to disruptions in traffic flow. This problem can be generalized into a special case of VRP, which aims to find the optimal route for a fleet of vehicles within a network of destinations. Finding solutions to this problem requires an exponential number of operations, hindering the ability of exact solvers to deal with large instances, which must therefore be tackled using heuristics, often leading to suboptimal results. Quantum-based algorithms may allow us to find exact solutions in polynomial time with high probability, offering a potential future alternative to classical solvers and in this work, we focus on the QAOA. Our novel contributions are a parameter-initialization strategy that improves the convergence probability and the integration of the subtour constraints directly into the optimization without using additional qubits by employing an approximation of exponential equality constraints. We believe that our results pave the way for effectively solving instances of VRP using quantum-based solutions, leveraging the space-efficient problem encoding and our initialization strategy, which limits the effect of barren-plateau under random parameter initialization.

AI.title_translation: 量子车辆路径问题：一种针对病态优化景观的智能初始化策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的智能初始化策略，以解决车辆路径问题（VRP），旨在提高收敛概率并有效处理子路径约束。
AI.motivation: 车辆路径问题（VRP）在处理大规模实例时，传统精确求解器需要指数级操作，导致次优结果。量子算法有望在多项式时间内找到精确解，为经典求解器提供潜在的替代方案，因此研究量子方法解决VRP具有重要意义。
AI.method: 本文专注于量子近似优化算法（QAOA），并提出了两个主要贡献：1) 一种参数初始化策略，旨在提高收敛概率；2) 通过近似指数等式约束，在不使用额外量子比特的情况下将子路径约束直接整合到优化中。
AI.result: 提出的参数初始化策略改善了收敛概率，并且结合空间高效的问题编码，使得量子解决方案能有效解决VRP实例，同时限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的结果为使用基于量子的解决方案有效解决VRP实例铺平了道路，通过利用空间高效的问题编码和提出的初始化策略，限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。
AI.translation: 随着复杂交通基础设施的扩展，连接不同目的地的新路径不断涌现，使得多种路线的定义成为可能。新道路的引入也可能导致交通流量中断。这个问题可以泛化为VRP的一个特例，旨在在一个目的地网络中为一支车队找到最优路径。解决这个问题需要指数级的操作，阻碍了精确求解器处理大型实例的能力，因此必须使用启发式方法，但这通常会导致次优结果。基于量子的算法可能使我们能够以高概率在多项式时间内找到精确解，为经典求解器提供了潜在的未来替代方案，在本工作中，我们专注于QAOA。我们的新颖贡献是一种参数初始化策略，它提高了收敛概率，并通过采用指数等式约束的近似，在不使用额外量子比特的情况下将子路径约束直接整合到优化中。我们相信，我们的结果为使用基于量子的解决方案有效解决VRP实例铺平了道路，利用了空间高效的问题编码和我们的初始化策略，这限制了随机参数初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响。
AI.summary: 本文针对车辆路径问题（VRP）在处理大规模实例时经典算法的局限性，提出了一种基于量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的新方法。主要贡献包括一种智能参数初始化策略，旨在提高算法的收敛概率，以及一种无需额外量子比特即可将子路径约束直接整合到优化中的方法。研究结果表明，该方法能够有效解决VRP实例，并限制了随机初始化下荒漠高原效应的影响，为量子解决VRP提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 量子车辆路径问题, QAOA, 初始化策略, 荒漠高原, 组合优化
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了针对QAOA的智能参数初始化策略和高效的子路径约束集成方法，有效解决了量子优化中常见的荒漠高原问题，并提高了算法的收敛性。这对于将量子计算应用于实际的组合优化问题，特别是VRP，具有重要意义。

title: Koopman--Lyapunov and Koopman--Riccati Controller Synthesis
summary: While the Koopman operator-based lifted representations of nonlinear autonomous and controlled systems have been well covered in the literature, the direct controller synthesis problem largely remains open. As the controlled system is generally a bilinear (instead of fully linear) Koopman model, controller synthesis appears to lose the linear--quadratic structures of the classical Lyapunov and Riccati methods for finite-dimensional linear systems. However, in infinite dimensions, bilinearity in the feature map should be merely artifactual and hence reducible to linearity in principle. In this work, by considering the operator semigroups in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space with a linear--Sobolev kernel and utilizing the Yosida approximation of their generators, the synthesis problems of a stabilizing controller and an input-unconstrained optimal controller can be formulated as an operator Lyapunov inequality and an operator Riccati equation, respectively. These formulations recover the desirable linear--quadratic structures, and hence, with sample data, they are solvable efficiently in analogous ways to usual linear systems by semidefinite programming solvers and Kleinman iterations, respectively. In addition to proving control performance bounds dependent on the sampling denseness and Yosida regularization, through numerical comparison to linearized LQR, bilinear EDMD-based synthesis, nonlinear MPC, and Koopman MPC methods on numerical models and process control examples, this work demonstrates the proposed Koopman--Riccati synthesis as a computationally efficient approach to obtain a near-optimal state-feedback control law.

title: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification on Simplicial Complexes with Conformalized Simplicial Neural Networks
summary: Simplicial neural networks (SNNs) are powerful tools for prediction tasks on higher-order relational datasets stored on simplicial complexes (SCs), a higher-order generalization of graphs. However, SNNs usually lack rigorous uncertainty quantification (UQ), limiting their usefulness in high-stakes scenarios. We propose conformalized SNN (CF-SNN), a framework that, given a simplicial-complex entity with m prediction targets, generates prediction sets for all m targets simultaneously. Under mild assumptions, CF-SNN guarantees that, for each target, the prediction set contains the true label with a user-specified nominal coverage probability, and the realized miscoverage proportion across all m targets is guaranteed to remain close to the nominal level with high probability. Extensive experiments across a wide range of SC prediction tasks demonstrate that CF-SNN is a flexible UQ framework that achieves user-specified coverage while producing informative prediction sets of small size.

title: Quantum query complexity of Hurwitz stability testing
summary: Determining whether every trajectory of the linear system $\dot{x}=Ax$ converges to zero (or, equivalently, whether $A$ is Hurwitz stable) is a fundamental problem in control theory. It arises, for example, in verifying the stability of feedback controllers and state observers, as well as of linearized dynamical models. We study the quantum query complexity of deciding whether a matrix $A\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times n}$ is Hurwitz stable, given an exact normalized block-encoding of $A$. The query complexity is characterized in terms of the system dimension $n$ and a supplied lower bound $0<ν\leq ω_A$ on the imaginary-axis distance $ω_A:=\min_{t\in\mathbb{R}}σ_{\min}(A-\mathrm{i}tI)$, where $σ_{\min}(A)$ is the smallest singular value of $A$. We prove a query-complexity lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{n}/ν)$, which holds even when $A$ is restricted to be real and diagonal. For general matrices with nonzero $ω_A$, we encode an approximation of the right-half-plane spectral projector $\operatorname{sign}^+(A):=(I+\operatorname{sign}(A))/2$ as a block of a matrix inverse, where $A$ is Hurwitz if and only if the projector is zero. To test this, we produce a quantum algorithm which determines if a $(β,b,1/(4\sqrt{n}))$-block-encoded projector matrix (like $\operatorname{sign}^+(A)$) is zero or not; for constant success probability, it has complexity $Θ(β\sqrt{n})$. When the zero test is applied to specific approximations of $\operatorname{sign}^+(A)$, this yields an upper bound of $O(\sqrt{n}ν^{-2}\log(\sqrt{n}/ν))$ queries in the general case, and $O(\sqrt{n}ν^{-1}\log n)$ when $A$ is Hermitian or normal. The latter upper bound matches the lower bound up to a logarithmic factor. Thus the dimension dependence of quantum Hurwitz testing is nearly optimal, while the remaining factor in the non-normal case isolates an open conditioning gap.

title: DistFlow and Its Conic Relaxation: Regularity, Monotonicity, and Hybrid Exactness via Graph Decomposition
summary: Classical exactness conditions for conic relaxations of the DistFlow model rely, among other assumptions, either on all nodal injections being adjustable or on a network-wide path condition. In practice, these conditions may not hold uniformly across a feeder: controllable distributed energy resources (DERs) sit at some buses and fixed loads at others, while reverse flows from DER-rich regions can violate the path condition. This paper certifies exactness region by region and composes the regional certificates, accounting for perturbations that propagate downstream through voltages. We first introduce a subtree voltage stability region, in which the network and all compatible subtrees remain regular. Within it, two endpoint sign conditions, one relaxing the nonnegative-flow assumption and one implied by the classical path condition, yield monotone responses of voltages, currents, and losses to root voltages. Using duality, the implicit function theorem, and sign properties of inverse sensitivity matrices, we recast both classical arguments as individual sign certificates on branch multipliers. This turns exactness into a branchwise property that can be certified region by region. A partition rule then splits the network into dispatchable and passive subtrees, and a hybrid certificate combines their local conditions into exactness of the full-network relaxation, under additional operating-limit and objective conditions. In particular, placing controllable DERs at both ends of a branch with large reverse flow exempts that branch from the passive sign conditions.

title: Understanding LLM-Based Bargaining of Driving Agents in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a flexible computational approach for modeling social interactions among heterogeneous agents. This paper develops a novel framework towards characterizing and understanding LLM-based population-level bargaining of shared road space between autonomous vehicle (AV) and human-driven vehicle (HV) agents in mixed-autonomy traffic. Through controlled experiments varying traffic density, agent objectives, and traffic-domain knowledge, we first characterize bargaining outcomes and observe heterogeneous agreement rates across different experimental conditions. To understand how the bargaining process shapes the outcomes, we introduce a behavioral taxonomy that jointly characterizes numerical bidding actions and communicative attitudes. We examine two complementary aspects of social interaction: inter-agent bargaining dynamics and private-to-public behavioral transformation. Results reveal distinct interaction patterns associated with agreement and breakdown, including greater constructive reciprocity in agreement trials and more frequent conflict escalation in breakdown trials. Furthermore, private and public communicative attitudes often differ even when numerical bids remain unchanged. These findings illustrate how LLM-based bargaining simulations can support a structured analysis of social interaction behaviors in mixed-autonomy traffic.

title: PBSR: Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution via Zero-Shot Novel View Synthesis
comments: Accepted for publication in New Generation Computing. 17 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables
summary: Burst super-resolution (BSR) achieves higher reconstruction fidelity than single-image super-resolution (SISR) by aggregating sub-pixel information from multiple frames. However, it requires a burst of frames captured under near-static conditions, and such frames are unavailable for single photographs or archival images. We propose Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution (PBSR), which brings BSR-style reconstruction to the single-image input setting by synthesizing pseudo-burst frames via zero-shot novel view synthesis (NVS). PBSR first generates pseudo-burst frames with realistic parallax using a viewpoint sampling strategy calibrated to the pixel-shift distribution of real burst datasets. The frames are then processed by a BSR backbone equipped with a geometry-aware alignment module that reuses the NVS camera parameters and estimated depth. While the NVS stage is zero-shot, the backbone is fine-tuned with an artifact-aware adaptation so that it can exploit the synthesized frames despite their generative artifacts. Experiments on the BurstSR dataset show that PBSR consistently improves in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS over the single-frame baseline with the same reconstruction backbone.
comment: Accepted for publication in New Generation Computing. 17 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables

title: Coarse-Graining Optimal Transport for Rollout-Free Post-Training of Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching depends critically on the coupling used to pair source and target samples. Optimal transport (OT) couplings can reduce velocity conflict and straighten trajectories; but, in practice, challenges remain: the source comes from a continuous distribution, only a finite number of target samples data are accessible, and the neural network has finite capacity. For these reasons, making the coupling more OT-like may not consistently improve sampling quality, in particular in the low number-of-function-evaluation (NFE) regime. Motivated by this, we introduce ReCouple, a controllable framework that constructs coarse-grained OT couplings, to better understand rollout-free OT-based post-training. We also consider extensions of this basic framework: ReCouple+ extends this toward the continuous-source setting by increasing source resolution, converging to semi-discrete OT in the appropriate limit; and ReCouple++ further adds spatial regularization, motivated by the observation that straight trajectories need not correspond to spatially simple velocity fields. Empirical validation demonstrates the effectiveness of these methods, and it reveals an NFE-dependent interplay between coupling optimality, neural realizability, and generation quality.

title: Estimation of Quantum Umlaut Information
summary: Quantifying correlations is important for understanding how quantum states and channels support information processing. Quantum umlaut information $U$ connects such correlations to reliability in hypothesis testing and certain communication settings, but its known formulas require classical descriptions of the underlying states. To estimate correlations without these descriptions, we introduce measured quantum umlaut information $U^M$ by replacing Umegaki relative entropy with measured relative entropy. Its variational formulation leads to a quantum generative adversarial framework for estimating $U^M$ from measurement statistics of unknown bipartite states and classical-quantum channels. This framework optimizes reference states and measurements without reconstructing the target states or channel outputs. For classical-quantum channels, it also optimizes the input probabilities. We further analyze the relation between $U^M$ and $U$, deriving a state-dependent gap bound and characterizing equality for full-rank bipartite states. Numerical simulations show trained estimates close on average to independently computed numerical references for $U^M$ across the tested states and channels. These estimates could help assess how well quantum memories preserve correlations and how noise or drift affects input-output dependence in quantum transmitters and state-preparation devices.

title: Truthful and Admissible Principal--Agent Testing with Nuisance Parameters
summary: Statistical contracts reward experimenters according to the evidence produced by a costly study, so the reward rule influences both who participates and what they report. Principal--agent testing theory explains how to prevent ineffective proposals from being profitable. We ask when such contracts can also elicit honest parameter reports if the decision concerns a mean effect but the variance or distributional shape is unknown. Under risk neutrality and a fixed participation cost, we construct menus of e-values --- nonnegative normalized rewards with expected value at most one under every null --- such that (i) agents who know they are null have no incentive to participate, (ii) every alternative type earns positive expected profit and is thus incentivized to participate, (iii) truthful reporting uniquely maximizes expected their reward, (iv) and each contract is admissible: its payouts cannot be pointwise improved while retaining null validity. For Gaussian observations, we treat separately agents who know both mean and variance and agents who know only their mean; in the latter case, truthfulness holds at every variance without requiring a nuisance prior. Multi-sample extensions preserve these incentives and can reward accumulating evidence. Beyond Gaussian models, we show that two independent nonnegative observations suffice to elicit any finite mean above a positive null threshold, without any further distributional knowledge, but one observation cannot combine strict mean elicitation with individual admissibility on this class. Finally, we distinguish the existence of useful tests from the identification needed for truthful contracts. Boundedness is not required, and finitely many null constraints do not by themselves guarantee admissible elicitation.

title: ART of PIV: Agentic Real-Time Particle Image Velocimetry for Active Flow Control
summary: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) measures fluid motion from images of tracer particles, but its accuracy depends on choices throughout the estimation pipeline, including image preprocessing, flow estimation, and postprocessing. These choices are typically left to expert tuning, and a fixed configuration can become less accurate as conditions change. This matters especially when PIV supplies feedback for real-time control, where measurements must be both accurate and fast, and flow conditions vary. We introduce ART of PIV -- short for Agentic Real-Time and also a nod to the art of tuning a PIV pipeline -- which automates pipeline choice for each image pair. A learned agent selects a configuration according to a chosen measurement objective from a library assembled for a specified speed budget. Across cross-correlation, classical optical-flow, and learning-based estimators, ART of PIV reduces average end-point error (AEPE) by 12.2-22.4 % relative to the best single estimator at matched speed, with gains extending to 1000-4000 image pair/s. In a simulated local velocity regulation task, it reduces mean normalized closed-loop cost by 13.24-13.59 percentage points relative to a tuned fixed estimator, with the same classical controller in both cases. In a tabletop water channel, we illustrate two ways to tune ART of PIV for a fluidic pinball of three rotating cylinders: selecting between complementary optical-flow tunings for accuracy, and selecting regions of interest with coherent rotation or shear using a common flow estimator. For the first variant, we train a DreamerV3 reinforcement learning controller directly in the physical world and demonstrate tracking of a prescribed flow field in the wake of a fluidic pinball.

title: Feature-preserving interface reconstruction using piecewise circles and cusps
comments: 55 pages, 30 figures. Code and benchmark data: https://github.com/jerrywliu/interface-reconstruction/releases/tag/jcp-submission-2026-10-22-r1
summary: We present a geometric interface reconstruction method for Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) simulations that captures both curved interfaces and sharp features using only volume fraction data. We represent interfaces with linear facets, circular arcs, and corner facets formed by two lines or arcs joined within a single cell. We first propagate local orientation constraints through a graph and merge cells to resolve ambiguities, treating topological consistency as a first-class constraint. An optional conservative refinement improves $C^0$ continuity while preserving local volume constraints. Users can independently enable circular facets, corner facets, cell merging, and continuity refinement to balance accuracy and computational cost. In its simplest configuration, our method provides a fast local line-fitting scheme competitive with state-of-the-art PLIC methods. On standard static benchmarks, the full configuration reconstructs identifiable lines, circles, and sufficiently resolved corners to numerical precision on coarse, perturbed Cartesian meshes. On varying-curvature interfaces, it achieves third-order convergence in facet-gap error and approximately first-order convergence in curvature error. These results demonstrate global volume conservation and accurate reconstruction of curved and corner features.
