title: Sparse descent subspace-Newton thresholding algorithm for sparse optimization problems
summary: In this paper, we propose a sparse descent direction derived from the Newton direction within a low-dimensional subspace for sparse optimization problems. Building upon this direction and incorporating hard thresholding and orthogonal projection, we develop a novel algorithm termed the sparse descent subspace-Newton thresholding (SDSNT) algorithm. We further establish its global convergence under the restricted isometry property $δ_{3k}\leq \sqrt{3/20}$ of the measurement matrix. Numerical experiments on random sparse vector recovery and audio signal reconstruction reveal that SDSNT achieves comparable performance to several state-of-the-art algorithms. Notably, relative to most of them, it delivers superior recovery at high sparsity levels and improved efficiency at low sparsity levels.

title: With foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification
summary: Whole-slide image classifiers are usually developed within one hospital and often go untested at unseen hospitals. We assembled 5,036 haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained gastric slides from five Korean hospitals, scanned at 20x and 40x, and compared multiple-instance learning aggregators under leave-one-hospital-out validation on frozen pathology foundation-model features. A hierarchical patch-region-slide graph aggregator (CHIME-MIL) with site alignment and two-scale fusion reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.837, above six conventional attention and transformer aggregators trained without these steps. Under a matched recipe it did not exceed attention-based pooling, and global max pooling given the same alignment and fusion was better (AUC 0.855, P = 0.0002). The alignment, which subtracts each hospital's mean feature vector without labels, onboarded a new hospital from ten unlabelled slides and cost 0.002 AUC without held-out-hospital data, but its accuracy gains were small and inconsistent. The model had low top-label calibration error (0.053) but under-confident malignancy probabilities, and removing its most-attended patches lowered the malignancy probability far more than removing random patches. With these features, more complex aggregators did not improve discrimination; what a deployable system adds is label-free onboarding, calibration checks and auditable evidence.

title: Bayesian PET Reconstruction with Learned Flow Matching Priors via Langevin Sampling
comments: Selected as the Best Student Paper Award for 2026 IVMSP
summary: Image reconstruction for positron emission tomography (PET) is a challenging inverse problem due to its inherent ill-posedness and Poisson counting noise, particularly in low-dose acquisitions. In this work, we introduce a novel Bayesian PET reconstruction framework that leverages a flow-matching generative prior learned from high-quality PET images. By incorporating this prior, we formulate PET reconstruction as a Bayesian inference problem and solve it via latent-space posterior sampling using the unadjusted Langevin algorithm. We evaluate the proposed method through numerical experiments and benchmark it against classical reconstruction methods and state-of-the-art deep learning-based baselines. The proposed method achieves improved reconstruction performance while enabling posterior uncertainty quantification.
comment: Selected as the Best Student Paper Award for 2026 IVMSP

title: PRIN: A Perceptual-Structural Retinex-Inspired Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) focuses not only on visibility recovery but also on preserving structurally meaningful content and perceptual naturalness. Existing learning-based methods may achieve favorable pixel-wise fidelity while still producing over-smoothed textures, color deviations, or spatially incoherent illumination. Retinex-inspired methods provide interpretable decomposition into reflectance and illumination components, however, the asymmetric restoration roles of these components are rarely encoded through branch-specific frequency-domain refinement. To address this issue, we propose a Perceptual-Structural Retinex-Inspired Network (PRIN), which integrates Retinex priors with restoration-role-aware enhancement. PRIN employs a shared encoder and asymmetric decoders to estimate reflectance and illumination components. The reflectance branch performs attention-guided and edge-aware wavelet refinement to preserve textures and boundaries, whereas the illumination branch promotes spatially coherent brightness adjustment. After the recomposition of reflectance and illumination branches, a curve-based post-composition enhancement head calibrates residual tone and exposure deviations. Experiments on LOL-v1, LOL-v2-Syn, and LOL-v2-Real show that the proposed network ties for the best structural similarity index (SSIM) and obtains the second-lowest learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) on LOL-v1, achieves the best SSIM and LPIPS on LOL-v2-Syn, and obtains the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and the second-lowest LPIPS on LOL-v2-Real.

title: Pinching Antennas for ISAC: Waveguide Architectures, Solutions, and Future Directions
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a core design principle for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, yet fixed antenna geometry limits its performance. Pinching antenna systems (PASS) guide electromagnetic waves along dielectric waveguides and radiate them through position-adaptive antennas, allowing communication links and sensing observations to benefit from spatial reconfiguration. This article reviews PASS-enabled ISAC through single-waveguide, multi-waveguide, and segmented-waveguide architectures, comparing their feed structures, spatial degrees of freedom, operating protocols, and uplink/downlink support. We organize solution pathways around physics-consistent modeling, joint spatial-signal optimization, dynamic channel acquisition, and stable real-time control. A segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) case study demonstrates joint segment selection, antenna po?sitioning, and transmit beamforming using segment-hysteresis reinforcement learning. The results illustrate how waveguide loss and per-segment aperture gain create communication-sensing tradeoffs. We conclude with research directions in joint transmit?receive operation, measurement-calibrated digital twins, and trustworthy control.

title: The lattice of antichains of intervals: Dyck paths, level sets, and sweep dimension
summary: The Clarke-Cormack-Burkowski lattice $\mathcal{E}_n$ is the lattice of antichains of intervals of the chain $\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, the algebraic structure underlying minimal-interval semantics, a query semantics used in information retrieval. We give an explicit, elementary anti-isomorphism between $\mathcal{E}_n$ minus its top element and the Stanley lattice of Dyck words of semilength $n+1$ (an anti-isomorphism whose existence is implicit in work of Ferrari and Munarini), under which the rank of an antichain is $\binom{n+1}{2}$ minus the area of the associated Dyck word. Hence the rank generating function of $\mathcal{E}_n\setminus\{\top\}$ is the reverse of the Carlitz-Riordan $q$-Catalan polynomial. Using a local limit theorem for the area of random-walk excursions, we confirm unconditionally an asymptotic formula of Takács: the size $λ_n$ of the largest level set of $\mathcal{E}_n$ satisfies $λ_n\simκ\,4^{n+1}/(n+1)^3$, where $κ\approx1.0807$. Finally, for the antichains of intervals of an arbitrary finite poset $P$ we study the sweep dimension, the minimum number of linear orders needed to separate every interval from every element outside it. It equals the Dushnik-Miller dimension of the lattice of convex subsets of $P$, it is the least $k$ for which $P$ maps into $\mathbb{R}^k$ so that every interval is the preimage of an upper orthant, and it lies between $\max(2,w)$ and $2w$, where $w$ is the width of $P$, both bounds being tight. Antichains of intervals embed, preserving joins, into $k$-dimensional staircase regions.

title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
summary: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. These results motivate a coupled quantum--classical architecture with two interacting cycles: rapid decoding protects quantum information, while slower learning renews the models from operating experience. The long-term vision is a scalable decoder model factory that produces high-performance, low-latency decoders and continually adapts them to evolving quantum hardware.

title: Conditional Neural SDEs for Financial Time-Series Generation
summary: Conditional generation of time-series paths is a central problem in probabilistic modeling, where the goal is to simulate future trajectories that are both realistic and responsive to external context. It has direct applications in finance and economics. Neural stochastic differential equations provide a natural framework for this task by combining continuous-time stochastic dynamics with learnable drift and diffusion functions. However, directly modeling the target state can be unstable in conditional settings, especially when the target and conditioning variables have strong level dependence, limited training data, or different dimensions.We propose a residualanchor Neural SDE architecture that decomposes the target into a learned conditional anchor and a stochastic residual. The anchor captures the context-dependent baseline, while the Neural SDE (Stochastic Differential Equation) models the residual dynamics around this baseline. This separation reduces the burden on the stochastic dynamics and generalizes spread-based representations to more general conditioning settings.We evaluate the approach on real-world financial time series, including conditional interest-rate scenarios and a comparison with a time-series foundation model. The results show that the proposed model can generate plausible conditional paths, maintain competitive point accuracy, and provide calibrated uncertainty estimates.

title: GNSS Receiver Operating Point Comparison Between Vector and Scalar Tracking Under High-Dynamics
summary: This paper presents a measurement noise adaptation mechanism for Kalman filter-based carrier tracking in a navigation-aided GNSS receiver designed for launch-vehicle applications. The tracking loop is tuned for 20\,g acceleration steps, which requires a wide bandwidth that makes the loop vulnerable to noise-driven pull-out at low carrier-to-noise density ratios. To resolve this tradeoff, the measurement noise covariance, $R$, is inflated via a two-layer gate: a sigmoid envelope keyed to the signal $C/N_0$, modulated by a dynamics indicator derived from the discriminator output statistics of the Loop Bandwidth Control Algorithm. During noise-dominated periods the gate inflates~$R$, reducing the Kalman gain so the filter coasts on the navigation-aided prediction; when dynamics are detected the gate opens within one epoch, restoring the high-bandwidth tuning. The navigation aiding is formulated as a stochastic control input whose uncertainty is propagated from the navigation EKF covariance. Simulation results on a 20\,g acceleration step scenario show that the adapted vector architecture doubles the lock-retention rate relative to the standalone scalar filter at $C/N_0 = 31$\,dB-Hz. The receiver is implemented in MSGR, an open-source MATLAB GNSS software-defined receiver.

title: Distributed Grid Search for Hyperparameter Tuning
summary: The performance of many distributed optimization algorithms over peer-to-peer networks strongly depends on the choice of their hyperparameters. However, existing selection rules often require global quantities, yield conservative choices, or are tied to specific algorithms and hyperparameters. We propose Distributed Grid Search (D-GS), a consensus-based search method that evaluates and selects hyperparameter configurations across the network, requiring only the ability to run the tuned algorithm and evaluate local gradients. We also propose a zoom-in variant, Distributed Zoom Grid Search (D-ZGS), which improves empirical performance at a reduced cost. We prove that both methods terminate in finite time with all agents holding the same hyperparameter configuration, and quantify the (sub)optimality of this configuration. Numerical experiments on linear and logistic regression show that D-GS closely matches a centralized reference and that tuning and deployment cost a fraction of deploying algorithms with hyperparameters tuned using theoretical results.

title: On $t$-designs supported by self-orthogonal codes
summary: We study self-orthogonal $t$-$(v,k,λ)$ designs satisfying the condition that the codes generated by the designs are self-orthogonal codes whose codewords of minimum weight $k$ correspond to the blocks. A classification of such designs is given under the conditions that $t\geq \lfloor k/4\rfloor+1\geq2$ and $t \le 11$. This yields a classification of self-orthogonal codes of minimum weight $k$ whose codewords of minimum weight form a $t$-design under the same conditions.

title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph: A Geometry and Topology-Aware Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
summary:
We developed TopoHyperClinicalGraph, a multimodal framework combining hyperbolic tissue geometry, persistent topology and clinical graph learning for cancer survival prediction. Pre-extracted UNI2-h features are reduced from 1,536 to 1,024 dimensions using training-fold PCA. A pathology backbone combines hyperbolic neighborhoods with Lorentz-centroid attention pooling. Once frozen, its survival logits are adjusted using persistence descriptors from up to 64 landmarks per slide and sampling controls. A five-node clinical graph then learns a further correction from age, sex, stage, T and N.
  Five-fold patient-level evaluation covered eight TCGA and CPTAC cohorts with 2,364 patients. Mean validation-selected C-indices for TopoHyperClinicalGraph versus pathology-only spatial PatchGCN were 0.7563 versus 0.7386 in COADREAD, 0.6220 versus 0.5998 in HNSC, 0.6755 versus 0.6535 in BRCA and 0.6409 versus 0.6176 in STAD. CPTAC scores were 0.5984 in HNSC, 0.6060 in PDA, 0.8055 in CCRCC and 0.7192 in LUAD. CPTAC-HNSC used TCGA-initialized adaptation; other CPTAC backbones were trained within their cohorts. Geometry accounted for most pathology-only gains, with smaller persistence effects. Clinical graph fusion exceeded its matched node-wise control in five cohorts, tied in one and scored lower in two; clinical-only prediction exceeded fusion in three CPTAC cohorts.
  The framework supports separate evaluation of geometric, topological and clinical contributions. All scores were validation-selected; independent testing is needed to establish generalizability.

AI.title_translation: TopoHyperClinicalGraph：一种用于癌症生存预测的几何与拓扑感知多模态框架
AI.tldr: 提出了结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑特征与临床图学习的多模态癌症生存预测框架，在多个癌症队列中取得优于传统病理GCN的预测效果。
AI.motivation: 为提升癌症生存预测准确性，开发一种能够同时融合组织双曲几何、持续拓扑特征与临床多模态信息的几何和拓扑感知框架。
AI.method: 使用PCA将预提取的UNI2-h特征由1536维降至1024维；病理主干网络融合双曲邻域与洛伦兹质心注意力池化；冻结病理主干后，利用来自每张切片最多64个标志物及其采样对照的持续性拓扑描述符微调生存logits；构建包含年龄、性别、分期、T和N的五节点临床图以学习进一步修正。
AI.result: 在包含2364例患者的8个TCGA与CPTAC队列五折交叉验证中，该模型在COADREAD、HNSC、BRCA和STAD的平均C-index分别为0.7563、0.6220、0.6755和0.6409，均优于空间PatchGCN；CPTAC各队列得分在0.5984至0.8055之间。消融显示几何特征贡献了病理模型的主要提升，临床图融合在多数队列中优于节点对照。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持独立评估几何结构、拓扑特征和临床数据对生存预测的贡献。由于现有评估结果均基于验证集筛选，仍需独立的外部测试以验证其泛化能力。
AI.translation: 我们开发了TopoHyperClinicalGraph，这是一个结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑和临床图学习的多模态框架，用于癌症生存预测。预先提取的UNI2-h特征在训练折中通过PCA从1536维降至1024维。病理主干网络结合了双曲邻域与洛伦兹质心注意力池化。该主干网络冻结后，其生存logits会利用每张切片最多64个标志物和采样对照提取的持续拓扑描述符进行调整。随后，一个五节点的临床图进一步根据年龄、性别、分期、T分期和N分期学习修正值。在涵盖8个TCGA和CPTAC队列、共2364名患者的五折患者级别评估中，TopoHyperClinicalGraph对比仅使用病理的空间PatchGCN，在COADREAD中的平均验证选择C-index为0.7563对0.7386，HNSC为0.6220对0.5998，BRCA为0.6755对0.6535，STAD为0.6409对0.6176。CPTAC在HNSC、PDA、CCRCC和LUAD上的得分分别为0.5984、0.6060、0.8055和0.7192。几何特征占据了病理端大部分收益，拓扑持续性影响较小。临床图融合在5个队列中优于匹配的节点级对照，1个持平，2个较低；在3个CPTAC队列中，单纯临床预测优于融合模型。该框架支持分别评估几何、拓扑和临床的贡献。所有得分均为验证集选择结果；仍需要独立测试来验证其泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TopoHyperClinicalGraph，一种结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑与临床图学习的多模态癌症生存预测框架。通过在8个TCGA和CPTAC队列（共2364名患者）上的五折验证，展示了该模型相较传统病理图卷积网络的性能优势，并解耦分析了几何、拓扑与临床数据各自的贡献。
AI.keywords: 癌症生存预测, 双曲几何, 持续拓扑, 临床图学习, 多模态融合
AI.comments: 该研究的主要创新点在于将双曲几何、持续同调拓扑特征与临床图学习有机融合，用于多模态癌症预后预测，并细化评估了各模块的贡献度。局限性在于所有指标均为验证集选择得分，尚未在完全独立的数据集上进行外部泛化性测试；此外在部分CPTAC队列中，单纯临床预测甚至优于多模态融合模型，表明图融合机制与跨模态特征交互仍有进一步优化的空间。

title: Group Physical-Layer Authentication and Confidential Beamforming in Non-Terrestrial Networks
summary: Coordinated high-altitude platform station (HAPS) networks need to authenticate group responses and protect private data under shared power constraints. This paper studies joint group physical-layer authentication (PLA) and confidential beamforming using a fresh secret tag superimposed on private data. For received attacks independent of the current tag, we derive exact finite-block expressions for false acceptance and legitimate rejection. These expressions translate authentication error targets into a required tag signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR). We establish a nonzero asymptotic tag-energy floor and analyze residual frequency offset and peak-power restrictions. The legitimate receiver removes the tag by orthogonal projection, which discards one temporal dimension. For colluding eavesdroppers, we identify the spatial coverage condition under which artificial noise (AN) keeps their SINR bounded as data and AN powers increase together. We jointly optimize the private beams, tag beam, and AN covariance to minimize transmit power under authentication, secrecy, and per-HAPS power constraints. The method combines semidefinite relaxation (SDR), exact private-beam rank reduction, and feasible successive convex approximation. A corrected dual lower bound measures the remaining optimality gap. Numerical results show that increasing the tag length from 16 to 64 symbols reduces the required tag SINR by 7.16 dB. Joint beam design reduces mean transmit power by 27.4% relative to an optimized fixed-tag-direction baseline. The authentication guarantee requires fresh secret tags and excludes relays of the current response.

AI.title_translation: 非地面网络中的组物理层认证与保密波束成形
AI.tldr: 本文研究了非地面网络中HAPS的组物理层认证与保密波束成形，通过叠加秘密标签和人工噪声，联合优化波束以最小化发射功率，同时满足认证、保密和功率约束，并取得了显著的功率节省。
AI.motivation: 协调式高空平台站（HAPS）网络需要在共享功率约束下对组响应进行认证并保护私有数据。
AI.method: 本文研究了使用叠加在私有数据上的新秘密标签的联合组物理层认证（PLA）和保密波束成形。对于独立于当前标签的接收攻击，推导了虚假接受和合法拒绝的精确有限块表达式，将认证错误目标转化为所需的标签信噪比（SINR）。建立了非零渐近标签能量底线，并分析了残余频率偏移和峰值功率限制。合法接收器通过正交投影移除标签。对于合谋窃听者，确定了在数据和人工噪声（AN）功率同时增加时，AN能使窃听者SINR有界的空间覆盖条件。联合优化私有波束、标签波束和AN协方差，以在认证、保密和每个HAPS功率约束下最小化发射功率。该方法结合了半正定松弛（SDR）、精确私有波束秩降和可行逐次凸逼近。使用修正的对偶下界来衡量剩余的最优性差距。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，将标签长度从16个符号增加到64个符号，可将所需的标签SINR降低7.16 dB。联合波束设计相对于优化的固定标签方向基线，将平均发射功率降低了27.4%。认证保证需要新的秘密标签，并排除当前响应的中继。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出并验证了一种在非地面网络中实现组物理层认证和保密波束成形的方法，通过引入新的秘密标签和人工噪声，并联合优化波束设计，显著降低了发射功率，并提供了可靠的认证和保密性。
AI.translation: 协调式高空平台站（HAPS）网络需要在共享功率约束下对组响应进行认证并保护私有数据。本文研究了使用叠加在私有数据上的新秘密标签的联合组物理层认证（PLA）和保密波束成形。对于独立于当前标签的接收攻击，我们推导了虚假接受和合法拒绝的精确有限块表达式。这些表达式将认证错误目标转化为所需的标签信噪比（SINR）。我们建立了非零渐近标签能量底线，并分析了残余频率偏移和峰值功率限制。合法接收器通过正交投影移除标签，这会丢弃一个时间维度。对于合谋窃听者，我们确定了在数据和人工噪声（AN）功率同时增加时，AN能使窃听者SINR有界的空间覆盖条件。我们联合优化私有波束、标签波束和AN协方差，以在认证、保密和每个HAPS功率约束下最小化发射功率。该方法结合了半正定松弛（SDR）、精确私有波束秩降和可行逐次凸逼近。修正的对偶下界衡量了剩余的最优性差距。数值结果表明，将标签长度从16个符号增加到64个符号，可将所需的标签SINR降低7.16 dB。联合波束设计相对于优化的固定标签方向基线，将平均发射功率降低了27.4%。认证保证需要新的秘密标签，并排除当前响应的中继。
AI.summary: 本文针对非地面网络中的协调式高空平台站（HAPS）网络，提出了一种联合组物理层认证（PLA）和保密波束成形方案。该方案通过将新的秘密标签叠加在私有数据上，并在存在合谋窃听者的情况下引入人工噪声，实现了在认证、保密和功率约束下的发射功率最小化。研究推导了认证错误表达式，分析了标签能量和功率限制，并采用半正定松弛等优化技术进行联合波束设计。数值结果表明，增加标签长度和联合波束设计能显著降低所需的标签SINR和平均发射功率，强调了新秘密标签对于认证保证的重要性。
AI.keywords: 组物理层认证, 保密波束成形, 非地面网络, HAPS, 秘密标签, 人工噪声
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将物理层认证与保密波束成形在非地面网络HAPS场景下进行联合设计，引入了“新秘密标签”的概念，并结合人工噪声来对抗窃听者，这对于提升HAPS通信的安全性具有重要意义。在方法上，通过高级优化技术（如SDR和逐次凸逼近）来解决复杂的联合优化问题，并提供了具体的功率节省量化结果，显示了其实用价值。对标签长度和认证保证条件的分析也较为深入。

title: Reliability-Weighted Direct Preference Optimization: Penalized Weights for Robust Preference Learning
summary:
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) treats every reported comparison as correct, yet preference data contain
  reversed, tied or otherwise noisy comparisons. RW-DPO gives each comparison an unknown reliability weight
  $w_i\in[0,1]$ that enters the likelihood linearly -- DPO is $w\equiv1$, a reversed comparison $w_i=0$ -- and estimates
  the weights jointly with the policy under a minimax-concave penalty on $-\log w_i$. The penalty keeps every
  comparison the model agrees with at exactly $w_i=1$ and acts only on those it contradicts, through closed-form weight
  updates at negligible cost over DPO. We prove that recovering all flipped comparisons from a single annotation per
  comparison requires margins of order $\log n$. Furthermore, in a linear-index model, starting from an initial fit
  pointing in the correct direction, our estimator jointly consistently recovers the preference direction and weights,
  as well as identifies the flipped comparisons above this margin scale, even when a fixed fraction of comparisons is
  flipped. In simulations RW-DPO has the lowest average estimation error among DPO, noise-rate corrections and recent
  robust methods, with far more precise flags than recent label-correction methods. In DPO fine-tuning of a language
  model with 10-30% flipped labels, its win rate does not fall as the flip rate grows and exceeds that of DPO trained on
  clean labels, matching the strongest recent method with corrections concentrated on the flipped labels.

AI.title_translation: 可靠性加权直接偏好优化：用于鲁棒偏好学习的惩罚权重
AI.tldr: RW-DPO通过对偏好样本引入可靠性权重与非凸惩罚项，以极小计算开销实现对噪声和反转标签的自适应过滤，显著提升偏好微调的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）默认所有标注的比较样本都是正确的，但现实偏好数据中常含有反转、平局或其他噪声比较，严重影响策略微调性能。
AI.method: 提出了RW-DPO方法：为每个偏好对比样本赋予未知可靠性权重$w_i \in [0, 1]$并线性代入似然函数，同时在$-\log w_i$上施加极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty），从而与策略联合优化；该惩罚对模型认同的样本保持$w_i=1$，仅对冲突样本通过闭式解更新权重，计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在单次标注下单样本反转恢复所需的间隔阶数为$\log n$，并在线性指标模型中证明了联合一致恢复性；仿真中其估计误差在同类方法中最低；在10-30%标签反转的语言模型微调实验中，RW-DPO的胜率未随反转率上升而下降，甚至超越了在纯净数据上训练的DPO。
AI.conclusion: RW-DPO通过引入可靠性权重惩罚机制，在理论和实证上均证明了其能够有效纠正和过滤噪声/反转偏好对，显著提升了偏好学习的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）将每个给出的对比样本均视为正确，但偏好数据中往往存在反转、平局或其他噪声对比。RW-DPO为每个对比样本赋予一个未知的可靠性权重 $w_i \in [0,1]$，该权重线性进入似然函数——其中DPO对应于 $w \equiv 1$，完全反转的对比则对应于 $w_i = 0$——并在施加于 $-\log w_i$ 的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）下与策略联合估计权重。该惩罚项使得模型赞同的每个对比样本权重严格保持在 $w_i=1$，且仅作用于与模型预测矛盾的样本，同时仅需极小额外计算开销即可通过闭式解更新权重。我们从理论上证明，在每个对比仅有单次标注的情况下，恢复所有反转的对比样本需要 $\log n$ 阶的间隔（margin）。此外，在线性指标模型中，从指向正确方向的初始拟合出发，即使存在固定比例的反转对比，我们的估计器也能联合一致地恢复偏好方向与权重，并识别出该间隔尺度以上的反转对比。在模拟实验中，与DPO、噪声率修正法及近期鲁棒方法相比，RW-DPO取得了最低的平均估计误差，且标记精度远高于近期的标签修正方法。在包含10%至30%反转标签的语言模型DPO微调中，其胜率不仅未随反转率增加而下降，甚至超过了在干净标签上训练的DPO，比肩最优秀的近期方法，并将修正精准集中在反转标签上。
AI.summary: 本文针对偏好数据中普遍存在的噪声与标签反转问题，提出了可靠性加权直接偏好优化（RW-DPO）。该方法为每个样本引入可靠性权重并通过非凸惩罚项与策略联合估计，仅对模型矛盾样本进行低开销的闭式权重调整。理论与实验均证明该方法能够精确识别反转样本，在不同噪声比例下保持高度鲁棒的偏好学习效果。
AI.keywords: 直接偏好优化 (DPO), 鲁棒偏好学习, 标签噪声, 可靠性加权, 大语言模型微调
AI.comments: RW-DPO巧妙地结合了统计学中的极大极小凹惩罚（minimax-concave penalty）与DPO目标函数，不仅在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下实现了权重的闭式更新，还提供了在单次标注设置下恢复反转标签的理论边界。该方法在噪声偏好微调场景下展现出极强的鲁棒性，甚至胜过纯净数据训练的标准DPO。

title: PDE-Residual-Informed Kriging
summary: Physics-informed Gaussian process (GP) methods provide a probabilistic framework for PDE solving. Existing approaches incorporate PDE information in different ways: pointwise conditioning uses the governing equation only at finitely many selected locations, globally constrained GPs restrict the admissible functions to satisfy the PDE exactly, and residual-penalized methods control the PDE mismatch over the whole domain through an additional penalty weight. What is still missing is a GP formulation that directly incorporates global PDE-residual information of the entire domain into its covariance structure, while retaining model flexibility and standard GP conditioning without a separate residual-weight parameter. To solve this issue, this study proposes PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK) based on a PDE-residual kernel. The PDE-residual kernel is constructed by equipping a kernel-section space with an inner product defined by the $L^{2}$ inner product of PDE residuals. This construction makes PRIK yield the posterior mean with minimum integrated squared PDE residual. It also provides direct statistical interpretations: the variance-scale estimate equals the normalized PDE-residual energy (i.e., the integrated squared PDE residual of the posterior mean divided by the number of labeled observations), and the profile likelihood balances this residual energy against model complexity. Under the stated regularity and stability conditions, we establish $H^{2}$-quasi-optimality and convergence rates for the posterior mean, together with a nonasymptotic bound for its PDE-residual norm. We further show that the normalized posterior kernel converges to a variational Green-type kernel and derive a uniform nonasymptotic contraction bound for the posterior variance. Numerical studies provide empirical evidence consistent with the theory and demonstrate the PDE-solving capability of PRIK.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PRIK方法，通过引入新型PDE残差核，将全局偏微分方程残差直接纳入高斯过程协方差，无需调参即可实现理论保证的高精度PDE求解。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法在将PDE信息融入时存在局限：逐点条件化仅在有限位置使用，全局约束限制了解的准确性，而残差惩罚法则需要人为调节惩罚权重。缺少一种能直接将全域全局PDE残差信息纳入协方差结构、保持模型灵活性且无需独立残差权重参数的GP公式。
AI.method: 提出基于PDE残差核的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，通过在核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^2$内积定义的内积来构建PDE残差核。
AI.result: 理论上建立了后验均值的$H^2$准最优性和收敛速度、PDE残差范数的非渐近界、后验核向变分Green型核的收敛性以及后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界；数值研究验证了理论并展示了出色的PDE求解能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的PRIK方法成功将全局PDE残差信息融入高斯过程协方差结构，兼具理论保证和良好的数值求解性能。
AI.translation: 物理信息高斯过程（GP）方法为求解偏微分方程（PDE）提供了一个概率框架。现有方法以不同方式整合PDE信息：逐点条件化仅在有限个选定位置使用控制方程，全局约束GP限制容许函数精确满足PDE，而残差惩罚法则通过额外的惩罚权重来控制整个域上的PDE失配。目前所缺少的是一种GP公式，它能够将整个域的全局PDE残差信息直接纳入其协方差结构中，同时保持模型的灵活性和标准GP条件化，而无需单独的残差权重参数。为了解决这个问题，本研究提出了基于PDE残差核的PDE残差信息克里金法（PRIK）。PDE残差核是通过为核截面空间配备由PDE残差的$L^{2}$内积定义的内积来构建的。这种构建使得PRIK能够产生具有最小积分平方PDE残差的后验均值。它还提供了直接的统计学解释：方差尺度估计等于归一化的PDE残差能量（即后验均值的积分平方PDE残差除以带标签观测值的数量），并且profile似然平衡了该残差能量与模型复杂度。在规定的正则性和稳定性条件下，我们建立了后验均值的$H^{2}$准最优性和收敛速度，以及其PDE残差范数的非渐近界。我们进一步证明了归一化后验核收敛于变分Green型核，并推导出了后验方差的均匀非渐近收缩界。数值研究提供了与理论一致的经验证据，并展示了PRIK的PDE求解能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)的新型高斯过程方法，通过构建基于PDE残差的核函数，将全局PDE残差信息直接整合到协方差结构中，从而在无需残差权重参数的情况下实现了具有理论保证的高效PDE求解。
AI.keywords: 高斯过程, 偏微分方程求解, 克里金法, 残差核函数, 变分法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK)方法，将全局偏微分方程残差信息直接融入高斯过程的协方差结构中，无需调节残差惩罚权重，并在理论和数值实验上都展现了优越性。

title: On reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale flocking dynamics
summary: Flocking refers to a phenomenon in collective motion where particles align their velocities with each other, commonly modelled using Cucker-Smale dynamics. In this work, we introduce and analyse two general reduced SPDE models for stochastic Cucker-Smale particle dynamics that encompass environmental and i.i.d.-type noises. Our models are computationally cheaper alternatives to the underlying particle system and preserve the flocking behaviour. To derive our reduced models, we consider suitable empirical particle densities which depend on position and time, but feature velocity dependency in a multiplicative fashion: this setup crucially allows for a very intuitive and convenient notion of flocking at the SPDE level. In $d=1$ we prove flocking of the reduced SPDE models, and, for the environmental noise, we also quantify the discrepancy between the reduced SPDE and mollified particle system. We also discuss the technical modifications required to extend the results to higher dimensions. We then provide extensive numerical experiments to verify our theoretical results in $d=1$ and to explore the behaviour of our models in $d=2$.

AI.title_translation: 关于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维SPDE模型，既能降低计算成本又能保持群集行为，并通过理论证明和数值实验进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的随机Cucker-Smale粒子系统在计算上成本高昂，因此需要开发计算成本更低、同时能保持群集行为的降维SPDE模型。
AI.method: 考虑依赖于位置和时间、且速度依赖性呈乘法关系的经验粒子密度，从而推导出两个通用的降维SPDE模型；在一维情况下证明了群集行为并量化了误差，同时讨论了高维扩展的技术修改并进行了数值实验。
AI.result: 在一维情况下证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，量化了环境噪声下降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异，并经一维和二维的广泛数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功导出了随机Cucker-Smale动力学的降维SPDE模型，在数学上证明了一维情况下的群集行为及误差界，并通过高维数值实验验证了模型的有效性。
AI.translation: 群集是指集体运动中的一种现象，其中粒子的速度相互对齐，通常使用Cucker-Smale动力学来建模。在这项工作中，我们引入并分析了两个通用的降维SPDE模型，用于描述包含环境噪声和独立同分布（i.i.d.）噪声的随机Cucker-Smale粒子动力学。我们的模型是底层粒子系统的计算成本更低的替代方案，并且能够保持群集行为。为了推导出我们的降维模型，我们考虑了适当的经验粒子密度，这些密度取决于位置和时间，但以乘法方式表现出速度依赖性：这种设置至关重要地允许在SPDE层面上对群集进行非常直观和方便的概念化。在 $d=1$ 维度下，我们证明了降维SPDE模型的群集性，对于环境噪声，我们还量化了降维SPDE与平滑粒子系统之间的差异。我们还讨论了将结果扩展到更高维度所需的技术修改。随后，我们提供了大量的数值实验，以验证我们在 $d=1$ 下的理论结果，并探讨了我们的模型在 $d=2$ 下的行为。
AI.summary: 本文针对随机Cucker-Smale粒子系统，引入并分析了两个降维SPDE模型以降低计算成本。通过特殊的经验粒子密度设定，模型在SPDE层面直观地保持了群集行为。作者在一维情况下证明了群集性并量化了模型误差，讨论了高维扩展，并通过数值实验验证了理论。
AI.keywords: Cucker-Smale模型, 群集动力学, 随机偏微分方程, 降维模型, 粒子系统
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了适用于随机Cucker-Smale群集动力学的降维随机偏微分方程（SPDE）模型，不仅在计算上更具优势，而且在SPDE层面上保持了群集行为，并通过数学证明和数值实验进行了严格验证。

title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
comments: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental material: 11 pages
summary: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.
comment: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental material: 11 pages

AI.title_translation: 具有朗道尔边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优输运：机器学习与解析解
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于解决具有朗道尔非线性边界条件的高非线性欠阻尼随机最优输运问题，并通过微扰展开进行了基准验证。
AI.motivation: 欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议求解是控制理论中的重要难题，尤其在存在非线性边界条件（如朗道尔比特擦除）时问题高度非线性，通常缺乏解析解。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于机器学习的直接求解方法，仅通过调节可控外势将系统在位置空间中从单峰分布引导至双峰分布，并利用过阻尼极限下的微扰展开法进行基准比对。
AI.result: 成功获得了非线性边界条件下欠阻尼随机最优输运的数值解，并利用合适过阻尼极限下的微扰展开基准对其进行了有效验证。
AI.translation: 寻找欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议是控制理论中一个困难但重要的问题。在本文中，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于在存在非线性边界条件（包括模拟朗道尔比特擦除问题的边界条件）时寻找该问题的最优解。仅通过作用于可控的外加势，动力学在位置空间中从单峰分布被引导至双峰分布。该问题具有高度非线性，通常无法获得解析解。我们使用微扰展开对数值结果进行了基准测试，该微扰展开预计在合适的过阻尼极限下成立。
AI.summary: 针对具有朗道尔非线性边界条件的欠阻尼随机最优输运控制难题，本文提出了一种基于机器学习的直接求解方法，仅通过控制外势实现单峰到双峰分布的状态转移，并借助过阻尼极限下的微扰展开对结果进行了基准测试。
AI.keywords: 欠阻尼随机过程, 最优输运, 机器学习, 朗道尔边界条件, 微扰展开
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将机器学习直接方法引入欠阻尼随机最优输运问题中，有效应对了朗道尔比特擦除等复杂的非线性边界条件，并通过过阻尼极限下的微扰展开进行基准验证，在非平衡统计物理与现代控制理论的结合上具有重要价值。

title: Distributed Zeroth-Order Composite Finite-Sum Optimization via Incremental Variance Reduction
summary: We study decentralized composite finite-sum optimization over a fixed connected undirected network, where agents access local component functions through function evaluations and share a possibly nonsmooth convex regularizer. In this setting, standard two-point gradient estimators can retain nonvanishing variance at a solution, complicating their integration with gradient tracking. We propose Distributed Zeroth-Order Incremental Variance Reduction (Distributed ZIVR), which combines incrementally updated component-gradient estimates with a proximal gradient-tracking scheme. The method admits an implementation using a constant number of function evaluations per agent at every iteration, without intermittent full-component or full-coordinate refreshes. For convex smooth component functions and strongly convex local averages, we establish linear convergence up to a controllable finite-difference error. With the finite-difference radius chosen for the target accuracy, Chebyshev-accelerated mixing yields a per-agent oracle complexity of $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ for expected squared solution error $ε$, where $d$ is the dimension, $m$ is the number of components per agent, and $κ$ is the condition number. This matches the centralized ZIVR oracle bound, while the communication bound has only an inverse square-root dependence on the network spectral gap. Experiments on logistic and robust regression demonstrate rapid reduction of solution and consensus errors.

AI.title_translation: 基于增量方差约简的分布式零阶复合有限和优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的分布式零阶优化算法（Distributed ZIVR），通过增量方差约简实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在分散式复合有限和优化中，标准的两点梯度估计在解处会保留非零方差，从而使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂，因此需要一种新的零阶优化方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出分布式零阶增量方差约简算法（Distributed ZIVR），结合了增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案，利用Chebyshev加速混合。
AI.result: 对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，建立了达到可控有限差分误差的线性收敛性；在目标精度下，每个智能体的预言机复杂度达到 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$，匹配了集中式ZIVR的预言机界。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Distributed ZIVR算法在分布式零阶组合有限和优化问题上取得了突破，实现了与集中式算法相匹配的预言机复杂度，并通过实验验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了固定连通无向网络上的分散式复合有限和优化问题，其中智能体通过函数评估访问局部组件函数，并共享一个可能非光滑的凸正则化器。在此设置下，标准的两点梯度估计器在解处可能保留非零方差，这使其与梯度追踪的集成变得复杂。我们提出了分布式零阶增量方差指数约简（Distributed ZIVR），它将增量更新的分量梯度估计与近端梯度追踪方案结合起来。该方法在每次迭代中每个智能体只需使用常数个函数评估，无需间断的全组件或全坐标刷新。对于凸平滑分量函数和强凸局部平均，我们建立了一个可控有限差分误差范围内的线性收敛性。当为目标精度选择有限差分半径时，Chebyshev加速混合产生了 $\widetilde{O}(d(m+κ)\log(1/ε))$ 的每个智能体预言机复杂度（对应于期望平方解误差 $\varepsilon$），其中 $d$ 是维度，$m$ 是每个智能体的组件数，$k$ 是条件数。这与集中式ZIVR的预言机界相匹配，而通信界对网络谱隙只有逆平方根依赖。逻辑回归和鲁棒回归的实验证明了解误差和共识误差的快速降低。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了分散式复合有限和优化问题，提出了一种名为Distributed ZIVR的新算法，结合了增量方差约简和梯度追踪，在保持极低函数评估次数的同时实现了线性收敛，并在预言机复杂度上追平了集中式方法。
AI.keywords: 分布式优化, 零阶优化, 方差约简, 梯度追踪, 复杂度分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种分布式零阶组合有限和优化算法，通过结合增量方差约简与近端梯度追踪技术，在保证较低函数评估次数的同时实现了线性收敛，并在理论上匹配了集中式算法的预言机复杂度，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: Co$^2$ODE: Conditionally Coarse-Grained Model Discovery for Rewiring in Biochemical Networks
summary: Biochemical networks propagate the signals that regulate cellular behaviour, and which routes carry them depends on cellular context: a shift in context rewires the network's effective dynamics. Mechanistic simulators are misspecified here because the effective dynamics emerge from an interaction structure that is only partially known. Model discovery instead learns the dynamics from data, but sparse, correlated measurements poorly identify a full network model. What matters is narrower: the portion the context rewires. We introduce conditionally coarse-grained ODEs (Co$^2$ODE), which model that portion as a sparse neural or symbolic ODE: a conditional mask selects the markers carrying the rewiring, and a variational autoencoder compresses the remaining markers into a learnt closure term. On single-cell phosphoproteomic data spanning 30 cancer-relevant overexpressions, Co$^2$ODE compresses a 30-marker panel into a 10-dimensional state while matching the predictive accuracy of a neural ODE fit to the full panel. The closure absorbs what the mask drops, hence the accuracy is insensitive to which markers are kept. Adding a prior score to the loss shifts the selected markers at no cost in fit, indicating the data are not interventional enough to identify the underlying biology.

AI.title_translation: Co$^2$ODE：用于生物化学网络重连的条件粗粒化模型发现
AI.tldr: 提出Co$^2$ODE方法，通过条件掩码和变分自编码器对生物化学网络中的上下文重连动态进行建模与降维，在保证预测准确率的同时简化了模型。
AI.motivation: 生物化学网络的有效动力学随细胞上下文而改变（重连），而传统的机械模拟器存在模型设定误差，全网络模型又难以从稀疏且相关的测量数据中准确辨识，因此需要一种能够聚焦于上下文重连部分的模型发现方法。
AI.method: 引入条件粗粒化ODEs (Co$^2$ODE)，利用稀疏神经或符号ODE建模重连部分，通过条件掩码选择携带重连的标记，并使用变分自编码器将其余标记压缩为学习到的闭包项（closure term）。
AI.result: 在涵盖30种癌症相关过表达的单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上，Co$^2$ODE将30个标记的面板压缩为10维状态，同时保持了与拟合全面板的神经ODE相同的预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: Co$^2$ODE提供了一种有效的、针对上下文重连的生物化学网络简化与建模方法，兼具准确性与鲁棒性，同时也揭示了现有数据在识别潜在生物学机制方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 生物化学网络传播调节细胞行为的信号，其传输路径取决于细胞上下文：上下文的转变会重连网络的有效动态。此处的机械模拟器存在设定误差，因为有效动力学源于仅部分已知的相互作用结构。模型取而代之是从数据中学习动态，但稀疏且相关的测量难以识别完整的网络模型。重要的是更狭窄的部分：上下文重连的部分。我们引入了条件粗粒化常微分方程（Co$^2$ODE），将其建模为稀疏神经或符号ODE：条件掩码选择携带重连的标记，变分自编码器将剩余标记压缩为学习到的闭包项。在跨越30种癌症相关过表达的单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上，Co$^2$ODE将30个标记的面板压缩为10维状态，同时匹配了拟合完整面板的神经ODE的预测准确度。闭包吸收了掩码丢弃的内容，因此准确度对应保留哪些标记不敏感。在损失函数中加入先验得分可以在不付出拟合代价的情况下改变所选标记，这表明数据不足以进行干预以识别底层生物学机制。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Co$^2$ODE方法，用于对生物化学网络中因细胞上下文改变而发生重连的动态过程进行条件粗粒化模型发现。该方法通过条件掩码和变分自编码器的结合，在压缩状态维度的同时保持了高预测准确度。
AI.keywords: 条件粗粒化常微分方程, 生物化学网络, 模型发现, 变分自编码器, 单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了条件掩码（conditional mask）与变分自编码器（VAE），提出了Co$^2$ODE方法，能够有效解决生物化学网络中由于上下文改变导致的动态重连问题，并在单细胞磷酸化蛋白质组学数据上取得了很好的效果。

title: Enhancing Medical Lesion Segmentation via Several Simple Modules
summary: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. To address these challenges, we first propose DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling to optimize differentiable topological structures and boundary continuity. Second, we introduce 3D Group Prompt, which extracts domain-universal knowledge via curated volumetric image-mask alignment prompts together with text prompts built on SAT baseline. Finally, we replace conventional output layers with Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head equipped with synonym-resolved routing, which brings negligible computational cost and enables fast incremental learning for new categories without sacrificing performance on old tasks. Ablation studies on abdominal and extra-abdominal datasets covering both organ and lesion segmentation verify the efficacy of our modules.

AI.title_translation: 通过几个简单的模块增强医学病灶分割
AI.tldr: 本文提出了三个轻量级的增强模块，解决了医学病灶分割中的形态失真、跨域知识迁移困难及灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主流方法在处理缺乏高质量注释的稀有病理时容易产生形态失真，且在跨任务迁移时面临数据受限和灾难性遗忘的挑战，需要轻量级且高效的模块来提升临床适用性。
AI.method: 1. 提出结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失函数；2. 引入利用体图像-掩膜对齐提示和文本提示的3D Group Prompt；3. 使用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替代传统输出层。
AI.result: 消融实验在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹部外数据集上验证了所提模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了所提出的三个轻量级模块在腹部及腹部外数据集上的有效性，能够提升医学病灶分割的性能并支持快速增量学习。
AI.translation: 本研究引入了三个用于医学病灶分割的轻量级增强模块，以提高临床适用性，特别是在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境下。当前的主流方法在缺乏高质量稀有病理注释的情况下，尽管获得了看似理想的DSC分数，但在推理过程中往往会导致严重的形态畸变。此外，各个分割任务的孤立发展限制了跨域方法的创新，这凸显了利用同一解剖区域内不同病灶之间共享知识的必要性。然而，对历史数据和注释的受限访问阻碍了高效的知识提取，并在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为了解决这些挑战，我们首先提出了结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失，以优化可微分拓扑结构和边界连续性。其次，我们引入了3D Group Prompt，通过精心策划的体积图像-掩膜对齐提示以及基于SAT基线构建的文本提示来提取域通用知识。最后，我们用配备同义词解析路由的多对一条件分割头替换了传统的输出层，这带来了微不足道的计算成本，并实现了对新类别的快速增量学习，同时不牺牲对旧任务的性能。在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹部外数据集上的消融实验验证了我们模块的有效性。

title: Exponential quantum-classical query separations for cyclic Forrelation
summary:
We study the randomized classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation, a cyclic analogue of $k$-Forrelation [AA15, STOC'15; BS21, STOC'21]. Given $k$ Boolean functions $f_1,\ldots,f_k:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\{-1,1\}$, the goal is to estimate $T_k=N^{-1}\operatorname{Tr}(D_{f_1}H^{\otimes n}\cdots D_{f_k}H^{\otimes n}),$ where $D_{f_i}=\operatorname{diag}(f_i(x):x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n)$, $H$ is the Hadamard gate, and $N=2^n$. This normalized-trace problem can be solved with $k$ quantum queries in the DQC1 model. Its classical query complexity was left open in [JLS+26, FOCS'26], which conjectured a lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(N^{1-2/k})$.
  We establish a nearly complete characterization of the nonadaptive classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation. For even $k\ge 4$, we prove a tight bound of $Θ_k(N^{1-2/k})$ for constant additive error. For odd $k\ge 5$, we obtain a lower bound of $Ω_k(N^{1-2/(k-1)})$ and an upper bound of $O_k(N^{1-2/k})$. Surprisingly, $k=3$ admits a polylogarithmic-query nonadaptive classical algorithm, disproving the conjecture in this case. These results suggest an unexpected parity-dependent structure: the nonadaptive complexity may be governed by the independence number of the $k$-cycle, leading to the exponent $1-1/\lfloor k/2\rfloor$, rather than the previously conjectured $1-2/k$, which was motivated by a Fourier-growth heuristic. Finally, allowing adaptivity, we prove a lower bound of $Ω(N^{1/4})$ for every $k\ge4$.
  Although formally close to $k$-Forrelation, the cyclic structure leads to rather different classical behavior and requires different techniques. Our lower bounds are based on hidden-shift collision constructions, and our upper bounds follow from randomized sampling together with cycle-specific conditional-moment estimates. Our results provide a systematic understanding of its query advantages over classical computation.

AI.title_translation: 循环相关性的指数级量子-经典查询分离
AI.tldr: 论文研究了循环相关性的量子与经典查询复杂度，证明了其复杂的奇偶依赖界限，并在$k=3$时推翻了先前的经典下界猜想。
AI.motivation: 填补关于循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）经典查询复杂度的空白，并验证先前关于其下界的猜想。
AI.method: 下界基于隐藏位移碰撞构造，上界通过随机采样结合特定循环的条件矩估计得出。
AI.result: 对于偶数$k\ge 4$证明了紧界$\Theta_k(N^{1-2/k})$；对于奇数$k\ge 5$给出了下界与上界；对于$k=3$发现了多项对数查询的非自适应经典算法，推翻了此前的猜想。
AI.conclusion: 我们对循环相关性的量子与经典查询复杂度有了系统的理解，揭示了其与传统$k$-相关性截然不同的经典行为。
AI.translation:
我们研究了循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）的随机经典查询复杂度，这是 $k$-相关性（$k$-Forrelation）的一个循环模拟。给定 $k$ 个布尔函数，目标是估计一个归一化迹问题的值。该问题在 DQC1 模型中可以用 $k$ 次量子查询解决，而其经典查询复杂度此前未知，并曾被猜想具有 $\widetilde{\Omega}(N^{1-2/k})$ 的下界。
我们对循环相关性的非自适应经典查询复杂度建立了近乎完整的刻画。对于偶数 $k \ge 4$，我们证明了常数加法误差下的紧界 $\Theta_k(N^{1-2/k})$。对于奇数 $k \ge 5$，我们得到了 $\Omega_k(N^{1-2/(k-1)})$ 的下界和 $O_k(N^{1-2/k})$ 的上界。令人惊讶的是，$k=3$ 允许一个多项对数查询的非自适应经典算法，从而在该情况下推翻了猜想。这些结果表明了一种意想不到的奇偶性依赖结构：非自适应复杂度可能由 $k$ 元环的独立数决定，从而导致指数为 $1-1/\lfloor k/2 \rfloor$，而不是先前由傅里叶增长启发式所激发的 $1-2/k$。最后，允许适应性时，我们证明了对于每个 $k \ge 4$，都有 $\Omega(N^{1/4})$ 的下界。
尽管形式上接近 $k$-相关性，但循环结构导致了相当不同的经典行为，并需要不同的技术。我们的下界基于隐藏位移碰撞构造，而我们的上界则来自随机采样以及循环特定的条件矩估计。我们的结果提供了对它相对于经典计算的查询优势的系统理解。
AI.summary: 本文研究了循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）的随机经典查询复杂度，证明了其非自适应经典查询复杂度的几乎完整刻画，发现了一种意想不到的奇偶性依赖结构，并在特定情况下推翻了先前的猜想。
AI.keywords: 循环相关性, 量子查询复杂度, 经典查询复杂度, 非自适应算法, 隐藏位移碰撞
AI.comments: 该论文对循环相关性（cyclic Forrelation）的非自适应经典查询复杂度进行了深入研究，给出了近乎完整的刻画，并推翻了先前的某些猜想，展现了量子计算与经典计算之间惊人的奇偶性依赖结构。

title: Extending Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization to Systems of Linear Equations
comments: 13 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code: Python package sqd_linsolve (MIT License) with two notebooks in the ancillary files: reproduce_paper.ipynb reproduces the numerical results of the paper; sqd_linear_systems_selfcontained.ipynb gives a self-contained, step-by-step implementation with explanations and a worked example
summary: Solving systems of linear equations, $Ax=b$, is a ubiquitous task in computational science. The Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm requires phase estimation, controlled rotations, and post-selection, impractical on noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware. We extend sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), developed for quantum chemistry, to linear systems. Following the sample-based Krylov variant, the Hermitian matrix $A$ is decomposed in the Pauli basis, the Trotterized time evolution of $|b\rangle$ is sampled at several times to select computational-basis configurations, and the system is solved classically by a Galerkin projection onto the selected subspace. We prove that the subspace solution is exact when the sampled configurations contain the Krylov support of $b$ and optimal in the energy norm for symmetric positive-definite matrices, so that noise-induced configurations cannot degrade it as long as they do not displace the ideal ones. On IBM Quantum hardware, the sampled distribution of a $4\times4$ example deviates from the exact one by eleven times the shot-noise level, yet the solution is recovered exactly. For a localized problem of dimension $N=1024$, SQD selects 33 configurations, reaches a relative error of $10^{-5}$, and its truncated subspaces coincide with the optimal choice; readout errors enlarge the subspace without degrading the accuracy. The tests also show the limitations: the selected subspace coincides with that of inexpensive classical selection, banded matrices require exponentially many Pauli terms in the binary encoding, and Trotter errors populate spurious configurations unless the circuits are deep. An MIT-licensed Python package and notebooks that reproduce the numerical results are provided.

AI.title_translation: 将基于样本的量子对角化扩展到线性方程组
AI.tldr: 该研究将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法从量子化学领域扩展到求解线性方程组。通过在泡利基下分解矩阵 A，对 |b⟩ 的 Trotter 化时间演化进行采样以选择计算基配置，然后通过 Galerkin 投影在经典计算机上求解。研究证明，当采样配置包含 Krylov 支撑时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵是能量范数最优的。实验结果表明，即使在存在噪声的情况下，该方法也能精确恢复解。该方法在处理大规模问题时表现出良好的精度，并且对噪声具有鲁棒性。然而，该方法也存在一些局限性，例如对于带状矩阵需要指数级的泡利项，以及 Trotter 误差可能导致虚假配置的出现。
AI.motivation: 传统的 Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd 算法在现实的量子硬件上难以实现。因此，需要一种适用于含噪声中规模量子硬件的求解线性方程组的新方法。
AI.method: 将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法扩展到线性方程组。具体步骤包括：1. 将厄米矩阵 A 分解为泡利基。2. 对 |b⟩ 的 Trotter 化时间演化进行采样，以选择计算基配置。3. 在经典计算机上通过 Galerkin 投影到选定的子空间来求解方程组。
AI.result: 在 IBM Quantum 硬件上，一个 4x4 示例的采样分布与精确分布的偏差为 11 倍的散粒噪声水平，但仍能精确恢复解。对于 N=1024 的局部问题，SQD 选择 33 个配置，达到 10^-5 的相对误差，并且其截断子空间与最优选择一致；读出误差会扩大子空间但不会降低精度。
AI.conclusion: 样本型量子对角化（SQD）是一种有前景的求解线性方程组的方法，尤其适用于含噪声的中等规模量子硬件。该方法在精度和噪声鲁棒性方面表现出色，但仍存在一些局限性，例如对带状矩阵和 Trotter 误差的处理。
AI.translation: 求解线性方程组 $Ax=b$ 是计算科学中的一个普遍任务。Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd 算法需要相位估计、受控旋转和后选择，这在含噪声的中等规模量子硬件上是不切实际的。我们将为量子化学开发的基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）扩展到线性系统。遵循基于样本的 Krylov 变体，将厄米矩阵 $A$ 分解在泡利基中，对 $|bangle$ 的 Trotter 化时间演化在多个时间点进行采样，以选择计算基配置，并通过 Galerkin 投影到选定的子空间在经典计算机上求解。我们证明，当采样配置包含 $b$ 的 Krylov 支撑时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵来说，在能量范数上是最优的，因此只要噪声引起的配置不取代理想配置，就不会降低其性能。在 IBM Quantum 硬件上，一个 4x4 示例的采样分布与精确分布的偏差为散粒噪声水平的 11 倍，但仍能精确恢复解。对于维度为 N=1024 的局部问题，SQD 选择 33 个配置，达到 10^-5 的相对误差，并且其截断子空间与最优选择一致；读出误差会扩大子空间而不会降低精度。测试也显示了其局限性：所选子空间与廉价的经典选择的子空间一致，带状矩阵在二进制编码中需要指数级的泡利项，并且除非电路很深，否则 Trotter 误差会产生虚假的配置。我们提供了一个 MIT 许可的 Python 包和笔记本，可重现数值结果。
AI.summary: 本研究将样本型量子对角化（SQD）方法从量子化学领域扩展到求解线性方程组。该方法通过在泡利基下分解矩阵 A，对 |b⟩ 的 Trotter 化时间演化进行采样以选择计算基配置，然后通过 Galerkin 投影在经典计算机上求解。研究证明，当采样配置包含 Krylov 支撑时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵是能量范数最优的。实验结果表明，即使在存在噪声的情况下，该方法也能精确恢复解，并且在处理大规模问题时表现出良好的精度和对噪声的鲁棒性。然而，该方法也存在一些局限性，例如对带状矩阵和 Trotter 误差的处理。
