AI.translation: Chapel编程语言最近增加了对RISC-V架构的支持。本文讨论了Chapel在RISC-V上工作所需的更改以及从移植过程中汲取的经验教训。我们使用Chapel广泛的基准测试套件的一部分，以进一步了解RISC-V架构对未来HPC使用的适用性。我们将SiFive P550和Unmatched开发板以及Sophon SG2042的性能与各种其他最近的HPC CPU平台进行了比较。讨论了在不同架构上出现的各种可移植性和性能异常。虽然RISC-V机器代表了较小的初步产品，而不是HPC级硬件，但这些结果仍然给人以希望，即RISC-V硬件在不久的将来可以成为HPC的可行选择。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了将Chapel编程语言移植到RISC-V架构的过程与经验，并利用基准测试在多种RISC-V及其他HPC平台上进行了性能对比，评估了RISC-V未来在高性能计算领域的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: Chapel, RISC-V, HPC, 架构移植, 性能基准测试
AI.comments: 本文首次探讨了Chapel编程语言在新兴RISC-V架构上的移植工作，并结合HPC基准测试评估了RISC-V硬件在高性能计算领域的应用潜力，对理解RISC-V在HPC中的发展具有重要参考价值。

title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorization creates a tension between aggregation fidelity and local optimization continuity. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch. We propose FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned framework that addresses both mismatches and establishes convergence bounds for homogeneous and heterogeneous ranks. Clients preserve local factors across rounds to eliminate initialization mismatch and align their products with rank-specific global references to reduce client drift. The server aggregates heterogeneous-rank updates in product space to mitigate aggregation mismatch and efficiently reconstructs a rank-constrained global adapter without forming the dense aggregate. By decoupling local and reference ranks, FedPA-LoRA supports client-specific computation and communication budgets. Experiments on natural language understanding and generation tasks show consistent gains under data and resource heterogeneity, including a 6.82 percentage-point improvement in average GLUE accuracy under heterogeneous ranks. The code is available at https://github.com/Juseok-Jeon/FedPA-LoRA.

AI.title_translation: FedPA-LoRA：缓解异构联邦LoRA中聚合与初始化误差的产品对齐框架
AI.tldr: FedPA-LoRA通过产品对齐框架同时解决了联邦LoRA中的聚合不匹配与初始化不匹配问题，在大模型联邦微调中显著提升了异构环境下的性能。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型的联邦微调中，LoRA的因式分解在聚合保真度与本地优化连续性之间造成了张力：按因子聚合会导致聚合不匹配但能保持因子连续性，而乘积空间重构虽减少了不匹配却带来更大的因子级初始化不匹配。现有的方法难以同时解决这两种不匹配。
AI.method: 提出FedPA-LoRA框架，客户端跨轮次保留本地因子以消除初始化Mismatch，并通过将本地产品的秩特定全局参考对齐以减少客户端漂移；服务器在乘积空间中聚合异构秩更新，并在不形成稠密聚合的情况下高效重构受秩约束的全局适配器，同时解耦本地和参考秩。
AI.result: 建立了同构和异构秩的收敛界。在自然语言理解和生成任务上的实验表明，该方法在数据和资源异构性下取得了稳定提升，在异构秩下的平均GLUE准确率提高了6.82个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedPA-LoRA通过乘积对齐框架有效缓解了异构联邦LoRA中的聚合与初始化误差，支持客户端特定的计算和通信预算，并在多项自然语言处理任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 低秩自适应（LoRA）使得大语言模型的联邦高效微调成为可能，但其因式分解在聚合保真度与本地优化连续性之间产生了张力。按因子聚合会引发聚合不匹配，但能更好地保持因子连续性；而乘积空间重构减少了这种不匹配，代价是更大的因子级初始化不匹配。我们提出了FedPA-LoRA，这是一个产品对齐的框架，它解决了这两种不匹配问题，并建立了同构和异构秩的收敛界。客户端在各轮次中保留本地因子以消除初始化不匹配，并将它们的乘积与秩特定的全局参考对齐以减少客户端漂移。服务器在乘积空间中聚合异构秩的更新，以减轻聚合不匹配，并在不形成稠密聚合的情况下高效重构一个受秩约束的全局适配器。通过解耦本地秩和参考秩，FedPA-LoRA支持客户端特定的计算和通信预算。自然语言理解和生成任务的实验表明，该方法在数据和资源异构性下展现出持续的性能增益，包括在异构秩下平均GLUE准确率提升了6.82个百分点。代码已发布于 https://github.com/Juseok-Jeon/FedPA-LoRA。
AI.summary: FedPA-LoRA是一个针对异构联邦LoRA的产品对齐框架，旨在通过在乘积空间聚合异构秩更新、保留本地因子以及解耦本地和参考秩，来同时解决聚合不匹配和初始化不匹配问题，从而在资源和数据异构的场景下实现高效的大语言模型联邦微调。
AI.keywords: Federated Learning, Low-Rank Adaptation, Heterogeneous Ranks, Product-Aligned Framework, Large Language Models
AI.comments: FedPA-LoRA通过在乘积空间进行异构秩更新的聚合，并解耦本地和参考秩，创新性地解决了联邦LoRA中聚合保真度与本地优化连续性之间的张力，在数据和资源异构性下表现出色。

title: Keeping the Franka Emika Panda alive: a ROS 2 stack with a reliable position interface
summary: This paper presents an open-source software stack that restores ROS 2 support for the Franka Emika Panda robot while resolving the long-standing unreliability of its external position control interface. We first analyze the root causes of unstable position control and show that the observed vibrations and protective stops arise from the timing of the external control loop and sampling jitter, rather than from limitations of the robot itself. Building on this analysis, we introduce an asynchronous hardware interface that decouples real-time communication from the ROS 2 control loop, a rate-matching mechanism for slower command sources, and a position-domain reference generation strategy that produces reliable, smooth position commands. Experimental validation shows that the proposed architecture reliably tracks velocity references by reducing motion artifacts introduced by the official implementation, and the stack is validated across motion planning, compliance control, position-controlled manipulation, and haptic teleoperation on two independent Panda platforms. By restoring a modern, reliable, and open ROS 2 ecosystem for the Panda, this work lowers the barrier to developing safe, responsive, and reproducible human-robot collaboration applications that integrate planning, perception, interaction, and shared autonomy. Code and videos are available on our website at https://sites.google.com/unisa.it/fer-ros2.

AI.title_translation: 延续Franka Emika Panda的生命力：具有可靠位置接口的ROS 2软件栈
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套开源ROS 2软件栈，通过异步解耦通信和速率匹配机制，彻底解决了Franka Emika Panda机械臂外部位置控制容易抖动和报错停机的问题。
AI.motivation: 解决Franka Emika Panda机器人在ROS 2环境下外部位置控制接口长期存在的不稳定性、剧烈振动和频繁触发保护性停机的问题，恢复其对现代ROS 2生态的支持。
AI.method: 首先分析位置控制不稳定的根因（外部控制循环时序与采样抖动）；进而设计了一种将实时通信与ROS 2控制循环解耦的异步硬件接口，引入了针对低频指令源的速率匹配机制，并采用了位置域参考生成策略以产生平滑可靠的位置指令。
AI.result: 实验表明，该架构能显著减少官方实现引入的运动伪影并可靠跟踪速度参考；在两台独立的Panda机器人平台上成功验证了运动规划、顺应性控制、位置控制操作及触觉遥操作等功能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作恢复并升级了Franka Emika Panda的现代化ROS 2开源生态，降低了开发安全、高响应且可复现的人机协作应用的门槛。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一套开源软件栈，该软件栈恢复了Franka Emika Panda机器人对ROS 2的支持，同时解决了其外部位置控制接口长期存在的不稳定性问题。我们首先分析了不稳定位置控制的根本原因，并表明观察到的振动和保护性停机源于外部控制循环的时序和采样抖动，而非机器人本身的限制。基于这一分析，我们引入了一种将实时通信与ROS 2控制循环解耦的异步硬件接口、一种适用于较慢指令源的速率匹配机制，以及一种能够生成可靠平滑位置指令的位置域参考生成策略。实验验证表明，所提出的架构通过减少官方实现所引入的运动伪影，能够可靠地跟踪速度参考，并且该软件栈在两台独立的Panda平台上跨运动规划、顺应性控制、位置控制操作和触觉遥操作等任务中得到了验证。通过为Panda恢复现代化、可靠且开放的ROS 2生态系统，这项工作降低了开发集成规划、感知、交互和共享自主性的安全、高响应且可复现的人机协作应用的门槛。代码和视频可在我们的网站获取：https://sites.google.com/unisa.it/fer-ros2。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一套开源的ROS 2软件栈，解决了Franka Emika Panda机器人外部位置控制接口的不稳定性问题。作者证明抖动与停机源于控制循环时序和采样抖动，并通过异步解耦硬件接口、速率匹配机制及平滑参考生成策略克服了该缺陷，成功在两台独立机械臂上验证了其在多种控制与人机协作任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: Franka Emika Panda, ROS 2, 位置控制 (Position Control), 异步硬件接口, 人机协作
AI.comments: 该论文针对学术界广泛使用的Franka Emika Panda机械臂在ROS 2环境下长期存在的外部位置控制不稳定、易产生抖动和保护性停机（reflex stop）这一痛点，给出了深入的时序根因分析与工程上切实可行的异步解耦解决方案。这对于延续该硬件平台在人机协作和触觉遥操作等前沿研究中的生命力具有显著的实用价值与社区贡献。

title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models
summary: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert carrier to transmit secrets through seemingly innocuous text. In both cases, this limited leakage is exploited using a novel adaptive attack that assumes black-box access to the underlying model. In controlled experiments across eight proprietary models, we find that 2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82\% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests. We observe that more capable models leak more: stronger instruction-following amplifies sensitivity to in-context secrets, suggesting leakage is a byproduct of capability as opposed to a patchable bug. We show this leakage enables two practical attacks: (1) a trained classifier that infers semantic predicates about user memories (e.g., health conditions, financial events) from routine natural-language outputs, and (2) an RL-trained adversary that extracts full Social Security Numbers from a production-style agent.

AI.title_translation: 语言模型中的无意上下文泄露
AI.tldr: 大语言模型在处理敏感上下文时，其普通输出会无意中泄露机密信息，且模型越聪明，泄露越严重。
AI.motivation: 随着AI Agent处理越来越多包含日历、财务和健康记录等敏感用户上下文数据，研究仅凭这些机密存在于模型的上下文窗口中是否会给模型的良性输出带来隐藏关联，从而允许进行重建。
AI.method: 提出一种新型自适应黑盒攻击方法，在控制实验中测试了8个专有模型，研究被动上下文泄露以及对抗性提示下的主动秘密传输。
AI.result: 实验表明，在普通、非对抗性请求的输出中，2位数的上下文秘密能以近乎完美的准确率被重建，4位数秘密的精确匹配率达82%；更强的模型泄露更多信息；并成功实现了分类器推断语义谓词和RL训练对抗者提取社保号两个实际攻击。
AI.conclusion: 上下文中的敏感信息会通过大语言模型的良性输出发生无意泄露，且模型能力越强泄露越严重，这可通过自适应攻击被利用来窃取隐私。
AI.translation: 为了让AI代理在简单聊天之外发挥作用，它们必须保存敏感的用户上下文，如日历、凭证、健康记录和财务数据。我们研究了仅仅在模型的上下文窗口中存在这些秘密是否会引入隐藏的关联到模型的良性输出中，从而即使在模型正确拒绝直接提取时也允许重建。我们进一步研究了攻击者是否可以主动设计放大这种效应的提示，利用模型作为隐蔽载体通过看似无害的文本传输秘密。在这两种情况下，这种有限的泄露都是通过一种假设对底层模型具有黑盒访问权限的新型自适应攻击来利用的。在八个专有模型的控制实验中，我们发现2位数的上下文秘密可以以近乎完美的准确率重建，4位数的秘密可以达到82%的精确匹配，所有这些都来自模型为响应普通、非对抗性请求而产生的输出。我们观察到，更有能力的模型泄露更多：更强的指令遵循能力放大了对上下文中秘密的敏感性，这表明泄露是能力的副产品，而不是一个可修补的漏洞。我们展示了这种泄露实现了两次实际攻击：（1）一个训练有素的分类器，从常规的自然语言输出中推断关于用户记忆的语义谓词（例如，健康状况、财务事件），以及（2）一个经RL训练的攻击者，从生产级代理中提取完整的社会安全号码。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大语言模型中的无意上下文泄露问题。研究发现，即使模型拒绝直接提取，上下文中的敏感数据也会隐式关联到模型的良性输出中。作者设计了一种自适应黑盒攻击，在八个专有模型上进行了实验，证明了这种泄露的存在及严重性，且能力越强的模型泄露越多，并展示了其在实际隐私攻击中的危害。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 上下文泄露, 隐私安全, 黑盒攻击, AI Agents
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了大语言模型中一种新型且隐蔽的安全风险：上下文隐私泄露。作者证明了即使模型拒绝直接泄露机密，其输出也会无意中暴露出上下文中的敏感信息。这种现象随模型能力的提升而加剧，表明这是能力提升带来的副作用而非简单的漏洞，对未来AI Agent的隐私设计提出了重大挑战。

title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
comments: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model the terminal retrieval stage with a causal graph grounded in Reichenbach's common cause principle: the keywords shared by the query and a retrieved document form a latent common cause A, and the document's residual keywords form a latent set B linking the document to the ideal output. Since a retrieved document is a collider (A -> d <- B), retrieval itself opens an associational path between the query and B, which licenses a training-free, attention-style re-scoring rule: the cosine similarity between the query embedding and the weighted centroid embedding of B. Unlike causality-enhanced RAG variants that model causal relations inside the knowledge content, our graph models the causal structure of the retrieval process itself. On a real 471-document enterprise knowledge base, the method promotes a relevant guideline from rank 6 to the top 3; on a controlled diagnostic corpus reproducing the keyword-stuffing regime, it improves the mean target rank from 2.88 to 1.25, while a trained cross-encoder reranker barely helps (2.63). Conversely, on three BEIR benchmarks the score underperforms the similarity baseline, delineating the applicability boundary: the method guards the keyword-stuffing regime of growing proprietary knowledge bases and complements neural rerankers; a corpus-level calibration gate selects the correct regime with >= 95% reliability. A fully local testbed demonstrates deployability.
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank

AI.title_translation: 从关联到因果：通过因果关系和注意力机制提高检索增强生成（RAG）的检索精度
AI.tldr: 本文通过将检索过程建模为因果图，并引入一个基于因果关系和注意力机制的重评分规则，解决了RAG中因关键词相似性导致的检索不准确问题，特别是在关键词堆砌的知识库中显著提高了检索精度。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）的标准检索阶段（稠密向量相似性，可选的重排序）经常返回与查询共享关键词但缺乏所需信息的文档，这个问题随着知识库的增长而加剧。作者将其归因于一个概念性差距：相似性仅捕捉关联关系，而真正有用的文档与查询之间存在因果关联。
AI.method: 本文将终端检索阶段建模为一个基于Reichenbach共同原因原则的因果图：查询和检索到的文档共享的关键词构成一个潜在的共同原因A，文档的剩余关键词构成一个将文档与理想输出联系起来的潜在集合B。由于检索到的文档是一个对撞机（A -> d <- B），检索本身在查询和B之间打开了一条关联路径。基于此，提出了一种无需训练的、注意力风格的重评分规则：查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入之间的余弦相似度。与在知识内容内部建模因果关系不同，本文的图模型对检索过程本身的因果结构进行建模。
AI.result: 在包含471个文档的企业知识库中，该方法将一个相关指南从排名第6提升到前3名。在一个复制关键词堆砌机制的受控诊断语料库中，它将平均目标排名从2.88提高到1.25，而经过训练的交叉编码器重排序器几乎没有帮助（2.63）。相反，在三个BEIR基准测试中，该得分低于相似性基线，这划定了其适用性边界：该方法适用于不断增长的专有知识库中的关键词堆砌机制，并补充了神经重排序器。一个语料库级别的校准门可以以>=95%的可靠性选择正确的机制。一个完全本地的测试平台证明了其可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种通过因果关系和注意力机制改进RAG检索精度的方法，尤其适用于解决专有知识库中关键词堆砌导致的检索不准确问题。它通过对检索过程本身进行因果建模，提供了一种与神经重排序器互补的解决方案，并能可靠地识别适用场景。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大型语言模型（LLM）的生成基于检索到的文档，但标准的终端检索阶段——稠密向量相似性，可选地辅以重排序——通常会返回与查询共享关键词但未包含所需信息的文档，这种失败模式随着知识库的增长而加剧。我们将其追溯到一个概念性差距：相似性仅捕捉关联关系，而重要的文档与查询之间是因果关联的。我们用一个基于Reichenbach共同原因原则的因果图来建模终端检索阶段：查询和检索到的文档共享的关键词形成一个潜在的共同原因A，文档的剩余关键词形成一个将文档与理想输出联系起来的潜在集合B。由于检索到的文档是一个对撞机（A -> d <- B），检索本身在查询和B之间打开了一条关联路径，这允许使用一个无需训练的、注意力风格的重评分规则：查询嵌入与B的加权质心嵌入之间的余弦相似度。与在知识内容内部建模因果关系的因果增强RAG变体不同，我们的图模型对检索过程本身的因果结构进行建模。在一个真实的包含471个文档的企业知识库中，该方法将一个相关指南从排名第6提升到前3名；在一个复制关键词堆砌机制的受控诊断语料库中，它将平均目标排名从2.88提高到1.25，而经过训练的交叉编码器重排序器几乎没有帮助（2.63）。相反，在三个BEIR基准测试中，该得分低于相似性基线，这划定了其适用性边界：该方法适用于不断增长的专有知识库中的关键词堆砌机制，并补充了神经重排序器；一个语料库级别的校准门可以以>=95%的可靠性选择正确的机制。一个完全本地的测试平台证明了其可部署性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的RAG检索增强方法，通过将检索过程建模为因果图，旨在解决现有RAG因关键词相似性而非因果关联导致的检索精度问题。该方法基于Reichenbach的共同原因原则，设计了一个无需训练的注意力风格重评分规则，即通过查询嵌入与文档剩余关键词加权质心嵌入的余弦相似度进行评分。实验证明，该方法在企业知识库和关键词堆砌场景下显著提升了检索排名，并能与神经重排序器互补，但其适用范围限于特定知识库类型和问题模式。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 因果关系, 注意力机制, 检索精度, 关键词堆砌
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将因果关系引入RAG的检索过程建模，而非仅仅关注知识内容本身的因果性，从而解决了RAG在处理关键词堆砌和大型知识库时，相似性匹配不足以捕获真正因果关联的问题。该方法无需训练的特点降低了部署成本，且在特定场景下表现优于传统重排序器，具有重要的实际应用价值。其明确划定适用边界并提供校准机制，也增加了方法的鲁棒性和实用性，为RAG的检索精度提升提供了一个新颖且有效的思路。

title: Predicting Dose-Response Success from Primary Screening Data
summary: High-throughput drug screening uses inexpensive primary screens to select compounds for more costly follow-up dose-response experiments, which estimate compound potency (pXC50) by determining the concentration required to produce a specified biological effect. However, many promoted compounds fail to yield a reportable potency, even when activity is subsequently confirmed. We investigated whether inexpensive three-point primary-screening data could predict whether a more costly 11-point dose-response experiment would yield a reportable pXC50. Using a dataset of 32,971 compound-assay pairs with three-point primary-screening and 11-point dose-response measurements, we trained random-forest models to predict successful potency quantification. Our model achieved an AUROC of 0.939 +/- 0.002 and generalized to previously unseen chemical scaffolds and assay-mechanism families. We found that primary-screen response features were more predictive of dose-response quantifiability than molecular structure-based features. Successful potency quantification was also strongly associated with primary-screen response amplitude. Across eight chronological test releases, the model retrospectively retained 90% of reportable potencies while selecting only 55.7% of historically promoted compound-assay pairs for follow-up profiling. These findings suggest that predicting potency quantifiability from primary-screening data could improve the efficiency of compound prioritization and reduce unnecessary dose-response experiments.

AI.title_translation: 从初筛数据预测剂量-反应成功率
AI.tldr: 利用低成本初筛数据和随机森林模型预测剂量-反应实验成功率，可大幅提升药物筛选效率并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 高通量药物筛选中的初筛成本低，但后续的剂量-反应实验成本高昂，且许多被推进的化合物最终无法得出可报告的效力，因此需要探讨是否能利用初筛数据预测后续剂量-反应实验的成功率。
AI.method: 使用包含32,971个化合物-测定对的数据集，训练随机森林模型，通过三点初筛反应特征来预测11点剂量-反应实验是否能成功量化效力。
AI.result: 随机森林模型的AUROC达到0.939，能够泛化到未见过的化学骨架和测定机制家族；初筛反应特征比分子结构特征更能预测效力的可量化性；在保留90%可报告效力的同时，仅需对55.7%的历史推进化合物对进行后续分析。
AI.conclusion: 利用初筛数据预测剂量-反应成功率是切实可行的，能够显著提高药物筛选效率并降低后续实验成本。
AI.translation: 高通量药物筛选利用廉价的初筛来选择化合物进行成本高昂的后续剂量-反应实验，通过测定产生特定生物学效应所需的浓度来估计化合物效力（pXC50）。然而，许多被推荐的化合物未能产生可报告的效力，即使随后证实了其活性。我们研究了廉价的三点初筛数据是否能预测更昂贵的11点剂量-反应实验是否会产生可报告的pXC50。使用包含32,971个化合物-测定对（具有三点初筛和11点剂量-反应测量值）的数据集，我们训练了随机森林模型来预测成功的效力定量。我们的模型实现了0.939 +/- 0.002的AUROC，并且能够推广到以前未见过的化学骨架和测定机制家族。我们发现，初筛反应特征比基于分子结构的特征更能预测剂量-反应的可定量性。成功的效力定量也与初筛反应幅度密切相关。在八个按时间顺序的测试版本中，该模型回顾性地保留了90%的可报告效力，同时仅选择了55.7%的历史推荐化合物-测定对进行后续分析。这些发现表明，从初筛数据预测效力可定量性可以提高化合物优先级排序的效率，并减少不必要的剂量-反应实验。
AI.summary: 该研究开发了一种基于初筛数据使用随机森林模型预测后续剂量-反应实验成功率的方法，实验表明该模型能高效预测效力可量化性，显著减少不必要的后续实验并降低研发成本。
AI.keywords: 高通量药物筛选, 剂量-反应实验, 随机森林模型, 化合物优先级排序, 初筛数据预测
AI.comments: 该论文利用低成本的初筛数据成功预测了剂量-反应实验的成功率，具有极高的药物研发应用价值，不仅降低了成本，还提高了化合物筛选的效率。局限性在于主要基于特定的三点初筛和11点剂量-反应数据集，未来可在更多样化的数据集上验证。

title: Waveguiding in systems of high contrast resonators: Theory and fast computations
summary: In this work, we study guided modes in systems of high-contrast resonators near nonzero interior Neumann frequencies, beyond the subwavelength regime. In the regular exterior regime, where the exterior Dirichlet problem is well-posed at the reference wavenumber, we introduce an infinite-dimensional frequency-dependent capacitance operator obtained by compressing the exterior Helmholtz Dirichlet-to-Neumann map to the traces of the interior resonant Neumann eigenspaces. We prove the norm-resolvent convergence of the continuous problem to this discrete effective operator as the contrast $δ\to0$, and derive first-order asymptotic formulas for compact-defect frequencies and line-defect band functions. We then establish exponential off-diagonal decay of the capacitance coefficients by a Combes--Thomas argument, yielding an exponentially accurate truncation of the discrete operator, and show that its retained coefficients can be computed from local Helmholtz problems. At the physical frequency, this local approximation converges exponentially under a uniform stability assumption for the growing finite-cluster problems. The stability assumption can be removed by introducing a vanishing complex absorption together with a Hermitian symmetrization. In particular, an absorption parameter of order $\sqrtδ$, together with interaction truncation and patch radii of order $|\logδ|$, suffices to preserve the $O(δ^2)$ accuracy of the first-order high-contrast expansion of the defect eigenfrequencies, yielding a fast computational method. Numerical experiments for dipole and quadrupole resonances illustrate the accuracy, exponential locality, and applicability of the discrete model to straight and bent waveguides generated by material or geometric detuning.

AI.title_translation: 高对比度谐振器系统中的波导：理论与快速计算
AI.tldr: 本文研究了高对比度谐振器系统中的导模，通过引入频率相关电容算子构建了一个离散有效算子，证明了其收敛性，推导了渐近公式，并建立了一种指数精确的快速计算方法，适用于缺陷频率和波导分析。
AI.motivation: 研究在高对比度谐振器系统中，在非零内部诺伊曼频率附近，超越亚波长范围的导模，并开发一种针对这些系统的快速计算方法。
AI.method: 引入一个无限维频率相关电容算子，通过将外部亥姆霍兹狄利克雷-诺伊曼映射压缩到内部谐振诺伊曼本征空间的迹来获得。证明了连续问题到该离散有效算子的范数-预解式收敛。推导了紧凑缺陷频率和线缺陷带函数的一阶渐近公式。通过Combes-Thomas论证建立了电容系数的指数非对角衰减。展示了保留系数可以从局部亥姆霍兹问题中计算。通过引入消失的复吸收和厄米对称化来消除稳定性假设。使用$O(\sqrtδ)$量级的吸收参数、相互作用截断和$O(|\logδ|)$量级的补丁半径，以实现快速计算。
AI.result: 证明了连续问题到离散有效算子的范数-预解式收敛。推导了紧凑缺陷频率和线缺陷带函数的一阶渐近公式。建立了电容系数的指数非对角衰减。开发了一种指数精确的离散算子截断方法，其系数可从局部亥姆霍兹问题计算。提出了一种能保持缺陷本征频率$O(δ^2)$精度的一阶高对比度展开的快速计算方法。数值实验验证了该离散模型的准确性、指数局部性以及对直波导和弯曲波导的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为高对比度谐振器系统中的波导分析提供了一个严谨的理论框架和一种快速、准确的计算方法，并通过数值实验证明了其适用性和效率。
AI.translation: 在这项工作中，我们研究了在高对比度谐振器系统中，在非零内部诺伊曼频率附近，超越亚波长范围的导模。在外部正则区域，其中外部狄利克雷问题在参考波数下适定，我们引入了一个无限维的频率相关电容算子，该算子通过将外部亥姆霍兹狄利克雷-诺伊曼映射压缩到内部谐振诺伊曼本征空间的迹而获得。我们证明了当对比度$δ\to0$时，连续问题到该离散有效算子的范数-预解式收敛，并推导了紧凑缺陷频率和线缺陷带函数的一阶渐近公式。然后，我们通过Combes-Thomas论证建立了电容系数的指数非对角衰减，从而实现了离散算子的指数精确截断，并表明其保留系数可以从局部亥姆霍兹问题中计算出来。在物理频率下，这种局部近似在增长的有限簇问题的一致稳定性假设下呈指数收敛。通过引入一个消失的复吸收以及一个厄米对称化可以消除稳定性假设。特别是，一个$O(\sqrtδ)$量级的吸收参数，以及相互作用截断和$O(|\logδ|)$量级的补丁半径，足以保持缺陷本征频率的一阶高对比度展开的$O(δ^2)$精度，从而产生一种快速计算方法。偶极子和四极子共振的数值实验说明了该离散模型的准确性、指数局部性以及对由材料或几何失谐产生的直波导和弯曲波导的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种分析高对比度谐振器系统中导模的理论框架和快速计算方法。它引入了一个频率相关电容算子，证明了其向离散有效算子的收敛性，并推导了渐近公式。该方法通过系数衰减和局部亥姆霍兹问题计算实现了指数精度和局部性，最终形成了一种能保持缺陷本征频率高精度的快速方法，并通过对波导的数值实验进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 高对比度谐振器, 波导, 电容算子, 渐近公式, 快速计算
AI.comments: 本文通过提供一个严谨的数学框架和高效的计算方法，为波导领域的难题做出了重要贡献。频率相关电容算子的使用，结合收敛性和指数衰减的证明，展示了深刻的理论理解。由此产生的快速计算方法，特别是其处理高对比度系统和保持精度的能力，使其在设计和分析谐振结构方面具有高度实用性。

title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions
summary: Agent guardrails are checks that approve or refuse each action before an LLM executes it. Sometimes they refuse requests that are genuinely safe. This over-safety blocks deployment when a guardrail refuses an authorized task. Evaluating over-safety is hard: at the boundary an authorized action resembles an unauthorized one, and the safe-versus-unsafe label is a choice of authorization policy, not fixed by the action alone. We argue it therefore requires a benchmark that does not yet exist, one that maps the decision boundary of an ideal guardrail. Harvesting such a benchmark from real data is impractical: boundary cases are hard to collect, their labels hard to verify. The gap is real, so we construct Cautious Bench, the first benchmark to make over-safety the construct for agent guardrails; it codesigns each sample and its label with a stated authorization policy. A build-time gate re-derives every example to certify it, so each label is a mechanical consequence of the policy rather than an annotator's per-sample verdict, a reference against which researchers can measure real guardrails. The benchmark renders 756 Decidable benign/twin pairs, each under three object-name types (2,268 measured pairs), and 40 Undecidable pairs reported separately. Measuring six guardrails from five designs, we find a name-superstition effect: each over-refuses an authorized action more often under a scary-looking object name than a benign one. Since only the object name varies in the aforementioned contrast experiments, the deviation is the name's doing: the guardrails read the surface label, not the authorization context.

AI.title_translation: 狼来了的守卫：可怕的词语如何使代理护栏拒绝合法行为
AI.tldr: 代理护栏有时会因“可怕词语”而错误地拒绝合法动作，研究者构建了Cautious Bench基准来评估这种过度安全，并发现护栏会受表面标签影响而非授权上下文。
AI.motivation: 代理护栏有时会错误地拒绝真正安全的请求，这种过度安全性阻碍了部署。评估这种“过度安全”很困难，因为授权动作与未授权动作在边界上相似，且安全与否取决于授权策略。现有基准无法映射理想护栏的决策边界。
AI.method: 构建了第一个专门用于评估代理护栏过度安全性的基准“Cautious Bench”。该基准通过预先设定的授权策略共同设计每个样本及其标签，并通过构建时门控机制重新推导每个示例以进行认证，确保标签是策略的机械结果。
AI.result: Cautious Bench生成了756个可判定的良性/双生对（在三种对象名称类型下共2,268个测量对）以及40个单独报告的不可判定对。对六个来自五种设计的护栏进行测量，发现存在“名称迷信效应”：在“可怕”的对象名称下，护栏拒绝授权动作的频率远高于“良性”名称。
AI.conclusion: 代理护栏会读取表面标签（即对象名称），而不是授权上下文，导致它们在面对“可怕”词语时过度拒绝合法动作。
AI.translation: 代理护栏是在大型语言模型执行每个动作之前进行批准或拒绝的检查。有时它们会拒绝真正安全的请求。当护栏拒绝授权任务时，这种过度安全会阻碍部署。评估过度安全很困难：在边界上，授权动作与未授权动作相似，并且安全与否的标签是授权策略的选择，而非仅由动作本身决定。因此，我们认为这需要一个尚不存在的基准，一个能够映射理想护栏决策边界的基准。从真实数据中获取这样的基准是不切实际的：边界情况难以收集，其标签难以验证。这个空白是真实存在的，因此我们构建了“Cautious Bench”，这是第一个将过度安全性作为代理护栏构建的基准；它与既定的授权策略共同设计每个样本及其标签。一个构建时门控机制重新推导每个示例以进行认证，因此每个标签都是策略的机械结果，而不是注释者的逐样本判断，这是一个研究人员可以衡量真实护栏的参考。该基准生成了756个可判定的良性/双生对，每对在三种对象名称类型下（2,268个测量对），以及40个单独报告的不可判定对。在测量了五种设计的六个护栏后，我们发现了一种“名称迷信效应”：在“可怕”的对象名称下，每个护栏拒绝授权动作的频率远高于“良性”名称。由于在上述对比实验中只有对象名称发生变化，这种偏差是名称造成的：护栏读取的是表面标签，而不是授权上下文。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了代理护栏在LLM执行动作前过度拒绝合法请求的问题，这种“过度安全”阻碍了部署。为解决现有评估基准的不足，作者构建了“Cautious Bench”，这是一个专门评估代理护栏过度安全性的基准。该基准通过与授权策略共同设计样本和标签，并进行机械认证来确保标签的准确性。实验结果显示，护栏存在“名称迷信效应”，即在包含“可怕”词语的对象名称下，护栏更容易拒绝合法动作，这表明护栏更多地依赖表面标签而非授权上下文进行判断。
AI.keywords: 代理护栏, 过度安全, Cautious Bench, 名称迷信效应, 授权策略
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“Cautious Bench”基准，创新性地解决了评估代理护栏过度安全性的难题，特别是其机械化标签认证方法提高了评估的可靠性。其发现的“名称迷信效应”揭示了当前护栏设计中的一个重要局限性，即它们容易受表面词语影响而忽视实际授权上下文，这对未来LLM代理护栏的鲁棒性设计具有重要指导意义。

title: Do User-Authored Permission Policies Improve Protection Against AI Agent Overreach?
comments: 15 pages, 5 figures, conditionally accepted at the 2027 ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI 2027)
summary:
AI agents are poised to become a primary interface to digital products, acting across email, files, payments, and personal data. People without professional software backgrounds need understandable, reusable ways to control actions across services. We examine a mechanism in which a language model maps actions to plain-language consequence categories with user-authored "allow", "ask", or "never" rules. We ask what is gained and lost when decisions are made in advance as reusable rules rather than separately for each action.
  We analyzed 113 participants without professional software backgrounds across three conditions: per-action human-in-the-loop approval (HITL), automated per-action model review (AUTO), or user-authored consequence policy (POLICY). Participants judged 2 examples in each of 4 consequence categories; POLICY participants then set one rule per category. All supervised an 18-action simulated day, including 7 overreach actions. POLICY blocked less overreach than HITL (-20.1 percentage points, 95% CI [-32.1, -8.1]) and AUTO (-14.5 points, 95% CI [-25.8, -3.2]). POLICY lowered runtime prompts from 18.0 to 10.9, but total intervention time was not reliably lower when rule setup was included.
  Exploratory analysis showed that participants chose "ask" for 114 of 140 POLICY rules, returning most overreach actions to runtime. Of the 148 overreach actions executed in POLICY, 133 followed human approval and 15 ran automatically under "allow" rules. Across all 7 overreach actions, POLICY had the highest approval rate. Counterintuitively, user-authored rules did not by themselves provide stronger protection: many actions outside users' original requests went through after users approved them. These results reveal a gap between preference and commitment: repeatedly choosing "ask" preserves case-by-case choice but prevents a standing policy from settling decisions in advance.
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, conditionally accepted at the 2027 ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI 2027)

AI.title_translation: 用户编写的权限策略能提高防范AI代理越权的能力吗？
AI.tldr: 研究发现，普通用户编写的权限策略由于倾向于选择“询问”而非“禁止”，并未能比传统的每动作审查更有效地防止AI代理越权。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理深入数字生活的各个方面，缺乏专业软件背景的普通用户需要一种可理解、可重用的方式来跨服务控制AI代理的动作，以防止AI代理越权。
AI.method: 招募了113名无专业软件背景的参与者，对比了三种条件：每动作人工介入（HITL）、自动每动作模型审查（AUTO）以及用户编写的后果策略（POLICY）。参与者评估了模拟日常中的18个动作（含7个越权动作），分析了策略对越权的拦截效果及干预时间。
AI.result: 与HITL和AUTO相比，POLICY拦截的越权动作更少（分别少20.1和14.5个百分点）。虽然POLICY减少了运行时的提示次数，但如果算上规则设置时间，总干预时间并没有明显降低。这主要是因为用户在编写策略时大量选择‘ask’，导致大多数越权动作最终仍由人工在运行时批准。
AI.conclusion: 用户编写的权限策略本身并不能更有效地防止AI代理越权，因为用户倾向于重复选择‘ask’，从而将决策退回给运行时。要实现有效的防护，需要在系统设计中桥接用户的偏好与承诺。
AI.translation:
AI代理有望成为数字产品的主要接口，跨越电子邮件、文件、支付和个人数据采取行动。没有专业软件背景的人需要通俗易懂、可重用的方法来控制跨服务的行动。我们研究了一种机制，其中语言模型通过用户编写的“允许”、“询问”或“never”规则将行动映射到通俗语言的后果类别中。我们探讨了当决策作为可重用的规则提前做出，而不是针对每个行动单独做出时，会得到什么，又会失去什么。
我们分析了113名没有专业软件背景的参与者，他们被分为三种条件：每动作人工介入审批（HITL）、自动每动作模型审查（AUTO）或用户编写的后果策略（POLICY）。参与者在4个后果类别的每一个中判断2个示例；然后POLICY参与者为每个类别设置一条规则。所有人都监督了一个包含18个行动（包括7个越权行动）的模拟日常。POLICY拦截的越权行为比HITL（-20.1个百分点，95% CI [-32.1, -8.1]）和AUTO（-14.5个百分点，95% CI [-25.8, -3.2]）都要少。POLICY将运行时的提示从18.0次降至10.9次，但如果包括规则设置时间在内，总的干预时间并没有可靠地减少。
探索性分析显示，在140条POLICY规则中，参与者为114条选择了“询问”，将大多数越权行动退回到了运行时。在POLICY中执行的148个越权行动中，133个遵循了人类批准，15个在“允许”规则下自动运行。在所有7个越权行动中，POLICY的批准率最高。与直觉相反，用户编写的规则本身并没有提供更强的保护：在用户批准后，许多超出用户最初请求的行动得以放行。这些结果揭示了偏好与承诺之间的差距：重复选择“询问”保留了逐案选择的权利，但阻碍了长期政策提前敲定决策。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了普通用户编写的权限策略（POLICY）对防止AI代理越权的保护效果。通过对113名参与者的实验发现，由于用户在策略中倾向于设置“询问（ask）”而非绝对的“允许”或“禁止”，导致POLICY在阻止越权行为方面不如每动作人工介入或自动审查机制有效。这揭示了用户偏好与实际承诺之间的差距。
AI.keywords: AI agents, Permission policies, Human-in-the-loop, Overreach protection, End-user security
AI.comments: 该研究探讨了普通用户编写权限策略来控制AI代理越权的有效性。创新之处在于对“策略（POLICY）”与“HITL/AUTO”机制进行了实证对比，揭示了用户偏好与实际承诺之间的差距（倾向于选择‘ask’导致策略失效），为未来AI代理的安全交互设计提供了重要启示。

title: The Depth Flow of Token Representations Is Nonlinear and Does Not Descend Its Own Density
comments: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps), Proceedings Track, to appear in PMLR. 9 pages plus appendix. Code and results: https://github.com/hotherio/paper-neurreps-depth-flow
summary: A token's representation is carried through the network layer by layer. The whole vocabulary carried together forms a flow. We fit this flow's equation of motion as a discrete Langevin model over corpus-mean trajectories of Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, and score the predicted steps on held-out tokens. Linear maps are often used as cheap surrogates for a layer. The flow they summarize is not linear: a quadratic drift beats the linear map at every transition of both models, and the Kramers-Moyal estimator agrees wherever its neighborhoods stay local. At full width, the step of a mean trajectory is nearly affine, 3% non-affine, while the step of an individual state is not, 17%. We then characterize the flow further. First, we show that it does not descend its own log-density, whatever the diffusion matrix. The drift instead descends a potential that is not the density. Second, the rotational component is not negligible, 4 to 45% of the explainable drift, and it is the antisymmetric part of the linear map. Finally, a token keeps its angular rank and its local-density rank across all thirteen layers, on two corpora and both models.
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps), Proceedings Track, to appear in PMLR. 9 pages plus appendix. Code and results: https://github.com/hotherio/paper-neurreps-depth-flow

AI.title_translation: 词元表示的深度流动是非线性的且不沿其自身密度下降
AI.tldr: 通过朗之万模型分析发现，神经网络中词元表示的层间流动是显著非线性的，不遵循自身密度的下降，且包含明显的旋转分量。
AI.motivation: 为了解开词元表示在神经网络层与层之间流动的动力学本质，检验线性映射作为层代理的合理性，并探索其是否遵循密度下降等物理隐喻。
AI.method: 在Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M模型的语料库平均轨迹上，使用离散朗之万模型拟合流动运动方程，并通过Kramers-Moyal估计器评估预测步骤。
AI.result: 二次漂移优于线性映射；全宽度下平均轨迹的步骤接近仿射（3%非线性），而个体状态的步骤非仿射性更强（17%）；流动并不沿自身对数密度的方向下降，而是沿一个非密度势下降；旋转分量占可解释漂移的4%到45%；词元在所有十三层中保持其角排位和局部密度排位。
AI.conclusion: 词元表示在网络层间的流动表现出复杂的非线性、非梯度下降以及保持特定排名的特性，这挑战了将层间变换视为简单线性或纯梯度流的传统假设。
AI.translation: 一个词元的表示在网络中一层一层地传递。整个词汇表共同承载的形式构成了流动。我们在Pythia-160M和Pythia-410M的语料库平均轨迹上，将这种流动的运动方程拟合为离散朗之万模型，并在留存的词元上对预测步骤进行评分。线性映射经常被用作层的廉价替代品。它们所总结的流动并不是线性的：在两个模型的每一个转换中，二次漂移都战胜了线性映射，并且只要Kramers-Moyal估计器的邻域保持局部性，它就与之相符。在全宽度下，平均轨迹的步骤几乎是仿射的（3%非仿射），而个体状态的步骤则不是（17%）。接着，我们进一步表征了这种流动。首先，我们证明了无论扩散矩阵如何，它都不会沿自身的对数密度下降。相反，漂移下降的是一个并非密度的势。其次，旋转分量不可忽略，占可解释漂移的4%到45%，并且它是线性映射的反对称部分。最后，在一个词元跨越两个语料库和两个模型的全部十三层时，它保持了其角排位和局部密度排位。
AI.summary: 该论文通过将语言模型中词元表示的层深流动建模为离散朗之万过程，发现其流动本质上是高度非线性的，不遵循自身的对数密度下降，具有显著的旋转分量，且词元的角排位和局部密度排位在各层间保持稳定。
AI.keywords: 表征流动, 朗之万模型, 非线性动力学, 语言模型, 词元表示
AI.comments: 该论文通过离散朗之万模型对语言模型中词元表示的层深流动进行了深入的统计物理分析，创新性地证明了其非线性特征、非密度下降特性以及显著的旋转分量，为理解深度神经网络内部表征动力学提供了新的视角。

title: On the Degree of Safety: Beyond Safe or Unsafe with Control Barrier Functions
summary: A valid control barrier function (CBF) certifies if its represented safe set can be rendered forward invariant, and the sign of its value indicates whether a state is safe or not, but it does not quantify a degree of safety beyond the binary indication. In this paper, we show that among valid CBFs representing the same safe set, interior values and gradients can be changed arbitrarily, so neither quantity determines a degree of safety that is independent of how the set is represented. We also show that whether a candidate CBF-based inequality constraint is feasible does not by itself quantify a degree of safety. In particular, infeasibility can occur either because the safe set is not controlled invariant or because the candidate CBF representation fails. This motivates our distinction between intrinsic and representational infeasibility. Finally, we introduce the invariance authority demand (IAD), a representation-independent degree of safety that quantifies the control authority required for maintaining safety and can be used to guide actuator redesign or safe set repair.

AI.title_translation: 论安全度：借助控制屏障函数超越安全与非安全的二元划分
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了CBF函数值不能客观测定安全程度，并提出了与函数表示无关的“不变性控制权需求”（IAD）作为新的安全度量指标。
AI.motivation: 现有的有效控制屏障函数（CBF）仅能给出安全与否的二元判定，无法量化安全程度；且针对同一安全集，不同CBF表示的内部值、梯度和约束可行性差异极大，不能作为客观的安全度量标准。
AI.method: 提出了“内在不可行性”与“表示不可行性”的区分概念；引入了“不变性控制权需求”（Invariance Authority Demand, IAD），将其作为一种与具体表示无关的安全度量化指标，用于衡量系统维持安全所需的控制权限。
AI.result: 证明了相同安全集的不同有效CBF内部值和梯度可被任意改变，表明二者无法独立反映安全程度；阐明了CBF不等式约束不可行性可能源自集合本身或CBF表示失败；成功构建了独立于表示的安全度指标IAD。
AI.conclusion: 传统的CBF数值及其约束可行性无法独立表征系统的安全程度；而提出的IAD指标克服了表示形式的依赖性，能够有效量化维持安全所需的控制能力并指导系统或安全集的改进。
AI.translation: 有效的控制屏障函数（CBF）能够证明其代表的安全集是否可以实现前向不变性，其函数值的符号可以指示状态是否安全，但除了这种二元指示之外，它并不能量化安全程度。在本文中，我们证明了在代表同一安全集的有效CBF中，内部值和梯度可以被任意改变，因此这两个量都无法确定一种独立于该集合表示方式的安全度。我们还表明，候选的基于CBF的不等式约束是否可行，其本身并不能量化安全度。特别是，不可行性的出现既可能是因为安全集不具备受控不变性，也可能是因为候选CBF的表示失效。这促使我们对内在不可行性与表示不可行性进行了区分。最后，我们引入了不变性控制权需求（IAD），这是一种与表示形式无关的安全度指标，用于量化维持安全所需的控制权限，并可用于指导执行器的重新设计或安全集的修复。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用控制屏障函数（CBF）衡量安全度的问题。作者证明了CBF函数值、梯度及其约束可行性均无法独立于表示形式来客观测定安全程度，并据此区分了内在不可行性与表示不可行性。在此基础上，提出了一种不依赖具体表示的度量指标——不变性控制权需求（IAD），用以量化维持安全所需的控制权限，为执行器改进与安全集修复提供指导。
AI.keywords: 控制屏障函数, 安全度, 不变性控制权需求, 受控不变性, 安全集修复
AI.comments: 该论文针对控制屏障函数（CBF）理论中普遍存在的一个误区做出了重要的基础性澄清：即从业者常误将CBF函数值的大小或梯度视为安全裕度，而本文严格指明这些数值取决于具体表示形式，并不具备客观度量意义。提出的不变性控制权需求（IAD）提供了一个独立于函数表示的客观安全度指标，对执行器重新设计和安全集修复具有明确的工程指导价值。其局限在于摘要未给出具体的计算复杂度与实施成本。

title: SV-WAM: An Efficient Surround-View World-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World models (WMs) have demonstrated strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by learning predictive representations of future scene dynamics. However, generating future videos during inference introduces substantial computational overhead, leading many recent driving WMs to adopt a single front camera as input for efficient deployment. This design restricts spatial coverage in safety-critical maneuvers such as lane changes, merges, and turns. To address this limitation, we propose SV-WAM, a surround-view world-action model (WAM) that preserves full six-camera observations while maintaining efficient inference. SV-WAM leverages future-video prediction as dense training supervision for action learning within a shared generative model, rather than as an inference-time output. At the core of this design is an action-centered causal mask that prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens during joint action-video denoising. Consequently, the video branch can be discarded at deployment, enabling efficient action-only planning. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable drivable-area compliance regularizer that penalizes vehicle-footprint corners approaching or crossing drivable boundaries, improving planning safety and boundary awareness. Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIMv2 benchmark and the open-loop nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that SV-WAM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance with low inference latency and competitive zero-shot transfer capability.

AI.title_translation: SV-WAM：一种高效的环视世界-动作模型，用于端到端自动驾驶
AI.tldr: SV-WAM是一种高效的环视世界模型，它使用未来视频预测作为训练监督来学习动作，并在部署时丢弃视频分支以实现高效的仅动作规划。它还引入了一个可微分的可驾驶区域合规正则化器来提高规划安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界模型因推理时生成未来视频而产生高计算开销，通常只使用前置摄像头以提高效率，但这限制了在变道、并道和转弯等关键场景下的空间覆盖范围。
AI.method: SV-WAM 提出了一种环视世界-动作模型（WAM），它保留了六个摄像头的完整观测，同时保持了高效的推理。它利用未来视频预测作为共享生成模型中动作学习的密集训练监督，而不是在推理时输出。核心是一个以动作为中心的因果掩码，它在联合动作-视频去噪过程中阻止动作标记关注未来视频标记，从而允许在部署时丢弃视频分支。此外，还引入了一个可微分的可驾驶区域合规正则化器，以提高规划安全性和边界意识。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIMv2 和 nuScenes 基准测试上，SV-WAM 取得了最先进的规划性能，同时具有低推理延迟和具有竞争力的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SV-WAM 是一种高效的环视世界-动作模型，通过利用未来视频预测作为训练监督并在推理时丢弃视频分支，实现了高效的仅动作规划，并在自动驾驶任务中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 世界模型（WM）通过学习未来场景动态的预测性表示，在端到端自动驾驶方面展现了巨大潜力。然而，在推理过程中生成未来视频会带来巨大的计算开销，导致许多近期的驾驶 WM 采用单个前置摄像头作为输入以实现高效部署。这种设计限制了在诸如变道、并道和转弯等安全关键操作中的空间覆盖范围。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了 SV-WAM，一种环视世界-动作模型（WAM），它在保持高效推理的同时保留了完整的六个摄像头观测。SV-WAM 利用未来视频预测作为动作学习在共享生成模型中的密集训练监督，而不是作为推理时的输出。这种设计的核心是一个以动作为中心的因果掩码，它在联合动作-视频去噪过程中阻止动作标记关注未来视频标记。因此，在部署时可以丢弃视频分支，从而实现高效的仅动作规划。此外，我们引入了一个可微分的可驾驶区域合规正则化器，它会惩罚接近或越过可驾驶边界的车辆轮廓角，从而提高规划的安全性和边界意识。在闭环 NAVSIMv2 基准测试和开环 nuScenes 基准测试上的大量实验表明，SV-WAM 具有低推理延迟和具有竞争力的零样本迁移能力，取得了最先进的规划性能。
AI.summary: SV-WAM 是一种创新的环视世界-动作模型，旨在解决现有自动驾驶世界模型在计算效率和空间覆盖范围方面的不足。该模型利用六个摄像头的完整观测，并将未来视频预测作为训练过程中的密集监督信号，而非推理时的输出。通过引入以动作为中心的因果掩码，SV-WAM 能够在部署时丢弃视频分支，实现高效的仅动作规划。此外，模型还包含一个可微分的可驾驶区域合规正则化器，以提升规划的安全性和对边界的感知能力。实验结果表明，SV-WAM 在 NAVSIMv2 和 nuScenes 基准测试中均取得了最先进的规划性能，同时保持了低推理延迟和良好的零样本迁移能力。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 自动驾驶, 环视, 动作规划, 推理效率
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决自动驾驶世界模型中的计算效率和空间覆盖范围问题。通过将未来视频预测作为训练监督而非推理输出，并利用因果掩码实现高效的仅动作规划，SV-WAM 在保持完整环视信息的同时显著提高了效率。可微分的可驾驶区域合规正则化器的引入进一步增强了规划的安全性。该模型在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，展示了其在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Simulation-free Unbalanced Dynamic Optimal Transport with General Growth Penalty
summary: Inferring cellular dynamics from unpaired single-cell snapshots requires modeling both state transitions and population growth or death. Unbalanced dynamic optimal transport (UDOT) addresses this by penalizing growth along transport paths, making the choice of growth penalty a key way to encode biological priors on proliferation and apoptosis. However, existing UDOT solvers either rely on computationally expensive NeuralODE simulations or depend on analytical solutions of conditional paths, restricting their efficiency solely to quadratic penalties, i.e. Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geodesics. To enable an efficient UDOT solver for general growth penalties, we first show that concave growth penalties lead to degenerate solutions where growth and transport are separated. We then introduce \textbf{S}imulation-free \textbf{U}nbalanced \textbf{D}ynamic \textbf{O}ptimal transport (SUDO), a simulation-free framework for UDOT with general non-quadratic convex growth penalties. SUDO learns the conditional paths and transport costs, solves the induced semi-coupling problem, and subsequently leverages unbalanced flow matching to achieve a simulation-free solution. On WFR benchmarks, SUDO matches the accuracy of efficient, analytical solution-driven algorithms while outperforming simulation-based methods in computational speed. Beyond WFR, SUDO supports asymmetric penalties that encode proliferation-dominant priors and produce more plausible trajectories and growth estimates on synthetic and single-cell datasets.

AI.title_translation: 具有一般增长惩罚的免模拟非平衡动态最优传输
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SUDO的免模拟框架，用于解决具有一般非二次凸增长惩罚的非平衡动态最优传输问题，显著提升了单细胞动力学推断的效率和生物学合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有的非平衡动态最优传输（UDOT）求解器要么依赖于计算代价高昂的NeuralODE模拟，要么受限于二次惩罚（如WFR测地线）的解析解，因此需要开发一个能够支持一般增长惩罚的高效UDOT求解器。
AI.method: 首先证明凹增长惩罚会导致退化解，随后提出SUDO框架，通过学习条件路径和传输成本、求解半耦合问题，并利用非平衡流匹配来实现免模拟求解。
AI.result: 在WFR基准测试中，SUDO在保持与解析解驱动算法相当准确度的同时，计算速度超越了基于模拟的方法；此外，它还支持非对称惩罚，在合成数据集和单细胞数据集上生成了更合理的轨迹和增长估计。
AI.conclusion: SUDO通过结合条件路径学习、半耦合问题求解和非平衡流匹配，实现了针对一般凸增长惩罚的高效且免模拟的非平衡动态最优运输求解，拓展了该技术在生物学模拟中的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 从未配对的单细胞快照中推断细胞动力学需要对状态转变以及种群生长或死亡进行建模。非平衡动态最优传输（UDOT）通过惩罚传输路径上的增长来解决这一问题，这使得增长惩罚的选择成为编码增殖和细胞凋亡生物学先验的关键方式。然而，现有的UDOT求解器要么依赖于计算成本高昂的NeuralODE模拟，要么依赖于条件路径的解析解，将其效率严格限制在二次惩罚（即Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao测地线）上。为了实现适用于一般增长惩罚的高效UDOT求解器，我们首先证明了凹增长惩罚会导致生长和传输分离的退化解。随后，我们引入了免模拟非平衡动态最优传输（SUDO），这是一个针对具有一般非二次凸增长惩罚的UDOT的免模拟框架。SUDO学习条件路径和传输成本，求解诱导的半耦合问题，并随后利用非平衡流匹配来实现免模拟解。在WFR基准测试中，SUDO在计算速度上超越了基于模拟的方法，同时匹配了高效的解析解驱动算法的准确度。除了WFR之外，SUDO还支持编码增殖为主的先验的不对称惩罚，并在合成数据集和单细胞数据集上产生了更合理的轨迹和生长估计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SUDO（Simulation-free Unbalanced Dynamic Optimal Transport），这是一个用于求解具有一般非二次凸增长惩罚的非平衡动态最优传输问题的免模拟框架。通过结合条件路径学习、半耦合求解和非平衡流匹配，SUDO克服了现有方法计算代价高或受限于特定惩罚的缺点，在单细胞动力学推断中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 非平衡动态最优传输, 单细胞动力学, 增长惩罚, 流匹配, 免模拟算法
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了SUDO框架，突破了传统非平衡动态最优传输对二次惩罚的限制，能够高效处理一般的非二次凸增长惩罚，并在单细胞动力学推断中展现出优越的性能和生物学合理性。

title: TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech
comments: 14 pages, 7 tables. Code, data and models: https://github.com/santhosh-005/tamil-eot
summary: A voice agent must decide, at each pause, whether the speaker has finished or is still thinking. Without a model of the language, systems fall back to a fixed silence timeout: too short, and the agent interrupts; too long, and every turn pays the full wait. We release TamilEOT, to our knowledge the first open dataset and detector for semantic end-of-turn detection in a South Indian language: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, two audio-only detectors built on Smart Turn v3's architecture, and a turn-level companion set of 4,774 whole turns with their pause structure. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. Our rule-derived negative-class labels scored 44.4% against a blind human pass, below chance, because the rule answered a different question than the model is asked; an audio-LLM labeller at 97.5% agreement replaced them for US$5.69. Of six training levers, only encoder capacity moved the result: three identical runs spanned 0.87 accuracy points, the floor below which nothing else here is a finding. Replaying labelled boundaries through the production VAD and streaming adapter costs a further 2.60 points, and 7.8% of boundaries never reach the model at all. Data, weights, code and every negative result are public.
comment: 14 pages, 7 tables. Code, data and models: https://github.com/santhosh-005/tamil-eot

title: HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. To characterize why such hybridization helps, when to trigger the handover, and how to realize it in practice, we first develop a unified error-scaling theoretical framework and prove that, under explicit error-scaling assumptions, i) the hybrid structure achieves strictly lower expected regret than either backbone alone, and ii) there exists a unique optimal trigger step that minimizes the hybrid regret. We then design a lightweight adaptive trigger that combines policy entropy and RL-DM disagreement to detect trajectory-level signals of the regime shift as a practical proxy, since the optimal trigger step is defined at the expected-regret level and is not directly computable on individual trajectories. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HyCO achieves consistent improvements over both backbones and support the empirical effectiveness of adaptive triggering. Our code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/wmd3i/HyCO.

title: SIRF: A Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model for Industrial Content Risk Control
comments: 14 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the Industry Track of EMNLP 2026
summary: For industrial content risk control, the real deployment constraint is not average accuracy but how much risk can be auto-handled under high precision and second-level latency. We present SIRF (Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model), which internalizes a platform's complex policies, synthesized without additional human annotation via EntiGraph, MAGA rewriting and account-level chain-of-thought (CoT), into the weights via continued pretraining (CPT), so rules are applied at high precision under an ultra-low-latency, verdict-only deployment. A controlled same-source comparison (Qwen3-8B-SFT vs. SIRF-8B-SFT, identical policy injection and verdict-only output form, differing only in policy-grounded CPT) attributes the gain to internalization: SIRF-8B-SFT reaches 71.3% Black Recall@P95, +15.1pp over the baseline, using only ~70M CPT tokens without harming general ability, and among included, logprob-available models under this interface it matches or exceeds far larger systems. SIRF is deployed as a tree-model adjudication layer (20% more mis-penalized samples recovered) and transfers to a freezing scenario at low cost (~70% relative mis-penalization reduction).
comment: 14 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the Industry Track of EMNLP 2026

title: A Unified Per-Token Gating Family for On-Policy Distillation: FKL/RKL Mixing with Multi-Channel and Bias Coefficients
comments: Accepted at the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026 Findings)
summary: Per-token gating of forward/reverse KL losses has become a standard technique for on-policy knowledge distillation (OPD), but existing methods such as EOPD (Jin et al., 2026) and ToDi (Jung et al., 2025) each fix a single gating signal and a single gating direction, and the two have never been compared directly. We introduce a four-coefficient parameterization lambda_t = sigma(a * h_t + b * u(x) + c + d * gap_t) in which direction-aligned proxies of EOPD and ToDi appear as one-dimensional (1D) restrictions, and which adds multi-channel composition and an explicit bias as further degrees of freedom. On TweetEval (Barbieri et al., 2020) emotion and hate, with a Qwen3-32B teacher and a Qwen3-4B student, configurations in the full family reach higher accuracy than the matched-magnitude single-channel (entropy-only / gap-only) 1D restrictions in 33 of 36 comparable cells, and a 26-cell mean-match isolation experiment places dynamic gating ahead of effective-KL-matched static baselines in 19 of 26 cells. Because cells share training data, models, and parameter substructure, we report both counts as exploratory aggregate directional evidence rather than as independent hypothesis tests. Targeted three-seed paired replications of the nine headline comparisons singled out by that sweep -- including a third task, offensive -- are directionally consistent, but individually smaller than the single-seed estimates and not significant at n=3. We therefore present the parameterization primarily as a shared coordinate system for comparing per-token gating designs in short-output classification OPD.
comment: Accepted at the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026 Findings)

title: Unified Agentic Video Editing Across Levels of Complexity and Creativity
summary: Editing is a core component of video production, requiring creative planning and decisions under multiple constraints. Here, we report methods for agentic tooling for automated video editing across three tasks varying in editorial goal, complexity and creativity, namely scene previews, video summaries and cinematic trailers. We evaluate the outputs and discuss implications for automation and agency.

title: Toward Optimal Switching Regret for Multi-Armed Bandits with Oblivious Adversary
summary: We study switching regret in adversarial multi-armed bandits, where the learner competes with an arm sequence that changes at most $S$ times. When $S$ is known, an optimal expected regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ is obtainable [Auer et al., 2002]. However, when $S$ is unknown, Marinov and Zimmert [2021] show that this guarantee is impossible under an adaptive adversary. In this paper, we show that a single algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(S+1)KT})$ expected regret for every $S$ against an oblivious adversary, resolving an open problem of Auer et al. [2019b]. Our algorithm combines a fixed-share learner initialized with a small learning rate and dyadic-interval subroutines that search for local improvements using randomized learning rates and implicit exploration. Importantly, a non-uniform prior favors following the main learner, keeping the cost of maintaining many subroutines small. When the subroutines accumulate sufficient improvement over the main learner, its learning rate doubles, allowing adaptation to the unknown number of comparator switches $S$.

title: One-Step Retrieval Framework for Real-Time Sponsored Search Ads Using Hierarchical Text Representations
summary: Traditional retrieval systems typically use multi-stage cascading architectures (MCA), where each module is optimized independently, leading to inconsistent objectives and the premature elimination of high-potential candidates. Recent LLM-based generation methods offer end-to-end solutions but use discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) to retrieve ads, which are not learned by the base LLM and require memorization of numerous SID-to-ad mappings during SFT, suffering from limited generalization to unseen ads, high maintenance and update costs. The one-to-one mapping between SIDs and advertisements leads to inefficient decoding. Moreover, these methods rely on a small reward model (e.g. pctr) for relevance and ranking, limiting the LLM's ability to fully assess ads' commercial value. To address these challenges, we propose A uNified Generation-discriminative-ranking reaL-time rEtrieval (ANGLE) framework. ANGLE uses LLM-generated hierarchical textual representations, which consist of commercial intent that provide high-level overviews and ad abstract that deliver fine-grained details. Additionally, ANGLE integrates retrieval, relevance, and ranking directly within a single LLM, enabling precise and efficient ranking of ads by leveraging the full capabilities of the LLM. We applied ANGLE to the real-world search scenarios, achieving a 1.81% increase in consumption and a 2.16% increase in gross merchandise volume (GMV). We also conducted offline evaluations of ANGLE and seven baselines, with ANGLE outperforming all across key metrics such as HR and ACR.

title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
summary: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. To learn each source policy, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. To transfer the acquired software to new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. We evaluate policy learning and its relationship to cross-task transfer. For learning, across four source tasks in RoboCasa, iterative optimization increases the success rate from 28.3% with initially generated policy code to 64.2% with validation-selected policy code. We further validate this learning approach on a physical Unitree G1. For transfer, across nine additional target tasks in RoboCasa, success rates are 45.2% without references, 41.5% using initially generated policy code from source tasks, and 57.0% using their validation-selected policy code. These results show that improving source-task code also improves learning on new tasks.

title: DRT: Dense Reasoning Trace for Efficient and Grounded Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Despite the remarkable progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), prevailing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) paradigms remain confined to the natural-language expression space. Consequently, they inherently incur excessive linguistic overhead, leading to information dilution and weak visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose Dense Reasoning Trace (DRT), a paradigm that departs from natural-language-centered CoT by expressing reasoning as compact structured traces, which include concise intermediate states with symbolic connectors and disentangle visual observations from logical deductions. First, we introduce the Dense Trace Initialization to internalize the DRT reasoning mode into the model, substantially improving token efficiency while preserving visual evidence. To further enable the model to faithfully capture the logical relations within traces, we propose the Trace-Grounded Reinforcement Learning framework, which builds reference traces through a tri-perspective verification pipeline and employs Trace-Grounded GRPO with structured rewards, encouraging the model to generate concise DRT-style traces with reduced hallucination and stronger logical grounding. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks show that DRT achieves 5.5$\times$ token efficiency improvement while improving 1.3 accuracy points over the Qwen3-VL baseline. These findings suggest that complex multimodal reasoning may not require verbose natural-language traces, opening a more efficient path for next-generation MLLMs. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/HIT-leaderone/DRT

title: LazyAgent: Demand-Driven Materialization and Physical Optimization of Agentic Programs
comments: 57 pages. v2: rewrote the abstract and introduction; added a remark on pricing plans to the appendix; results unchanged
summary: Agent runtimes that plan before acting run every step as soon as it is ready. Neither these runtimes nor their benchmarks distinguish a step that is ready from a step the request needs, and the difference is large: across 303 requests on 154 production workflows, an eager runtime that stops once the goal is met spends 62.2% of its CPU on work the request never needed. LazyAgent is, to our knowledge, the first complete formulation of demand-driven execution for agent runtimes. Its rule: run a ready step only if the current request needs it, and keep that answer exact as the plan changes. A demanded set derived from the program decides, in one traversal with no model calls, so LazyAgent spends nothing outside the request. Because demand is defined exactly, its behavior is proved: builders know before any run where demand must save and where it must tie. The bill is known before a plan runs, so LazyAgent can act as a query optimizer to choose among candidate workflows. Measured live against that eager runtime, LazyAgent saves 51.7% and 52.1% of container time on release gates where a frontier LLM writes the patches, 12.8% of tokens on DataSciBench plans at matched quality, and 24.0% of dollars inside a live LangGraph application, with no losses. When the LLM re-plans after real code failures, it solves every solvable goal with 11.7% fewer tokens per goal. On the production workflows it saves 42.0% of CPU, ties exactly where a request needs the whole graph, and adds at most 0.43% overhead. The same set steers every physical operation: projection saves 80-89% of a shared CI step, where the identical eager control saves 0.0%. Public agent benchmarks are designed the same way as eager runtimes, so they cannot show this difference. We compose our test programs from their tasks and call on industry to build benchmarks that measure how efficiently agent workflows run.
comment: 57 pages. v2: rewrote the abstract and introduction; added a remark on pricing plans to the appendix; results unchanged

title: Anchor and Perturb: Lazy Agent Remediation by Exploration Injection
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures; v2 includes multi-cycle automated benchmarks and Section 5.3 additions
summary: Anchor and Perturb (AnP) is a lightweight framework that resolves multi-agent coordination failures by decoupling exploratory variance injection from recurrent manifold stability. Existing remediation strategies predominantly alter mixing network architectures or enforce simultaneous exploration across the collective, which inevitably precipitates severe temporal-difference penalties in non-monotonic reward spaces. Specifically, AnP isolates underperforming lazy agents and injects an asymmetric exploratory pulse into targeted coordinates whilst anchoring converged teammates to nominal greedy exploitation. Empirical telemetry benchmarks demonstrate that AnP successfully rescues collapsed joint policies (recovering from a 5% evaluation win rate nadir back to 85%) and facilitates escape from suboptimal coordination plateaus, sustaining peak win rates of 90% without requiring structural network modifications.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures; v2 includes multi-cycle automated benchmarks and Section 5.3 additions

title: Compressed delayed-information projection for underwater navigation under acoustic measurement latency
comments: 31 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America (JASA)
summary: Delayed acoustic position measurements describe past states but may reach an underwater vehicle after its navigation estimate has advanced. This paper presents compressed delayed-information projection (CDIP), a causal delayed-update method implemented in a 15-dimensional error-state Kalman filter (ESKF). CDIP retains source-associated inertial measurement unit (IMU) snapshots and maintains current-to-snapshot cross-covariances, projecting delayed corrections without repeated full-from-start filtering. In 154 paired simulation recordings with synthetic horizontal-position fixes delayed by 1.5~s, CDIP reduced mean trajectory-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 1.062~m for a reception-time Baseline to 0.456~m (57.1\%). Its mean RMSE approached that of full-from-start Replay (0.451~m), with 99.2\% lower mean core-loop time per processed IMU step for the tested implementations. A six-delay sweep, scheduled permanent-loss outages of 50--300~s, and packet-erasure tests further characterized sensitivity to measurement timing and availability. A separate 256-trial nonlinear synthetic assessment identified departures from the prespecified calibration criterion for CDIP and two fully augmented ESKF references. Together, these results demonstrate an accuracy--computation trade-off for causal underwater navigation under the evaluated delayed-measurement simulation conditions.
comment: 31 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America (JASA)

title: A Nearly Quadratic Lower Bound for Linear Optimization over Convex Bodies in the Membership Oracle Model
summary: We prove nearly quadratic lower bounds for randomized algorithms for linear optimization and uniform sampling over convex bodies in the membership oracle model. For linear optimization, this matches the known nearly quadratic upper bound up to a polylog factor in the dimension. For uniform sampling, this improves on the previous linear lower bound. Our construction also implies the same lower bound for volume estimation.

title: One Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows as Noise2Noise Denoisers for Low-Dose CT
summary: We study rectified flows for denoising without clean training targets. For an unconditional rectified flow trained on Noise2Noise pairs, the optimal velocity field yields the minimum mean squared error (MMSE) denoiser in one step. In a jointly Gaussian model, we show that integrating the flow before applying its denoising readout increases error with integration time. The flow transports between noisy distributions, so its endpoint is not a clean-image estimate. Experiments on low-dose CT and Gaussian-corrupted natural images follow this pattern: one-step flow performs similarly to direct regression on the same pairs, whereas additional Euler steps reduce PSNR. A direct regressor using spatially separated, similar patches gives our best label-free CT result, a $1.99$\,dB gain over the noisy input. We report these results in CTDenoiser, a benchmark covering five architectures, supervised and self-supervised training, and two per-image methods. Supervised CNNs gain about $4$\,dB, while label-free performance depends strongly on how training pairs account for correlated CT noise. A channelized Hotelling observer also shows that fidelity gains need not improve lesion detectability: detectability falls at $160$\,HU despite higher PSNR and SSIM, while changes at $40$--$80$\,HU are small. Code, model definitions, and data-loading utilities will be released publicly; the repository link is withheld for anonymous review.

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
summary: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, compact dynamic scene representations that support efficient rendering. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a promising approach, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to its dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness through sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs typically deform a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive solely on its associated anchor, limiting their ability to model non-local dynamics and disocclusions and exploit inter-anchor correlations. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built on Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents a dynamic scene using hierarchical sparse anchors in 4D space-time. Coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from features obtained through kernel interpolation among nearby anchors, enabling parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. A fixed-size memory with a novel orthogonality-informed slot-update strategy further captures long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors for entropy coding. Empirically, \name achieves PSNR-based BD-rate reductions of 90.88%, 64.30% and 65.14% relative to GIFStream, TED-4DGS, and OMG4, respectively, on the Neu3D testset.

title: Denoising Multirobot Trajectories
comments: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO) 2026
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes deformations to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO) 2026

title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
summary: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.

title: Recommendation Systems for Exploratory Data Tasks
summary: Exploratory Data Tasks (EDTs) involve iteratively steering workflows as users refine their subjective goals based on newly emerging insights. EDTs are performed by millions of users with varying levels of expertise to understand unfamiliar data, discover trends, and identify evidence that informs critical decision-making. However, a key challenge in EDTs is the enormous space of possible actions that one can take at each step: users struggle to choose among thousands of joins, transformations, and aggregations, leading to exploration paralysis. Because EDT workflows are interconnected, each choice shapes subsequent exploration, and suboptimal choices can lead to inefficiency, missed insights, confirmation bias, and incomplete coverage. This calls for intelligent recommendations that efficiently guide users toward optimal EDT actions. We envision recommendation as a core capability of data systems, proactively guiding users toward promising actions that lower the barrier to EDTs. This capability becomes even more critical as AI agents emerge as a new class of users that perform EDTs on behalf of humans. EDT recommendation is challenging because the action space is combinatorial and actions are data-dependent, which require costly materialization. Moreover, recommendation often involves bundles or sequences of actions across interdependent tasks, requiring coordination across tasks. In this paper, we present our vision of EDT recommendation systems along two axes: single-task vs. multi-task settings and single-action vs. multi-action recommendations. We outline a research agenda that progresses from recommending individual EDT actions to constrained bundles and sequences of actions, and ultimately to coordinated recommendations across interconnected EDTs. We identify research directions for incorporating various contexts, addressing efficiency challenges, and coordinating across tasks.

title: Non-Commutative Lie-Algebraic State-Space Models: Finite-Division Variety Laws, Semidirect Cascades, and Gradient Saddle Escape
comments: 44 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables; includes 5 ancillary Python reproducibility scripts in anc/
summary: Structured state-space sequence models (SSMs) achieve linear-time inference and logarithmic-time parallel training via associative scans, yet diagonal transitions generate solvable semigroups unable to track non-solvable group words or 3D rigid-body manifolds. We present Non-Commutative Lie-Algebraic State-Space Models (Lie-SSMs), parameterizing recurrent updates on Lie algebra tangent spaces via the matrix exponential. First, using an o-minimal cylindrical flag collar, we establish an unconditional single-layer finite-division criterion for contracting $SO(3)$ and $SU(2)$ heads, proving odd-prime Sylow abelianity, odd-$p$-core centrality, and exponent-30 commutator obstructions excluding $S_5$ in $SO(3)^m, SU(2)^m,$ and $SO(4)^m$ while identifying the sharp threshold $d^*(S_5)=d^*(A_6)=5$ in $SO(5)$. Second, Depth-2 semidirect and Schreier $2$-cocycle cascades resolve $S_5$, $2I\cong SL_2(F_5)$, and $\mathrm{Heis}(F_p)$ in $O(\log T)$ scan depth, whereas unnormalized contracting coupling collapses exponentially without Directional RMSNorm. Third, we characterize the $Θ(\varepsilon^{c-1})$ Chen--Magnus--Hall--Witt commutator saddle and $1/|[G,G]|$ coset-centroid dilution, proving generic first-order symmetry breaking at $\varepsilon=0$ and teacher-forced local Polyak--Łojasiewicz convergence under dense prefix supervision and factored readouts ($99.90\%/99.40\%$ on $S_5$ at $T=128$; $100.00\%$ on $D_{16}$). Across $SE_2(3)$ Left-Jacobian odometry, Hillis--Steele/Blelloch GPU scans ($48.24\times$ forward, $20.27\times/10.28\times$ full-layer speedup at $T=2048$), and three 3D IMU benchmarks (UCI HAR, UCI HAPT-PT, and 17-subject REALDISP), Lie-$SO(3)$ models reach $95.69\%\pm 0.14\%$ on HAR, $88.44\%\pm 0.83\%$ episode logit-vote ($83.97\%\pm 1.20\%$ C3 window in 30-subject 5-fold CV; $87.16\%\pm 0.64\%$ 9-subject split) on HAPT-PT, and $84.23\%\pm 1.00\%$ on REALDISP.

title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
comments: arXiv admin note: This submission has been withdrawn because it does not meet arXiv's research content quality standards
summary: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.

title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits
summary: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this question for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger minimizes a Bernoulli transportation cost plus a logarithmic penalty in its pull count. We first analyze the stabilized regime, in which the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$. In this regime, every suboptimal arm is sampled linearly often, and, with high probability, the stopping time is at most $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ plus stabilization and lower-order concentration terms, with the exact fixed-$β$ leading coefficient. The main remaining difficulty is therefore to control when the regime is reached. For the original rule, we obtain a non-asymptotic high-probability stopping bound on every Bernoulli instance with a unique best arm. Under a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound yields the sharp expected sample complexity; combined with the exploration result of Jourdan et al., this covers pairwise-distinct means under their tie-breaking convention. A mild forced-exploration guard, which uses only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, gives a self-contained sharp expected bound for any number of arms with a unique best arm. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
comments: The Science of Physical AI Safety Workshop at CoRL 2026
summary: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.
comment: The Science of Physical AI Safety Workshop at CoRL 2026

title: Fine-Tuning VLM for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Understanding 3D and 2D Rotations
summary: Spatial intelligence is a fundamental skill in multiple domains, such as Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), Medicine, Architecture, and Construction. Recent studies indicate that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still face limitations in spatial reasoning, which inhibits artificial intelligence (AI) from performing practical spatial tasks. Using multiple object-rotation datasets developed for training and evaluation, our experiments demonstrated promising improvements in both 2D and 3D rotation detection. Fine-tuned Google DeepMind-built Gemma-4 mixture-of-experts (MoE) models significantly outperformed fine-tuned Gemma-4 generalist models in predicting rotations defined by both their axes and angles. Fine-tuning also substantially improved angle estimation for 2D representation without requiring an explicit coordinate system. Furthermore, identifiable objects did not improve angle-detection accuracy; instead, objects with prominent linear features showed improved performance.

title: What Does a Harness Repair? Three Preregistered Studies Around a Longevity-Tuned Language Model
comments: 90 pages, 3 figures, 77 tables. v3 adds a third preregistered study (SmolLM3-3B and base Qwen3-1.7B on BoolQ, FPB and MMLU-Pro; Autocast exploratory) and a check of the selected harness texts, and withholds row-like passages that v1 and v2 printed. Ancillary files in anc/: frozen preregistrations, addenda (row keys withheld), aggregate reports, README, sha256sum list
summary: A harness search around a frozen longevity-tuned 1.7B model reported a rescue. An audit found that the gain came from rows the start left unparsed, that the caller sent each row's reference answer as an assistant turn, and that replication through the same pipeline missed it. Is a harness's gain more than a constant answer would give? We preregistered three studies and report every endpoint. In the first two, thinking off raised test accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 7 of 12 cells, mostly on rows the cap left unparsed. It was not meaningfully worse than a rescue in 7 of 9 small-model test cells or than four GEPA harnesses at 1.7B. Replication reproduced an injected defect's distortion in 9 of 20 evaluable cases (7 fixed by design). At 14B, two GEPA harnesses beat thinking off by 34 points on test but were not detectably above the strongest constant label, and answered "Yes" in 94.6% and 98.2% of parsed mortality answers on test. In the third study (SmolLM3-3B, base Qwen3-1.7B), GEPA beat the constant on FPB (confirmatory, both partitions); thinking off was not meaningfully worse than any BoolQ harness, and 3 of 4 MMLU-Pro searches kept their seed (the fourth inconclusive on test). On Autocast (exploratory), the harnesses were within 0.7 points of the constant and gave one label in 93.1% to 96.8% of parsed answers, both on test. On questions about the input or about knowledge (FPB, BoolQ, MMLU-Pro), GEPA beat the constant or found no clear gain over thinking off; on questions that ask for a prediction (14B mortality, descriptive; Autocast, exploratory), the harness ended near the constant and gave one label almost throughout while its gain over thinking off looked large. The constant label told the two apart wherever the gain was large. This rests on few tasks that also differ in label skew, number of labels and task type, so it is not shown to depend on the kind of question.

title: Sub-Voxel Displacement and Ipsilateral Territory Decoupling for 3D Bilateral Coronary Artery Tree Reconstruction in Cardiac CT Angiography
comments: 12 pages (8-page main manuscript and 4-page supplementary material), 2 figures, 8 tables, 5 algorithms
summary: Bilateral coronary tree (LCA/RCA) reconstruction in cardiac CT angiography (CCTA) faces $64^3$ discretization, territory ambiguity, and ostium drift. Within GT-foreground $128^3$ ROIs ($\pm 15$-voxel margin, 9.8--12.0 mm; seed-free in ROI; whole-volume localization upstream), we propose a canonical $(Z_{IS},Y_{PA},X_{LR})$ multi-task network and scalar-potential arborescence solver. Volumes, centerlines, and thick-stem ostia map to $(Z_{IS},Y_{PA},X_{LR})$, extending a 3D pyramid encoder and tubular decoder with a $128^3\to 64^3$ skip, stop-gradient $128^3$ residual branch, 3D sub-voxel displacement head $Δ\hat{u}(x)$, ipsilateral head $(P_{LCA},P_{RCA})$, and $32^3$ ostium head. From a recall-balanced anchor, 327,385 active parameters (398,843 total) are fine-tuned in a 30-epoch AdamW loop ($ε=10^{-8}$, 7 groups) with L2-SP/anchor blending. Our solver couples Valsalva-STJ calibration, $128^3$ rooting, contralateral inhibition, radius-ratio pruning, normal-plane pullback, and collision reduction. On OOS-50 (Cases 251--300, 50 volumes, 100 trees; 201--250 isolated) vs. 3D U-Net (skeleton/$M_3$--$M_5$) and 5 proxies, it reaches $2.7671\pm 1.1385$ mm $CD_{CL}^{union}$ (SD 0.0415), $3.2338\pm 1.3557$ mm $CD_{CL}^{arc1mm}$, and $3.2926\pm 2.6253$ mm $CD_{ipsi}$ (arc1mm 3.7460 mm, node $p_{Holm}\le 0.0400$ vs. Ext-0b [arc1mm $p=0.1629/0.2187$]; 76.33% junction [23.04% 1-to-1], 79.65% branch F1). On Dev-14 (14 volumes, 28 trees), it reaches $2.1362\pm 0.5041$ mm $CD_{CL}^{union}$ (SD 0.0369), $2.3798\pm 0.5725$ mm $CD_{CL}^{arc1mm}$, and $2.2480\pm 0.6835$ mm $CD_{ipsi}$ (arc1mm 2.4951 mm, node $CD_{CL}^{union}$ $p_{Holm}=0.0494$ vs. Ext-0b [$CD_{ipsi}$/arc1mm $p_{Holm}=0.1353/0.0676$--$0.0906$]; 56.76%/77.74% F1@1/2mm; 79.95% junction [21.06% 1-to-1], 83.80% branch F1, 4.6880/4.9298 mm ostia), and $N=64$ $CD_{CL}^{union}=2.6291\pm 1.0629$ mm (arc1mm 3.0470, $CD_{ipsi}$ 3.0641).
