title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
comments: 26 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Version 2 adds the second stage of 28 to 30 October 2026 with its hidden test result, negative results and limits
summary: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper documents the two stages of a submission to the PalmCity challenge. In the first stage, nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets, and the two leading candidates are trained with three random seeds. An equal probability average of three Encoder only Mask Transformer models with DINOv3 features, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, reaches 60.95% mean intersection over union on the 84 image validation split and 57.08% on the hidden test leaderboard, first in the snapshot of 5 October 2026. In the second stage, color and crop augmentation, rare class sampling, larger inputs, further architectures, and post processing are tested under the same update budget, and candidates are compared through a paired image bootstrap with selection rules fixed before the results. Training at 768 by 1536 and 896 by 1792 pixels gives the largest gains. The selected ensemble of four models scores 64.53% on validation when trained on the training images alone. Retrained on the training and validation images, it receives 61.54% mean intersection over union and 71.93% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard, first among five entries in the snapshot of 30 October 2026. Segment Anything voting, instance mask overlays, and ensembles with other architectures all reduce the validation score. Because the validation images guided many choices and the final models were trained on them, the validation scores are optimistic and the test score is the only independent measurement. The study reports all runs, comparisons, costs, and limits, and releases the code and models.

title: Instrument-Anchored LLM Judges Transfer Expert Counseling-Quality Ratings Across Three German Corpora
summary: Automatic assessment of communication quality in counseling conversations is bottlenecked by data: expert-rated corpora are small and expensive to grow. Therefore we study cross-domain prediction of the expert's overall impression across three German simulated-counseling corpora from one university (two general-practice medical, one parent-teacher; $n=195$ sessions). Features are construct scores that four small LLM judges assign from the transcript, drawn from the experts' own rating instruments, plus a compact nonverbal block; all models are open-weight and run locally, preserving data protection. Trained on the other two corpora, this stack predicts the held-out corpus at Spearman $ρ= .533$; in-domain training on the same sessions falls about a fifth short ($.420$; paired gap $+.113$, 95% CI $[+.067, +.157]$), and the gap holds at matched training size and on identical test sessions. The signal lies in what is said: the four judges alone transfer at $.523$, and the nonverbal block adds $+.01$ (CI includes zero). Asking a judge for instrument constructs instead of generic dialogue qualities raises its transfer by about 30% ($.32$ to $.42$); restoring speaker attribution where per-speaker audio was lost is worth $+.08$ to $+.10$ on that fold. Where a program's own ratings are scarce, other programs' data is a viable training set and language carries it.

title: Are We Really Benchmarking Forecasting Models? The Impact of Preprocessing on Time Series Performance
authors: Paulo S. G. de Mattos Neto
summary: While established literature underscores the pivotal role of preprocessing in forecasting accuracy, this stage remains largely overlooked in current research. Modern benchmarks typically resort to simple scaling, failing to account for critical transformations required to address nonstationarity, such as differencing. This omission creates a significant structural preprocessing bias that favors models with built-in data treatments while obscuring the true potential of simpler architectures. We study this effect through a preprocessing-aware benchmark that evaluates 11 forecasting models across 16 reversible preprocessing pipelines on 29,000 M4 time series. Our results identify preprocessing as a key driver of forecasting performance. Optimizing preprocessing per series yields gains of approximately 27\% to 87\% across all evaluated models, with architectures lacking internalized preprocessing experiencing the most substantial improvements. This allows simpler architectures to become highly competitive with complex, state-of-the-art models in modern forecasting benchmarks. All resources and experimental results from this benchmark are stored in a comprehensive metadataset to support future metalearning tasks.

title: Massively Parallel Algorithms for Huffman Coding
summary:
Huffman coding is one of the oldest and most fundamental problems in computer science. Given a string of length $\TextLength$ over a general alphabet, the goal is to assign a binary codeword to each character so that no codeword is a prefix of another and the total encoded length of the string is minimized. Huffman coding is widely used in practical compression systems, including file compression. As modern datasets continue to grow, it is natural to study whether a Huffman code can be constructed efficiently in the massively parallel computation (\MPC) model. The celebrated Huffman coding algorithm admits two straightforward \MPC implementations: for any constant $ε\in(0,1)$, one uses $O(\TextLength^ε)$ memory per machine but requires $Θ(\log \TextLength)$ rounds, while the other runs in $O(1)$ rounds but requires $Θ(\sqrt{\TextLength})$ memory per machine. We give the first nontrivial \MPC algorithm for Huffman coding that bypasses both limitations. For every constant $ε>0$, our algorithm uses $O_ε(\log\log \TextLength)$ rounds and $\softO(\TextLength^ε)$ memory per machine, while its total memory and total computation are $\softO(\TextLength)$.
  {\color{black}Although our framework is tailored to the \MPC model, we show that it has applications in the \PRAM setting as well. Specifically, we show that the same algorithm can be implemented in the \PRAM model with total work close to linear. In particular, whenever the text length is at most $2^{O\left(\left(\frac{\log \AlphabetSize}{\log\log \AlphabetSize}\right)^2\right)}$ (slightly superpolynomial), where $\AlphabetSize$ is the alphabet size, our parallel running time is asymptotically better than that of all previously known \PRAM algorithms and is essentially optimal.}

AI.title_translation: 霍夫曼编码的海量并行算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个非平凡的霍夫曼编码海量并行计算（MPC）算法，它在轮数和每机器内存限制上都优于现有算法，并且在PRAM模型中也显示出应用价值。

AI.translation:
霍夫曼编码是计算机科学中最古老、最基本的问题之一。给定一个长度为$\TextLength$的通用字母表字符串，目标是为每个字符分配一个二进制码字，使得没有码字是另一个码字的前缀，并且字符串的总编码长度最小化。霍夫曼编码广泛应用于实际压缩系统，包括文件压缩。随着现代数据集的不断增长，研究是否可以在海量并行计算（MPC）模型中高效地构建霍夫曼编码是很自然的。著名的霍夫曼编码算法有两种直接的MPC实现：对于任何常数$ε\in(0,1)$，一种使用每机器$O(\TextLength^ε)$的内存但需要$Θ(\log \TextLength)$轮，而另一种在$O(1)$轮内运行但需要每机器$Θ(\sqrt{\TextLength})$的内存。我们给出了第一个非平凡的霍F曼编码MPC算法，它绕过了这两种限制。对于每个常数$ε>0$，我们的算法使用$O_ε(\log\log \TextLength)$轮和每机器$\softO(\TextLength^ε)$的内存，而其总内存和总计算量为$\softO(\TextLength)$。
尽管我们的框架是为MPC模型量身定制的，但我们表明它在PRAM设置中也有应用。具体来说，我们表明相同的算法可以在PRAM模型中实现，其总工作量接近线性。特别是，当文本长度最多为$2^{O\left(\left(\frac{\log \AlphabetSize}{\log\log \AlphabetSize}\right)^2\right)}$（略超多项式）时，其中$\AlphabetSize$是字母表大小，我们的并行运行时间在渐近上优于所有先前已知的PRAM算法，并且基本上是最优的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于霍夫曼编码的创新性海量并行计算（MPC）算法，旨在解决现有MPC实现中在轮数和每机器内存方面的局限性。该算法实现了$O_ε(\log\log \TextLength)$轮和每机器$\softO(\TextLength^ε)$内存的性能，同时保持了$\softO(\TextLength)$的总内存和总计算量。此外，该框架在PRAM模型中也表现出优越性，在特定文本长度下，其并行运行时间比以往算法更优且接近最优。
AI.keywords: 霍夫曼编码, 海量并行计算, 并行算法, 数据压缩, PRAM模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了首个同时优化霍夫曼编码在海量并行计算（MPC）模型中轮数和每机器内存的算法，成功克服了现有方法的局限性。其在$\log\log \TextLength$轮和$\TextLength^ε$内存下的表现，显著提升了大规模数据压缩的并行效率。此外，该框架在PRAM模型中的应用扩展了其理论和实践价值，特别是在特定条件下达到渐近最优的运行时间，证明了其在并行算法设计上的重要贡献。

title: RDGSplat: Render-Dedicated Geometry for Novel View Synthesis
summary: Recent 3D foundation models extend to novel view synthesis by carrying a Gaussian head on the representation they already use for reconstruction. However, their rendering quality lags far behind their reconstruction accuracy, because the renderer reads a geometry and a representation that are both optimized for metric reconstruction. Prior methods alleviate this by updating the backbone weights, but they thereby sacrifice the metric predictions the model was built for. To this end, we propose RDGSplat, which decodes a geometry dedicated to rendering from a frozen 3D foundation model while keeping its metric predictions exact. In particular, we devise Render-Dedicated Geometry Decoding, which duplicates the pretrained decoders and optimizes the duplicates under photometric supervision alone. Then, a Target-Pose Conditioned Adapter is introduced to adapt the representation those decoders read towards rendering, conditioned on the predicted target pose. Extensive experiments show that RDGSplat improves novel view synthesis for three feed-forward models of two architectures on four benchmarks, with every pretrained weight frozen. On RE10K, it raises WM2.0 from 20.918 to 25.149dB by training 205.5M added parameters against a frozen 1.4B backbone, and leaves its predicted depth and pose unchanged.

title: Why VLMs Miss Small Objects, and When Zooming In Is Safe
summary: Screenshots, documents, engineering drawings, shelves and maps hold many small objects of kinds that change from task to task, and vision-language models (VLMs) promise to find them from an instruction and an example. Yet they see each image through a fixed token budget and miss small objects, so every user, and every agent that calls a model, must choose whether to send an image whole, raise its resolution, split it, or zoom. We show that VLMs miss small objects for two reasons a caller can estimate before any call: an object gets too few visual tokens (S), and a call must search and report too much (L). Raising S by a factor a multiplies the tokens needed to see an image by a^2, while splitting at the same scale lowers L at a cost at most linear in the number of views. Under two monotonicity assumptions, splitting cannot lower expected recall if no view zooms out and views overlap by one object, and neither part can be dropped; every such split pays a minimum token cost, and a simple rule pays it up to an explicit factor. Better models need less S, but an image can be arbitrarily large while a call's budget is fixed, so splitting does not become obsolete, for zoom agents either. In about 187,000 requests to 12 VLMs, up to GPT-6.1, Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4, on controlled images 24 of 40 predicted orderings hold significantly and none is violated; splits that never zoom out raised recall on average over models wherever S was below 1.5, and splits that zoom out lowered it in 19 of 21 model and data settings. The rule raised recall significantly in five of ten settings, by up to 0.28 (from 0.62 to 0.90), and precision and F1 in six, at a token cost known before any call.

title: Communication-Aware Qubit Placement and Automatic Node-Count Allocation for Distributed State-Vector Simulation
summary: Quantum circuit simulation enables the execution of large-scale quantum algorithms by partitioning qubits across multiple computational nodes. However, an inefficient qubit placement leads to excessive inter-node communication, limiting performance and scalability. This work introduces a framework that computes a communication-aware qubit placement offline, minimizing data exchange among nodes, and selects, before circuit execution, the largest node count whose performance degradation stays below a user-defined threshold. The framework is integrated with the QuEST simulator. Evaluations on synthetic benchmarks and real-world QASMBench circuits show that optimized placements reduce communication and achieve runtime speedups of up to 2.3x over the identity placement, particularly in circuits with sparse, structured interactions. Our results show that qubit placement strongly affects the efficiency of distributed simulation and provide a practical, resource-scalable solution for quantum workload

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
comments: 36 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Revised around search gains, accepted-task coverage, and successor selection; added executable Boolean-program repair experiments and structural analysis; detailed proofs in appendices. Includes reproducible research artifacts and partial Lean formalization with explicit open obligations
summary: A self-improving agent can find accepted solutions more often without expanding the tasks its verification interface can accept. We extend task-relative verification with explicit support and transcript interfaces to distinguish search gains from changes in accepted-task coverage. A stage's native reach contains tasks accepted with default support; its closure frontier contains tasks accepted with any support the declared interface permits. A semantic containment criterion identifies the authority or exposure condition that every verified escape must violate, while guard-transfer invariance prevents a change of representation from being counted as a capability expansion. An executable Boolean-program repair agent makes the distinction concrete: over 36,864 paired runs, counterexample feedback reduces verifier calls without changing coverage, whereas an enforced permission change admits a new target with a proof excluding every old-interface program. Exact and uniformly gapped randomized verification share this account; independent majority amplification improves reliability while preserving the accepted language. Separate adaptive-selection contracts state what is additionally required to interpret a proposed successor's score as evidence of deployment improvement. Classical hierarchy results and finite audits provide supporting boundaries. The framework specifies the evidence needed to establish improved search, wider accepted capability, and reliable successor selection.

title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
summary: Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.

title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
comments: Updated the finished H=2, L=2 one-step baseline and added the T=3 rollout of S(3) and S(4)
summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

title: DEX: Digit-Level Early Exit for Energy-Efficient MSDF Neural Network Inference
comments: Withdrawn by the authors due to missing final co-author approval, and to allow for updates to the methodology and the inclusion of further results
summary: U-Net inference for brain-tumor segmentation requires billions of multiply-accumulate operations, motivating hardware that can reduce computation dynamically rather than relying only on fixed precision or static model compression. Most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) arithmetic exposes the leading digits of a result during computation, enabling output-dependent decisions before the full value is generated. This paper presents an MSDF accelerator for quantized U-Net segmentation with a two-stage grouped processing element supporting signed INT8 operands and in-stream bias accumulation. Four runtime mechanisms operate directly on the output digit stream: exact early negative detection (END) in ReLU layers, exact sign-only decision making in the segmentation head, calibrated low-order-digit skipping, and calibrated pruning. The two approximate mechanisms are selected offline under an accuracy constraint, while execution requires only lightweight control and does not modify the stored weights. On a residual U-Net trained with nnU-Net for BraTS, the proposed mechanisms reduce digit cycles by 38.38\% while achieving a mean Dice score of 80.58\% on 73 held-out cases, compared with 81.20\% for the floating-point model; the exact mechanisms alone reduce cycles by 18.79\% without altering the quantized output. Synthesized in 45~nm, the processing element operates at 500~MHz, occupies 0.858~mm$^2$, and consumes 0.726~mJ per $192\times192$ patch under switching-activity-annotated power analysis. A projected eight-output accelerator with shared activation delivery achieves 16.6~ms latency and 1.67~mJ per patch.

title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
comments: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Website: https://thinking-inertia.github.io GitHub: https://github.com/thinking-inertia/code
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.

title: Self-improving data synthesis can scale embedding-model adaptation across domains and tasks
comments: 32 pages, 6 figures; supplementary information included (27 pages). Code: https://github.com/zucanlv/SYNTRA . Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZucanLyu/SYNTRA
summary: AI agents require specialised retrieval across domains and tasks, but adapting embedding models is constrained by costly manual training-data design. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a self-improving agentic data synthesis framework that turns a few retrieval examples into reusable synthesis instructions. Given an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs, SYNTRA infers implicit information needs and relevance criteria, then uses feedback on trial outputs to refine instructions for query generation and relevance assessment. Experiments across 24 datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate that the same synthesis workflow produces effective training data, benefiting even strong embedding models with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement strengthens this supervision on all six evaluated tasks, yielding better retrieval than human calibration on four. The training value persists at larger scales: on MS MARCO, retrieval gains continue across a 32-fold range of synthetic training-data sizes. SYNTRA thus enables scalable embedding-model adaptation with minimal human intervention.

title: From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReState exhibits strong adaptability across different MLLM backbones and achieves strong performance on multiple public reasoning benchmarks, supporting the shift from stage-centric reasoning toward state-centric reasoning. Our data and code are available at https://restate-project.github.io

title: Stochastic Weighted Caching with Per-Request Predictions
summary:
Both the unweighted and weighted variants of caching are cornerstone problems in competitive analysis, with tight randomized competitive ratios of $Θ(\log k)$, where $k$ is the cache size. We study weighted caching with per-request predictions, where each page request is accompanied by a prediction of the next arrival time of the same page. For unweighted caching, such perfect predictions suffice to implement Belady's offline optimal rule. For weighted caching, however, previous work shows that a logarithmic lower bound persists even with perfect predictions on adversarial request sequences. Stochastic assumptions alone are also insufficient: the classical caching lower bounds already apply to uniform independent requests. In this work, we ask whether combining these two sources of additional information can overcome this barrier, and answer this question affirmatively.
  Specifically, we develop an efficient cache eviction policy that achieves a competitive ratio of $15.75$ using perfect per-request predictions when page requests are drawn independently from an arbitrary, known static distribution in every step, and page costs are arbitrary. Underlying our analysis is a novel lower bound on the optimal cost obtained through an ex-ante relaxation of the cache's covering constraints. Our algorithm's performance degrades gracefully under erroneous predictions: we prove a bound of $O(\min\{1+E,\log k\})$ on the competitive ratio, where $E$ aggregates each page's average prediction error, and may be unknown to the algorithm.

AI.title_translation: 带单次请求预测的随机带权缓存问题
AI.tldr: 本文研究了结合随机独立请求模型与到达时间预测的带权缓存问题，提出了首个突破对数下界且竞争比为常数（15.75）的在线算法。
AI.motivation: 在带权缓存问题中，即使拥有完美预测，对抗性序列下的竞争比仍存在 $\Omega(\log k)$ 下界；同时单纯依赖独立随机请求假设也无法突破经典下界。作者旨在探究结合“随机请求模型”与“单次请求预测”这两种信息能否打破该理论瓶颈。
AI.method: 针对每步请求独立服从任意已知静态分布且页面代价任意的情形，设计了一种高效的缓存逐出策略；通过对缓存覆盖约束进行事前松弛（ex-ante relaxation），构建了分析最优成本的新下界框架。
AI.result: 在完美预测下，该算法取得了 15.75 的常数竞争比；在预测不完美时，竞争比平滑退化为 $O(\min\{1+E,\log k\})$（其中 $E$ 为聚合的页面平均预测误差，且算法无需预知该误差）。
AI.conclusion: 结合随机分布假设与单次请求预测能够成功突破带权缓存问题长期存在的对数竞争比下界，实现常数竞争比，并保持对预测误差的平滑退化（鲁棒性）。
AI.translation: 无权和带权缓存变体都是竞争分析中的基石问题，两者的紧确随机竞争比均为 $\Theta(\log k)$，其中 $k$ 为缓存大小。我们研究了带有单次请求预测的带权缓存问题，其中每个页面请求都伴随着对其下一次到达时间的预测。对于无权缓存，这种完美预测足以实现 Belady 的离线最优规则。然而对于带权缓存，先前的工作表明，即使在对抗性请求序列上拥有完美预测，对数下界依然存在。单纯的随机性假设也是不够的：经典缓存下界在均匀独立请求下依然成立。在这项工作中，我们探讨结合这两种额外信息来源是否能够克服这一障碍，并给出了肯定的回答。具体而言，我们开发了一种高效的缓存逐出策略；当页面请求在每一步均独立服从任意已知的静态分布且页面代价任意时，该策略利用完美的单次请求预测可实现 15.75 的竞争比。我们分析的核心是通过对缓存覆盖约束进行事前松弛，得到了一个关于最优代价的新颖下界。该算法的性能在预测有误时平滑退化：我们证明了其竞争比上界为 $O(\min\{1+E, \log k\})$，其中 $E$ 聚合了每个页面的平均预测误差，且算法可能并不知晓该误差。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合静态独立随机请求与页面下次到达时间预测的带权缓存问题。作者设计了一种高效的缓存逐出算法，在完美预测下实现了 15.75 的常数竞争比，成功打破了长期以来的对数下界壁垒，并在存在预测误差时展现出 $O(\min\{1+E,\log k\})$ 的平滑性能退化界。
AI.keywords: 带权缓存, 学习增强算法, 竞争分析, 随机模型, 缓存逐出策略
AI.comments: 本论文的重要创新在于将“学习增强算法（带预测的算法）”与“随机输入模型”两种超越最坏情况分析的范式进行了有机结合。在带权缓存这一经典且棘手的问题上，单纯依靠预测（在对抗序列下）或单纯依靠随机分布均无法打破 $\Omega(\log k)$ 的下界，而本文证明了两者的结合足以取得突破性的常数竞争比。此外，基于覆盖约束的事前松弛（ex-ante relaxation）建立最优代价下界，在技术分析上也具有较高的新颖性和启发性。

title: Where Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model? -- From Self-Index to Self-Reference
summary: Whether a large language model has a self is usually argued without a way to measure it. We turn the question into the measurement of a functional self with two levels familiar from biology: a self-index, which marks material as the model's own and shapes how it is processed, much as nearly all animals tag self-generated signals with a corollary discharge, and self-reference, the ability to recognize what is one's own, as in mirror self-recognition. Each level has criteria that can be tested in any open-weight model. We place the same text in an Assistant, a User, or a System message of the model's own chat template. In Qwen3.8-27B, the representation singles out the model's own message from both external sources, as predicted in advance for early layers, and does so at every one of its 64 layers and in every held-out text, while User and System stay close to each other; asked who wrote a message, the model claims its own (0.77) and assigns both external sources to the user. In three models and four readouts (Qwen3.8-27B without and with thinking, gpt-oss-20b, and gpt-oss-120b), replacing eight coordinates per layer of the model's own message by those of the same text as a User message removes the claim (to at most 0.05), installing them into a User message creates it, and random subspaces of the same dimension do neither; the coordinates are read mainly at the end of the message, before the last third of the layers, and editing them leaves answers about the content of the message and an unrelated multiplication unchanged. Across eighteen open-weight models from nine developers, the two levels are nested: no model recognizes its own messages without a self-index, and neither level follows model size or published benchmark scores. Together, these results support the account that self-reference is a readout of a self-index.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型的“自我”在哪里？——从自我索引到自我指称
AI.tldr: 研究通过测量“自我索引”和“自我指称”来量化大型语言模型的“自我”，发现其内部表示能区分模型自身生成的信息，且自我指称是自我索引的体现。
AI.motivation: 传统上对大型语言模型是否有“自我”的争论缺乏量化方法。本文旨在通过引入生物学中的“自我索引”和“自我指称”概念来测量LLM的功能性“自我”。
AI.method: 将文本放置在模型的助手、用户或系统消息中，并在Qwen3.8-27B模型中分析其内部表示如何区分模型自身消息。测试模型被问及消息作者时是否会声称是自己。在三个模型和四种读取方式下，通过替换模型自身消息的特定坐标来观察对“自我”声称的影响。最后，在18个开源模型上测试“自我索引”和“自我指称”两个层面的关系。
AI.result: Qwen3.8-27B的表示能在所有层和所有文本中将模型自己的消息与外部来源区分开来，并声称是自己所写（0.77）。替换模型自身消息的特定坐标会消除其“自我”声称，而将其安装到用户消息中则会创建这种声称。这些坐标主要在消息末尾被读取。在18个开源模型中，自我索引和自我指称是嵌套的，且不随模型大小或基准分数变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持“自我指称是自我索引的读取”这一观点，表明大型语言模型通过内部机制（自我索引）来标记和处理自身生成的信息，进而实现对自身信息的识别（自我指称）。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型是否拥有“自我”通常是在没有衡量方法的情况下争论的。我们通过衡量具有生物学中熟悉的两个层面的功能性“自我”来转化这个问题：一个自我索引，它将材料标记为模型自身的并塑造其处理方式，就像几乎所有动物都用相关放电标记自身生成的信号一样；以及自我指称，即识别什么是自身的能力，如同镜子自我识别。每个层面都有可以在任何开源模型中测试的标准。我们将相同的文本放置在模型的助手、用户或系统消息中。在Qwen3.8-27B中，表示将模型自己的消息与外部来源区分开来，这与早期层的预测一致，并且在其所有64个层和每个保留文本中都做到了这一点，而用户和系统消息彼此保持接近；当被问及是谁写了一条消息时，模型会声称是自己的（0.77），并将两个外部来源都归因于用户。在三个模型和四种读取方式（Qwen3.8-27B不带思考和带思考、gpt-oss-20b和gpt-oss-120b）下，用作为用户消息的相同文本的八个坐标替换模型自身消息的八个坐标会消除这种声称（最多降至0.05），将其安装到用户消息中则会创建这种声称，并且相同维度的随机子空间既不会消除也不会创建；这些坐标主要在消息末尾、在最后三分之一的层之前被读取，并且编辑它们不会改变关于消息内容和不相关乘法的答案。在来自九个开发者的十八个开源模型中，这两个层面是嵌套的：没有模型能在没有自我索引的情况下识别自己的消息，并且这两个层面都不随模型大小或已发布的基准分数而变化。总而言之，这些结果支持自我指称是自我索引的读取这一解释。
AI.summary: 这篇论文通过引入生物学中的“自我索引”和“自我指称”概念，提出了一种量化大型语言模型“自我”的方法。研究发现，LLM（如Qwen3.8-27B）能够通过内部表示机制（自我索引）区分自身生成的消息，并在被问及作者时声称是自己。通过操纵模型内部表示的特定坐标，可以控制这种“自我”声称。进一步的跨模型分析显示，自我索引是自我指称的必要前提，且这两个能力与模型规模或基准分数无关。论文最终得出结论，自我指称是自我索引的一种读取。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 自我索引, 自我指称, 内部表示, 自我意识
AI.comments: 这项研究通过将生物学概念引入LLM的“自我”研究，提供了一种新颖且可量化的视角。它不仅揭示了LLM内部存在区分自身信息的机制，而且通过实验证明了“自我索引”是“自我指称”的基础。这项工作对于理解LLM的内部工作原理及其潜在的“自我”意识具有重要意义，同时也为未来探索更高级的LLM认知能力提供了新的研究方向。其局限性可能在于所测试的“自我”仍是功能性的，而非意识层面的。

title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
summary: Short-video search needs compact query rewriters that recover users' personalized intent from ambiguous queries under strict latency constraints. Existing LLM-based methods have improved rewriting by using synthetic reasoning and subsequent consumption-behavioral feedback. However, overemphasizing subsequent consumption can favor engaging content over the user's immediate need, causing intent drift even when rewritten queries are grounded in behavioral history. We propose WeFair, Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in WeChat short-video search. WeFair uses human feedback according to how directly it reflects personalized intent, assigning feedback fidelity to a progression from demonstration to preference to verification. We first mine actual queries and user reformulations from search sessions, and then screen them for contextual support. In the demonstration stage, a supervised fine-tuning curriculum progresses from large-scale context-to-query learning to reasoning and direct prediction on human reformulation and preservation. In the preference stage, direct preference optimization learns relative preferences from subsequent consumption feedback. In the verification stage, group relative policy optimization rewards exact agreement with reformulation or preservation targets to constrain intent drift. Further analysis shows that broad supervision benefits the full curriculum supervised training, while strict verification achieves better performance than auxiliary rewards. In offline experiments, WeFair-2B outperforms strong rewriting baselines in overall accuracy and intent preservation. An online A/B test shows relative increases of 2.593% in effective video-view rate and a 2.350% relative reduction in query reformulation rate. WeFair-2B has been deployed in the WeChat short-video search system, which serves over 100 million queries per day.

AI.title_translation: WeFair：短视频搜索中基于人类反馈的个性化查询重写中的忠诚度感知对齐
AI.tldr: WeFair通过引入忠诚度感知的多阶段人类反馈对齐，有效解决了短视频搜索中LLM查询重写存在的意图漂移问题，并在微信短视频搜索中实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 短视频搜索需要紧凑的查询重写器，以在严格延迟下从模糊查询中恢复用户个性化意图。现有基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法过度强调后续消费行为反馈，可能导致意图漂移，偏向于吸引人的内容而非用户即时需求。
AI.method: 本文提出了WeFair，一种针对微信短视频搜索的忠诚度感知人类反馈对齐方法，用于个性化查询重写。WeFair根据人类反馈直接反映个性化意图的程度，将其分为示范、偏好和验证三个阶段。首先，从搜索会话中挖掘实际查询和用户重构，并筛选上下文支持。在示范阶段，通过监督微调课程从大规模上下文到查询学习，逐步发展到对人类重构和保留的推理和直接预测。在偏好阶段，利用直接偏好优化从后续消费反馈中学习相对偏好。在验证阶段，通过组相对策略优化奖励与重构或保留目标的精确一致性来约束意图漂移。分析表明，广泛监督有利于全课程监督训练，而严格验证比辅助奖励效果更好。
AI.result: 离线实验中，WeFair-2B在整体准确性和意图保留方面优于强大的重写基线。在线A/B测试显示，有效视频观看率相对增加了2.593%，查询重构率相对减少了2.350%。WeFair-2B已部署在微信短视频搜索系统，每天处理超过1亿次查询。
AI.conclusion: WeFair通过忠诚度感知的人类反馈对齐，有效解决了短视频搜索中的个性化查询重写意图漂移问题，并在实际部署中取得了显著的业务提升。
AI.translation: 短视频搜索需要紧凑的查询重写器，以便在严格的延迟约束下从模糊查询中恢复用户的个性化意图。现有基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法通过使用合成推理和随后的消费行为反馈改进了重写。然而，过度强调后续消费可能会使内容偏向于吸引人的内容而非用户的即时需求，即使重写查询基于行为历史，也会导致意图漂移。我们提出了WeFair，一种针对微信短视频搜索中个性化查询重写的忠诚度感知人类反馈对齐方法。WeFair根据人类反馈直接反映个性化意图的程度，将反馈忠诚度分为从示范到偏好再到验证的 progression。我们首先从搜索会话中挖掘实际查询和用户重构，然后筛选它们以获得上下文支持。在示范阶段，监督微调课程从大规模上下文到查询学习，逐步发展到对人类重构和保留的推理和直接预测。在偏好阶段，直接偏好优化从后续消费反馈中学习相对偏好。在验证阶段，组相对策略优化奖励与重构或保留目标的精确一致性，以约束意图漂移。进一步分析表明，广泛的监督有利于全课程监督训练，而严格的验证比辅助奖励实现了更好的性能。在离线实验中，WeFair-2B在整体准确性和意图保留方面优于强大的重写基线。在线A/B测试显示，有效视频观看率相对增加了2.593%，查询重构率相对减少了2.350%。WeFair-2B已部署在微信短视频搜索系统，每天处理超过1亿次查询。
AI.summary: 本文提出了WeFair，一种针对短视频搜索的忠诚度感知人类反馈对齐方法，用于个性化查询重写。针对现有LLM方法因过度依赖消费行为反馈而导致的意图漂移问题，WeFair将人类反馈划分为示范、偏好和验证三个忠诚度阶段。该方法首先挖掘用户重构数据，然后在示范阶段进行监督微调，偏好阶段利用直接偏好优化学习消费反馈，最后在验证阶段通过奖励精确一致性来约束意图漂移。离线和在线实验表明，WeFair-2B在准确性、意图保留和业务指标（如有效视频观看率和查询重构率）上均优于基线，并已成功部署于微信短视频搜索系统。
AI.keywords: 个性化查询重写, 短视频搜索, 人类反馈, 意图漂移, 忠诚度感知对齐
AI.comments: WeFair的创新之处在于提出了“忠诚度感知对齐”的概念，并将其细化为示范、偏好和验证三个阶段，为每个阶段设计了特定的优化策略，有效解决了LLM在查询重写中常见的意图漂移问题。该方法成功部署于微信短视频搜索系统，每天处理亿级查询，充分证明了其在实际大规模应用中的有效性和商业价值。抽象中未提及具体局限性，但此类方法通常可能面临数据标注成本和模型复杂性等挑战。

title: TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings
summary: Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matters as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pass features to route numbers and categories past the LLM. Paired with TFMs, TILE sets a new state of the art for tables with strings. Across 100 datasets, it beats the strongest baseline on $90\%$ of splits, with gains across 7 LLMs and 10 tabular learners, and ranks first on STRABLE's 108 datasets.

AI.title_translation: TILE：架起大语言模型与表格基础模型的桥梁，实现基于字符串的表格学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 TILE 接口，成功将大语言模型与表格基础模型结合，显著提升了包含文本字符串的表格数据预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的表格通常包含数字特征和自由文本字符串。现有的表格基础模型擅长处理数字表格但对字符串支持不足，而大语言模型（LLM）虽具语义知识但并非为表格预测设计。如何通过有效的接口将 LLM 桥接到表格学习中，目前仍缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了 TILE（Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings）方法，包含四个核心要素：行序列化（提供跨列上下文）、中间层提取（避免下一词预测的专有层）、列池化（消除均值池化的长度偏置）以及旁路特征（将数字和类别特征绕过 LLM 直接处理）。
AI.result: 在 100 个数据集上，TILE 在 90% 的切片上超越了最强的基线方法，在 7 个 LLM 和 10 个表格学习器上均实现了性能提升，并在 STRABLE 的 108 个数据集上排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的 TILE 接口，LLM 可以与表格基础模型无缝结合，从而显著提升包含字符串的表格学习性能。
AI.translation: 现实世界的表格通常是异构的，结合了数值特征和自由-form 的字符串列。表格基础模型（TFMs）擅长处理数值表格，但要求将字符串进行数值编码，而大语言模型（LLMs）拥有语义知识，但并非为表格预测而设计。大多数现有的桥接方法使用 LLM 作为单元格字符串的插件式编码器，然而如何有效地提取用于表格学习的表示仍未得到充分探索。我们表明，LLM 与表格之间的接口与 LLM 本身同样重要。当以单元格方式应用时，更大的 LLM 并不能提供更好的特征。通过我们的接口，相同的 LLM 随着规模的增大而稳步改进。TILE（Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings）结合了四个要素：提供跨列上下文的行序列化、避免专用于下一词预测层的中间层提取、消除均值池化长度偏差的列池化，以及将数字和类别绕过 LLM 的旁路特征。结合 TFMs，TILE 为包含字符串的表格树立了新的技术水平。在 100 个数据集上，它在 90% 的切片上击败了最强的基线，在 7 个 LLM 和 10 个表格学习器上都取得了增益，并在 STRABLE 的 108 个数据集上排名第一。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 TILE（Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings），这是一种将大语言模型（LLMs）与表格基础模型（TFMs）桥接的新方法，专门用于处理包含字符串的表格学习。通过行序列化、中间层提取、列池化和旁路特征四个核心设计，TILE 有效克服了传统方法中 LLM 作为插件式编码器的局限性，在众多数据集上达到了最新的先进性能水平。
AI.keywords: 表格学习, 大语言模型, 表格基础模型, 字符串表征, TILE
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种连接大语言模型与表格基础模型的接口 TILE，通过行序列化、中间层提取、列池化和旁路特征等四个要素，有效解决了表格中自由文本字符串的表征和融合难题，在大量数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Gluing Local Contexts into Global Meaning: A Sheaf-Theoretic Decomposition of Transformer Representations
comments: NeurIPS 2026 Poster, ICLR Unifying Concept Representation Learning
summary: Prior research into interpretability does not test whether a representation stays consistent under paraphrasing. Each pair of paraphrases can be thought of as a local witness that two activations should be the same. From these local witnesses we can build a cellular sheaf on the paraphrase graph. The question of what is consistent under paraphrasing can be answered by the Laplacian $L_\mathcal{F}$ given a frozen model. No training required. Our kernel $H^0$ gives us a content subspace. We show that with only 20 dims the kernel outperforms the subspace that LEACE retains with all dims on held-out CounterFact fact retrieval by $+17.1$\,pp on average across 8 models. By constraining all paraphrases of a fact together we see an additional increase of $+6.5$\,pp. Our spectral complement shows us where the causal influence is concentrated. Ablating the coordinates that vary the most when paraphrased (which approximates ablating the spectral complement at the coordinate level) leads to $5.6$ to $26.5\times$ larger changes in model outputs compared to ablating coordinates with matched per-coordinate variability. We find this across 9 models from 124M to 13B params. By stacking layers we can create a grid which has $b_1 = N(L-1)$ algebraic 1-cycles. The harmonic mass derived from the model varies by nearly 3 orders of magnitude between the 6 architectures. It also tracks the order of steering fragility (Spearman's $ρ= 0.90$, exact one-sided permutation $p = 0.014$). The kernel, its spectral complement and the harmonic mass all come from the same paraphrase graph. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/.
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster, ICLR Unifying Concept Representation Learning

AI.title_translation: 将局部上下文粘合成全局意义：Transformer表征的层论分解
AI.tldr: 利用层论和同义句图，无需训练即可将Transformer的局部表征粘合成全局一致的语义，显著提升了可解释性和事实检索性能。
AI.motivation: 以往的可解释性研究未测试表征在同义句改写下是否保持一致，作者旨在通过层论将局部改写上下文粘合成全局意义，解决Transformer表征的一致性问题。
AI.method: 构建同义句图，在其上建立细胞层（cellular sheaf），利用拉普拉斯算子 $L_\mathcal{F}$ 和核空间 $H^0$ 提取内容子空间，并通过谱补集分析因果影响及通过谐波质量评估操控脆弱性。
AI.result: 仅使用20维的核空间在CounterFact事实检索任务中超越了保留全部维度的LEACE方法（平均提升17.1个百分点），约束同义句可再增益6.5个百分点；消融变异最大的坐标会导致5.6到26.5倍的输出变化；谐波质量与模型操控脆弱性高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 基于层论的全局意义分解方法不仅无需训练，而且在事实检索任务中显著优于现有方法，能有效揭示模型的因果影响分布和操控脆弱性。
AI.translation: 先前对可解释性的研究并没有测试表征在同义句改写（paraphrase）下是否保持一致。每一对同义句可以被视为两个激活应该相同的局部见证。从这些局部见证中，我们可以在同义句图上构建一个细胞层（cellular sheaf）。对于一个冻结的模型，在同义句下什么是一致的问题可以通过拉普拉斯算子 $L_\mathcal{F}$ 来回答，且无需训练。我们的核 $H^0$ 给出了一个内容子空间。我们表明，在跨 8 个模型的留出 CounterFact 事实检索任务中，仅用 20 维的核 subspace 在性能上就平均超过了保留全部维度的 LEACE 子空间 $+17.1$ 个百分点。通过将一个事实的所有同义句约束在一起，我们看到了 $+6.5$ 个百分点的额外提升。我们的谱补集展示了因果影响集中的位置。消融在改写时变化最大的坐标（近似于在坐标级别消融谱补集）导致模型输出的变化比消融具有匹配的逐坐标变异性的坐标大 $5.6$ 到 $26.5$ 倍。我们在 9 个参数量从 124M 到 13B 的模型中发现了这一点。通过堆叠层，我们可以创建一个具有 $b_1 = N(L-1)$ 个代数 1-周期的网格。不同模型架构导出的谐波质量在 6 种架构之间相差近 3 个数量级。它还追踪了操控脆弱性的顺序（Spearman 的 $\rho = 0.90$，精确单侧置换检验 $p = 0.014$）。核、其谱补集以及谐波质量都来自同一个同义句图。项目网页：https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于层论（sheaf-theoretic）的方法，通过同义句图和拉普拉斯算子分解Transformer的表征，有效提取了全局一致的内容子空间，解释了模型的因果影响分布与操控脆弱性。
AI.keywords: 层论, Transformer可解释性, 同义句图, 拉普拉斯算子, 代数拓扑
AI.comments: 该论文首次引入代数拓扑和层论（sheaf theory）来分析Transformer模型的表征，利用同义句图（paraphrase graph）和拉普拉斯算子来捕捉全局语义的致密一致性，具有极高的理论创新性和跨学科应用的启发性。

title: CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum
summary: The pass-all-test binary reward has become a standard recipe for training software engineering agents, but its sparsity eliminates difference of partially correct patches. The test pass-rate is a natural alternative. However, we find that it is not a reliable indicator of patch quality. A functionality being tested can be covered by either one challenging test or one hundred trivial tests, where the majority might be already satisfied pass-to-pass tests. We introduce CodeLift, a reinforcement learning method that dynamically calibrates pass-rate rewards, turning the test suite into an adaptive curriculum. At each iteration, CodeLift groups tests that kill the same patches and patches that pass the same tests, then gives more weight to test groups that fewer patch groups pass. This reduces the impact of majority simple tests and focuses more on what is still challenging. Within each rollout, CodeLift applies the same scoring rule to repository snapshots, assigning credit to useful actions even when later ones introduce regressions. Experiments on SWE benchmarks show that CodeLift consistently improves pass@1/2/4/8 over binary and pass-rate baselines. Analyses show that CodeLift provides dense, stable learning signals and unlocks the inherent curriculum in the test suite.

AI.title_translation: CodeLift：你的测试套件暗中就是一个密集的软件工程课程
AI.tldr: CodeLift 将测试套件转化为自适应的强化学习课程，通过动态校准奖励解决了软件工程智能体训练中的奖励稀疏问题，显著提升了补丁生成质量。
AI.motivation: 传统的“全部通过”二元奖励具有稀疏性，无法区分部分正确的补丁；而简单的测试通过率又无法准确反映补丁质量（容易被大量平庸的测试误导）。因此，需要一种能够利用测试套件提供更密集、更有效学习信号的方法。
AI.method: 引入了 CodeLift，一种动态校准通过率奖励的强化学习方法；在每次迭代中，将杀死相同补丁的测试和通过相同测试的补丁进行分组，并赋予较少补丁通过的测试组更多权重；同时在每次 rollout 内部应用相同的评分规则，为即使引入回归的有用操作分配信用。
AI.result: 在 SWE 基准测试上的实验表明，CodeLift 在 pass@1/2/4/8 指标上均 consistently 优于二元奖励和通过率基线，能提供密集、稳定的学习信号。
AI.conclusion: CodeLift 通过将测试套件转化为密集且自适应的课程，有效提升了软件工程智能体的训练效果和性能。
AI.translation: “全部通过”的二元奖励已成为训练软件工程智能体的标准方法，但其稀疏性消除了部分正确补丁之间的差异。测试通过率是一个自然的替代方案。然而，我们发现它并不是补丁质量的可靠指标。被测试的功能可以被一个具有挑战性的测试覆盖，也可以被一百个琐碎的测试覆盖，其中大多数可能已经是通过到通过（pass-to-pass）的测试。我们引入了 CodeLift，这是一种通过动态校准通过率奖励将测试套件转变为自适应课程的强化学习方法。在每次迭代中，CodeLift 将杀死相同补丁的测试和通过相同测试的补丁分组，然后赋予更少补丁通过的测试组更多权重。这减少了多数简单测试的影响，并将重点更多地放在仍然具有挑战性的部分。在每次 rollout 中，CodeLift 将相同的评分规则应用于代码库快照，即使后续操作引入了回归，也能将信用分配给有用的操作。在 SWE 基准测试上的实验表明，与二元和通过率基线相比，CodeLift 在 pass@1/2/4/8 指标上均有一致的提升。分析表明，CodeLift 提供了密集、稳定的学习信号，并释放了测试套件中固有的课程。
AI.summary: CodeLift 是一种新型的强化学习方法，旨在解决软件工程智能体训练中奖励稀疏和测试质量度量不准的问题。它通过动态校准测试通过率奖励、将测试套件转化为自适应课程，并对代码库快照进行精细的信用分配，显著提升了智能体的性能。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 软件工程智能体, 测试套件, 课程学习, 动态奖励校准
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将软件工程中的测试套件转化为自适应课程，通过双向分组和动态奖励校准，解决了传统稀疏二元奖励和简单测试占主导的问题，为强化学习在软件工程智能体中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider
comments: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. v2: revised after external review; adds a correctness judge, a second-model check, database-level intervals and a human label pilot, and corrects the reproducibility statement. Code, frozen scorer (branch prereg), analysis scripts and data: https://github.com/numberz-ai/numberz-ies-tdd-h-calibration (release v2.0)
summary: Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with five samples per question, the designed score separates right from wrong answers weakly (AUROC 0.624) and withholds 35.7% of correct answers. Nearly all of its ranking signal comes from agreement among the samples, and most of it is lost where agreement is combined by a minimum with a checklist that drops to zero on any unsupported claim, including commentary. Before any Spider answer existed we froze and hashed a rule in which agreement with the shown answer is the score, with deterministic vetoes and deterministic and judge-based caps. On Spider dev AUROC rose from 0.566 to 0.725 (+0.159, 95% CI +0.097 to +0.221; database-level CI +0.098 to +0.234), with PASS accuracy 95.7% against a 92.6% base rate. The frozen rule was not the best agreement-based rule on Spider, and the harness and prompts were rebuilt after registration. Added after review: a GPT-5.1 judge asked for P(correct), averaged with agreement, ranked higher in every evaluation (0.837 on Spider), but it grades its own model's answers and its gain shrinks under execution-match labels; one answer per question from a second model family raised agreement's AUROC from 0.749 to 0.800 on Spider, a gain that held under both label definitions. Labels are model-judged; a ten-answer human pilot found no disagreement, and a full audit has not been done.
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. v2: revised after external review; adds a correctness judge, a second-model check, database-level intervals and a human label pilot, and corrects the reproducibility statement. Code, frozen scorer (branch prereg), analysis scripts and data: https://github.com/numberz-ai/numberz-ies-tdd-h-calibration (release v2.0)

AI.title_translation: 受控的置信度分数知道Text-to-SQL答案何时正确吗？对BIRD的探索性研究和对Spider的预注册确认
AI.tldr: 评估了Text-to-SQL系统中置信度分数判断答案正确性的能力，发现现有设计较弱，但基于样本一致性和多模型的方法能显著提高其性能。
AI.motivation: 会话式分析系统只有在答案可信和可解释时才有用。这类生产系统会为每个数据库答案附加一个置信度分数来决定是否显示或警告，但该分数的设计需要被审计以确保其有效性。
AI.method: 本文审计了生产系统中现有置信度分数的设计。首先在BIRD dev数据集上，使用GPT-5.1生成答案（每个问题五次采样），评估设计的分数在区分正确和错误答案上的表现。随后，在Spider dev数据集上，预注册并测试了一个新的规则，该规则将样本间的一致性作为主要分数，并结合确定性否决和基于判断的上限。审阅后补充，进一步探索了结合GPT-5.1评判员的P(correct)分数，以及使用第二个模型家族的一个答案来提高一致性。
AI.result: 在BIRD dev数据集上，设计的分数区分能力弱（AUROC 0.624），并错误地抑制了35.7%的正确答案，其排名信号主要来自样本间的一致性。在Spider dev数据集上，预注册的规则使AUROC从0.566显著提高到0.725（+0.159），PASS准确率达到95.7%（基线92.6%）。结合GPT-5.1评判员的P(correct)分数后，Spider上的AUROC进一步提高到0.837。使用第二个模型家族的一个答案，将Spider上的一致性AUROC从0.749提高到0.800。一项十个答案的人工试点未发现模型判断标签与人类判断的差异。
AI.conclusion: 现有的Text-to-SQL系统置信度分数设计效果不佳。通过将样本间的一致性作为核心指标，并结合评判员分数或多模型方法，可以显著提高置信度分数在判断答案正确性方面的性能。
AI.translation: 会话式分析让人们能够询问分布在多个系统中的记录，并以自然语言获取答案；只有当每个答案都可信且可解释时，它才有用。这类生产系统会为它通过数据库写出的每个答案附加一个置信度分数，并用它来显示答案、带警告显示答案或不显示答案。该分数在设计时设定了权重、上限和阈值。本文审计了这一设计。在BIRD dev的1,534个问题上，由GPT-5.1每个问题生成五个样本回答，设计的分数在区分正确和错误答案方面的能力较弱（AUROC 0.624），并且错误地抑制了35.7%的正确答案。其几乎所有的排名信号都来自样本间的一致性，并且大部分信号在一致性通过最小值与一个清单结合时丢失了，该清单在任何不受支持的主张（包括评论）上都会降至零。在任何Spider答案存在之前，我们冻结并散列了一个规则，其中与所示答案的一致性是分数，并具有确定性否决以及确定性和基于判断的上限。在Spider dev上，AUROC从0.566上升到0.725（+0.159，95% CI +0.097到+0.221；数据库级别CI +0.098到+0.234），PASS准确率达到95.7%，而基线准确率为92.6%。冻结的规则并不是Spider上最好的基于一致性的规则，并且在注册后重新构建了测试工具和提示。审阅后补充：一个GPT-5.1评判员被要求给出P(correct)，并与一致性平均后，在每次评估中排名更高（Spider上为0.837），但它评估的是自己模型的答案，并且其增益在执行匹配标签下会缩小；来自第二个模型家族的每个问题一个答案将Spider上的一致性AUROC从0.749提高到0.800，这一增益在两种标签定义下都保持不变。标签是模型判断的；一项十个答案的人工试点没有发现分歧，但尚未进行全面审计。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了Text-to-SQL系统中置信度分数判断答案正确性的能力。研究发现，现有设计的分数在BIRD数据集上表现不佳（AUROC 0.624），主要依赖样本间一致性。通过在Spider数据集上引入基于样本一致性的新规则，AUROC显著提升至0.725，PASS准确率达95.7%。进一步结合模型评判员或多模型采样，置信度分数的性能可进一步提高，表明改进置信度分数设计对于提升会话式分析系统可靠性至关重要。
AI.keywords: Text-to-SQL, 置信度分数, 会话式分析, 样本一致性, 模型评判员
AI.comments: 创新点：系统性地审计了Text-to-SQL系统中置信度分数的设计，并提出了通过样本一致性、模型评判员和多模型融合来显著提升其性能的方法。强调了在AI生成内容中建立信任机制的重要性。重要性：解决了会话式分析系统中一个关键的信任问题，即如何可靠地判断AI生成答案的正确性，这对于实际部署至关重要。局限性：初始设计的分数表现较弱。模型判断的标签尚未经过全面的人工审计，尽管小规模试点未发现分歧。GPT-5.1评判员评估自身模型答案的增益在特定条件下会缩小。

title: I3L: Iterative Interactive Imitation Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
summary: Policies trained offline from teleoperated demonstrations can degrade outside their training distribution. This gap is particularly acute in long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation, where long horizons amplify compounding errors and coordinated arm, torso, and base motion makes exhaustive demonstration coverage impractical. We introduce I3L, an integrated hardware and learning system that combines whole-body correction with iterative policy refinement to address this last-mile reliability gap. Its low-cost, open-source JoyLo+ interface uses policy-tracking leader arms and touch-triggered takeover to enable coordinated corrections across the body parts, while iterative deployment and retraining allow operators to target failures of the updated policy. We evaluate I3L across three robot embodiments and eight simulated and real-world tasks, including four long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation experiments show that four-round HG-DAgger achieves the highest final success on both tasks. Under this protocol, I3L improves autonomous success over the base policies by an average of 68.3 percentage points and achieves at least 90% success on every task, outperforming demonstration-only training by 35.6 percentage points on average with the same number of training trajectories. Averaged across tasks, takeover duration per episode decreases by 72% over four rounds. Together, these results show that I3L helps close the last-mile gap between offline training and reliable deployment and provides practical insights into collecting and using corrections for long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation. Videos, visualizations, and appendix are at https://i-3l.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: I3L：用于全身移动操作的迭代交互式模仿学习
AI.tldr: I3L通过结合全身人工修正与迭代策略训练，显著提升了机器人长程全身移动操作的可靠性和自主成功率。
AI.motivation: 离线示教训练的策略在训练分布之外容易退化，这在长程全身移动操作中尤为严重，因为长期的累积误差会放大这一问题，且手臂、躯干和底盘的协调运动使得穷举式示教变得不切实际。
AI.method: 引入I3L硬件与学习系统，结合低成本、开源的JoyLo+接口（支持策略跟踪的主动臂和触控触发接管）进行全身协调修正，并采用迭代部署与重新训练（HG-DAgger协议）来靶向修正更新后策略的失败案例。
AI.result: 在控制仿真和真实世界实验中，四轮HG-DAgger协议使策略的自主成功率平均提高了68.3个百分点，每个任务的成功率至少达到90%，在相同示教轨迹数下比纯示教训练平均高出35.6个百分点，且接管持续时间在四轮后平均减少了72%。
AI.conclusion: I3L通过迭代交互式模仿学习与全身修正机制，有效解决了全身移动操作中的累积误差和最后一英里可靠性问题，在多个仿真和真实任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 离线从遥操作示教中训练出的策略在训练分布之外会发生性能退化。这种差距在长周期全身移动操作中尤为严重，因为长周期会放大复合误差，且手臂、躯干和底盘的协调运动使得穷举式的示教覆盖变得不切实际。我们引入了I3L，一个结合了全身修正与迭代策略优化的集成硬件与学习系统，以解决这最后一英里的可靠性鸿沟。其低成本、开源的JoyLo+接口利用策略跟踪的主动臂和触摸触发的接管机制，实现了跨身体各部位的协同修正，同时迭代部署和重新训练使操作员能够针对更新后策略的失败点进行修正。我们在三种机器人形态和八项模拟及现实任务（包括四项长周期全身移动操作任务）上评估了I3L。受控仿真实验表明，四轮HG-DAgger在两项任务中均取得了最高的最终成功率。在该协议下，I3L将基础策略的自主成功率平均提高了68.3个百分点，每项任务的成功率至少达到90%，在相同训练轨迹数下比仅靠示教训练平均高出35.6个百分点。在各项任务中平均，每集的接管持续时间在四轮中减少了72%。这些结果共同表明，I3L有助于弥合离线训练与可靠部署之间的最后一英里鸿沟，并为收集和使用长周期全身移动操作的修正提供了实用的见解。视频、可视化和附录可在 https://i-3l.github.io/ 查看。
AI.summary: 本文提出了I3L（迭代交互式模仿学习）系统，通过集成全身人工修正机制与迭代策略精炼流程，有效解决了长程全身移动操作中的分布偏移和累积误差问题，显著提升了机器人的自主操作成功率和可靠性。
AI.keywords: 模仿学习, 全身移动操作, 交互式修正, 策略精炼, 机器人学
AI.comments: 该论文针对全身移动操作中长程任务的分布偏移和累积误差问题，提出了一种结合全身人工修正与迭代策略精炼的系统（I3L）。创新之处在于低成本的JoyLo+接口支持全身协调修正，且通过迭代训练显著提升了策略的可靠性，消除了“最后一英里”的可靠性鸿沟。

title: PixelMoE: Scaling Pixel-Space Diffusion with LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. However, scaling pixel-space models has predominantly followed dense strategies, tightly coupling model capacity with active computation. In this work, we show that standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can be effectively transferred to pixel-space diffusion. Building on this finding, we introduce PixelMoE, a pixel-space generative framework that sparsely scales model capacity with standard LLM-style MoE, without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. On class-conditional ImageNet-1K, PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256x256 and 1.53 at 512x512 without representation alignment or perceptual losses, comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/KlingAIResearch/PixelMoE and https://huggingface.co/KlingTeam/PixelMoE, respectively.

AI.title_translation: PixelMoE：结合LLM风格混合专家的像素空间扩散模型扩展
AI.tldr: PixelMoE通过引入LLM风格的MoE架构和分层流匹配技术，实现了像素空间扩散模型的高效稀疏扩展，在ImageNet上取得了领先的生成性能。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型通常采用稠密计算策略，将模型容量与实际计算紧密耦合。为了实现更高效的扩展，本文旨在探究是否可以将大语言模型（LLM）风格的混合专家（MoE）架构有效地转移并应用于像素空间扩散模型中。
AI.method: 引入了PixelMoE框架，结合了标准Token-Choice (TC) 路由与细粒度专家、用于捕获通用表示的共享专家、基于偏差的负载均衡策略，以及用于沿去噪轨迹改变空间分辨率的像素空间分层流匹配技术。
AI.result: 在同等有效参数量下，PixelMoE在多个模型尺度上持续优于稠密模型。在ImageNet-1K数据集上，无需表征对齐或感知损失，256x256和512x512分辨率下的FID分别达到了1.47和1.53。
AI.conclusion: PixelMoE成功将LLM风格的MoE架构与像素空间扩散模型相结合，通过稀疏容量扩展和分层流匹配技术，在ImageNet-1K上取得了优异的生成效果，证明了像素空间稀疏扩展的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 像素空间扩散模型通过直接对原始图像进行建模而不依赖于学习到的分词器，为潜在空间扩散模型提供了一个引人注目的替代方案。然而，像素空间模型的扩展主要采用稠密策略，将模型容量与主动计算紧密耦合。在这项工作中，我们表明标准的LLM风格混合专家（MoE）架构可以有效地转移到像素空间扩散中。基于这一发现，我们介绍了PixelMoE，一个像素空间生成框架，它利用标准的LLM风格MoE稀疏扩展模型容量，无需扩散特定的路由机制或辅助路由目标。具体来说，PixelMoE将标准的Token-Choice (TC) 路由与输入自适应稀疏计算的细粒度路由专家、用于捕获通用表示的共享专家以及基于偏差的负载均衡策略相结合。为了补充稀疏容量扩展，PixelMoE进一步引入了像素空间分层流匹配，它沿去噪轨迹改变空间分辨率，从全局结构形成到细粒度细节精炼。在可比的主动参数量下，PixelMoE在各个模型尺度上始终优于其稠密对应模型，证明了像素空间中有效的稀疏容量扩展。在类条件ImageNet-1K上，PixelMoE在无需表征对齐或感知损失的情况下，在256x256和512x512分辨率下分别获得了1.47和1.53的FID分数，与领先的像素空间和潜在空间生成模型相比表现优异。代码和预训练模型分别可在https://github.com/KlingAIResearch/PixelMoE和https://huggingface.co/KlingTeam/PixelMoE获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PixelMoE，这是一种将LLM风格的混合专家（MoE）架构引入像素空间扩散模型的生成框架，通过稀疏扩展模型容量和像素空间分层流匹配技术，实现了高效且高质量的图像生成。
AI.keywords: Pixel-space diffusion, Mixture-of-Experts, Hierarchical Flow Matching, Sparse scaling, Generative models
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型中的混合专家（MoE）架构引入到像素空间扩散模型中，通过稀疏扩展模型容量在不显著增加计算开销的同时提升了生成质量，为像素空间生成模型的发展提供了新思路。

title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
comments: Updated project website and code repository links; research content unchanged. Project: https://tacclaw-infinity.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/tacclaw-infinity/TacClaw-Infinity
summary: Large-scale robot learning increasingly relies on diverse human demonstrations, yet tactile manipulation data remain difficult to scale, and existing multimodal datasets often lack consistent quality control and structured supervision. We present TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale structured Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) dataset for contact-rich manipulation, collected with TacClaw, a tactile-enabled UMI-style handheld interface that records synchronized visual observations, fingertip tactile signals, and end-effector trajectories without requiring a target robot during data collection. TacClaw-Infinity is built through a distributed worldwide collection across homes, laboratories, industrial workplaces, retail stores, and outdoor environments including tasks contributed by academic and industrial collaborators. Together, these efforts yield over 10,000 hours, 1 million episodes, and 1 billion frames spanning more than 1,000 task types. We develop a scalable pipeline for trajectory reconstruction, multimodal quality control, embodiment-aware filtering, and structured annotation, covering contact-centric segmentation, subtask description, and spatial grounding. We validate TacClaw-Infinity at both the data and model levels: At the data level, we assess the collection interface, the action-space compatibility of the curated demonstrations, and the structured annotations, while for the model level, we demonstrate cross-embodiment transfer across three heterogeneous robots without robot-specific demonstrations.

AI.title_translation: TacClaw-Infinity：用于灵巧操作的大规模视觉-触觉-语言-动作数据集
AI.tldr: 本文推出了超大规模的视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集TacClaw-Infinity，用于解决机器人触觉操作数据匮乏和难以规模化的难题，并实现了出色的跨机器人泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人学习高度依赖人类示范，但触觉操作数据难以规模化，且现有的多模态数据集往往缺乏一致的质量控制和结构化监督。
AI.method: 开发了TacClaw触觉手持采集接口以录制同步数据，并构建了包含轨迹重建、多模态质控、具身感知过滤和结构化标注的可扩展数据处理流水线。
AI.result: 收集了超过10,000小时、100万个片段、10亿帧、涵盖1000多种任务的数据集，并在数据和模型层面进行了验证，成功实现了在无需特定机器人示范情况下的跨异构机器人迁移。
AI.conclusion: TacClaw-Infinity通过大规模的分布式采集和结构化处理，有效填补了高质量触觉操作数据集的空白，并验证了其在跨机器人迁移中的有效性。
AI.translation: 大规模机器人学习日益依赖于多样化的示范，但触觉操作数据仍然难以规模化，现有的多模态数据集往往缺乏一致的质量控制和结构化监督。我们提出了TacClaw-Infinity，这是一个用于富含接触操作的大规模结构化视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集。该数据集使用TacClaw采集，TacClaw是一个具备触觉功能的UMI风格手持接口，能够在数据采集过程中无需目标机器人的情况下，记录同步的视觉观测、指尖触觉信号和末端执行器轨迹。TacClaw-Infinity是通过在全球范围内的家庭、实验室、工业工作场所、零售店和户外环境中进行分布式采集构建的，其中包括学术界和工业界合作者贡献的任务。这些努力共同产生了超过10,000小时、100万个片段和10亿帧的数据，跨越了1000多种任务类型。我们开发了一个可扩展的流水线，用于轨迹重建、多模态质量控制、具身感知过滤和结构化标注，涵盖以接触为中心的分割、子任务描述和空间 grounding（空间基础/定位）。我们在数据和模型两个层面上对TacClaw-Infinity进行了验证：在数据层面，我们评估了采集接口、策划示范的动作空间兼容性以及结构化标注；在模型层面，我们展示了在没有特定机器人示范的情况下，跨三个异构机器人的跨具身迁移。
AI.summary: 本文推出了TacClaw-Infinity，这是一个大规模的结构化视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集，用于富含接触的具巧手操作。该数据集通过TacClaw手持接口在多场景下分布式收集，包含超100万个片段，并经过严格的质控和结构化标注，有效支持了多模态机器人学习和跨具身迁移。
AI.keywords: 触觉操作, 数据集, 视觉-触觉-语言-动作, 机器人学习
AI.comments: 本文提出了目前规模最大的视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集TacClaw-Infinity，创新性地结合了触觉传感与手持式采集接口，解决了触觉操作数据难以规模化的痛点，并展示了出色的跨具身泛化能力。

title: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. This paper proposes PriorityFEC, a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that jointly exploits model-side KV importance and transport-side reliability. PriorityFEC first constructs a utility-aware source stream by placing high-utility KV blocks at earlier transmission positions. It then protects the ordered stream using a feedback-adaptive Streaming Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) mechanism, which schedules repair packets according to receiver feedback before the TTFT deadline. We implement PriorityFEC on a distributed edge LLM serving prototype and evaluate it with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across multiple datasets. Results show that PriorityFEC achieves superior task quality over the compared transport schemes, with its advantages becoming particularly pronounced under stringent deadline constraints. These results demonstrate the importance of jointly optimizing KV-cache utility and deadline-aware transport reliability when reusable LLM state must be handed off across unreliable edge networks.

AI.title_translation: PriorityFEC：边缘多智能体系统中面向KV缓存切换的截止时间感知流式前向纠错
AI.tldr: PriorityFEC通过联合优化KV缓存重要度排序与反馈自适应流式FEC，在边缘弱网和严苛截止时限下实现了高效、高质的跨智能体KV缓存移交。
AI.motivation: 在边缘多智能体协作中，跨智能体共享上下文需重复预填充从而造成大量冗余计算；而跨网络传输KV缓存虽可避免重算，但在不可靠边缘链路及严苛的TTFT截止时间约束下难以完成全量传输，亟需在有限网络预算内优先保障高价值KV信息的交付。
AI.method: 提出了PriorityFEC机制：1）构建效用感知源数据流，将模型端高重要性的KV块安排在靠前位置优先传输；2）采用反馈自适应的流式前向纠错（Streaming FEC）技术，在TTFT截止时间前根据接收端反馈动态调度修复数据包以保障传输可靠性。
AI.result: 在分布式边缘大模型原型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）与多数据集上的测试表明，PriorityFEC的任务质量显著优于对比传输方案，且在严苛的截止时间约束下性能优势更为突出。
AI.conclusion: 在不可靠边缘网络中进行可复用LLM状态跨智能体移交时，联合优化KV缓存效用与截止时间感知的传输可靠性至关重要。
AI.translation: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统日益部署于边缘端，以支持需要多智能体协作与信息交换的复杂任务。然而，当任务上下文在智能体之间传递时，已被上游智能体处理过的共享上下文通常需要重新进行预填充，导致大量的冗余计算。复用已预填充的键值（KV）缓存可以避免此类重复计算，但这需要先通过网络传输可复用的KV状态，接收端智能体才能开始生成。在严格的首字生成时间（TTFT）截止期限和不可靠边缘链路的约束下，交付完整的KV缓存往往不可行，因此必须在有限的传输预算内优先传输并保护最有价值的KV信息。本文提出了PriorityFEC，一种兼顾模型端KV重要性与传输端可靠性的效用感知KV缓存移交方案。PriorityFEC首先构建效用感知的数据源流，将高价值KV块置于靠前的传输位置；随后采用反馈自适应的流式前向纠错（FEC）机制保护该有序数据流，在TTFT截止期限前根据接收端反馈调度修复数据包。我们在分布式边缘LLM服务原型上实现了PriorityFEC，并在多个数据集上使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行了评估。结果表明，PriorityFEC在任务质量上显著优于对比传输方案，尤其在严苛的截止期限约束下优势更为明显。这些结果证明了在不可靠边缘网络中移交可复用LLM状态时，联合优化KV缓存效用与截止时间感知传输可靠性的重要性。
AI.summary: 针对边缘多智能体系统中KV缓存跨网络传输受限于弱网与严苛TTFT时限的问题，本文提出了PriorityFEC方案。该方案结合模型端KV重要度与网络端流式FEC，优先传输高价值KV块并自适应调度修复包，在严苛时延下有效避免了冗余预填充计算并保证了生成质量。
AI.keywords: KV缓存 (KV-Cache), 多智能体系统 (Multi-Agent Systems), 边缘计算 (Edge Computing), 前向纠错 (FEC), 首字生成时间 (TTFT)
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于打破了传统的模型推理与网络传输割裂的设计，实现了语义级KV缓存重要性与网络层流式FEC的跨层联合优化。在边缘设备算力与网络受限的双重瓶颈下，以部分高价值KV缓存的及时交付保障推理任务质量，切中了边缘多智能体协作的核心痛点。局限性在于摘要未展开说明KV缓存重要度评估的计算开销，以及反馈自适应机制对高动态弱网环境的敏捷度。

title: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed as conversational agents are increasingly expected to follow procedural logic. While factual hallucination has received extensive attention, a different failure mode has been overlooked: procedural hallucination, in which an agent produces individually fluent and factually plausible utterances while deviating from the intended conversational process. We introduce DialFork, the first benchmark to measure this failure mode on raw dialogue text. DialFork is built by forking conformant dialogues at controlled turn positions and injecting one of four hallucination types, yielding 36,278 dialogues across 24 tasks in 12 domains; 30 human annotators validate the construction. We define three evaluation tasks that characterize procedural deviation at three granularities: how far a set of dialogues deviates from conformant ones (monitoring deployed agents), how far a single dialogue does (procedural retrieval), and at which turn a dialogue first goes off-track (real-time guardrails). For the first two, we propose dialog-flow-aware metrics, FlowKL and FlowScore, that compare dialogues by how they unfold rather than their content. At the dialogue level, FlowScore significantly outperforms all baselines across seven encoders, showing that semantic similarity is no substitute for procedural similarity. We release DialFork under open licenses at https://github.com/idiap/dialfork, hoping the community will measure conversational process alongside content.

AI.title_translation: DialFork：超越事实性评估对话代理中的程序性幻觉
AI.tldr: 引入DialFork基准，用于衡量对话代理中的程序性幻觉，并提出新指标FlowKL和FlowScore，发现程序相似性比语义相似性更重要。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注事实性幻觉，但忽视了对话代理在遵循程序逻辑时出现的“程序性幻觉”这一失败模式，即代理在对话过程中偏离预期流程。
AI.method: 引入DialFork，一个用于衡量程序性幻觉的基准。它通过在受控轮次位置分叉符合规范的对话并注入四种幻觉类型之一来构建，生成了36,278个对话。定义了三个评估任务来表征程序偏差，并提出了对话流感知指标FlowKL和FlowScore来比较对话的展开方式而非其内容。
AI.result: 在对话级别上，FlowScore在七个编码器上显著优于所有基线，表明语义相似性不能替代程序相似性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究引入了DialFork基准和新的评估指标（FlowKL、FlowScore）来衡量对话代理中的程序性幻觉，强调了在评估对话代理时，除了内容，对话过程的重要性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）作为对话代理，越来越被期望遵循程序逻辑。尽管事实性幻觉已受到广泛关注，但另一种失败模式——程序性幻觉却被忽视了。程序性幻觉是指代理在偏离预期的对话过程的同时，产生单独流畅且事实可信的表达。我们引入了DialFork，这是第一个在原始对话文本上衡量这种失败模式的基准。DialFork通过在受控的轮次位置分叉符合规范的对话并注入四种幻觉类型之一来构建，产生了跨12个领域的24项任务中的36,278个对话；30名人类标注员验证了其构建。我们定义了三个评估任务，以三个粒度表征程序偏差：一组对话与符合规范的对话偏离了多远（监控已部署的代理），单个对话偏话偏离了多远（程序性检索），以及对话在哪一轮首次偏离轨道（实时护栏）。对于前两项，我们提出了对话流感知指标FlowKL和FlowScore，它们通过对话的展开方式而非其内容来比较对话。在对话级别上，FlowScore在七个编码器上显著优于所有基线，表明语义相似性不能替代程序相似性。我们以开放许可发布DialFork，网址为https://github.com/idiap/dialfork，希望社区能同时衡量对话过程和内容。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型语言模型作为对话代理时，在遵循程序逻辑方面存在的“程序性幻觉”问题，即代理在对话中偏离预期流程但仍生成流畅合理回复的现象，提出了DialFork基准。DialFork通过构造包含程序性幻觉的对话数据集，并定义了三种评估任务。研究还引入了对话流感知指标FlowKL和FlowScore，用于比较对话的展开方式。实验结果表明，FlowScore在评估程序偏差方面显著优于现有基线，强调了程序相似性在对话评估中的不可替代性。
AI.keywords: 程序性幻觉, 对话代理, 基准测试, FlowKL, FlowScore
AI.comments: 这篇论文创新性地提出了“程序性幻觉”这一重要的LLM失败模式，填补了现有研究主要关注事实性幻觉的空白。通过构建大规模的DialFork基准和引入对话流感知指标FlowKL和FlowScore，为评估和改进对话代理的程序逻辑能力提供了有力的工具和方法。其发现语义相似性无法替代程序相似性，对未来对话系统评估具有重要指导意义。

title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine
summary: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.

AI.title_translation: Terminal-RSI：通过递归自我重写与策略精炼的递归自我提升终端智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出Terminal-RSI，通过递归自我重写和策略精炼交替进行，显著提升了终端智能体解决复杂任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 如何将验证器的结果转化为有用的策略更新，以及如何将部分进展转化为完整的任务解决，是终端智能体面临的关键挑战。为此，本文旨在开发一种递归自我提升的终端智能体方法。
AI.method: 提出Terminal-RSI方法，交替进行已验证轨迹的递归自我重写（RSR）和继承批评模型的递归策略精炼（RPR）；引入TB-GAE、FDR、SPR等技术，并通过五阶段序列逐步提升模型。
AI.result: Terminal-RSI-27B模型在Terminal-Bench 4.0上达到19.84%，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到86.52%，在Terminal-Bench 3.0上达到16.95%，在Terminal-Bench Hard上达到79.00%；在LHTB和SWR100上也取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: Terminal-RSI通过递归耦合验证后的轨迹重写与继承批评模型的策略精炼，成功将智能体从局部修复引导至严格的终端验证，显著提升了模型性能。
AI.translation: 将验证器结果转化为有用的策略更新以及将部分进展转化为完整的任务解决对于终端智能体至关重要。我们提出了Terminal-RSI，它交替进行已验证轨迹的递归自我重写（RSR）和继承批评模型的递归策略精炼（RPR）。我们提出了轮次边界跳过观察GAE（TB-GAE），在应用跨交互轮次衰减的同时保留token特定的基线；家族密集奖励（FDR）校准了跨任务家族的语义进展；成功优先奖励（SPR）将严格成功与有界部分信用区分开来。预热批评模型、递归批评交接和特定阶段的学习率协调了这两个精炼阶段。从Qwen3.8-27B基础模型通过RSR-1、RPR-1、RSR-2和RPR-2的五阶段序列产生了Terminal-RSI-27B：在Terminal-Bench 4.0上达到19.84%，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到86.52%，在Terminal-Bench 3.0上达到16.95%，在Terminal-Bench Hard上达到79.00%。在LHTB上，过程奖励从0.21上升到0.37，严格完成率从0/46上升到5/46；SWR100成功率翻倍，从3.00%增加到6.00%。通过递归地将已验证的轨迹重写与继承批评模型的策略精炼相耦合，每个保留的阶段都巩固了发现的行为，并逐步将智能体从局部的部分修复推进到严格的终端验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Terminal-RSI，一种通过递归自我重写和策略精炼实现递归自我提升的终端智能体。该方法交替应用已验证轨迹的递归自我重写（RSR）和继承批评模型的递归策略精炼（RPR），并结合多种奖励和优势估计机制，显著提升了智能体在多个基准测试上的任务解决能力。
AI.keywords: Terminal Agents, Recursive Self-Improvement, Self-Rewrite, Policy-Refine, Terminal-Bench
AI.comments: Terminal-RSI通过递归自我重写和策略精炼，有效地提升了终端智能体在复杂环境中的任务完成率，创新性地结合了轨迹级重写与基于批评模型的策略优化。

title: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
summary: Streaming data analytics helps businesses identify opportunities and spot risks in a timely fashion. As large language model (LLM) usage grows, people are exploring incorporating agents or LLMs in streaming data pipelines to help find patterns in datasets without supervision or interpret natural languages for content moderation. However, most streaming systems are currently optimized for data movement and perform poorly on GPU intensive workloads such as performing inference with LLMs. We introduce a system on Google Cloud Dataflow designed to tackle hybrid streaming machine learning workloads with co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching. This increases throughput 1.5x to 2x for streaming pipelines using LLMs while maintaining similar latency with up to 75% peak resource savings and 84% lower peak tail latency compared with existing streaming data processing systems.

title: Self-Building Labs
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still requires extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate SBL's end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, SBL makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable. Project website: https://self-building-labs.github.io/

title: PACE: Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs
summary: Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes, and (ii) early-layer visual tokens are indiscriminable and uniformly redundant. Guided by these findings, we propose PACE (Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs), the first visual token compression framework tailored for native MLLMs with Multimodal-RoPE. Leveraging dimensional decoupling of positional encoding, PACE decomposes attention into two orthogonal spatial saliency estimates along height and width, gated by a positional attention signal, yielding direction-aware importance with negligible overhead. It further casts token budget allocation as Pareto optimization over performance preservation, inference efficiency, and spatial coverage, jointly identifying optimal compression depths and retention ratios. Experiments show PACE maintains near-lossless performance at only 25%-50% visual token retention, even improving several benchmarks, while delivering over 2x FLOPs reduction.

title: Transport What Shares the Conduction Pathway: Normal-Anchored SPD Geometric Transport for Source-Free Patient Adaptation of Holter and Patch ECG
comments: 51 pages (25-page main text and 26-page Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 4 tables
summary: Continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) streams are dominated by normal beats (87.9-98.6% of the label-free adaptation prefix in our four databases), and patient-specific waveform distortion is not shared by every beat class; under this combination, source-free and test-time adaptation methods that assume class-balanced target batches collapse. We propose Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT, GA_NS), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal anchors in the first 5 min of each recording and applies it only to the normal and supraventricular prototypes, keeping the ventricular and fusion prototypes fixed. Decision rules were set on MIT-BIH and the rate-invariant RR head was adopted after the development databases (INCART, SVDB) had been opened; the frozen model was then evaluated once under a pre-specified locked evaluation protocol on the held-out Icentia11k chest-patch cohort. In 493 patients (973 recordings, 3,615,388 evaluated beats), NAGT raised the arrhythmia macro-F1 J from 34.5% to 48.7% ($ΔJ$ = +14.1 [+8.6, +19.3] pp; non-AF 43.9% to 59.8%) and outperformed all five Holm-adjusted comparators, including AdaBN, Tent and T3A. In post hoc analyses of the frozen outputs, ventricular false alarms fell by 68% (41.1 to 13.2 per hour) and 98.3% of normal beats stayed outside the alarm classes. Adaptation takes 5.8 ms per record without back-propagation.
